products.description: Maps marketplace seller-submitted product listings to the platform's canonical catalog items, enabling multi-seller catalog deduplication and buy box competition. Captures seller reference, seller SKU code, seller-provided product title, mapped canonical catalog item reference, mapping status (mapped, pending_review, rejected, unmapped), confidence score, mapping method (exact_barcode_match, fuzzy_title_match, image_match, manual_review), reviewer reference, rejection reason, and mapping timestamp. Critical for marketplace GMV attribution, catalog quality governance, preventing duplicate listings, and ensuring sellers compete on the same canonical product page.

attributes.name: seller_sku_mapping_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Seller Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) Mapping Identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the seller SKU mapping record. Primary key for the seller SKU mapping entity.

attributes.name: agent_id
attributes.description: Reference to the catalog operations agent or system user who performed manual review or approval of this mapping. Null for automated mappings that did not require human intervention.
attributes.references: Product Information Management System - User Management

attributes.name: canonical_catalog_item_id
attributes.description: Reference to the platform's authoritative catalog item (ASIN-equivalent) that this seller SKU has been mapped to. Enables buy box competition and GMV attribution. Null when mapping status is unmapped or pending_review.
attributes.references: Product Information Management System - Canonical Catalog

attributes.name: seller_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketplace seller who submitted this product listing. Links to the seller master record in the Seller Management Portal.

attributes.name: auto_remap_enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this seller SKU is eligible for automatic remapping if the canonical catalog item is merged or deprecated. False requires manual seller intervention for catalog changes.
attributes.references: Product Information Management System - Catalog Maintenance Standards

attributes.name: canonical_brand_name
attributes.description: The authoritative brand name from the platform's canonical catalog for the mapped item. Used to detect brand mismatches and potential intellectual property violations.
attributes.references: Product Information Management System - Brand Master Data

attributes.name: canonical_category_path
attributes.description: The authoritative product category hierarchy path from the platform's canonical taxonomy that the mapped catalog item belongs to. Used for category compliance validation.
attributes.references: Product Information Management System - Canonical Taxonomy

attributes.name: compliance_check_status
attributes.description: Status of regulatory and policy compliance validation for this seller SKU mapping. Includes CPSC product safety, intellectual property, restricted product category, and marketplace policy checks.
attributes.references: Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) - Product Safety Standards

attributes.name: compliance_failure_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of compliance check failures including specific regulations violated, policy breaches, or safety concerns. Null when compliance_check_status is passed or not_required.
attributes.references: Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) - Compliance Reporting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this seller SKU mapping record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: gmv_attribution_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) Attribution Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether sales of this seller SKU are included in GMV reporting and seller commission calculations. False may indicate mapping is pending or rejected.

attributes.name: image_match_score
attributes.description: Computer vision similarity score (0.0000 to 1.0000) comparing seller-provided product images to canonical catalog item images. Used when image_match mapping method is applied.
attributes.references: Search and Recommendation Engine - Image Recognition Standards

attributes.name: is_buy_box_eligible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this mapped seller SKU is eligible to compete for the buy box on the product detail page. False may indicate seller performance issues, policy violations, or pricing problems.
attributes.references: Seller Management Portal - Buy Box Eligibility Rules

attributes.name: is_duplicate_listing
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this seller SKU was identified as a duplicate of an existing seller listing for the same canonical catalog item. True indicates the seller is attempting to create multiple listings for the same product.
attributes.references: Product Information Management System - Deduplication Rules

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this seller SKU mapping record was most recently updated. Tracks any changes to mapping status, canonical item reference, or metadata.

attributes.name: last_review_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time of the most recent manual or automated review of this mapping. Used for audit trails and re-review scheduling.

attributes.name: mapping_confidence_score
attributes.description: Algorithmic confidence score (0.0000 to 1.0000) indicating the certainty of the mapping between seller SKU and canonical catalog item. Higher scores indicate stronger match signals. Used to prioritize manual review queue.
attributes.references: Search and Recommendation Engine - Matching Algorithm Standards

attributes.name: mapping_method
attributes.description: The technique or algorithm used to establish the mapping between seller SKU and canonical catalog item. Exact_barcode_match is highest confidence; manual_review indicates human intervention was required.
attributes.references: Product Information Management System - Mapping Algorithm Documentation

attributes.name: mapping_source_system
attributes.description: The system or integration channel through which the seller submitted this SKU for mapping (e.g., Seller Portal UI, API, EDI, Bulk Upload). Used for channel performance analysis.

attributes.name: mapping_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the seller SKU mapping. Mapped indicates successful linkage to canonical catalog; pending_review requires manual intervention; rejected indicates failed mapping with reason; unmapped indicates no match found.
attributes.references: Product Information Management System - Mapping Workflow

attributes.name: mapping_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the seller SKU was successfully mapped to the canonical catalog item. Represents the business event time when the mapping became effective for buy box competition.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Processing priority assigned to this mapping request based on seller tier, product category importance, or business rules. High priority mappings are reviewed first in the manual review queue.
attributes.references: Seller Management Portal - Service Level Agreement (SLA) Standards

attributes.name: rejection_notes
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by the reviewer detailing the specific reasons for rejection and guidance for seller remediation. Null when mapping status is not rejected.
attributes.references: Product Information Management System - Review Process Standards

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Categorical reason code explaining why a seller SKU mapping was rejected. Used for seller feedback, catalog quality governance, and compliance reporting. Null when mapping status is not rejected. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: duplicate_listing|prohibited_product|insufficient_product_data|barcode_mismatch|category_violation|quality_standards_failure|intellectual_property_violation|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Product Information Management System - Catalog Quality Standards

attributes.name: seller_brand_name
attributes.description: The brand name as declared by the seller in their listing submission. Used for brand validation and intellectual property compliance checks during mapping.
attributes.references: Product Information Management System - Brand Registry

attributes.name: seller_category_path
attributes.description: The product category hierarchy path as declared by the seller in their listing submission. Used for category validation and mismatch detection during mapping.
attributes.references: Product Information Management System - Taxonomy Standards

attributes.name: seller_ean_code
attributes.description: The 13-digit EAN barcode provided by the seller for exact barcode matching to canonical catalog items. Used in international marketplace operations.

attributes.name: seller_product_title
attributes.description: The product title or name as provided by the seller in their listing submission. Used for fuzzy matching and manual review processes.
attributes.references: Product Information Management System - Product Naming Standards

attributes.name: seller_sku_code
attributes.description: The seller's own SKU or product identifier code used in their internal catalog system. This is the seller-provided reference that must be mapped to the platform's canonical catalog.
attributes.references: Product Information Management System - SKU Standards

attributes.name: seller_upc_code
attributes.description: The 12-digit UPC barcode provided by the seller for exact barcode matching to canonical catalog items. Critical for automated mapping via exact_barcode_match method.

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the seller originally submitted this SKU listing for mapping. Used to calculate mapping SLA performance and queue aging metrics.

attributes.name: title_match_score
attributes.description: Natural language processing similarity score (0.0000 to 1.0000) comparing seller product title to canonical catalog item title. Used when fuzzy_title_match mapping method is applied.
attributes.references: Search and Recommendation Engine - Text Matching Standards

products.name: brand_seller_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the contractual agreement between a brand and a seller profile. It captures exclusivity flags, commission rates, and the start and end dates of the agreement for each brand‑seller pairing.. Existence Justification: A brand can be sold by multiple seller profiles and a seller profile can sell multiple brands. The marketplace manages a contract for each brand‑seller pairing that records exclusivity, commission rates, and agreement start/end dates. This relationship is actively created, updated, and terminated by business users.

attributes.name: brand_seller_agreement_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Brand Seller Agreement - Brand Seller Agreement Id
attributes.description: Primary key for the brand_seller_agreement association

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the brand master record

attributes.name: seller_profile_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Brand Seller Agreement - Seller Profile Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the seller profile master record

attributes.name: agreement_end_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Brand Seller Agreement - Agreement End Date
attributes.description: Date when the brand‑seller agreement expires or is terminated

attributes.name: agreement_start_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Brand Seller Agreement - Agreement Start Date
attributes.description: Date when the brand‑seller agreement becomes effective

attributes.name: commission_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of each sale retained by the marketplace from this brand‑seller agreement

attributes.name: exclusive_agreement_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Brand Seller Agreement - Exclusive Agreement Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement grants exclusive selling rights to the seller for the brand

products.name: sku_asset_assignment
products.description: Association product representing the assignment of digital assets to SKUs. It captures which assets are primary for a SKU, licensing information, SEO score, and compliance flags. Each record links one SKU to one digital asset with attributes that belong only to the relationship.. Existence Justification: Each SKU can be linked to multiple digital assets (images, videos, banners) and each digital asset can be used by multiple SKUs. The association is actively managed in a product‑digital‑asset table that stores attributes such as primary flag, licensing details, SEO score, and brand compliance. This operational entity is therefore a true many‑to‑many relationship.

attributes.name: sku_asset_assignment_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sku Asset Assignment - Sku Asset Assignment Id
attributes.description: Primary key for the sku_asset_assignment association

attributes.name: content_digital_asset_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sku Asset Assignment - Digital Asset Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to Digital Asset

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to SKU

attributes.name: brand_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates if the asset complies with brand guidelines for the SKU

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Indicates if this asset is the primary representation for the SKU

attributes.name: license_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the asset license

attributes.name: license_type
attributes.description: Type of license governing asset usage

attributes.name: rights_holder
attributes.description: Entity that holds the rights for the asset

attributes.name: seo_score
attributes.description: SEO relevance score for the asset when used on the SKU page

attributes.name: usage_rights_notes
attributes.description: Free‑form notes about usage rights

products.name: regulation_compliance
products.description: Association representing the compliance relationship between a catalog item and a regulation. Captures the compliance status and supporting evidence for each product‑regulation pair.. Existence Justification: Each catalog item may need to satisfy multiple regulations (e.g., data privacy, payment security) and each regulation applies to many catalog items. The compliance team actively creates, updates, and deletes records linking a product to a regulation, tracking compliance status and evidence for each link.

attributes.name: regulation_compliance_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Product Regulation Compliance - Product Regulation Compliance Id
attributes.description: Primary key for the product_regulation_compliance association

attributes.name: catalog_item_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Product Regulation Compliance - Catalog Item Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catalog_item

attributes.name: regulation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulation

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance state of the product for the regulation (e.g., compliant, non‑compliant, pending)

attributes.name: evidence_url
attributes.description: Link to evidence document or audit artifact supporting the compliance status

products.name: brand_compliance_enrollment
products.description: Represents the enrollment of a brand in a compliance program, capturing when the brand joined the program and its current status. Each record links one brand to one compliance program and stores attributes that belong only to this relationship.. Existence Justification: Brands are actively enrolled in compliance programs, and each program includes many brands. The enrollment is managed as a distinct business process with enrollment dates and status tracked for each brand‑program link. This many‑to‑many relationship is a core operational entity.

attributes.name: brand_compliance_enrollment_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Brand Compliance Enrollment - Brand Compliance Enrollment Id
attributes.description: Primary key for the brand_compliance_enrollment association

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the brand

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Brand Compliance Enrollment - Compliance Program Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the compliance program

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date the brand was enrolled in the compliance program

attributes.name: program_status
attributes.description: Current status of the brand within the compliance program (e.g., active, pending, completed)

domains.name: order
domains.description: Core transactional domain managing the full order lifecycle from cart submission through confirmed delivery. Owns order capture, OMS orchestration, order status tracking, cancellations, delivery confirmation, and order-level SLA management across B2C, B2B, and marketplace channels. Tracks AOV, CVR, and GMV at the order level.
domains.references: Order Management System (OMS), EDI X12, ISO 20022

products.name: cart
products.description: Represents a customers active shopping cart prior to order submission. Captures session context, channel origin (B2C, B2B, marketplace, mobile app), cart creation and expiry timestamps, applied coupon codes, estimated totals, saved-for-later flag, and cart abandonment signals (last activity timestamp, abandonment email trigger status). Serves as the SSOT for pre-purchase intent and cart-to-order conversion tracking. This is the entry point of the order lifecycle — cart submission triggers order_header creation. Line-item details are held in the related cart_item product.

attributes.name: cart_id

attributes.name: customer_profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer who owns the cart.

attributes.name: price_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_list. Business justification: CART PRICING CONTEXT: The cart calculates totals using a selected price list; persisting the list ID enables seamless order conversion.

attributes.name: session_id
attributes.description: Web or app session identifier associated with the cart.

attributes.name: abandonment_email_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a cart abandonment email has been sent.

attributes.name: abandonment_reason
attributes.description: Free‑text reason captured (if any) for why the cart was abandoned.

attributes.name: cart_number
attributes.description: Business-facing cart identifier shown to customers and used in support.

attributes.name: cart_source
attributes.description: System or integration source that created the cart.

attributes.name: cart_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cart.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Origin channel through which the cart was created.

attributes.name: coupon_code
attributes.description: Promotional coupon applied to the cart, if any.

attributes.name: coupon_discount_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the coupon discount.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the cart was initially created (business event time).

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: device_type

attributes.name: discount_total_amount
attributes.description: Aggregate discount amount from coupons, promotions, and cart-level discounts.

attributes.name: estimated_delivery_date

attributes.name: expiry_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the cart is scheduled to expire if not converted.

attributes.name: gift_message

attributes.name: ip_address

attributes.name: is_gift
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cart is marked as a gift purchase.

attributes.name: item_count

attributes.name: last_activity_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent interaction with the cart.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_applied

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the cart record was first persisted in the data lake (audit).

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: saved_for_later_flag
attributes.description: Indicates if the cart is marked as saved for later purchase.

attributes.name: shipping_address_city

attributes.name: shipping_address_country_code

attributes.name: shipping_address_line1

attributes.name: total_estimated_amount

attributes.name: total_quantity

attributes.description: Aggregate volume of all items, used for logistics planning.

attributes.name: total_weight_kg
attributes.description: Aggregate weight of all items in the cart, used for shipping calculations.

attributes.name: user_agent

attributes.name: version

products.name: cart_item

Tracks SKU identifier, quantity requested, unit price at time of add-to-cart, seller ID for marketplace items, product variant details, and item-level promotional flags. attributes.name: cart_item_id

attributes.name: bundle_id

attributes.name: cart_id

attributes.name: seller_profile_id

attributes.name: sku_id

attributes.name: user_session_id

attributes.name: variant_sku_id

products.name: header
products.description: The authoritative master record for a confirmed customer order within the OMS. Captures the full order header including order number, channel (B2C, B2B, marketplace, BOPIS, DTC), order placement timestamp, customer reference, billing address, total GMV, AOV contribution, tax amount, discount amount, currency, order status, SLA tier, and payment reference. This is the SSOT for order-level identity and lifecycle management across all channels.

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Primary key for header

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Required for B2B order processing: links each order to the corporate account used for billing and credit checks, enabling account‑level revenue and risk reporting.

attributes.name: audience_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.audience_segment. Business justification: Required for Audience Segment ROI analysis: associates each order with the targeted audience segment, supporting segment‑level conversion and spend efficiency reports.

attributes.name: billing_address_order_address_id
attributes.description: Reference to the address used for billing purposes.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Required for Campaign‑Order Performance tracking: directly ties an order to the originating marketing campaign (e.g., email or ad) for conversion and revenue attribution.

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.channel. Business justification: Required for Order‑Channel Attribution Report: links each order to the marketing channel that drove it, enabling ROI calculations and channel performance dashboards.

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.contact. Business justification: Captures the B2B contact person responsible for the order, essential for order support, invoicing, and compliance audit trails.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: REQUIRED: Allocate order fulfillment costs to a cost center for expense tracking and budgeting.

attributes.name: entitlement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.entitlement. Business justification: Business process: Apply customer's support entitlement to each order for SLA and case handling; experts expect an order to reference its entitlement tier.

attributes.name: fulfillment_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse or fulfillment center assigned to the order.

attributes.name: header_order_address_id
attributes.description: Reference to the address where the order will be shipped.

attributes.name: household_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.household. Business justification: Supports household‑level order aggregation for family plans and shared loyalty, enabling reporting of total household GMV and order counts.

attributes.name: merchant_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.merchant_account. Business justification: REQUIRED: Reconciliation reports need the merchant account that processed each order; linking order_header to merchant_account enables accurate financial statements and audit trails.

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_obligation. Business justification: Order processing must satisfy specific compliance obligations (consumer protection, data privacy); linking allows tracking obligation fulfillment per order for audit trails.

attributes.name: payment_gateway_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.gateway. Business justification: REQUIRED: Operational dashboards track which payment gateway handled each order for SLA monitoring and compliance; a FK from order_header to gateway provides this linkage.

attributes.name: payment_method_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.payment_method. Business justification: REQUIRED: Storing the tokenized payment method used for an order enables refunds, recurring billing, and fraud analysis; the FK links order_header to payment_method.

attributes.name: price_approval_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_approval. Business justification: COMPLIANCE APPROVAL: High‑value orders may need price approval; linking to the approval record satisfies audit and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: price_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_list. Business justification: ORDER PRICING AUDIT: Each order is priced using a specific price list; storing price_list_id enables price source traceability for compliance reports.

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_zone. Business justification: REGIONAL PRICING: Orders are assigned to a price zone to apply region‑specific pricing rules; FK required for zone‑based revenue analysis.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: REQUIRED: Assign each order to a profit center for profit‑center performance reporting.

attributes.name: query_log_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to search.query_log. Business justification: Attribution of each order to the originating search query for marketing ROI and search performance reporting.

attributes.name: regulation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulation. Business justification: Tax compliance reporting requires each order to reference the tax regulation (e.g., VAT, sales tax) governing the transaction, enabling accurate filing and audit.

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.segment. Business justification: Needed for segment‑based order analytics and targeted marketing, allowing each order to be attributed to the customer segment at time of purchase.

attributes.name: seller_profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the marketplace seller fulfilling the order (if applicable).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the order header record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three‑letter currency identifier for the order.

attributes.name: delivery_actual_date
attributes.description: Date the order was actually delivered to the customer.

products.name: order_line
products.description: Individual SKU-level line items within a confirmed order. attributes.name: general_ledger_id

attributes.name: header_id

attributes.name: indexed_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to search.indexed_document. Business justification: Enables linking purchased line items to the catalog document used in search, supporting search relevance and conversion attribution analysis.

products.name: status_history
products.description: Immutable audit log of all order lifecycle state transitions for a sales order. Records each status change event (e.g., PLACED → CONFIRMED → ALLOCATED → SHIPPED → DELIVERED → CANCELLED), the timestamp of transition, the actor or system that triggered the change, and any associated reason codes. Enables SLA breach detection, order lifecycle analytics, and OMS orchestration tracing.

products.name: order_payment
products.description: Order-level payment allocation records linking a sales order to one or more payment transactions. Captures payment method type, payment reference from the payment gateway, amount allocated to this order, currency, payment status (authorized, captured, failed, refunded), split-payment flags, and gift card or store credit redemption amounts. This is the order domains local reference to payment events — it does NOT own gateway integration, PCI-scoped card data, or settlement processing (those belong to the payment domain). Enables order-level payment reconciliation, refund eligibility checks, and revenue recognition without crossing domain boundaries.

domains.name: inventory
domains.description: SSOT for stock positions across all warehouse nodes and virtual locations. Manages SKU-level inventory records, stock allocation, replenishment planning, safety stock, OOS tracking, FIFO/LIFO lot tracking, cycle counting, MOQ rules, DSR metrics, and real-time inventory visibility. Integrates with WMS for inventory control.

products.name: stock_position
products.description: Core master record and SSOT representing the current stock position and velocity profile for a SKU at a specific warehouse node or virtual location. Tracks on-hand quantity, reserved quantity, available-to-promise (ATP) quantity, in-transit quantity, and physical/logical inventory states (on-hand, allocated, quarantined, damaged). Includes comprehensive velocity metrics: rolling daily sales rate (DSR) at 7/30/90-day windows, velocity tier classification (A/B/C/D based on BSR and sales volume), average units sold per day, peak DSR, seasonal velocity index, and last velocity recalculation timestamp. Velocity data drives slotting decisions, replenishment frequency, and safety stock calculations. No separate velocity entity exists — stock_position is the SSOT for both inventory quantities and SKU velocity at the node level. Integrates with WMS for real-time inventory visibility across all fulfillment nodes.

attributes.name: stock_position_id

attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) — Inventory Control Module

attributes.name: content_digital_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.digital_asset. Business justification: Needed to associate a primary product image with each stock position for warehouse UI and pick‑face displays, a standard e‑commerce operational requirement.

attributes.name: item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.content_item. Business justification: Required for inventory dashboards to link each stock position to its product detail page, enabling real‑time UI and reporting of SKU information.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: REQUIRED: Enables PO‑level stock traceability for recall, cost allocation and supplier performance dashboards.

attributes.name: seller_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketplace seller who owns this inventory. Null for first-party (1P) inventory owned by the platform operator.
attributes.references: Seller Management Portal — Seller Onboarding Module

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product SKU whose inventory position is being tracked. Links to the product catalog master record.
attributes.references: Product Information Management System (PIM) — Catalog Module; ISO 8000 Data Quality

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: REQUIRED: Provides supplier‑wise inventory health reporting and compliance checks, a core e‑commerce operational need.

attributes.name: warehouse_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical or virtual warehouse node (fulfillment center, dark store, 3PL facility, virtual location) where this stock position is held.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) — Facility Management Module

attributes.name: atp_qty
attributes.description: Net units available for new order commitments, calculated as on_hand_qty minus reserved_qty minus quarantined_qty. The ATP quantity is the real-time sellable inventory figure exposed to the storefront and OMS for order promising.
attributes.references: Order Management System (OMS) — Available-to-Promise (ATP) Engine; APICS Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: bin_location_code
attributes.description: WMS bin, slot, or storage location code within the warehouse node where this SKU is primarily slotted (e.g., A-01-03-B). Used for pick path optimization, slotting analysis, and physical inventory audits.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) — Slotting and Location Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this stock position record was first created in the system, typically when the SKU was first received at this warehouse node or when the node was onboarded. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity and Accountability; ISO 27001

attributes.name: cycle_count_variance_qty
attributes.description: Difference between the system-recorded on-hand quantity and the physically counted quantity at the last cycle count (counted minus system). Positive = overage, negative = shrinkage. Used for inventory accuracy KPI reporting and shrinkage investigation.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) — Cycle Count; APICS Inventory Accuracy; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: damaged_qty
attributes.description: Units at the node that have been identified as damaged and are unsellable in their current condition. May be eligible for liquidation, refurbishment, or disposal. Tracked for shrinkage reporting and insurance claims.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) — Damage Tracking; ERP SAP S/4HANA — Inventory Write-Down

attributes.name: days_of_supply
attributes.description: Estimated number of days the current ATP quantity will last at the current 30-day DSR before reaching zero stock. Calculated as atp_qty divided by dsr_30d. Key operational metric for replenishment urgency triage and OOS risk scoring.
attributes.references: APICS Supply Chain Planning — Days of Supply (DOS); Inventory Management KPI Standards

attributes.name: dsr_30d
attributes.description: Average units sold per day for this SKU at this node over the trailing 30-day window. Medium-term velocity metric used for safety stock calculation, reorder point setting, and monthly replenishment planning.
attributes.references: Daily Sales Rate (DSR) Metric; APICS Demand Planning Standards; WMS Velocity Analytics

attributes.name: dsr_7d
attributes.description: Average units sold per day for this SKU at this node over the trailing 7-day window. Short-term velocity metric used for immediate replenishment decisions and flash sale impact assessment. Recalculated nightly from order fulfillment data.
attributes.references: Daily Sales Rate (DSR) Metric; APICS Demand Planning Standards; WMS Velocity Analytics

attributes.name: dsr_90d
attributes.description: Average units sold per day for this SKU at this node over the trailing 90-day window. Long-term velocity baseline used for seasonal trend analysis, annual replenishment planning, and velocity tier classification.
attributes.references: Daily Sales Rate (DSR) Metric; APICS Demand Planning Standards; WMS Velocity Analytics

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration or best-before date of the current lot/batch at this node. Applicable for perishable, pharmaceutical, or regulated goods. Drives FEFO pick sequencing and OOS-before-expiry alerts. Null for non-perishable SKUs.
attributes.references: Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC); FDA Expiry Labeling Standards; WMS Lot Management

attributes.name: in_transit_qty
attributes.description: Units of the SKU currently in transit to this warehouse node from a supplier, another node, or a returns processing center. Included in future ATP projections but not in current on-hand. Tracked via Transportation Management System (TMS) shipment records.
attributes.references: Transportation Management System (TMS) — Shipment Tracking; WMS Receiving Module

attributes.name: inventory_ownership_type
attributes.description: Classifies who owns the inventory: first_party (platform-owned), third_party_fba (Fulfillment By Amazon-style seller inventory held at platform warehouse), consignment, dropship (never physically held), or vendor_managed inventory (VMI). Drives cost accounting and liability treatment.
attributes.references: ERP SAP S/4HANA — Inventory Accounting; WMS Ownership Module

attributes.name: inventory_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this stock position record. Active = normal operations; quarantined = held pending quality inspection; suspended = temporarily blocked from sale; archived = historical record no longer in active use.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) — Inventory Control; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: is_hazmat
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is classified as a hazardous material requiring special storage, handling, or shipping restrictions at this node. Drives WMS storage zone assignment, carrier eligibility filtering in TMS, and regulatory compliance checks.
attributes.references: Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC); DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations

attributes.name: is_oos
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SKU is currently out of stock (OOS) at this node, meaning ATP quantity is zero or below safety stock threshold. Drives storefront availability suppression, OOS alerts, and replenishment escalation. Key KPI for inventory health reporting.
attributes.references: Order Management System (OMS) — Availability Engine; Out-of-Stock (OOS) KPI Standards

attributes.name: is_serialized
attributes.description: Indicates whether individual units of this SKU are tracked by unique serial number at this node. When true, each unit has a distinct serial number record in the WMS. Relevant for high-value electronics, regulated goods, and warranty management.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) — Serial Number Tracking; Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC)

attributes.name: last_cycle_count_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical cycle count performed for this SKU at this warehouse node. Cycle counting is the primary mechanism for validating perpetual inventory accuracy. Frequency is driven by velocity tier (A-items counted more frequently).
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) — Cycle Count Module; APICS CPIM Inventory Accuracy Standards

attributes.name: last_movement_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent inventory movement transaction (receipt, pick, transfer, adjustment) for this SKU at this node. Used to identify dormant stock, trigger dead-stock reviews, and validate real-time inventory visibility.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) — Inventory Transaction Log; ERP SAP S/4HANA — Material Movement

attributes.name: last_received_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent inbound goods receipt (GR) posted for this SKU at this warehouse node. Used to assess inventory freshness, identify slow-moving stock, and validate replenishment cycle adherence.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) — Receiving Module; ERP SAP S/4HANA — Goods Receipt

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the storage location: physical_warehouse (owned/leased FC), virtual_location (logical inventory bucket), dropship_node (supplier ships direct), store_backroom (BOPIS-enabled store), or 3pl_facility (Third-Party Logistics partner site).
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS); Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS) Standards

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Supplier or internal lot/batch identifier for the current stock at this node. Enables traceability for product recalls, quality investigations, and FEFO rotation. Null when lot_tracking_method is 'none'.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) — Lot Tracking; Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) Recall Traceability; ISO 9001

attributes.name: lot_tracking_method
attributes.description: Inventory costing and lot rotation method applied to this SKU at this node: FIFO (First In First Out), LIFO (Last In First Out), FEFO (First Expired First Out for perishables), or none (no lot tracking). Governs pick sequencing in WMS and cost-of-goods-sold (COGS) calculation in ERP.
attributes.references: ERP SAP S/4HANA — Inventory Valuation; GAAP/IFRS Inventory Accounting Standards; WMS Lot Management

attributes.name: max_stock_qty
attributes.description: Upper bound on inventory units to hold at this node for this SKU, constrained by bin capacity, working capital policy, or perishability. Replenishment orders are sized to not exceed this level. Used in min-max replenishment planning.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) — Slotting and Capacity; ERP SAP S/4HANA — Supply Chain Planning

attributes.name: moq
attributes.description: Minimum number of units that must be ordered per replenishment purchase order for this SKU at this node, as stipulated by the supplier contract. Constrains replenishment order sizing in the ERP procurement module.
attributes.references: ERP SAP S/4HANA — Procurement/Purchasing; Supplier Contract Terms

attributes.name: on_hand_qty
attributes.description: Total physical units of the SKU currently present at the warehouse node, regardless of reservation or allocation status. Includes allocated, quarantined, and damaged units. Source of truth from WMS cycle count or perpetual inventory.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) — Inventory Ledger; FIFO/LIFO Accounting Standards

attributes.name: oos_since_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the SKU first became out of stock at this node in the current OOS episode. Used to calculate OOS duration for SLA compliance, lost sales estimation, and seller performance monitoring. Null when is_oos is false.
attributes.references: Order Management System (OMS); Service Level Agreement (SLA) Compliance Reporting

attributes.name: peak_dsr
attributes.description: Highest single-day sales rate observed for this SKU at this node within the trailing 90-day window. Used to size safety stock for peak demand scenarios (e.g., flash sales, holiday events) and to stress-test replenishment plans.
attributes.references: Daily Sales Rate (DSR) Metric; APICS Demand Planning; Pricing and Promotions Management

attributes.name: quarantined_qty
attributes.description: Units physically present at the node but held in quarantine pending quality inspection, regulatory hold, or recall investigation. Not available for sale or fulfillment. Tracked separately for compliance and quality management reporting.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) — Quality Hold Module; Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) Recall Standards; ISO 9001

attributes.name: reorder_point_qty
attributes.description: Inventory level at which a replenishment purchase order (PO) should be triggered for this SKU at this node. Calculated as safety_stock_qty plus demand during replenishment lead time. Drives automated replenishment in the ERP/WMS.
attributes.references: ERP SAP S/4HANA — MRP Module; APICS CPIM Standards; Inventory Management Best Practices

attributes.name: replenishment_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Expected number of calendar days from purchase order (PO) placement to receipt of goods at this warehouse node for this SKU. Used in reorder point and safety stock calculations. Sourced from supplier SLA agreements.
attributes.references: ERP SAP S/4HANA — Procurement; Service Level Agreement (SLA) Standards; APICS CPIM

attributes.name: reserved_qty
attributes.description: Units of the SKU that have been soft-allocated to open orders or reservations but not yet physically picked. Reduces available-to-promise (ATP) quantity. Managed by the Order Management System (OMS) allocation engine.
attributes.references: Order Management System (OMS) — Allocation Engine; WMS Inventory Control

attributes.name: safety_stock_qty
attributes.description: Minimum buffer stock level maintained at the node to protect against demand variability and supply lead time uncertainty. When ATP quantity falls below safety stock, a replenishment alert is triggered. Calculated from DSR metrics and lead time data.
attributes.references: ERP SAP S/4HANA — MRP/Supply Chain Planning; APICS CPIM Standards

attributes.name: seasonal_velocity_index
attributes.description: Multiplicative seasonal adjustment factor applied to the baseline DSR to account for predictable seasonal demand patterns (e.g., 1.5 = 50% above baseline in peak season, 0.7 = 30% below in off-season). Used in demand forecasting and safety stock uplift calculations.
attributes.references: APICS Demand Planning — Seasonal Adjustment; ERP SAP S/4HANA — Demand Forecasting

attributes.name: stock_condition
attributes.description: Physical or logical state of the stock at this node: on_hand (available in bin), allocated (reserved for an order), quarantined (held for QC), damaged (unsellable), in_transit (moving between nodes). Drives WMS pick eligibility and ATP calculations.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) — Inventory State Machine; ISO 9001

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure in which inventory quantities for this SKU are tracked at this node (e.g., EA = each, CASE, PALLET, KG, LB, L, M). Must align with the UOM defined in the product catalog and supplier purchase orders. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CASE|PALLET|KG|LB|L|M — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GS1 Unit of Measure Standards; Product Information Management System (PIM); ISO 80000 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this stock position record, including quantity adjustments, status changes, velocity recalculations, or cycle count postings. Essential for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; ISO 27001; Databricks Lakehouse CDC Best Practices

attributes.name: velocity_recalculated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent recalculation of DSR metrics and velocity tier for this stock position record. Indicates data freshness for downstream consumers (replenishment engine, slotting optimizer, search ranking). Recalculated nightly or on-demand.
attributes.references: WMS Velocity Analytics; Search and Recommendation Engine — Relevance Ranking

attributes.name: velocity_tier
attributes.description: ABC/D velocity tier assigned to this SKU at this node based on Best Seller Rank (BSR) and sales volume: A = fast-moving (top ~20% by volume), B = medium-moving, C = slow-moving, D = dead stock / near-zero velocity. Drives slotting decisions, replenishment frequency, and pick path optimization in WMS.
attributes.references: Best Seller Rank (BSR) Classification; ABC Analysis — APICS CPIM; WMS Slotting Optimization

products.name: warehouse_location
products.description: Master record for physical and virtual storage locations within a warehouse node, including bin, shelf, aisle, zone, and rack identifiers. Defines location type (pick face, bulk storage, receiving dock, returns area, virtual), capacity constraints, temperature zone, and hazmat classification. Used by WMS for slotting optimization and inventory allocation to specific storage positions.

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a physical or virtual storage location within a warehouse node. Primary key for this master record.

attributes.name: warehouse_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent warehouse node that contains this storage location. Used to scope location records to a specific fulfillment center or distribution node.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Inventory Control Module

attributes.name: accessibility_type
attributes.description: Equipment or method required to access this storage location. Determines which picking and putaway resources the WMS can assign to tasks involving this location. Automated locations are served by Automated Storage and Retrieval Systems (AS/RS).

attributes.name: aisle_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the aisle within the warehouse zone where this location is physically situated. Used by WMS for pick-path optimization and travel-time minimization in fulfillment operations.

attributes.name: barcode
attributes.description: Barcode value printed on the physical label affixed to this storage location. Scanned by warehouse operatives using handheld devices or fixed scanners during pick, putaway, and cycle count operations to confirm location identity.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Barcode Scanning; GS1 Barcode Standards

attributes.name: bin_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the individual bin or slot within the shelf. The most granular physical unit of the warehouse location hierarchy. Directly maps to a scannable barcode label affixed to the physical bin in the warehouse.

attributes.name: capacity_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure in which the capacity of this storage location is expressed. Aligns with the WMS capacity management configuration for the warehouse node (e.g., 'pallets' for bulk storage, 'units' for pick-face bins, 'kg' for weight-constrained locations).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this warehouse location master record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for record provenance and supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 - Audit Logging; SOX - Internal Controls

attributes.name: cycle_count_frequency_days
attributes.description: Target number of days between cycle counts for this location. Drives the WMS cycle count scheduling engine. High-velocity or high-value locations typically have shorter intervals (e.g., 7 days) while low-velocity locations may be counted quarterly (e.g., 90 days).
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Cycle Count Scheduling; SOX - Inventory Accuracy Controls

attributes.name: dedicated_sku
attributes.description: Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) code of the product permanently assigned to this location under a fixed slotting strategy. Null for floating or multi-SKU locations. Used by WMS to enforce single-SKU integrity and prevent mixed-SKU putaway errors.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Fixed Slotting; Product Information Management System (PIM)

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which this storage location record became operationally active and available for inventory allocation in the WMS. Supports bi-temporal data management and warehouse expansion tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 - Date and Time Standards; Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Location Lifecycle

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date on which this storage location record ceases to be operationally active. Null for currently active locations. Used to manage decommissioned or seasonally inactive locations without hard-deleting master records.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 - Date and Time Standards; Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Location Lifecycle

attributes.name: hazmat_class
attributes.description: Hazardous materials classification code assigned to this location, indicating the category of dangerous goods that may be stored here (e.g., Class 3 Flammable Liquids, Class 8 Corrosives). Null for non-hazmat locations. Governs WMS slotting restrictions and regulatory compliance for storage. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: class_1_explosives|class_2_gases|class_3_flammable|class_4_flammable_solids|class_5_oxidizers|class_6_toxic|class_7_radioactive|class_8_corrosives|class_9_misc|none — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Federal Trade Commission (FTC) - Hazardous Materials Regulations; NIST Cybersecurity Framework; Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC)

attributes.name: height_cm
attributes.description: Physical height dimension of the storage location in centimetres. Used for vertical clearance validation during slotting and for determining forklift or reach-truck accessibility requirements.

attributes.name: is_bulk_storage
attributes.description: Indicates whether this location is designated as a bulk or reserve storage position. Bulk locations hold overstock inventory that replenishes pick face locations. Used in WMS replenishment trigger logic.

attributes.name: is_hazmat_approved
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storage location has been certified and approved for storing hazardous materials. Drives WMS slotting rules to prevent non-approved locations from receiving hazmat inventory.
attributes.references: Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) - Hazardous Materials Storage; Federal Trade Commission (FTC)

attributes.name: is_pick_face
attributes.description: Indicates whether this location is designated as an active pick face — a forward-pick position from which pickers directly fulfil customer orders. Pick face locations are replenished from bulk storage and are optimized for pick speed and ergonomics.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Pick Face Management

attributes.name: is_quarantine
attributes.description: Indicates whether this location is designated as a quarantine hold area. Inventory placed in quarantine locations is blocked from pick and shipment pending quality inspection, regulatory hold, or Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) processing.
attributes.references: Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) - Product Safety Hold Procedures; ISO 9001 - Quality Management

attributes.name: is_virtual
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a virtual (system-only) storage location with no physical counterpart in the warehouse. Virtual locations are used for in-transit inventory, damaged goods holding, or system adjustment buckets in the WMS.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Virtual Location Configuration

attributes.name: last_cycle_count_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent cycle count was performed at this storage location. Used to schedule future cycle counts, assess inventory accuracy compliance, and prioritize locations overdue for counting per the warehouse cycle count program.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Cycle Count Management; SOX - Inventory Controls

attributes.name: length_cm
attributes.description: Physical length dimension of the storage location in centimetres. Used in WMS slotting optimization to match product dimensions to available location space and to calculate volumetric utilization.

attributes.name: level_number
attributes.description: Numeric vertical level of the storage location within the rack structure (e.g., 1 = ground level, 2 = second level). Used for ergonomic slotting rules, forklift accessibility constraints, and pick-path optimization in the WMS.

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this storage location within the warehouse. Used by WMS for pick-pack-ship operations, barcode scanning, and slotting optimization. Typically formatted as ZONE-AISLE-RACK-SHELF-BIN (e.g., A-01-03-02-05).

attributes.name: location_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the storage location, used in WMS user interfaces, slotting reports, and operational dashboards (e.g., 'Aisle 3 Rack B Shelf 2 Bin 5').

attributes.name: location_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle state of the storage location. Controls whether the WMS can allocate inventory to or pick from this location. 'blocked' indicates a temporary hold (e.g., quality inspection); 'under_maintenance' indicates physical inaccessibility.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Location Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Functional classification of the storage location within the warehouse. Determines how the WMS uses this location in fulfillment workflows: pick_face (active picking slot), bulk_storage (reserve/overflow stock), receiving_dock (inbound goods receipt), returns_area (Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) processing), virtual (system-only allocation node), staging (pre-shipment consolidation area).
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Location Type Reference

attributes.name: lot_tracking_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether inventory stored at this location must be tracked at the lot or batch level. Required for locations holding perishables, pharmaceuticals, or regulated goods where First In First Out (FIFO) / First Expired First Out (FEFO) lot traceability is mandated.
attributes.references: Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) - Traceability Requirements; ISO 9001 - Lot Control

attributes.name: max_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum storage capacity of this location expressed in the unit defined by capacity_uom. Used by WMS to enforce inventory allocation limits and prevent overstocking. Critical for slotting optimization and replenishment planning.

attributes.name: max_fill_level
attributes.description: Maximum inventory quantity (in capacity_uom) that should be stocked at this location. Used by the WMS to cap replenishment quantities and prevent overfilling. Typically set equal to or less than max_capacity to allow for operational buffer.

attributes.name: max_weight_kg
attributes.description: Maximum allowable weight in kilograms that this storage location can safely bear. Enforced by WMS during inventory allocation to prevent structural overloading. Particularly relevant for high-density racking and mezzanine-level locations.
attributes.references: Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) - Structural Safety Standards; ISO 9001

attributes.name: min_fill_level
attributes.description: Minimum inventory quantity (in capacity_uom) that should be maintained at this location before a replenishment task is triggered. Used by the WMS replenishment engine to prevent Out of Stock (OOS) conditions at pick face locations.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Replenishment Management; Out of Stock (OOS) Prevention

attributes.name: mixed_sku_allowed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mixed Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) Allowed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether multiple distinct Stock Keeping Units (SKUs) may be co-located in this storage position simultaneously. When false, the WMS enforces single-SKU integrity. Mixed-SKU locations are common in bulk storage but typically prohibited at pick faces to prevent picking errors.

attributes.name: pick_sequence
attributes.description: Numeric sequence number used by the WMS to order this location within a pick path or wave. Lower numbers are visited first. Optimized to minimize picker travel distance and maximize throughput in fulfillment operations.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Pick Path Optimization

attributes.name: putaway_strategy
attributes.description: Strategy used by the WMS to direct incoming inventory to this location during receiving and putaway operations. Fixed: always assigned to specific Stock Keeping Units (SKUs); floating: any compatible SKU; directed: WMS algorithm assigns; nearest_empty: proximity-based assignment.

attributes.name: rack_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the rack or bay within the aisle where this location is physically situated. Part of the hierarchical location address used by WMS for precise inventory positioning.

attributes.name: replenishment_strategy
attributes.description: Inventory rotation and replenishment strategy applied to this location. Governs the order in which stock is consumed and replenished: First In First Out (FIFO), Last In First Out (LIFO), First Expired First Out (FEFO) for perishables, manual (operator-directed), or none (no automated replenishment).
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Replenishment Configuration; ISO 9001 - Inventory Control

attributes.name: rfid_tag
attributes.description: RFID tag identifier associated with this storage location for automated inventory tracking and real-time location visibility. Null if the location is not RFID-enabled. Supports real-time inventory visibility in RFID-equipped warehouse nodes.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - RFID Integration; GS1 EPC Standards

attributes.name: shelf_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the shelf level within the rack where this location is physically situated. Shelf codes are used for vertical positioning in WMS pick-path logic and ergonomic slotting (e.g., golden zone placement for high-velocity Stock Keeping Units (SKUs)).

attributes.name: slotting_velocity_class
attributes.description: ABC/D velocity classification assigned to this location based on the throughput of Stock Keeping Units (SKUs) slotted here. Class A: highest-velocity (golden zone, ergonomic height); Class B: medium-velocity; Class C: low-velocity; Class D: very slow-moving or seasonal. Drives slotting optimization decisions.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Slotting Optimization; Best Seller Rank (BSR) Analytics

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Temperature classification of the storage location, defining the environmental condition maintained at this position. Drives product-to-location compatibility rules in WMS slotting: ambient (room temperature), chilled (2–8°C), frozen (below -18°C), controlled (specific regulated range for pharmaceuticals or electronics).
attributes.references: Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) - Storage Condition Standards; ISO 9001 - Quality Management

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this warehouse location master record was most recently modified. Used for change data capture (CDC) processing, incremental ETL loads, and audit compliance in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 - Audit Logging; SOX - Internal Controls; ETL Change Data Capture

attributes.name: width_cm
attributes.description: Physical width dimension of the storage location in centimetres. Used alongside length_cm and height_cm for volumetric capacity calculations and product-to-location fit validation in WMS slotting.

attributes.name: zone_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the warehouse zone in which this location resides. Zones group locations by operational function, temperature requirement, or product category (e.g., DRY, COLD, HAZMAT, RETURNS). Used for slotting optimization and pick-path routing.

products.name: lot
products.description: Master record for a specific production lot or batch of inventory received into the warehouse. Tracks lot number, manufacture date, expiry date, country of origin, supplier batch reference, and FIFO/LIFO sequencing position. Supports lot-level traceability for perishable goods, regulated products, and recall management. Links to goods receipt and stock position for lot-level quantity tracking.

attributes.name: lot_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inventory lot or batch record. Primary key for the lot entity.

attributes.name: content_digital_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.digital_asset. Business justification: Regulatory compliance mandates attaching digital certificates (assets) to lots; linking enables automated audit reports and traceability.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: REQUIRED: Links each lot to its originating PO for audit, recall handling and accurate landed‑cost calculation.

attributes.name: regulation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulation. Business justification: Regulatory reporting requires each inventory lot to be linked to its primary regulation (e.g., FDA, CE) for compliance status tracking.

attributes.name: seller_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to seller.seller_profile. Business justification: Enables Lot Ownership Tracking for seller‑specific batch traceability and recall management.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Lot tracking must be tied to a specific SKU to enforce expiration, traceability, and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supplier or vendor who provided this lot. Links to supplier master data for procurement and quality tracking.

attributes.name: warehouse_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse or fulfillment center where this lot is stored. Supports multi-node inventory visibility.

attributes.name: allocated_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of units reserved for pending orders but not yet shipped. Reduces available quantity without physically moving inventory.

attributes.name: available_quantity
attributes.description: Current quantity of units available for allocation and order fulfillment. Updated in real-time as inventory is allocated or consumed.

attributes.name: batch_reference
attributes.description: Supplier or manufacturer batch reference code used for cross-referencing with supplier records and quality documentation.

attributes.name: cost_per_unit
attributes.description: Landed cost per unit for this lot including purchase price, freight, duties, and handling. Used for inventory valuation and Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) calculation.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating where the product was manufactured or produced. Required for customs, trade compliance, and tariff classification.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the lot record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for cost per unit. Supports multi-currency inventory valuation and financial reporting.

attributes.name: cycle_count_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical cycle count for this lot. Supports inventory accuracy and shrinkage tracking.

attributes.name: cycle_count_variance
attributes.description: Difference between system quantity and physical count during the most recent cycle count. Positive values indicate overage, negative indicate shortage.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the lot expires and is no longer suitable for sale or use. Used for perishable goods, pharmaceuticals, and regulated products. Null for non-perishable items.

attributes.name: fifo_sequence
attributes.description: Numeric sequence position for First In First Out (FIFO) allocation logic. Lower numbers are allocated first to minimize expiry risk.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_number
attributes.description: Warehouse Management System (WMS) goods receipt document number. Links lot to receiving transaction for audit trail and discrepancy resolution.

attributes.name: hold_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the lot is on hold or in quarantine status. Supports quality management and inventory disposition decisions.

attributes.name: hold_release_date
attributes.description: Date when the lot was released from hold or quarantine status and made available for allocation. Null if lot is still on hold.

attributes.name: inspection_date
attributes.description: Date when quality inspection was completed. Used for compliance documentation and quality audit trail.

attributes.name: inspection_status
attributes.description: Result of quality inspection performed at goods receipt. Determines whether lot can be released to available inventory or must remain in quarantine.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lot record is currently active in the system. Inactive lots are retained for historical reporting but excluded from operational inventory views.

attributes.name: lifo_sequence
attributes.description: Numeric sequence position for Last In First Out (LIFO) allocation logic. Higher numbers are allocated first for specific inventory strategies.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier for the production lot or batch. Used for traceability and recall management. Typically assigned by manufacturer or supplier.
attributes.references: ISO 22005 - Traceability in the Feed and Food Chain

attributes.name: lot_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the lot. Determines whether inventory is available for allocation, under quality hold, expired, or subject to recall.

attributes.name: lot_type
attributes.description: Classification of the lot based on handling requirements. Determines storage conditions, expiry tracking, and regulatory compliance needs.

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: Date when the product lot was manufactured or produced. Critical for shelf-life calculation and First In First Out (FIFO) sequencing.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes for special handling instructions, quality observations, or other relevant information about the lot.

attributes.name: quality_grade
attributes.description: Quality classification assigned during goods receipt inspection. Determines pricing tier, allocation priority, and disposition rules.

attributes.name: quarantine_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of units placed on quality hold pending inspection or testing. Not available for allocation until released.

attributes.name: recall_date
attributes.description: Date when the recall was initiated for this lot. Used for compliance reporting and customer notification timelines.
attributes.references: Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) - Recall Guidelines

attributes.name: recall_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lot is subject to a product recall. When true, inventory is blocked from allocation and recall procedures are initiated.
attributes.references: Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) - Recall Guidelines

attributes.name: recall_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for the product recall. Supports root cause analysis, customer communication, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) - Recall Guidelines

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: Date when the lot was received into the warehouse. Marks the start of inventory availability and FIFO sequencing position.

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: Original quantity of units received into inventory for this lot. Baseline for calculating remaining stock and depletion rate.

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Physical storage location code within the warehouse (aisle, rack, bin). Supports pick-pack-ship efficiency and cycle counting.

attributes.name: storage_zone
attributes.description: Warehouse zone classification based on environmental or security requirements. Determines handling procedures and storage costs.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for quantity tracking. Aligns with product catalog and warehouse management system conventions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: each|case|pallet|kg|lbs|liter|gallon — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the lot record was last modified. Supports change tracking and data quality monitoring.

products.name: stock_movement
products.description: Transactional record and sole audit trail capturing every inventory movement and adjustment event including receipts, issues, transfers, manual corrections, cycle count variances, returns, write-offs, and system-initiated adjustments. Records movement type, source and destination location, quantity moved, unit of measure, movement reason code (shrinkage, damage, count variance, system error, expiry write-off, recount adjustment), reference document (PO, RMA, transfer order, cycle count, investigation), operator ID, authorizing user for adjustments, adjusted quantity (positive or negative), adjusted value for financial reconciliation, and financial impact. Serves as the SSOT for all inventory change audit trails including both automated movements and manual corrections requiring authorization. Feeds replenishment triggers, DSR calculations, inventory write-off reconciliation, and SOX-compliant financial reporting.
products.reference: Inventory Movement / Goods Movement (WMS / SAP MM)

attributes.name: stock_movement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the stock movement transaction. Primary key for the stock movement audit trail.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the logistics carrier or 3PL provider involved in the movement, applicable for inbound receipts and inter-warehouse transfers. Null for internal movements.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the cost center responsible for the inventory movement, used for internal cost allocation and profitability analysis. Particularly relevant for issue and consumption transactions.

attributes.name: destination_location_warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse location, bin, or virtual location to which inventory is being moved. Null for issue transactions leaving the warehouse network or write-off transactions.

attributes.name: fulfillment_shipment_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the inbound or outbound shipment associated with this movement. Links inventory movements to transportation and logistics events for end-to-end supply chain visibility.
attributes.references: GS1 SSCC - Serial Shipping Container Code

attributes.name: lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.lot. Business justification: Add lot_id FK to lot for proper normalization; lot_number string is redundant.

attributes.name: primary_stock_warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse location, bin, or virtual location from which inventory is being moved. Null for receipt transactions originating outside the warehouse network.

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.route. Business justification: Inter‑warehouse stock movements are executed via transport routes; linking enables route efficiency reporting.

attributes.name: seller_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to seller.seller_profile. Business justification: Required for Stock Movement Audit Report per seller to track inventory changes attributable to each seller.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Required for inventory transaction reporting; linking movement records to product SKU details (price, dimensions, compliance) is essential for audit and fulfillment.

attributes.name: warehouse_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse or distribution center where the movement occurred. Supports multi-site inventory management and regional stock visibility.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason_notes
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for manual adjustments, write-offs, or variance corrections. Required for audit trail completeness and regulatory compliance. Captures business context not conveyed by reason code alone.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this stock movement record was first created in the database. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking. Distinct from movement_timestamp which represents the business event time.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 - Date and Time Format; ISO 15489

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the movement value. Supports multi-currency inventory valuation for global operations.

attributes.name: erp_document_number
attributes.description: Material document or goods movement document number generated by the ERP system (e.g., SAP material document). Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration or best-before date for perishable or time-sensitive inventory. Used for FEFO (First Expired First Out) picking logic and automated expiry write-off processing. Null for non-perishable items.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act; ISO 8601

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which the inventory movement value was posted. Typically inventory asset account for receipts, cost of goods sold for issues, or inventory variance account for adjustments. Null for non-financial movements.

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: Accounting period date when the inventory movement value was posted to the general ledger. May differ from movement_timestamp due to period close timing. Null for non-financial movements.
attributes.references: IAS 1 - Presentation of Financial Statements; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: is_financial_impact
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this movement has financial impact requiring general ledger posting (True) or is a non-financial movement such as location transfer within the same warehouse (False). Critical for financial reconciliation and month-end close.

attributes.name: is_system_initiated
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the movement was automatically triggered by system logic (True) or manually initiated by a user (False). Used to distinguish automated replenishment, allocation, and reservation movements from manual transactions.
