attributes.name: movement_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the stock movement transaction. Human-readable reference number used in operational systems and audit reports.

attributes.name: movement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the stock movement transaction. Pending = awaiting execution; In Transit = movement initiated but not yet received; Completed = movement finalized and inventory updated; Cancelled = movement voided before completion; Failed = movement attempted but rejected by system validation.

attributes.name: movement_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the physical inventory movement occurred or was recorded in the system. This is the business event timestamp used for inventory valuation and audit trail sequencing.

attributes.name: movement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the inventory movement transaction. Receipt = inbound from supplier or production; Issue = outbound to fulfillment or consumption; Transfer = inter-location movement; Adjustment = manual correction; Return = customer or supplier return; Write-off = inventory removal due to damage, expiry, or shrinkage.

attributes.name: quality_status
attributes.description: Quality control status of the inventory at the time of movement. Approved = passed quality inspection and available for use; Quarantine = held for inspection or investigation; Rejected = failed quality standards; Inspection Pending = awaiting quality review. Critical for regulated industries and quality-sensitive products.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of inventory units moved in this transaction. Positive for receipts and returns; negative for issues and write-offs. Supports fractional quantities for items sold by weight or volume.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code explaining the business reason for the inventory movement. Critical for root cause analysis of inventory variances, write-offs, and adjustments. Shrinkage = theft or loss; Damage = physical damage; Count Variance = cycle count discrepancy; System Error = ERP correction; Expiry = expired product removal; Recount = audit adjustment; Returns = RMA processing; Production Scrap = manufacturing waste. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: shrinkage|damage|count_variance|system_error|expiry|recount|customer_return|supplier_return|production_scrap — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the source document (PO number, SO number, transfer order, cycle count ID, RMA number, work order) that authorized this movement. Enables drill-through to originating transaction.

attributes.name: reference_document_type
attributes.description: Type of source document that triggered or authorized this stock movement. Links the movement to upstream business processes for full audit trail and traceability. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: purchase_order|sales_order|transfer_order|cycle_count|rma|work_order|manual_adjustment — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number for serialized inventory items requiring unit-level tracking (electronics, high-value goods, regulated products). Null for non-serialized items.
attributes.references: GS1 SGTIN - Serialized Global Trade Item Number

attributes.name: total_value
attributes.description: Total financial value of the inventory movement (quantity × unit cost). Used for general ledger posting, inventory asset reconciliation, and SOX-compliant financial reporting. Positive for receipts; negative for issues and write-offs.

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Per-unit inventory cost at the time of movement, used for inventory valuation and financial reconciliation. Reflects weighted average cost, FIFO cost, or standard cost depending on accounting policy.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the movement quantity. Each = individual item; Case = manufacturer case pack; Pallet = full pallet quantity; Weight and volume units for bulk items. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: each|case|pallet|kg|lb|liter|gallon — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this stock movement record was last modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization. Null if record has never been updated after initial creation.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 - Date and Time Format; ISO 15489

attributes.name: wms_transaction_reference
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier from the source Warehouse Management System. Enables reconciliation between WMS and ERP inventory records and supports end-to-end audit trail.

products.name: stock_allocation
products.description: Transactional record linking a specific quantity of inventory to a fulfillment demand (order line, reservation, or pre-allocation). Tracks allocated SKU, warehouse location, lot, allocated quantity, allocation type (hard/soft), allocation status, expiry timestamp, and the originating order or transfer reference. Ensures ATP accuracy and prevents overselling by managing the reserved inventory pool.

attributes.name: stock_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the stock allocation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Allocation charge‑back report requires each stock allocation to be charged to a cost center for internal expense tracking.

attributes.name: customer_profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer for whom this inventory is allocated. Enables customer-specific allocation rules and analytics.

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.fulfillment_order. Business justification: Required for the Fulfillment Order creation process that reserves inventory for each order line, enabling real‑time allocation tracking.

attributes.name: fulfillment_shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shipment that will fulfill this allocation. Links allocation to outbound logistics.

attributes.name: line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific order line item that this allocation fulfills. Enables line-level allocation tracking.

attributes.name: lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.lot. Business justification: Add lot_id FK to lot for proper normalization; lot_number string is redundant.

attributes.name: pick_wave_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the pick wave or batch to which this allocation has been assigned. Supports wave-based fulfillment optimization.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Allocation engine needs SKU attributes (weight, hazardous flag) to calculate pick plans and reserve inventory accurately.

attributes.name: transfer_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to an inter-warehouse transfer order if this allocation is for inventory movement between facilities.

attributes.name: warehouse_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse or fulfillment center from which inventory is allocated.

attributes.name: allocated_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of inventory reserved for this allocation. Reduces Available-to-Promise (ATP) and prevents overselling.

attributes.name: allocation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or special instructions related to this allocation. Captures operational context and exceptions.

attributes.name: allocation_reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason for the allocation or any special handling requirements. Examples: STANDARD, EXPEDITED, REPLACEMENT, SAMPLE.

attributes.name: allocation_source
attributes.description: The system or process that originated this allocation. Distinguishes automated allocations from manual interventions.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the allocation. Tracks progression from reservation through fulfillment or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|confirmed|picked|packed|shipped|cancelled|expired|released — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: allocation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the inventory was allocated to this demand. Represents the business event time of reservation.

attributes.name: allocation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the allocation commitment. Hard allocation is firm and reduces ATP; soft allocation is tentative and may be released; pre-allocation reserves inventory before order confirmation; reservation holds inventory for future demand.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the allocation was cancelled. Examples: customer cancellation, inventory unavailable, order modification, fraud.

attributes.name: cancelled_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the allocation was cancelled. Null if allocation was not cancelled.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this allocation record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: expiry_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this allocation expires if not fulfilled. After expiry, the allocation may be automatically released back to ATP.

attributes.name: hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allocation is on hold and cannot proceed to fulfillment. True if held, False otherwise.

attributes.name: hold_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the allocation is on hold. Examples: payment pending, fraud review, inventory quality check, customer request.

attributes.name: inventory_condition
attributes.description: Physical condition of the allocated inventory. Supports allocation rules that prioritize new stock over returned or refurbished items.

attributes.name: packed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the picked inventory was packed for shipment. Tracks fulfillment milestone.

attributes.name: picked_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity that has been physically picked from the warehouse location. Tracks fulfillment progress.

attributes.name: picked_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the allocated inventory was picked. Marks transition from allocated to in-fulfillment state.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking for this allocation. Higher priority allocations are fulfilled first. Supports SLA-based fulfillment sequencing.

attributes.name: released_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of inventory released from this allocation back to ATP. May differ from allocated quantity if partial fulfillment occurred.

attributes.name: released_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the allocation was released back to ATP. Null if allocation is still active.

attributes.name: shipped_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the allocation was shipped to the customer. Marks completion of the allocation lifecycle.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the allocated quantity is expressed (e.g., each, case, pallet, kg). Aligns with inventory tracking standards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: each|case|pallet|kg|lb|liter|gallon — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this allocation record was last modified. Audit trail for record changes.

attributes.name: warehouse_location_code
attributes.description: Specific bin, aisle, or zone within the warehouse where the allocated inventory resides. Supports pick-path optimization.

products.name: replenishment_order
products.description: Transactional record representing a replenishment request or purchase order trigger generated by the inventory planning engine to restock a SKU at a warehouse node. Captures reorder point breach, suggested order quantity, MOQ constraints, lead time, supplier reference, replenishment type (automatic/manual), approval status, and expected receipt date. Integrates with procurement and ERP for PO creation.
products.reference: Replenishment Order / MRP Planned Order (SAP S/4HANA)

attributes.name: replenishment_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the replenishment order record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Replenishment orders are expense items; they must be booked against a cost center for budgeting and P&L reporting.

attributes.name: seller_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to seller.seller_profile. Business justification: Supports replenishment planning per seller to maintain stock levels for each seller's catalog.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Replenishment rules rely on SKU master data (lead time, safety stock) to generate purchase orders; FK provides that linkage.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supplier or vendor from whom the inventory is being procured for replenishment.

attributes.name: warehouse_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse or fulfillment center node where inventory is being replenished.

attributes.name: actual_receipt_date
attributes.description: The actual date when the replenishment inventory was received at the warehouse. Null until receipt is confirmed.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The approval workflow status for this replenishment order. High-value orders may require manager or procurement approval before submission.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the user who approved this replenishment order for submission to the supplier.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this replenishment order was approved for submission.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: The reason why this replenishment order was cancelled, if applicable. Null for non-cancelled orders.

attributes.name: cancelled_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this replenishment order was cancelled. Null for non-cancelled orders.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this replenishment order record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the order cost (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: current_stock_level
attributes.description: The on-hand inventory quantity at the warehouse node at the time this replenishment order was created.

attributes.name: dsr
attributes.description: The average daily sales rate for this SKU at the time the replenishment order was created, used in demand forecasting and order quantity calculation.

attributes.name: expected_receipt_date
attributes.description: The anticipated date when the replenishment inventory will arrive at the warehouse, calculated from order date plus lead time.

attributes.name: forecast_demand
attributes.description: The projected demand for this SKU over the lead time period, used by the inventory planning engine to calculate optimal order quantity.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: The expected number of days from order submission to receipt at the warehouse, based on supplier lead time and transportation time.

attributes.name: lot_tracking_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU requires lot or batch tracking for FIFO/LIFO inventory management, expiration date tracking, or recall management.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the user or system process that last modified this replenishment order record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this replenishment order record was last modified.

attributes.name: moq
attributes.description: The Minimum Order Quantity constraint imposed by the supplier for this SKU. The order quantity must meet or exceed this threshold.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions, or context related to this replenishment order.

attributes.name: order_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the SKU requested in this replenishment order, calculated by the inventory planning engine or entered manually by the planner.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: The urgency classification of this replenishment order, used to prioritize processing and expedite shipments when necessary.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: The Purchase Order number generated in the ERP system when this replenishment order is approved and submitted to the supplier.

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: The actual quantity received at the warehouse. May differ from order quantity due to partial shipments or supplier shortages.

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: The inventory level threshold that triggered this replenishment order. When on-hand inventory falls below this point, replenishment is initiated.

attributes.name: replenishment_method
attributes.description: The inventory replenishment strategy applied for this SKU: fixed order quantity, fixed period review, min-max, Economic Order Quantity (EOQ), or Just-In-Time (JIT).

attributes.name: replenishment_order_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the replenishment order, used for tracking and reference in procurement and warehouse operations.

attributes.name: replenishment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the replenishment order in the procurement and receiving workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|submitted|in_transit|partially_received|received|cancelled|rejected — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: replenishment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the replenishment order based on trigger mechanism: automatic (system-generated based on reorder point), manual (planner-initiated), emergency (urgent stockout prevention), seasonal (planned for seasonal demand), promotional (campaign-driven), or transfer (inter-warehouse movement).

attributes.name: safety_stock_level
attributes.description: The buffer inventory level maintained to protect against demand variability and supply uncertainty. Used in replenishment calculations.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The originating system that created this replenishment order: WMS (Warehouse Management System), ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning), IPS (Inventory Planning System), or MANUAL (user-initiated).

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this replenishment order was submitted to the supplier or converted to a Purchase Order in the ERP system.

attributes.name: total_order_cost
attributes.description: The total cost of this replenishment order, calculated as order quantity multiplied by unit cost, before taxes and fees.

attributes.name: trigger_event
attributes.description: The business event or condition that initiated the creation of this replenishment order. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: reorder_point_breach|safety_stock_breach|forecast_demand|manual_request|promotional_campaign|stockout_alert|scheduled_replenishment — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: The cost per unit for the SKU as per the supplier contract or purchase agreement. Used for total order cost calculation.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the order quantity (EA=Each, CS=Case, PL=Pallet, BX=Box, KG=Kilogram, LB=Pound, LT=Liter, GL=Gallon). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PL|BX|KG|LB|LT|GL — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: variance_quantity
attributes.description: The difference between ordered quantity and received quantity. Positive indicates over-shipment, negative indicates shortage.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the user or system process that created this replenishment order record.

products.name: inventory_goods_receipt
products.description: Transactional record and SSOT for the complete inbound inventory lifecycle from supplier shipment notification through physical receipt and putaway at a warehouse node. Tracks the full inbound shipment journey including ASN (Advanced Shipping Notice) reference, carrier, tracking number, origin location, destination warehouse node, shipment status (in-transit, arrived, at-dock, receiving, putaway, closed), expected and actual arrival dates, PO reference, supplier, total SKU count, total unit count, received SKU detail, lot number, received quantity, accepted quantity, rejected quantity, unit cost, receipt date, dock door, quality inspection status, and discrepancy flags. Supports both full-container and parcel-level inbound tracking. Triggers stock position updates and lot creation in the WMS upon confirmation. Bridges procurement and inventory receiving workflows for complete inbound visibility from shipment to shelf.

attributes.name: inventory_goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inventory goods receipt transaction. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.carrier. Business justification: Goods receipt audit and inbound logistics cost analysis need a direct carrier FK.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order that authorized this inbound shipment.

attributes.name: seller_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to seller.seller_profile. Business justification: Enables goods receipt reconciliation per seller for payment accuracy and inventory integrity.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supplier or vendor who shipped this inventory.

attributes.name: warehouse_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the destination warehouse node where goods were received.

attributes.name: accepted_unit_count
attributes.description: Total number of units that passed quality inspection and were accepted into inventory.

attributes.name: actual_arrival_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the shipment physically arrived at the warehouse dock or receiving area.

attributes.name: asn_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number from the supplier's Advanced Shipping Notice that pre-notified this inbound shipment.

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_number
attributes.description: Bill of lading number provided by the carrier as proof of shipment and receipt.

attributes.name: container_count
attributes.description: Number of shipping containers, pallets, or packages included in this receipt.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this goods receipt record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the receipt cost amounts.

attributes.name: discrepancy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any discrepancies were found between expected and actual received quantities or conditions.

attributes.name: discrepancy_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes describing any discrepancies, damages, shortages, or overages identified during receiving.

attributes.name: dock_door_number
attributes.description: Specific dock door or bay number where the shipment was received at the warehouse.

attributes.name: expected_arrival_date
attributes.description: Planned or estimated date when the shipment is expected to arrive at the destination warehouse.

attributes.name: expected_unit_count
attributes.description: Total number of units that were expected to be received based on the purchase order or ASN.

attributes.name: freight_cost
attributes.description: Transportation and freight charges associated with this inbound shipment.

attributes.name: inspection_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when quality inspection was completed for this receipt.

attributes.name: inspector_name
attributes.description: Name of the warehouse personnel or quality inspector who performed the receiving inspection.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this goods receipt record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer or supplier lot number for traceability and FIFO/LIFO inventory management.

attributes.name: origin_location
attributes.description: Geographic location or facility from which the shipment originated (supplier warehouse, manufacturing plant, or distribution center).

attributes.name: putaway_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when all received goods were moved from the receiving area to their designated storage locations.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_status
attributes.description: Status of the quality inspection process for this goods receipt. Determines whether goods can be released to inventory.

attributes.name: receipt_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the receiving process was completed and all items were accounted for.

attributes.name: receipt_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for this goods receipt transaction. Used for tracking and reference across systems.

attributes.name: receipt_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when warehouse personnel began the physical receiving process (unloading and inspection).

attributes.name: receipt_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the goods receipt process. Tracks progression from shipment notification through final putaway completion. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: in_transit|arrived|at_dock|receiving|putaway|closed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: receiving_notes
attributes.description: General notes or comments recorded by receiving personnel during the goods receipt process.

attributes.name: recorded_temperature
attributes.description: Temperature recorded upon receipt for temperature-sensitive shipments, measured in degrees Celsius.

attributes.name: rejected_unit_count
attributes.description: Total number of units that failed quality inspection and were rejected or quarantined.

attributes.name: seal_intact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the container seal was intact upon arrival, confirming no tampering occurred during transit.

attributes.name: seal_number
attributes.description: Security seal number applied to the shipping container, verified upon receipt to ensure shipment integrity.

attributes.name: shipment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the inbound shipment format. Determines handling and receiving procedures.

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shipment required temperature-controlled handling (refrigerated or frozen goods).

attributes.name: total_receipt_cost
attributes.description: Total landed cost of all goods received in this transaction, including unit costs and any applicable freight or handling charges.

attributes.name: total_sku_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct SKUs included in this goods receipt.
attributes.references: GS1 Standards - GTIN (Global Trade Item Number)

attributes.name: total_unit_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual units (eaches) received across all SKUs in this shipment.

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier-provided tracking number for end-to-end shipment visibility.
attributes.references: GS1 Standards - SSCC (Serial Shipping Container Code)

products.name: cycle_count
products.description: Transactional record for a scheduled or ad-hoc physical inventory count task at a specific warehouse location or zone. Tracks count date, assigned counter, location or zone scope, count method (full/partial/ABC), expected quantity, counted quantity, variance quantity, variance percentage, count status (scheduled, in-progress, completed, reconciled), and approval status. Supports WMS cycle counting programs and inventory accuracy KPIs.

attributes.name: cycle_count_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cycle count task. Primary key for the cycle count record.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) being counted. Links to product master data.

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Specific storage location or bin within the warehouse being counted. Links to location master data.

attributes.name: warehouse_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse where the cycle count is performed. Links to the warehouse master data.

attributes.name: zone_id
attributes.description: Warehouse zone or area being counted. Used for zone-based cycle counting programs.

attributes.name: abc_classification
attributes.description: ABC classification of the SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) being counted: A (high-value, frequent count), B (medium-value, moderate count), C (low-value, infrequent count). Drives cycle count frequency.

attributes.name: actual_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the cycle count task was completed. Used to calculate count duration and productivity metrics.

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the cycle count task actually began. Used to track SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance and operational efficiency.

attributes.name: adjustment_posted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the inventory adjustment has been posted to the WMS (Warehouse Management System) and ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) systems. True if posted, false if pending.

attributes.name: adjustment_posted_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the inventory adjustment was posted to the system of record. Used for financial reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval status of the cycle count results: pending (awaiting review), approved (variance accepted), or rejected (count disputed).

attributes.name: approved_by_user_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the supervisor or manager who approved the cycle count results. Links to employee master data.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the cycle count results were approved. Used for audit trail and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: assigned_counter_name
attributes.description: Name of the warehouse employee assigned to perform the cycle count. Used for reporting and accountability.

attributes.name: assigned_counter_user_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse employee assigned to perform the cycle count. Links to employee master data.

attributes.name: count_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total time in minutes taken to complete the cycle count task. Calculated from actual start and end timestamps. Used for productivity analysis.

attributes.name: count_method
attributes.description: Method used to perform the physical count: manual (visual count), rfid (radio frequency identification), barcode_scan (handheld scanner), or automated (system-driven).

attributes.name: count_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the cycle count task. Human-readable reference number used in WMS and reporting.

attributes.name: count_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cycle count task: scheduled (planned), assigned (allocated to counter), in_progress (counting underway), completed (count finished), reconciled (variance resolved), or cancelled.

attributes.name: count_type
attributes.description: Type of cycle count being performed: full (complete inventory), partial (sample), abc (frequency-based), blind (no expected quantity shown), or spot (random verification).

attributes.name: counted_quantity
attributes.description: Actual physical quantity counted by the warehouse employee. This is the observed inventory level.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the cycle count record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: expected_quantity
attributes.description: System-recorded quantity expected to be found during the count. Sourced from WMS (Warehouse Management System) inventory records.

attributes.name: inventory_value_variance
attributes.description: Financial impact of the variance calculated as variance quantity multiplied by unit cost. Used for financial reporting and shrinkage analysis.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Lot or batch number of the inventory being counted. Used for FIFO (First In First Out) / LIFO (Last In First Out) tracking and traceability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the cycle count record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the cycle count task: critical (immediate attention), high (urgent), medium (standard), or low (routine). Used for task scheduling and resource allocation.

attributes.name: recount_number
attributes.description: Sequential number indicating which recount attempt this is (1 for first recount, 2 for second, etc.). Zero if no recount performed.

attributes.name: recount_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a recount is required due to variance exceeding tolerance threshold. True if recount needed, false otherwise.

attributes.name: scheduled_date
attributes.description: Date when the cycle count task is scheduled to be performed. Used for planning and resource allocation.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the cycle count task is scheduled to begin. Used for shift planning and resource scheduling.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Serial number of the specific item being counted. Used for serialized inventory tracking and warranty management.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit in which the count is recorded: EA (each), CS (case), PL (pallet), BX (box), KG (kilogram), LB (pound). Aligns with SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) base unit.

attributes.name: variance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes explaining the variance, corrective actions taken, or additional context. Used for root cause analysis and continuous improvement.

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: Variance expressed as a percentage of expected quantity. Used to assess inventory accuracy and trigger investigation thresholds.

attributes.name: variance_quantity
attributes.description: Difference between expected and counted quantities (counted minus expected). Positive indicates overage, negative indicates shortage.

attributes.name: variance_reason_code
attributes.description: Categorized reason for inventory variance: damaged (product damage), theft (shrinkage), miscount (counting error), system_error (WMS issue), receiving_error (inbound error), picking_error (outbound error), or other. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: damaged|theft|miscount|system_error|receiving_error|picking_error|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: adjustment
products.description: Transactional record documenting a manual or system-initiated correction to stock quantity or value at a specific location and lot. Captures adjustment reason (shrinkage, damage, count variance, system error, expiry write-off), adjusted quantity (positive or negative), adjusted value, authorizing user, and reference to the originating cycle count or investigation. Provides the financial reconciliation trail for inventory write-offs.

attributes.name: adjustment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inventory adjustment transaction. Primary key.

attributes.name: cycle_count_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating cycle count event that triggered this adjustment, if applicable. Supports traceability from physical count to financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 - Quality Management, Internal Audit Standards

attributes.name: investigation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the inventory discrepancy investigation or loss prevention case that resulted in this adjustment. Links to root cause analysis workflows.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Internal Controls, ISO 31000 - Risk Management

attributes.name: original_adjustment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original adjustment transaction being reversed, if this record is a reversal. Maintains audit trail for corrections.

attributes.name: warehouse_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse or fulfillment center where the inventory adjustment occurred.

attributes.name: adjusted_quantity
attributes.description: The net quantity change applied to inventory. Positive values indicate additions to stock; negative values indicate reductions. Measured in the SKU's unit of measure (UOM).

attributes.name: adjusted_value
attributes.description: The total financial value of the adjustment, calculated as adjusted_quantity × unit_cost. Represents the General Ledger (GL) impact for inventory write-offs or additions.
attributes.references: GAAP - Financial Reporting, SOX Section 404, IAS 2

attributes.name: adjustment_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the adjustment transaction, typically formatted as ADJ-YYYYMMDD-NNNN for external reference and audit trail.

attributes.name: adjustment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the adjustment transaction. Controls whether the adjustment has been applied to inventory balances and financial ledgers.

attributes.name: adjustment_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the physical or system adjustment event occurred. Distinct from record creation timestamp; represents the real-world business event time.

attributes.name: adjustment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the adjustment reason. Determines financial treatment and operational follow-up actions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: shrinkage|damage|count_variance|system_error|expiry_write_off|return_to_stock|transfer_correction|theft|obsolescence — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GAAP - Generally Accepted Accounting Principles, IAS 2 - Inventories

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the adjustment was formally approved by an authorized user. Marks the transition to posted status.

attributes.name: authorized_by_user_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who approved and authorized the adjustment. Required for segregation of duties and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The cost center responsible for the inventory adjustment. Used for internal financial reporting and variance accountability.
attributes.references: Management Accounting Standards, SAP Controlling (CO) Module

attributes.name: created_by_user_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who initiated or recorded the adjustment transaction in the system.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 - Information Security, NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this adjustment record was first created in the system. Audit field for record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the adjusted value. Supports multi-currency inventory valuation for global operations.

attributes.name: external_reference_number
attributes.description: Optional reference to an external document or transaction ID, such as a Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) number, supplier claim, or insurance case number.
attributes.references: EDI X12 Standards, Internal Document Management Policy

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The GL account number to which the inventory adjustment value was posted. Typically an inventory shrinkage or write-off account.
attributes.references: GAAP - Chart of Accounts, SAP S/4HANA GL Master Data

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting period date when the adjustment was posted to the General Ledger. May differ from adjustment_timestamp due to period-end cutoffs.
attributes.references: GAAP - Period Close, IAS 1 - Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this adjustment record was last updated. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Specific bin, aisle, or zone code within the warehouse where the adjustment was recorded. Supports granular inventory tracking per Warehouse Management System (WMS) location hierarchy.
attributes.references: ISO 3166 - Country Codes, Internal WMS Standards

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Batch or lot identifier for inventory tracking under First In First Out (FIFO) or Last In First Out (LIFO) methodologies. Critical for expiry management and recall traceability.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records, GS1 GTIN Management

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, investigation findings, or operational details related to the adjustment. Supports audit and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: posted_to_gl_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the adjustment has been posted to the financial General Ledger. True when the financial impact has been recorded in the ERP system.
attributes.references: GAAP - Financial Reporting, SAP S/4HANA Finance Documentation

attributes.name: quantity_after_adjustment
attributes.description: The resulting on-hand inventory quantity after the adjustment is applied. Calculated as quantity_before_adjustment + adjusted_quantity.

attributes.name: quantity_before_adjustment
attributes.description: The on-hand inventory quantity recorded in the system immediately prior to the adjustment. Provides audit trail for variance analysis.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Detailed reason code providing granular classification for the adjustment. Used for root cause analysis and loss prevention reporting.
attributes.references: Internal Inventory Control Policy, SOX Section 404 - Internal Controls

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this adjustment is a reversal of a previously posted adjustment. True when correcting an erroneous prior adjustment.
attributes.references: GAAP - Error Corrections, IAS 8 - Accounting Policies

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: The unique product identifier for which inventory is being adjusted. Links to the product catalog for item-level traceability.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The originating system or interface that created the adjustment record. Supports data lineage and integration troubleshooting.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 - Information Security, Data Governance Framework

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: The per-unit cost of the SKU at the time of adjustment, used to calculate the financial impact. Sourced from the Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system's inventory valuation layer.
attributes.references: GAAP - Inventory Valuation, IAS 2 - Cost Formulas

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the adjusted quantity is expressed. Must align with the SKU's base UOM in the Product Information Management (PIM) system. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: each|case|pallet|kg|lb|liter|gallon — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: transfer_order
products.description: Transactional record managing the inter-warehouse or inter-location movement of inventory. Captures source warehouse, destination warehouse, SKU, lot, transfer quantity, transfer type (replenishment, rebalancing, returns processing), requested date, confirmed ship date, in-transit quantity, and transfer status (created, picked, shipped, received, closed). Supports multi-node inventory rebalancing and fulfillment network optimization.
products.reference: Stock Transfer Order / STO (SAP MM / WMS)

attributes.name: transfer_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the transfer order. Primary key for the transfer order entity.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the transportation carrier handling the transfer shipment. Links to carrier master data for tracking and performance analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 6523 - Structure for Identification of Organizations

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Inter‑warehouse transfer expenses are allocated to a cost center for internal charge‑back and profitability reporting.

attributes.name: destination_warehouse_warehouse_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse or fulfillment center to which inventory is being transferred.
attributes.references: ISO 6523 - Structure for Identification of Organizations

attributes.name: primary_transfer_warehouse_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse or fulfillment center from which inventory is being transferred.
attributes.references: ISO 6523 - Structure for Identification of Organizations

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.route. Business justification: Transfer orders use defined logistics routes; FK supports route planning, cost allocation, and SLA tracking.

attributes.name: seller_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to seller.seller_profile. Business justification: Needed for Transfer Order Ownership Report, attributing inter‑warehouse transfers to the responsible seller.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Transfer orders move inventory of a particular SKU between warehouses; FK enables validation of SKU attributes and regulatory flags.

attributes.name: approved_by_user_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who approved the transfer order. Nullable until approval is granted. Used for authorization audit trail.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date when the transfer order was approved by inventory management or warehouse operations. Nullable for orders not yet approved.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the transfer order was cancelled. Nullable for non-cancelled orders. Used for process improvement analysis.

attributes.name: cancelled_by_user_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who cancelled the transfer order. Nullable for non-cancelled orders. Used for exception tracking and audit.

attributes.name: closed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the transfer order was closed after successful receipt and reconciliation. Nullable until order is closed. Used for cycle time analysis.

attributes.name: created_by_user_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system that created the transfer order. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the transfer order record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and order age analysis.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for freight cost. Enables multi-currency transfer cost tracking.

attributes.name: destination_location_code
attributes.description: Specific bin, aisle, or zone location within the destination warehouse where inventory will be stored. Used for putaway planning.

attributes.name: expected_delivery_date
attributes.description: Estimated date when the transfer shipment will arrive at the destination warehouse. Used for receiving planning and inventory availability forecasting.

attributes.name: freight_cost
attributes.description: Transportation cost for the transfer shipment in the company's base currency. Used for transfer cost allocation and network optimization analysis.

attributes.name: in_transit_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity currently in transit between warehouses. Used for real-time inventory visibility and available-to-promise calculations.

attributes.name: is_cross_dock
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this transfer bypasses storage and goes directly to outbound shipping. Used for fast-moving inventory optimization.
attributes.references: APICS Supply Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) Model

attributes.name: is_hazmat
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the transferred inventory contains hazardous materials requiring special handling and compliance documentation.
attributes.references: US DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations (49 CFR)

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Lot or batch identifier for inventory tracking. Used for FIFO/LIFO inventory management and traceability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the transfer order record was last modified. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or special instructions for the transfer order. Captures handling requirements, quality concerns, or operational exceptions.

attributes.name: picked_date
attributes.description: Date when inventory was picked from source warehouse location. Nullable until picking is completed.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification for processing the transfer order. Determines sequencing in warehouse pick queues and carrier selection.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Detailed reason code for the transfer. Provides granular classification for transfer analytics and root cause analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: stock_out|demand_spike|seasonal_prep|excess_inventory|product_recall|damage|expiry|network_optimization — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: APICS Supply Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) Model

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: Date when inventory was received and checked in at the destination warehouse. Nullable until receipt is completed.

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity received at destination warehouse. May differ from transfer quantity due to damage, loss, or discrepancies.

attributes.name: requested_date
attributes.description: Date by which the transfer is requested to be completed. Used for replenishment planning and fulfillment network optimization.

attributes.name: shipment_method
attributes.description: Transportation mode used for the transfer. Determines transit time and cost for network optimization.

attributes.name: shipped_date
attributes.description: Date when the transfer shipment departed the source warehouse. Used for in-transit inventory tracking and SLA monitoring.

attributes.name: source_location_code
attributes.description: Specific bin, aisle, or zone location within the source warehouse from which inventory is picked. Enables precise inventory tracking.

attributes.name: temperature_controlled
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the transfer requires temperature-controlled transportation. Used for cold chain compliance and carrier selection.

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier-provided tracking number for the transfer shipment. Used for real-time shipment visibility and exception management.

attributes.name: transfer_order_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible business identifier for the transfer order. Human-readable reference number used in warehouse operations and tracking systems.

attributes.name: transfer_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of units being transferred from source to destination warehouse. Measured in the SKU's base unit of measure.

attributes.name: transfer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the transfer order. Tracks the order through warehouse operations from creation to completion. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: created|approved|picked|packed|shipped|in_transit|received|closed|cancelled — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: APICS Supply Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) Model

attributes.name: transfer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the transfer order purpose. Indicates the business reason for the inter-warehouse movement.
attributes.references: APICS Supply Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) Model

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the transfer quantity. Defines how the transferred inventory is counted and tracked.

attributes.name: variance_quantity
attributes.description: Difference between transfer quantity and received quantity. Positive indicates overage, negative indicates shortage. Used for inventory reconciliation.

products.name: oos_event
products.description: Transactional record capturing an out-of-stock (OOS) event for a SKU at a warehouse node or virtual location. Records OOS start timestamp, OOS end timestamp, OOS duration, root cause classification (demand spike, replenishment delay, supplier stockout, forecast miss), estimated lost revenue, affected order count, and resolution action taken. Feeds OOS rate KPIs and replenishment policy reviews.

attributes.name: oos_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the out-of-stock event record.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Out‑of‑stock events generate cost impact; linking to a cost center enables OOS cost attribution in financial analysis.

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_obligation. Business justification: Out‑of‑stock events may stem from compliance‑driven supply constraints; linking supports the Compliance‑Driven OOS analysis report.

attributes.name: replenishment_order_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the purchase order or replenishment order created to resolve this OOS event.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Out‑of‑stock analysis requires SKU master data to calculate lost revenue, safety‑stock impact, and demand forecasts.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supplier responsible for replenishing this SKU, relevant for root cause analysis when supplier stockout is the cause.

attributes.name: warehouse_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse or fulfillment center where the OOS event occurred.

attributes.name: actual_replenishment_days
attributes.description: The actual number of days it took to replenish inventory and resolve the OOS event, measured from OOS start to end.

attributes.name: affected_order_count
attributes.description: Number of customer orders that were impacted, cancelled, or could not be fulfilled due to this OOS event.

attributes.name: assigned_to
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the team member or role responsible for managing and resolving this OOS event.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this OOS event record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the estimated lost revenue amount.

attributes.name: customer_impact_score
attributes.description: Calculated score representing the severity of customer experience impact from this OOS event, based on affected orders, customer tier, and product importance.

attributes.name: demand_spike_factor
attributes.description: Multiplier representing how much actual demand exceeded forecasted demand during the OOS event (e.g., 2.5 means demand was 250% of forecast).

attributes.name: detected_by
attributes.description: The source or method by which the OOS event was detected (automated system, manual audit, customer complaint, warehouse staff, demand planner).

attributes.name: dsr_at_oos
attributes.description: The average daily sales rate for this SKU at this location calculated at the time the OOS event occurred, used for replenishment velocity planning.

attributes.name: estimated_lost_revenue
attributes.description: Calculated estimate of revenue lost due to the OOS event based on historical sales velocity and average selling price.

attributes.name: forecast_accuracy_pct
attributes.description: The demand forecast accuracy percentage for this SKU in the period leading up to the OOS event, used to assess forecast miss as root cause.

attributes.name: inventory_level_at_oos
attributes.description: The inventory quantity recorded at the moment the OOS event was triggered (typically zero or below safety stock threshold).

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: The standard supplier lead time in days for replenishing this SKU, used to assess whether replenishment delay contributed to the OOS event.

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the location where the OOS event occurred (physical warehouse, virtual location, fulfillment center, etc.).

attributes.name: lost_unit_sales
attributes.description: Estimated number of product units that could not be sold during the OOS period based on demand forecasts and historical sales rate.

attributes.name: oos_duration_hours
attributes.description: Total duration of the OOS event measured in hours from start to end (or to current time if ongoing).

attributes.name: oos_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when inventory was replenished and the OOS condition ended. Null if still out of stock.

attributes.name: oos_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the SKU inventory reached zero and the OOS condition began.

attributes.name: oos_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the OOS event (active if still out of stock, resolved if inventory replenished, pending replenishment if order placed, cancelled if event invalidated).

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to resolving this OOS event based on SKU importance, revenue impact, and customer demand.

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: The product category or classification of the SKU experiencing the OOS event, used for category-level OOS rate analysis.

attributes.name: promotional_event_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a promotional campaign or marketing event was active during the OOS event, potentially causing demand spike.

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: The inventory level threshold that should have triggered replenishment action to prevent this OOS event.

attributes.name: resolution_action_taken
attributes.description: The primary corrective action taken to resolve the OOS event (emergency replenishment, supplier expedite, inventory transfer, customer notification, substitute offered, backorder created).

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes documenting the actions taken, decisions made, and outcomes of the resolution process for this OOS event.

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: Primary classification of the root cause that led to the OOS event (demand spike, replenishment delay, supplier stockout, forecast miss, system error, quality hold).
attributes.references: Internal Supply Chain Root Cause Analysis Framework

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of the specific circumstances and factors that caused the OOS event.

attributes.name: safety_stock_level
attributes.description: The configured safety stock threshold for this SKU at this location at the time of the OOS event.

attributes.name: seasonality_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is subject to seasonal demand patterns that may have contributed to the OOS event.

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the OOS event duration exceeded the defined service level agreement threshold for inventory availability.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this OOS event record was last modified or updated.

products.name: replenishment_rule
products.description: Master configuration record and SSOT defining the complete replenishment policy and safety stock parameters for a SKU-warehouse node combination. Stores reorder point (ROP), reorder quantity (ROQ), safety stock quantity, safety stock days of cover, maximum stock level, MOQ, lead time days, DSR baseline, replenishment method (min-max, fixed-period, demand-driven), review cycle, safety stock calculation method (statistical, fixed, seasonal), demand variability coefficient, supplier lead time variability, service level target percentage, last recalculation date, and safety stock optimization parameters. Serves as the unified SSOT for both replenishment triggers and safety stock buffering logic — no separate safety stock configuration exists. Drives automated replenishment order generation, dynamic safety stock optimization based on demand/supply variability, and integrates with ERP procurement planning.

attributes.name: replenishment_rule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the replenishment rule configuration record. Primary key.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) to which this replenishment rule applies.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary supplier for this SKU replenishment. Links to the supplier master for procurement execution.

attributes.name: warehouse_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse node or fulfillment center where this replenishment rule is active.

attributes.name: abc_classification
attributes.description: The ABC inventory classification category for this SKU. A items are high-value/high-velocity, C items are low-value/low-velocity.

attributes.name: auto_replenishment_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether automated replenishment order generation is enabled for this rule. When true, orders are created automatically when triggers are met.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this replenishment rule record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: demand_variability_coefficient
attributes.description: Statistical measure of demand volatility for this SKU. Used in safety stock optimization to account for demand uncertainty.

attributes.name: dsr_baseline
attributes.description: The baseline average daily sales rate for this SKU at this warehouse. Used as the demand input for replenishment and safety stock calculations.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this replenishment rule expires or is no longer applicable. Null indicates an open-ended rule.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this replenishment rule becomes active and applicable for order generation.

attributes.name: forecast_accuracy_percentage
attributes.description: Historical forecast accuracy for this SKU-warehouse combination. Used to adjust safety stock and replenishment parameters.

attributes.name: holding_cost_per_unit_per_day
attributes.business_glossary_term: Holding Cost Per Unit Per Day
attributes.description: The daily cost of holding one unit of this SKU in inventory. Includes warehousing, capital, insurance, and obsolescence costs.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this replenishment rule record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: last_recalculation_date
attributes.description: The date when the replenishment parameters (ROP, ROQ, safety stock) were last recalculated or optimized based on updated demand and supply data.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: The expected number of days between placing a replenishment order and receiving the inventory at the warehouse. Used for reorder point calculations.

attributes.name: lot_sizing_rule
attributes.description: The rule used to determine the size of replenishment lots. Complements the replenishment method with specific quantity logic.

attributes.name: maximum_stock_level
attributes.description: The upper inventory threshold for this SKU-warehouse combination. Used in min-max replenishment strategies to cap inventory levels.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: The smallest order quantity allowed by supplier or business rules. Replenishment orders must meet or exceed this threshold.
attributes.references: Supplier Contract Terms - Standard Procurement Practices

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next review and potential recalculation of replenishment parameters.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this replenishment rule. Used for documenting special conditions, exceptions, or planning context.

attributes.name: order_multiple
attributes.description: The quantity increment in which orders must be placed. Replenishment quantities are rounded to the nearest multiple of this value.
attributes.references: Supplier Contract Terms - Standard Procurement Practices

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: The priority ranking of this SKU for replenishment planning. Higher priority items receive preferential treatment in allocation and ordering.

attributes.name: procurement_category
attributes.description: The procurement category or commodity group to which this SKU belongs. Used for sourcing strategy and supplier management.

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: The inventory level threshold that triggers a replenishment order. When on-hand inventory falls to or below this quantity, a new order is initiated.

attributes.name: reorder_quantity
attributes.description: The standard quantity to order when the reorder point is reached. Represents the replenishment order size.

attributes.name: replenishment_method
attributes.description: The replenishment strategy applied for this SKU-warehouse combination. Defines the logic used to trigger replenishment orders.

attributes.name: replenishment_rule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the replenishment rule. Determines whether the rule is actively used for order generation.

attributes.name: review_cycle_days
attributes.description: The frequency in days at which inventory levels are reviewed for replenishment decisions. Applies to periodic review replenishment methods.

attributes.name: rule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label for this replenishment rule configuration.

attributes.name: safety_stock_calculation_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to calculate the safety stock quantity. Determines how demand and supply variability are factored into the buffer.

attributes.name: safety_stock_days
attributes.description: The number of days of demand coverage provided by the safety stock quantity. Used for planning and service level calculations.

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: The buffer inventory quantity maintained to protect against demand variability and supply uncertainty. Part of the unified replenishment and safety stock policy.
attributes.references: ISO 22400 - Key Performance Indicators for Manufacturing

attributes.name: seasonality_factor
attributes.description: Adjustment factor applied to baseline demand to account for seasonal demand patterns. Used in seasonal safety stock calculations.

attributes.name: service_level_target_percentage
attributes.description: The target in-stock service level percentage for this SKU-warehouse combination. Drives safety stock sizing to meet availability goals.

attributes.name: stockout_cost_per_unit
attributes.description: The estimated business cost incurred per unit when this SKU is out of stock. Used in economic optimization of safety stock levels.

attributes.name: supplier_lead_time_variability
attributes.description: Statistical measure of supplier delivery time variability. Used in safety stock calculations to account for supply uncertainty.

products.name: safety_stock_rule
products.description: Master record defining safety stock parameters for a SKU at a warehouse node, calculated to buffer against demand variability and supply uncertainty. Captures safety stock quantity, safety stock days of cover, calculation method (statistical, fixed, seasonal), demand variability coefficient, supplier lead time variability, service level target percentage, and last recalculation date. Supports dynamic safety stock optimization.
products.reference: Safety Stock Policy / Buffer Stock Parameters

attributes.name: safety_stock_rule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the safety stock rule record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Safety‑stock calculations allocate holding cost to a cost center, needed for cost‑of‑goods‑sold and inventory valuation reports.

attributes.name: warehouse_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse or distribution center node where this safety stock rule applies.

attributes.name: abc_classification
attributes.description: Inventory classification based on value and volume: A (high value, tight control), B (moderate), C (low value, loose control).

attributes.name: average_daily_demand
attributes.description: The mean daily sales rate or demand for this SKU at this warehouse node, used as baseline for safety stock calculation.

attributes.name: average_lead_time_days
attributes.description: The mean supplier or replenishment lead time in days for this SKU at this location.

attributes.name: calculation_frequency
attributes.description: How often the safety stock quantity is automatically recalculated to reflect changing demand patterns and supply conditions.

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to calculate safety stock quantity: statistical (based on demand variability), fixed (constant buffer), seasonal (adjusted for seasonality), dynamic (real-time optimization), min-max (reorder point logic), or service level (target fill rate).

attributes.name: created_by_user_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system process that created this safety stock rule record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this safety stock rule record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: demand_forecast_horizon_days
attributes.description: The number of days into the future for which demand forecasts are considered in safety stock calculation.

attributes.name: demand_variability_coefficient
attributes.description: Statistical measure of demand volatility (standard deviation or coefficient of variation) used in safety stock calculation to account for demand uncertainty.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this safety stock rule expires or is superseded by a new rule. Null indicates an open-ended rule.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this safety stock rule becomes active and is applied in inventory calculations.

attributes.name: holding_cost_per_unit_per_day
attributes.business_glossary_term: Holding Cost Per Unit Per Day
attributes.description: The daily cost of carrying one unit of inventory, including warehousing, insurance, obsolescence, and capital cost.

attributes.name: is_promotional_product
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this SKU is frequently subject to promotional campaigns that create demand spikes.

attributes.name: is_seasonal_product
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this SKU exhibits seasonal demand patterns requiring adjusted safety stock strategies.

attributes.name: last_calculation_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which the safety stock quantity was recalculated based on updated demand and lead time data.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system process that most recently updated this safety stock rule record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this safety stock rule record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: lead_time_variability_days
attributes.description: The standard deviation or variance in supplier lead time measured in days, capturing supply uncertainty for safety stock calculation.

attributes.name: maximum_stock_level
attributes.description: The upper inventory threshold for this SKU at this location, used in min-max inventory control systems.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum quantity that must be ordered from the supplier, which may influence safety stock levels and reorder point calculations.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next review and potential recalculation of this safety stock rule.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text comments or annotations about this safety stock rule for operational reference and knowledge transfer.

attributes.name: override_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation when safety stock levels are manually overridden from system-calculated values, documenting business justification.

attributes.name: priority_classification
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to this SKU for safety stock management, influencing service level targets and buffer sizing.

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: The inventory level at which a replenishment order should be triggered, calculated as lead time demand plus safety stock.

attributes.name: review_period_days
attributes.description: The frequency in days at which inventory levels are reviewed and replenishment decisions are made for this SKU.

attributes.name: rule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label for this safety stock rule configuration.

attributes.name: rule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the safety stock rule indicating whether it is actively applied in inventory planning.

attributes.name: safety_stock_days_of_cover
attributes.description: The number of days of average demand that the safety stock quantity represents, providing a time-based buffer metric.

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: The calculated safety stock quantity in units that should be maintained as buffer inventory to protect against stockouts.
attributes.references: ISO 22400 - Key Performance Indicators for Manufacturing

attributes.name: seasonality_factor
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to safety stock during seasonal demand periods to adjust buffer levels for predictable demand fluctuations.

attributes.name: service_level_target_percentage
attributes.description: The target in-stock probability or fill rate percentage (e.g., 95.00, 99.00) that this safety stock rule is designed to achieve.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: The unique product identifier for which this safety stock rule applies. Links to the product catalog.

attributes.name: stockout_cost_per_unit
attributes.description: The estimated business cost incurred per unit when a stockout occurs, including lost sales, expedited shipping, and customer dissatisfaction.

attributes.name: supplier_reliability_score
attributes.description: Quantitative score (0-100) measuring supplier on-time delivery performance and quality, influencing safety stock buffer requirements.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which safety stock quantity is expressed (each, case, pallet, weight, volume). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: each|case|pallet|kg|lb|liter|gallon — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: z_score
attributes.description: The standard normal distribution z-score corresponding to the service level target, used in statistical safety stock formulas.

products.name: snapshot
products.description: Periodic point-in-time snapshot of stock positions across all warehouse nodes and SKUs, captured at end-of-day or end-of-period for reconciliation, financial reporting, and trend analysis. Records snapshot timestamp, SKU, warehouse node, on-hand quantity, reserved quantity, in-transit quantity, unit cost, total inventory value, and days-of-cover. Supports SOX inventory valuation and FIFO cost layer reconciliation.

attributes.name: snapshot_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inventory snapshot record. Primary key.

attributes.name: lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.lot. Business justification: Add lot_id FK to lot for proper normalization; lot_number string is redundant.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Periodic inventory snapshots must reference SKU details for valuation, reporting, and trend analysis.

attributes.name: warehouse_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse, distribution center, or virtual inventory location where this stock position is held. Supports multi-node inventory visibility.

attributes.name: available_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the SKU available for new orders, calculated as on-hand quantity minus reserved quantity. Represents sellable inventory.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this snapshot record was first created in the data warehouse, used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the unit cost and total inventory value are denominated.

attributes.name: cycle_count_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent cycle count performed for this SKU at this warehouse node, used to track inventory accuracy and audit compliance.
