attributes.name: damaged_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the SKU identified as damaged or defective at the time of the snapshot. Typically marked for return to supplier or disposal.

attributes.name: days_of_cover
attributes.description: The number of days the current on-hand inventory can support expected demand, calculated as on-hand quantity divided by daily sales rate (DSR). Used for inventory health monitoring.

attributes.name: dsr
attributes.description: The average daily sales rate for this SKU at this warehouse node, used to calculate days of cover and forecast future inventory needs.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The expiration or best-before date for perishable or time-sensitive SKUs in this inventory position, used for inventory rotation and waste prevention.

attributes.name: fifo_cost_layer_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: First In First Out (FIFO) Cost Layer ID
attributes.description: Identifier linking this snapshot to a specific FIFO cost layer for inventory valuation and cost of goods sold reconciliation under FIFO accounting method.

attributes.name: in_transit_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the SKU currently in transit to this warehouse node from suppliers or other distribution centers, expected to arrive and increase on-hand stock.

attributes.name: inventory_status
attributes.description: The overall status classification of this inventory position, indicating whether the stock is available for sale, held for specific purposes, or flagged for special handling. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: available|reserved|quarantine|damaged|in_transit|expired|obsolete — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this snapshot record was last modified or refreshed in the data warehouse, supporting change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the warehouse node type where this inventory is held, distinguishing between physical warehouses, virtual inventory pools, cross-dock facilities, retail stores, or vendor-managed inventory locations.

attributes.name: moq
attributes.description: The minimum order quantity required by the supplier for replenishment orders of this SKU, used in replenishment planning calculations.

attributes.name: on_hand_quantity
attributes.description: The physical quantity of the SKU available in the warehouse at the time of the snapshot. Represents actual stock on shelves or in bins.

attributes.name: oos_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that is true when the available quantity for this SKU at this warehouse node is zero or below safety stock, signaling a stockout condition.

attributes.name: quarantine_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the SKU held in quarantine due to quality control holds, damage inspection, or regulatory compliance checks. Not available for sale until released.

attributes.name: reorder_point_quantity
attributes.description: The inventory level at which a replenishment order should be triggered for this SKU at this warehouse node to maintain optimal stock levels.

attributes.name: replenishment_status
attributes.description: The replenishment health status for this SKU at this warehouse node, indicating whether stock levels are adequate, require replenishment, or are overstocked.

attributes.name: reserved_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the SKU that is allocated to pending orders or fulfillment processes but not yet shipped. Reduces available-to-promise inventory.

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum quantity of the SKU that should be maintained at this warehouse node to prevent stockouts and ensure service level agreements are met.

attributes.name: snapshot_date
attributes.description: The business date for which this inventory snapshot represents the stock position, used for daily trend analysis and period-over-period comparisons.

attributes.name: snapshot_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when this inventory snapshot was captured, typically end-of-day or end-of-period for reconciliation and financial reporting purposes.

attributes.name: snapshot_type
attributes.description: Classification of the snapshot based on the reporting period it represents, such as daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, yearly, or ad-hoc snapshots for special reconciliation needs.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The source system from which this inventory snapshot data was extracted, such as Warehouse Management System, Enterprise Resource Planning system, or Order Management System.

attributes.name: total_inventory_value
attributes.description: The total monetary value of the on-hand inventory for this SKU at this warehouse node, calculated as on-hand quantity multiplied by unit cost. Used for financial reporting and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: The per-unit cost of the SKU at the time of the snapshot, used for inventory valuation and cost of goods sold calculations. Supports FIFO, LIFO, or weighted average costing methods.

attributes.name: variance_quantity
attributes.description: The difference between the system-recorded on-hand quantity and the physically counted quantity from the most recent cycle count, indicating inventory accuracy.

products.name: warehouse_node
products.description: Master record for a physical or virtual warehouse node in the fulfillment network, including distribution centers, fulfillment centers, dark stores, 3PL facilities, and virtual drop-ship nodes. Captures node code, node type, address, geographic coordinates, capacity (sqft and pallet positions), operating hours, supported fulfillment types (FBA-style, BOPIS, DTC), and active status. SSOT for warehouse network topology.

attributes.name: warehouse_node_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a warehouse node record in the fulfillment network. Primary key for the warehouse_node master data product.

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the warehouse node facility. Used for carrier pickup scheduling, regulatory filings, and geographic routing in the TMS.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; Transportation Management System (TMS) - Facility Address

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for the warehouse node (suite, dock number, building identifier). Supplements address_line1 for precise carrier and logistics routing.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Transportation Management System (TMS) - Facility Address

attributes.name: capacity_sqft
attributes.description: Total usable floor area of the warehouse node in square feet. Principal capacity measurement used for space utilization reporting, lease management, and network capacity planning.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Facility Capacity; ISO 9001 - Facility Management

attributes.name: carrier_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of carrier codes (e.g., 'UPS,FEDEX,USPS,DHL') representing the shipping carriers that service this warehouse node. Used by the TMS for carrier selection and rate shopping during order fulfillment.
attributes.references: Transportation Management System (TMS) - Carrier Assignment; SLA Management

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City in which the warehouse node is physically located. Used for geographic clustering, last-mile delivery zone assignment, and regulatory jurisdiction determination.

attributes.name: commissioned_date
attributes.description: Date on which the warehouse node was officially commissioned and became operational in the fulfillment network. Used for asset lifecycle tracking, depreciation calculations, and network history reporting.
attributes.references: ERP SAP S/4HANA - Fixed Asset Management; Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Facility Lifecycle

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the country in which the warehouse node is located. Drives cross-border trade compliance, customs documentation, and WTO regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; WTO International Trade Regulations; EU Electronic Commerce Directive

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the warehouse node master record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and record lifecycle management per ISO 27001 information security standards.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 - Information Security Management; GDPR Article 5 - Data Integrity

attributes.name: decommissioned_date
attributes.description: Date on which the warehouse node was decommissioned and removed from the active fulfillment network. Null for active nodes. Used for network topology history and asset lifecycle reporting.
attributes.references: ERP SAP S/4HANA - Fixed Asset Management; Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Facility Lifecycle

attributes.name: dock_doors_inbound
attributes.description: Number of inbound receiving dock doors at the warehouse node. Determines inbound throughput capacity for purchase order receiving, supplier deliveries, and FTL/LTL carrier appointments.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Dock Management; Transportation Management System (TMS)

attributes.name: dock_doors_outbound
attributes.description: Number of outbound shipping dock doors at the warehouse node. Determines outbound throughput capacity for order fulfillment, carrier pickups, and cross-dock operations.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Dock Management; Transportation Management System (TMS)

attributes.name: fulfillment_model
attributes.description: Primary fulfillment model supported by this node. Determines order routing eligibility and SLA commitments. FBA-style nodes handle seller-stocked inventory; BOPIS nodes support Buy Online Pick Up In Store; DTC nodes serve direct-to-consumer shipments. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fba_style|bopis|dtc|b2b|omnichannel|cross_dock — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Order Management System (OMS) - Fulfillment Routing Rules; WMS Facility Configuration

attributes.name: gl_cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA General Ledger cost center code associated with this warehouse node for financial reporting, operational cost allocation, and SOX-compliant expense tracking.
attributes.references: ERP SAP S/4HANA - Cost Center Accounting; SOX - Internal Controls; ISO 27001

attributes.name: gln
attributes.description: GS1 Global Location Number (GLN) — a 13-digit internationally standardized identifier for this warehouse node. Used in EDI transactions, supply chain partner communications, and global trade compliance.
attributes.references: GS1 GLN Standard; WTO International Trade Regulations; EDI Standards

attributes.name: is_24hr_operation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the warehouse node operates on a 24-hour, continuous basis. When true, overrides operating_hours_start and operating_hours_end for SLA and routing calculations.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Operating Hours Configuration

attributes.name: is_3pl
attributes.description: Indicates whether this warehouse node is operated by a third-party logistics (3PL) provider rather than owned/operated by the business. Drives cost allocation, SLA contract management, and operational reporting.
attributes.references: 3PL Industry Standards; Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) SAP S/4HANA - Procurement

attributes.name: is_cold_storage
attributes.description: Indicates whether the warehouse node has temperature-controlled cold storage capability. Used to route perishable or temperature-sensitive SKUs to eligible nodes during inventory allocation.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Temperature Zone Management; ISO 22000 - Food Safety

attributes.name: is_hazmat_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the warehouse node holds the required certifications to store and handle hazardous materials (hazmat). Drives SKU-level inventory routing and CPSC compliance checks.
attributes.references: Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) - Hazmat Storage Standards; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: is_returns_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this warehouse node is authorized to receive and process customer returns and RMA (Return Merchandise Authorization) shipments. Controls return routing logic in the OMS.
attributes.references: Order Management System (OMS) - Returns Routing; Warehouse Management System (WMS) - RMA Processing

attributes.name: is_virtual
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a virtual warehouse node (e.g., a drop-ship node or virtual inventory pool) with no physical facility. Virtual nodes participate in inventory allocation and order routing but have no physical location attributes.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Virtual Node Configuration; OMS - Drop-Ship Routing

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the warehouse node in decimal degrees (WGS 84). Used by the TMS for route optimization, delivery radius calculations, and geospatial analytics.
attributes.references: ISO 6709 - Geographic Coordinates; Transportation Management System (TMS) - Route Optimization

attributes.name: lease_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the facility lease for this warehouse node expires. Used for network planning, lease renewal management, and long-term capacity forecasting. Applicable to leased facilities only.
attributes.references: ERP SAP S/4HANA - Fixed Asset and Lease Management; SOX - Financial Reporting

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the warehouse node in decimal degrees (WGS 84). Used by the TMS for route optimization, delivery radius calculations, and geospatial analytics.
attributes.references: ISO 6709 - Geographic Coordinates; Transportation Management System (TMS) - Route Optimization

attributes.name: max_weight_capacity_kg
attributes.business_glossary_term: Warehouse Node Maximum Weight Capacity Kilograms
attributes.description: Maximum total weight capacity of the warehouse node in kilograms. Used for structural load compliance, inventory planning, and safety management per facility engineering specifications.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Capacity Planning; ISO 45001 - Occupational Health and Safety

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: Hierarchical tier classification of the warehouse node within the fulfillment network topology. Hub nodes serve as primary distribution points; spoke nodes serve last-mile delivery zones. Drives inventory positioning and replenishment flow.
attributes.references: Transportation Management System (TMS) - Network Topology; WMS - Replenishment Planning

attributes.name: node_code
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the warehouse node across all operational systems (WMS, TMS, OMS). Used as the business key in EDI, carrier integrations, and fulfillment routing logic.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Facility Master; GS1 GLN Standard

attributes.name: node_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the warehouse node as used in operational communications, reporting dashboards, and carrier documentation (e.g., 'Dallas Fulfillment Center - North').

attributes.name: node_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the warehouse node. Controls whether the node is eligible to receive inventory allocations, fulfill orders, or participate in replenishment planning.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Facility Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: node_type
attributes.description: Classification of the warehouse node by its operational role in the fulfillment network. Drives routing logic, SLA assignment, and capacity planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fulfillment_center|distribution_center|dark_store|3pl_facility|drop_ship_node|returns_center — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Facility Type Classification; 3PL Industry Standards

attributes.name: operating_days
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of operating days of the week for the warehouse node (e.g., 'MON,TUE,WED,THU,FRI'). Used for SLA cutoff scheduling, carrier appointment booking, and fulfillment routing logic.

attributes.name: operating_hours_end
attributes.description: Standard daily operating end time for the warehouse node in HH:MM (24-hour) format. Used to determine carrier pickup cutoff windows, SLA calculation, and order routing eligibility.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Operating Hours; SLA Management

attributes.name: operating_hours_start
attributes.description: Standard daily operating start time for the warehouse node in HH:MM (24-hour) format. Used to determine carrier pickup cutoff windows, SLA calculation, and order routing eligibility.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Operating Hours; SLA Management

attributes.name: pallet_positions
attributes.description: Total number of standard pallet positions available in the warehouse node. Used for inventory capacity planning, MOQ compliance, and replenishment scheduling in the WMS.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Capacity Planning; GS1 Pallet Standards

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the warehouse node facility. Used for carrier zone mapping, last-mile delivery cost calculation, and geographic analytics.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Universal Postal Union (UPU) Standards

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Internal geographic region code grouping warehouse nodes for network planning, carrier contract management, and regional fulfillment analytics (e.g., 'US-WEST', 'EU-CENTRAL').
attributes.references: Transportation Management System (TMS) - Network Region Configuration; ERP SAP S/4HANA - Organizational Structure

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State or province code where the warehouse node is located. Used for tax nexus determination, labor law compliance, and regional fulfillment routing. Follows ISO 3166-2 subdivision codes.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2; SOX - Tax Nexus Reporting; CCPA

attributes.name: temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum maintained temperature in degrees Celsius for the warehouse node's temperature-controlled storage areas. Applicable only when is_cold_storage is true. Used for SKU eligibility routing and compliance audits.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Temperature Zone Configuration; ISO 22000

attributes.name: temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum maintained temperature in degrees Celsius for the warehouse node's temperature-controlled storage areas. Applicable only when is_cold_storage is true. Used for SKU eligibility routing and compliance audits.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Temperature Zone Configuration; ISO 22000

attributes.name: timezone
attributes.description: IANA timezone identifier for the warehouse node location (e.g., 'America/Chicago'). Used to correctly interpret operating hours, SLA cutoff times, and carrier pickup windows across distributed fulfillment networks.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; WMS - Operating Hours Configuration

attributes.name: tms_location_code
attributes.description: Location code assigned by the Transportation Management System (TMS) for this warehouse node. Used for carrier pickup scheduling, route optimization, and shipment origin identification.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the warehouse node master record. Used for change detection, data synchronization with WMS/TMS, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 - Information Security Management; GDPR Article 5 - Data Integrity

attributes.name: wms_facility_reference
attributes.description: Native facility identifier assigned by the Warehouse Management System (WMS) for this warehouse node. Used for system integration, EDI message routing, and reconciliation between the WMS and the lakehouse SSOT.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Facility Master; EDI Standards

products.name: sku_velocity
products.description: Master record tracking the daily sales rate (DSR) and velocity classification for a SKU at a warehouse node. Stores rolling DSR (7-day, 30-day, 90-day), velocity tier (A/B/C/D based on BSR and sales volume), average units sold per day, peak DSR, seasonal velocity index, and last recalculation timestamp. Drives slotting decisions, replenishment frequency, and safety stock calculations.

attributes.name: sku_velocity_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for the SKU velocity record. Identifies a single master record tracking daily sales rate and velocity classification for a SKU at a warehouse node.

attributes.name: seller_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketplace seller who owns this SKU inventory at this node, where applicable. Relevant for Fulfillment By Amazon-style (FBA-style) models where seller inventory is co-mingled or segregated within the warehouse node.
attributes.references: Seller Management Portal - Seller Onboarding; Marketplace Seller Management

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) for which velocity metrics are tracked. Links to the product catalog master record.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) Standard

attributes.name: warehouse_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse node or fulfillment center at which this SKU velocity record applies. Enables node-level slotting and replenishment decisions.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Inventory Control Module

attributes.name: active_promotion_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this SKU is currently under an active promotional campaign that may be influencing its DSR. When true, velocity metrics may be temporarily elevated and should be interpreted with caution for baseline replenishment planning.
attributes.references: Marketing Automation Platform - Salesforce Marketing Cloud - Campaign Management

attributes.name: bsr_category
attributes.description: Product category within which the BSR rank is computed (e.g., 'Electronics', 'Apparel'). BSR is category-relative; this field provides the denominator context for rank interpretation.
attributes.references: Search and Recommendation Engine - Product Ranking; Product Information Management System (PIM)

attributes.name: bsr_rank
attributes.description: Best Seller Rank (BSR) of this SKU within its product category at the time of the last velocity recalculation. Lower rank indicates higher sales velocity. Used as a co-input with DSR for velocity tier classification.
attributes.references: Search and Recommendation Engine - Product Ranking; Product Information Management System (PIM)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SKU velocity record was first created in the data platform. Audit trail field supporting data lineage, compliance, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard; ISO 27001 - Information Security Management; SOX - Internal Controls

attributes.name: data_window_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the data window used in the most recent velocity recalculation. Defines the earliest transaction date included in DSR computations. Important for understanding the representativeness of velocity metrics for newly launched or recently reactivated SKUs.

attributes.name: days_of_supply
attributes.description: Estimated number of days the current on-hand inventory will last at the current 30-day DSR before reaching zero. Key Out-of-Stock (OOS) risk indicator used in replenishment prioritization.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Inventory Control; APICS Supply Chain Dictionary

attributes.name: dsr_30d
attributes.description: Rolling 30-day average Daily Sales Rate (DSR) expressed as units sold per day. Medium-term velocity indicator used for standard replenishment planning and safety stock calculations.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Replenishment Planning; APICS Supply Chain Dictionary

attributes.name: dsr_7d
attributes.description: Rolling 7-day average Daily Sales Rate (DSR) expressed as units sold per day. Short-term velocity indicator used for immediate replenishment triggers and safety stock adjustments.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Replenishment Planning; APICS Supply Chain Dictionary

attributes.name: dsr_90d
attributes.description: Rolling 90-day average Daily Sales Rate (DSR) expressed as units sold per day. Long-term velocity baseline used for seasonal trend analysis, safety stock floor calculations, and velocity tier classification.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Replenishment Planning; APICS Supply Chain Dictionary

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Timestamp from which this SKU velocity record is considered valid and active for operational use. Supports Slowly Changing Dimension (SCD) Type 2 history tracking and point-in-time velocity analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer - SCD Type 2 Pattern

attributes.name: effective_to
attributes.description: Timestamp at which this SKU velocity record was superseded by a newer version. Null indicates the current active record. Supports Slowly Changing Dimension (SCD) Type 2 history tracking and point-in-time velocity analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer - SCD Type 2 Pattern

attributes.name: fulfillment_model
attributes.description: Fulfillment model under which this SKU is stocked and shipped at this node. FBA = Fulfillment By Amazon-style (platform-fulfilled); FBM = Fulfilled by Merchant; 3PL = Third-Party Logistics; DTC = Direct to Consumer; BOPIS = Buy Online Pick Up In Store. Velocity benchmarks and slotting rules differ by fulfillment model.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Fulfillment Configuration; Order Management System (OMS)

attributes.name: is_seasonal_sku
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this SKU exhibits significant seasonal demand patterns. When true, the seasonal velocity index is weighted more heavily in safety stock and replenishment calculations.
attributes.references: Product Information Management System (PIM) - Catalog Attributes; APICS Supply Chain Dictionary

attributes.name: net_dsr_30d
attributes.description: Net 30-day Daily Sales Rate (DSR) adjusted for returns: gross units sold minus units returned, divided by 30 days. Provides a more accurate velocity signal for replenishment planning than gross DSR when return rates are material.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Replenishment Planning; APICS Supply Chain Dictionary

attributes.name: oos_risk_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this SKU at this node is at imminent risk of an Out-of-Stock (OOS) event, defined as days_of_supply falling below the replenishment lead time. Triggers priority replenishment workflows.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - OOS Prevention; FTC Consumer Protection Standards

attributes.name: peak_dsr
attributes.description: Maximum observed Daily Sales Rate (DSR) for this SKU at this node within the trailing 365-day window. Used to size safety stock buffers for peak demand events such as promotions or seasonal spikes.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Demand Planning; APICS Supply Chain Dictionary

attributes.name: peak_dsr_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the peak DSR was recorded. Provides temporal context for peak demand analysis and seasonal pattern identification.

attributes.name: prior_velocity_tier
attributes.description: Velocity tier assigned to this SKU-node combination in the previous recalculation cycle. Retained alongside the current tier to support tier-change analysis, slotting review workflows, and audit trails.

attributes.name: promotion_velocity_uplift
attributes.description: Multiplier representing the observed or forecasted increase in DSR during active promotional periods for this SKU. A value of 1.5 indicates a 50% uplift over baseline DSR during promotions. Used to pre-position inventory ahead of planned promotions.
attributes.references: Marketing Automation Platform - Salesforce Marketing Cloud - Campaign Management; APICS Supply Chain Dictionary

attributes.name: recalculation_frequency_hours
attributes.description: Configured frequency in hours at which the velocity metrics for this SKU-node record are recalculated. Tier-A SKUs may recalculate every 4 hours; Tier-D SKUs may recalculate daily. Drives scheduling of the velocity computation job.

attributes.name: reorder_point_qty
attributes.description: Inventory level at which a replenishment order should be triggered for this SKU at this node. Computed from DSR, replenishment lead time, and safety stock. When on-hand quantity falls to or below this level, a replenishment signal is generated.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Replenishment Planning; APICS Supply Chain Dictionary - Reorder Point

attributes.name: replenishment_frequency_days
attributes.description: Recommended replenishment cycle in days derived from the SKU velocity tier and DSR. Tier-A SKUs may have a 0.5-day (twice daily) replenishment cycle; Tier-D SKUs may be replenished every 30 days. Feeds the Warehouse Management System replenishment scheduler.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Replenishment Planning; APICS Supply Chain Dictionary

attributes.name: return_rate_30d
attributes.description: Ratio of units returned to units sold for this SKU at this node over the trailing 30-day window. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.05 = 5% return rate). High return rates may inflate gross DSR; net velocity should account for returns in replenishment planning.
attributes.references: Order Management System (OMS) - Returns and Refunds Processing; Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) Process

attributes.name: safety_stock_qty
attributes.description: Recommended safety stock quantity for this SKU at this node, calculated from DSR, lead time variability, and seasonal velocity index. Represents the buffer inventory held to prevent Out-of-Stock (OOS) events during demand spikes or supply delays.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Replenishment Planning; APICS Supply Chain Dictionary - Safety Stock

attributes.name: season_code
attributes.description: Primary selling season associated with this SKU. Used to contextualize the seasonal velocity index and align replenishment planning with seasonal demand cycles. 'YEAR_ROUND' indicates no dominant season.
attributes.references: Product Information Management System (PIM) - Catalog Attributes

attributes.name: seasonal_velocity_index
attributes.description: Dimensionless multiplier representing the ratio of current period DSR to the annual average DSR for this SKU at this node. Values above 1.0 indicate above-average seasonal demand; below 1.0 indicate below-average. Used to adjust safety stock and replenishment quantities for seasonal fluctuations.
attributes.references: APICS Supply Chain Dictionary - Seasonal Index; Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Demand Planning

attributes.name: slotting_zone
attributes.description: Warehouse slotting zone recommended or assigned to this SKU based on its velocity tier. 'prime' = highest-pick-frequency zone closest to packing; 'forward' = forward pick area; 'reserve' = reserve storage; 'bulk' = bulk pallet storage; 'overflow' = overflow/offsite storage. Drives pick path optimization and labor efficiency.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Slotting Module; WERC Warehouse Education and Research Council

attributes.name: tier_change_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the velocity tier changed during the most recent recalculation cycle. When true, triggers a slotting review workflow to evaluate whether physical relocation of the SKU within the warehouse is warranted.

attributes.name: tier_changed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the velocity tier last changed for this SKU-node combination. Used to measure tier stability, assess slotting decision lag, and support historical velocity analysis.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Slotting Module; ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard

attributes.name: units_sold_30d
attributes.description: Total units of this SKU sold from this warehouse node in the trailing 30-day window. Raw sales volume input used to compute the 30-day DSR and velocity tier assignment.
attributes.references: Order Management System (OMS) - Order Fulfillment; Warehouse Management System (WMS)

attributes.name: units_sold_7d
attributes.description: Total units of this SKU sold from this warehouse node in the trailing 7-day window. Raw sales volume input used to compute the 7-day DSR.
attributes.references: Order Management System (OMS) - Order Fulfillment; Warehouse Management System (WMS)

attributes.name: units_sold_90d
attributes.description: Total units of this SKU sold from this warehouse node in the trailing 90-day window. Raw sales volume input used to compute the 90-day DSR and long-term velocity baseline.
attributes.references: Order Management System (OMS) - Order Fulfillment; Warehouse Management System (WMS)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this SKU velocity record in the data platform. Audit trail field supporting data lineage, change detection, and Silver Layer merge operations.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard; ISO 27001 - Information Security Management; SOX - Internal Controls

attributes.name: velocity_recalculated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent velocity recalculation job that updated DSR values, velocity tier, and seasonal index for this SKU-node combination. Used to assess data freshness and trigger stale-data alerts.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Replenishment Planning; ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard

attributes.name: velocity_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of this SKU velocity record. 'active' = currently used for slotting and replenishment decisions; 'inactive' = SKU no longer stocked at this node; 'suspended' = temporarily excluded from velocity-driven decisions (e.g., during a product recall); 'pending_review' = awaiting manual validation after anomaly detection.

attributes.name: velocity_tier
attributes.description: ABC/D velocity tier assigned to the SKU at this warehouse node based on Best Seller Rank (BSR) and sales volume. A = fastest moving (top ~20%), B = moderate, C = slow, D = dead/near-zero movement. Drives slotting zone assignment and replenishment frequency.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Slotting Module; ABC Analysis (Pareto Principle)

attributes.name: velocity_trend
attributes.description: Directional trend of SKU velocity based on comparison of 7-day DSR to 90-day DSR. 'accelerating' = 7d DSR significantly above 90d DSR; 'stable' = within normal variance band; 'decelerating' = 7d DSR significantly below 90d DSR; 'volatile' = high variance with no clear direction. Used for proactive inventory positioning.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) - Demand Planning; APICS Supply Chain Dictionary

products.name: quarantine_record
products.description: Transactional record tracking inventory placed in quarantine status due to quality holds, damage, regulatory inspection, recall, or supplier dispute. Captures quarantine reason, quarantine start date, quarantine end date, affected SKU, lot, quantity, warehouse location, hold authority (QA team, regulatory body, supplier), inspection outcome, and disposition decision (return to stock, destroy, return to supplier, donate). Supports CPSC recall compliance.

attributes.name: quarantine_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the quarantine record. Primary key.

attributes.name: lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.lot. Business justification: Add lot_id FK to lot for proper normalization; lot_number string is redundant.

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_obligation. Business justification: Quarantine events are triggered by specific compliance obligations; linking enables the Quarantine‑Obligation impact report.

attributes.name: seller_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to seller.seller_profile. Business justification: Supports Quarantine Compliance Report per seller, monitoring quality issues affecting individual sellers.

attributes.name: service_support_case_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.service_support_case. Business justification: Regulatory compliance: quarantine actions are often initiated by a support case investigation; linking provides traceability for quality and safety audits.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the SKU placed in quarantine.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the supplier associated with the quarantined inventory, relevant for supplier disputes or returns.

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the specific warehouse location (bin, aisle, zone) where the quarantined inventory is stored.

attributes.name: warehouse_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the warehouse where the quarantined inventory is located.

attributes.name: affected_order_count
attributes.description: The number of customer orders that are impacted or blocked due to this quarantine.

attributes.name: corrective_action_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the corrective actions planned or implemented to address the root cause and prevent recurrence.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether corrective actions are required to prevent recurrence of this quarantine issue.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this quarantine record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the financial impact amount.

attributes.name: customer_impact_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this quarantine has direct impact on customer orders or commitments.

attributes.name: disposition_date
attributes.description: The date when the disposition decision was executed and the inventory was moved, destroyed, or returned.

attributes.name: disposition_decision
attributes.description: The final decision on how to handle the quarantined inventory (e.g., return to stock, destroy, return to supplier, donate, rework, scrap).

attributes.name: disposition_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the rationale, process, and details of the disposition decision and execution.

attributes.name: disposition_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of inventory units that were dispositioned. May differ from quarantined quantity if partial disposition occurred.

attributes.name: expected_resolution_date
attributes.description: The anticipated date by which the quarantine hold is expected to be resolved based on inspection or review timelines.

attributes.name: financial_impact_amount
attributes.description: The estimated or actual financial impact (cost, loss, or liability) associated with this quarantine event, in the base currency.

attributes.name: hold_authority_contact
attributes.description: Contact information (email or phone) for the authority that initiated the quarantine hold.

attributes.name: hold_authority_name
attributes.description: The name of the specific person, team, or organization that initiated the quarantine hold.

attributes.name: hold_authority_type
attributes.description: The type of authority or entity that initiated the quarantine hold (e.g., Quality Assurance team, regulatory body, supplier, warehouse manager).

attributes.name: inspection_date
attributes.description: The date when the inspection of the quarantined inventory was completed.

attributes.name: inspection_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting findings, observations, and details from the inspection process.

attributes.name: inspection_outcome
attributes.description: The result of the inspection performed on the quarantined inventory (e.g., pass, fail, conditional pass, pending).

attributes.name: inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a formal inspection is required before the quarantine can be resolved.

attributes.name: inspection_type
attributes.description: The type of inspection required or performed on the quarantined inventory (e.g., visual, functional, laboratory, regulatory, third-party).

attributes.name: inspector_name
attributes.description: The name of the person or team who performed the inspection of the quarantined inventory.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: The priority level assigned to resolving this quarantine, based on business impact, regulatory urgency, or customer commitments.

attributes.name: quarantine_end_date
attributes.description: The date when the quarantine hold was lifted or the inventory was dispositioned. Null if quarantine is still active.

attributes.name: quarantine_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise timestamp when the quarantine hold was lifted or the inventory was dispositioned. Null if quarantine is still active.

attributes.name: quarantine_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason inventory was placed in quarantine status. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: quality_hold|damage|regulatory_inspection|recall|supplier_dispute|expiry_risk|contamination — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: quarantine_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed free-text description of the specific reason for quarantine, providing additional context beyond the reason code.

attributes.name: quarantine_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the inventory was placed into quarantine status.

attributes.name: quarantine_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise timestamp when the inventory was placed into quarantine status, supporting audit trail and Service Level Agreement (SLA) tracking.

attributes.name: quarantine_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the quarantine record indicating whether the hold is active, under review, or resolved.

attributes.name: quarantined_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of inventory units placed in quarantine status.

attributes.name: recall_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this quarantine is related to a product recall issued by the Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) or other regulatory body.
attributes.references: Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) - Recall Compliance

attributes.name: recall_number
attributes.description: The official recall number or identifier issued by the Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) or other regulatory authority, if applicable.
attributes.references: Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) - Recall Compliance

attributes.name: regulatory_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number or case identifier from the regulatory body overseeing the quarantine or inspection.
attributes.references: Federal Trade Commission (FTC), Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC)

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: The high-level category of the root cause that led to the quarantine event. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: supplier_defect|warehouse_damage|transportation_damage|expiry|contamination|mislabeling|regulatory_change — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed free-text description of the root cause analysis findings for this quarantine event.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the quarantined quantity (e.g., each, case, pallet, weight, volume). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: each|case|pallet|kg|lb|liter|gallon — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this quarantine record was last updated in the system.

products.name: hold
products.description: Transactional record representing any active hold or quarantine placed on inventory that prevents allocation or shipment. Serves as the SSOT for all inventory restriction types including legal holds, regulatory holds, quality quarantines, financial holds, promotional reserves, damage holds, recall quarantines, and supplier dispute holds. Captures hold type, hold reason, affected SKU, lot, quantity, warehouse location, hold start date, hold end date, hold expiry date, hold authority (QA team, regulatory body, supplier, legal department), release conditions, inspection outcome, and disposition decision (return to stock, destroy, return to supplier, donate). Tracks full quarantine lifecycle including quarantine start/end dates, root cause classification, resolution timeline, and CPSC recall compliance. Supports hold-level reporting for inventory availability impact analysis and regulatory audit trails.

attributes.name: hold_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inventory hold record. Primary key.

attributes.name: agent_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee or quality assurance personnel who conducted the inspection.

attributes.name: legal_hold_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.legal_hold. Business justification: Inventory holds can be placed due to legal holds; linking enables the Legal‑Hold Management dashboard.

attributes.name: seller_profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the marketplace seller who owns the held inventory, relevant for marketplace fulfillment models (FBA-style).

attributes.name: service_support_case_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.service_support_case. Business justification: Required for audit: when a support case triggers a hold on inventory, linking enables case‑to‑hold traceability for SLA and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the SKU affected by this hold. Links to the product catalog.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supplier associated with the held inventory, relevant for supplier dispute holds or return to supplier dispositions.

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Specific bin, shelf, or zone location within the warehouse where the held inventory resides.

attributes.name: warehouse_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse node where the held inventory is located.

attributes.name: atp_impact_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of ATP inventory reduced due to this hold, impacting order fulfillment capacity and inventory availability reporting.

attributes.name: authority
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the authority that placed the hold (e.g., QA Team, CPSC, Legal Department, Supplier Name, Regulatory Body).

attributes.name: authority_contact
attributes.description: Contact information (email or phone) for the authority responsible for the hold, used for resolution coordination.

attributes.name: cpsc_compliance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hold is compliant with CPSC recall and quarantine requirements for consumer product safety.
attributes.references: Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) - Product Safety Standards

attributes.name: created_by_user_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system process that created this hold record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this hold record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the financial impact amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: disposition_date
attributes.description: Date when the disposition decision was executed and the inventory was moved to its final state.

attributes.name: disposition_decision
attributes.description: Final decision on what to do with the held inventory: return to stock (release to available), destroy (dispose of), return to supplier (RMA), donate (charitable contribution), rework (repair or repackage), or scrap (write off).

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when the hold was released or resolved, allowing inventory to return to available status. Null if hold is still active.

attributes.name: end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the hold was released or resolved. Null if hold is still active.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Scheduled expiration date for the hold, after which the hold should be reviewed or automatically released if no action is taken.

attributes.name: financial_impact_amount
attributes.description: Estimated financial impact of the hold in terms of inventory value at cost, used for financial reporting and variance analysis.

attributes.name: hold_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the hold: active (inventory is restricted), pending review (under evaluation), released (hold lifted and inventory returned to available), expired (hold period ended), or cancelled (hold removed before completion).

attributes.name: hold_type
attributes.description: Classification of the hold based on the originating business reason: legal holds, regulatory holds, quality quarantines, financial holds, promotional reserves, damage holds, recall quarantines, or supplier dispute holds. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: legal|regulatory|quality|financial|promotional|damage|recall|supplier_dispute — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: inspection_date
attributes.description: Date when the inspection or quality review was completed. Null if inspection has not occurred.

attributes.name: inspection_outcome
attributes.description: Result of the inspection or quality review conducted on the held inventory: pass (cleared for release), fail (remains quarantined), conditional pass (partial release), pending (inspection in progress), or not applicable.

attributes.name: inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal inspection or quality check is required before the hold can be released.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing or receiving lot number for FIFO/LIFO tracking and traceability of the held inventory.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments related to the hold, including communication history, escalation details, or special handling instructions.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification for resolving the hold, indicating urgency for review and disposition (critical for recalls, high for legal holds, medium for quality issues, low for administrative holds).

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of inventory units placed under this hold, preventing allocation or shipment.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the specific reason for placing the hold (e.g., QA_FAIL, RECALL_CPSC, LEGAL_INJUNCTION, DAMAGE_TRANSIT).

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed free-text explanation of why the hold was placed, including root cause and context.

attributes.name: recall_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hold is associated with a product recall issued by CPSC or other regulatory body.
attributes.references: Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) - Recall Guidelines

attributes.name: recall_number
attributes.description: Official recall identification number issued by CPSC or regulatory authority, if this hold is part of a recall action.
attributes.references: Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) - Recall Guidelines

attributes.name: release_conditions
attributes.description: Detailed description of the conditions that must be met before the hold can be released (e.g., pass re-inspection, receive supplier credit, legal clearance obtained).

attributes.name: resolution_timeline_days
attributes.description: Target number of days within which the hold should be resolved, based on hold type and priority level.

attributes.name: root_cause_classification
attributes.description: Standardized classification of the root cause that led to the hold (e.g., supplier defect, transit damage, regulatory non-compliance, system error).

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date when the hold was initiated and inventory was restricted from allocation.

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the hold was placed, capturing the exact moment inventory became restricted.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the held quantity (e.g., EA for each, CS for case, PLT for pallet).

attributes.name: updated_by_user_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system process that last updated this hold record.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this hold record was last modified, tracking the most recent change to hold status or attributes.

products.name: stock_valuation
products.description: Transactional record capturing the cost valuation of inventory for a SKU-lot-warehouse combination under the applicable costing method (FIFO, LIFO, weighted average, standard cost). Stores cost layer sequence, unit cost, total layer quantity, total layer value, valuation date, costing method, and currency. Feeds finance domain for inventory asset valuation, COGS calculation, and SOX financial reporting compliance.

domains.name: payment
domains.description: Authoritative source for all monetary transactions on the platform. Owns payment gateway authorization, settlement, refund processing, chargebacks, fraud detection, PCI DSS-compliant card data tokenization, multi-currency transaction records, payment method management, and payment reconciliation. Tracks transaction success rates and processing fees.
domains.references: Payment Gateway and Processing Platform, PCI DSS, ISO 20022, SOX

products.name: payment_transaction
products.description: Core authoritative record of every monetary transaction processed on the platform, including the immutable event log of all state transitions (authorized, captured, settled, voided, failed) and gateway webhook callbacks. Captures payment amount, currency, exchange rate applied, processing status, gateway response codes, authorization codes, timestamps, retry history, and event-driven lifecycle audit trail. Each transaction references a payment method, may have one or more authorizations, and flows through to settlement. Supports PCI DSS audit requirements and PSD2 Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) compliance evidence. SSOT for all payment transaction records, their lifecycle events, and state transition history.

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: general_ledger_id

products.name: authorization
products.description: Captures the real-time authorization request and response lifecycle for each payment attempt against the issuing bank via the payment gateway. Records authorization code, AVS/CVV result, issuer response, decline reason, authorization amount, hold expiry, 3DS/SCA authentication result and challenge status, and gateway latency. products.name: fraud_case
