attributes.description: Current compliance status of the obligation for the seller (e.g., active, waived, deferred)

products.name: fraud_investigation
products.description: Master reference table for fraud_investigation. Referenced by fraud_investigation_id.

attributes.name: fraud_investigation_id
attributes.description: Primary key for fraud_investigation

attributes.name: agent_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal investigator handling the case.

attributes.name: customer_profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the buyer implicated in the investigation.

attributes.name: seller_profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the seller implicated in the investigation.

attributes.name: amount_under_investigation
attributes.description: Monetary value associated with the suspected fraudulent activity.

attributes.name: assigned_team
attributes.description: Name of the internal team responsible for the investigation.

attributes.name: audit_trail
attributes.description: JSON‑encoded log of key actions taken on the case.

attributes.name: case_number
attributes.description: Human‑readable identifier used in communications and reporting.

attributes.name: closed_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact time the investigation was resolved or closed; null if still open.

attributes.name: compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates if the case triggers regulatory compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three‑letter currency code for the amount.

attributes.name: detection_method
attributes.description: Technique used to flag the suspicious activity.

attributes.name: detection_source
attributes.description: Origin of the fraud detection signal.

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: Tier of escalation applied to the case.

attributes.name: evidence_url
attributes.description: Link to external storage containing supporting evidence files.

attributes.name: external_reference_code
attributes.description: Identifier from an external system (e.g., law‑enforcement case number).

attributes.name: fraud_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the suspected fraudulent activity.

attributes.name: fraud_detection_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact time the fraud signal was generated.

attributes.name: fraud_indicator_codes
attributes.description: Comma‑separated list of internal codes that triggered the alert.

attributes.name: fraud_origin_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166‑1 alpha‑3 country code where the fraud originated.

attributes.name: fraud_origin_device_code
attributes.description: Device identifier (e.g., mobile device ID) associated with the fraudulent activity.

attributes.name: fraud_origin_ip
attributes.description: IP address observed at the point of fraud detection.

attributes.name: fraud_resolution_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact time the final resolution action was applied.

attributes.name: fraud_severity
attributes.description: Risk level assigned to the case based on impact and likelihood.

attributes.name: fraud_type
attributes.description: Category of fraud detected.

attributes.name: investigation_category
attributes.description: Broad classification of the investigation focus.

attributes.name: investigation_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the case for handling urgency.

attributes.name: is_escalated
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the case was escalated to a higher tier.

attributes.name: is_repeat_offender
attributes.description: True if the seller or buyer has prior fraud investigations.

attributes.name: last_review_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent case review or status update.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free‑form text capturing investigative observations and comments.

attributes.name: opened_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact time the investigation was initiated.

attributes.name: record_audit_created
attributes.description: Timestamp when the record was first inserted into the lakehouse.

attributes.name: record_audit_updated
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the record.

attributes.name: regulatory_reported
attributes.description: True if the investigation was reported to a regulator.

attributes.name: repeat_offender_count
attributes.description: Number of previous investigations linked to the same party.

attributes.name: report_date
attributes.description: Date the regulatory report was filed.

attributes.name: resolution_action
attributes.description: Final action taken to address the fraud case.

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the resolution action was executed.

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Numerical score (0‑100) representing overall fraud risk.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the investigation.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who created the investigation record.

attributes.name: related_fraud_investigation_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on fraud_investigation (related_fraud_investigation_id)

domains.name: fulfillment
domains.description: Manages pick-pack-ship operations, warehouse workflows, order allocation, packing slips, shipping labels, and fulfillment SLA tracking. Supports FBA-style fulfillment center operations, 3PL partner coordination, BOPIS orchestration, and proof-of-delivery records. Integrates with WMS and TMS for end-to-end fulfillment execution.

products.name: center
products.description: Master record for each physical fulfillment center (FC) or warehouse node in the fulfillment network. Captures FC identity, type (FBA-style, 3PL, BOPIS hub, dark store), geographic location, operational capacity, supported fulfillment methods, WMS integration identifiers, and SLA tier assignments. SSOT for all warehouse facility master data within the fulfillment domain.

attributes.name: center_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fulfillment center. Primary key for the center entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Maps each fulfillment center to its operational cost center, essential for budgeting, cost allocation, and expense tracking.

attributes.name: default_carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.carrier. Business justification: Default carrier per fulfillment center drives automated carrier selection in the 'Shipment Creation' workflow.

attributes.name: default_route_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.route. Business justification: Center‑specific default route is used by the routing engine to optimize outbound shipments; required for route‑based cost analysis.

attributes.name: manager_agent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.agent. Business justification: Each fulfillment center is overseen by a manager agent responsible for operations; linking enables manager‑level performance dashboards and incident escalation.

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_program. Business justification: Each fulfillment center must be associated with a compliance program for safety, labor and data protection audits.

attributes.name: warehouse_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.warehouse_node. Business justification: Maps each fulfillment center to its physical warehouse node, essential for inventory balance reports and location‑based replenishment.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the fulfillment center physical location, including street number and name.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for additional location details such as building, suite, or floor number.

attributes.name: automation_level
attributes.description: Degree of automation in fulfillment operations: manual (human-driven), semi-automated (mix of manual and automated processes), fully automated (end-to-end automation), or robotic (advanced robotics and AI).

attributes.name: available_capacity_units
attributes.description: Current available storage capacity in the fulfillment center, representing unused storage units available for new inventory allocation.

attributes.name: capacity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measurement used to quantify storage capacity: pallets, bins, cubic feet, cubic meters, square feet, or square meters.

attributes.name: center_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code for the fulfillment center, used in operational systems and partner integrations.

attributes.name: center_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the fulfillment center, used for display and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: center_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fulfillment center based on operational model: FBA-style (Fulfillment By Amazon-style), 3PL (Third-Party Logistics), BOPIS (Buy Online Pick Up In Store) hub, dark store, micro-fulfillment center, or returns processing center.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the fulfillment center is located.

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: Date when the fulfillment center ceased operations, applicable only if the center has been decommissioned or permanently closed.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Primary contact email address for the fulfillment center operations team, used for internal coordination and partner communication.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the fulfillment center operations team, used for internal coordination and partner communication.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code identifying the country where the fulfillment center is located.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fulfillment center record was first created in the system, used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: cutoff_time_local
attributes.description: Daily cutoff time in local time zone (HH:MM format) by which orders must be received to qualify for same-day processing and shipment.

attributes.name: daily_throughput_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of orders or units the fulfillment center can process per day under normal operating conditions, used for capacity planning and order allocation.

attributes.name: erp_site_code
attributes.description: Site or plant code in the ERP system (e.g., SAP S/4HANA) that corresponds to this fulfillment center, used for financial and supply chain integration.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the fulfillment center location, used for distance calculations and route optimization.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the fulfillment center location, used for distance calculations and route optimization.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, special handling instructions, or facility-specific information relevant to fulfillment operations.

attributes.name: opened_date
attributes.description: Date when the fulfillment center commenced operations and began processing orders.

attributes.name: operates_24_7
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the fulfillment center operates continuously (true) or has scheduled operating hours (false).

attributes.name: operating_hours
attributes.description: Standard operating hours for the fulfillment center if not 24/7, formatted as day ranges and time ranges (e.g., Mon-Fri 08:00-18:00, Sat 09:00-15:00).

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the fulfillment center in its lifecycle: active (fully operational), inactive (not processing orders), under construction (pre-launch), temporarily closed (planned downtime), decommissioned (permanently closed), or seasonal (operates during peak periods only).

attributes.name: ownership_model
attributes.description: Ownership and operational model of the fulfillment center: owned (company-owned and operated), leased (company-operated but leased facility), third-party operated (3PL partner), or hybrid (shared operations).

attributes.name: partner_operator_name
attributes.description: Name of the third-party logistics (3PL) partner or operator managing the fulfillment center, if applicable.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the fulfillment center address, used for shipping and logistics routing.

attributes.name: sla_tier
attributes.description: Service level tier assigned to this fulfillment center, defining performance commitments for order processing and delivery speed: premium (fastest), standard, economy, regional, express, or custom.
attributes.references: ITIL (Information Technology Infrastructure Library) Service Management

attributes.name: standard_processing_time_hours
attributes.description: Standard time in hours from order receipt to shipment dispatch under normal operating conditions, used for SLA calculations and customer promise dates.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region where the fulfillment center is located.

attributes.name: supported_fulfillment_methods
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of fulfillment methods supported by this center: standard_shipping, expedited_shipping, same_day_delivery, next_day_delivery, bopis, ship_from_store, white_glove, etc.

attributes.name: supports_cold_storage
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the fulfillment center has refrigerated or frozen storage capabilities for temperature-sensitive products.

attributes.name: supports_hazmat
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the fulfillment center is certified and equipped to handle hazardous materials shipments.
attributes.references: DOT (Department of Transportation) Hazardous Materials Regulations

attributes.name: supports_returns_processing
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the fulfillment center is equipped to receive, inspect, and process customer returns and RMA (Return Merchandise Authorization) requests.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the fulfillment center location, used for scheduling and SLA calculations.

attributes.name: tms_integration_reference
attributes.description: External system identifier used to integrate with the Transportation Management System (TMS) for carrier selection and shipment tracking.

attributes.name: total_capacity_units
attributes.description: Maximum storage capacity of the fulfillment center measured in storage units (pallets, bins, or cubic feet), representing the total inventory holding capacity.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fulfillment center record was last modified, used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: wms_integration_reference
attributes.description: External system identifier used to integrate with the WMS for real-time inventory synchronization and order orchestration.

attributes.name: wms_system_name
attributes.description: Name of the Warehouse Management System (WMS) software deployed at this fulfillment center for inventory and operations management.

products.name: fulfillment_order
products.description: Core operational record representing a fulfillment instruction issued to a warehouse or 3PL partner for a specific customer order or sub-order. Tracks fulfillment order status (received, allocated, picking, packed, shipped, delivered, cancelled), assigned fulfillment center, fulfillment method (standard, expedited, BOPIS, FBA-style, 3PL), promised SLA window, actual pick/pack/ship timestamps, and WMS/OMS reference identifiers. Central entity for pick-pack-ship orchestration.

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fulfillment order. Primary key for the fulfillment order entity.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Required for order‑to‑campaign ROI attribution report; e‑commerce analysts need to trace each fulfillment order back to the marketing campaign that generated it.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.carrier. Business justification: Order‑level carrier assignment is used in the 'Order Fulfillment Planning' process and carrier performance dashboards.

attributes.name: carrier_service_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.carrier_service. Business justification: Tracking the specific carrier service (e.g., Express, Ground) per order supports SLA compliance reporting and rate calculations.

attributes.name: customer_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who placed the order being fulfilled. Links to the Customer master data entity.

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating sales order in the Order Management System (OMS) that triggered this fulfillment instruction.

attributes.name: marketplace_listing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketplace.marketplace_listing. Business justification: Required for Fulfillment Attribution Report linking each fulfillment order to its originating marketplace listing for seller performance and inventory forecasting.

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_obligation. Business justification: Order‑level compliance checks (age‑restricted, hazardous) are enforced by associating each order with relevant obligations.

attributes.name: payment_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.payment_transaction. Business justification: Needed for fulfillment order payment status dashboard to show which payment transaction covers each order.

attributes.name: pick_wave_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.pick_wave. Business justification: Pick wave groups many fulfillment orders; adding pick_wave_id to fulfillment_order creates the required parent-child link and eliminates the siloed pick_wave table.

attributes.name: price_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_list. Business justification: Order pricing engine selects a price list for each fulfillment order; required for the Order Pricing Report linking orders to applied price lists.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Enables order‑level profit attribution, allowing profitability analysis per profit center in financial statements.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Drop‑ship fulfillment requires linking each fulfillment order to the purchase order that supplies the items for financial reconciliation and SLA tracking.

attributes.name: third_party_fulfillment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.third_party_fulfillment. Business justification: A fulfillment order may be outsourced to a third‑party logistics partner; linking allows tracking of the partner per order.

attributes.name: warehouse_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fulfillment center or warehouse node assigned to execute this fulfillment order. Links to the warehouse node master data.

attributes.name: allocated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when inventory was successfully allocated to this fulfillment order in the WMS. Marks transition from received to allocated status.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: The business reason why this fulfillment order was cancelled. Used for root cause analysis and process improvement.

attributes.name: cancelled_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the fulfillment order was cancelled. Triggers inventory de-allocation and order management system notification.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this fulfillment order record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: delivered_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the package was successfully delivered to the customer destination address. Sourced from carrier proof-of-delivery records.

attributes.name: fulfillment_method
attributes.description: The fulfillment execution strategy for this order. Determines Service Level Agreement (SLA) targets, routing logic, and carrier selection. BOPIS = Buy Online Pick Up In Store, FBA = Fulfillment By Amazon-style, 3PL = Third-Party Logistics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|expedited|same_day|next_day|bopis|fba|3pl — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Council of Supply Chain Management Professionals (CSCMP) - Supply Chain Terminology

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the fulfillment order, typically displayed on packing slips, shipping labels, and in Warehouse Management System (WMS) interfaces.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 15459 - Unique Identifiers for Transport Units

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fulfillment order. Tracks progression through warehouse workflow stages from receipt to delivery. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: received|allocated|picking|packed|shipped|delivered|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: gift_message
attributes.description: Optional personalized message to be included with gift orders. Printed on packing slip or gift card insert.

attributes.name: is_gift
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this order is a gift. When true, pricing information is excluded from packing slip and gift wrapping may be applied.

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the order based on business context. B2C = Business to Consumer, B2B = Business to Business. Determines packing requirements, documentation, and invoicing rules.
attributes.references: Council of Supply Chain Management Professionals (CSCMP) - Supply Chain Terminology

attributes.name: package_count
attributes.description: The number of individual packages or parcels created for this fulfillment order. Orders may be split into multiple packages based on size, weight, or inventory location.

attributes.name: packing_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when all items were packed, shipping label applied, and the package was ready for carrier pickup.

attributes.name: packing_slip_url
attributes.description: URL to the generated packing slip document that accompanies the shipment. Contains itemized order details for customer reference.

attributes.name: packing_started_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when packing operations began for this fulfillment order at the packing station.

attributes.name: picking_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when all items for this fulfillment order were successfully picked from warehouse locations.

attributes.name: picking_started_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when warehouse personnel began picking items for this fulfillment order. Marks start of physical fulfillment execution.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification for warehouse pick-pack-ship sequencing. High and urgent priorities are expedited through the fulfillment workflow.

attributes.name: promised_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date by which the order is promised to be delivered to the customer. Used for SLA tracking and customer communication.

attributes.name: promised_ship_date
attributes.description: The date by which the fulfillment center committed to ship this order to meet customer Service Level Agreement (SLA) expectations.

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the fulfillment order was received by the Warehouse Management System (WMS) from the Order Management System (OMS).

attributes.name: recipient_name
attributes.description: The full name of the person or business receiving the shipment. Printed on shipping label for carrier delivery verification.

attributes.name: recipient_phone
attributes.description: Contact phone number for the shipment recipient. Used by carriers for delivery coordination and customer notification.

attributes.name: shipped_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the package was handed over to the carrier and departed the fulfillment center. Triggers customer shipment notification.

attributes.name: shipping_address_line1
attributes.description: The primary street address line for the delivery destination. Contains street number, street name, and unit/apartment number if applicable.
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union (UPU) S42 - International Postal Address Components

attributes.name: shipping_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for additional delivery instructions, building name, or suite information.
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union (UPU) S42 - International Postal Address Components

attributes.name: shipping_city
attributes.description: The city or municipality name for the delivery destination address.
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union (UPU) S42 - International Postal Address Components

attributes.name: shipping_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the delivery destination. Determines customs requirements and international shipping regulations.

attributes.name: shipping_label_url
attributes.description: URL to the generated shipping label document stored in the Content Delivery Network (CDN) or document management system.

attributes.name: shipping_postal_code
attributes.description: The postal code or ZIP code for the delivery destination address. Used for carrier routing and delivery zone determination.
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union (UPU) S42 - International Postal Address Components

attributes.name: shipping_state_province
attributes.description: The state, province, or administrative region for the delivery destination address.

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field for special handling requirements, delivery instructions, or customer notes. Examples: fragile, signature required, leave at door.

attributes.name: total_item_quantity
attributes.description: The total number of individual units (across all Stock Keeping Units or SKUs) included in this fulfillment order.

attributes.name: total_volume_m3
attributes.description: The total packed volume of the fulfillment order in cubic meters. Used for warehouse space planning and transportation optimization.
attributes.references: ISO 80000-3 - Quantities and Units - Space and Time

attributes.name: total_weight_kg
attributes.description: The total packed weight of the fulfillment order in kilograms. Used for carrier rate calculation and capacity planning.
attributes.references: ISO 80000-3 - Quantities and Units - Space and Time

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: The carrier-provided tracking number for this shipment. Used for customer self-service tracking and proof-of-delivery verification.
attributes.references: ISO 15459 - Unique Identifiers for Transport Units

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this fulfillment order record was last modified. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the record.

products.name: fulfillment_order_line
products.description: Line-level detail for each SKU within a fulfillment order, serving as the unified pick-and-allocate record. Captures SKU identifier, ordered/allocated/picked/packed quantities, unit of measure, bin/slot location at time of pick, substitution flags, line-level fulfillment status, assigned picker (associate ID or robot unit), pick zone, pick method (single-order, batch, zone, wave), pick start/completion timestamps, pick exceptions (short pick, mispick), and confirmation status. SSOT for SKU-level fulfillment execution including pick task assignment and completion within the WMS workflow.
products.reference: Pick List Line / Order Line Item

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each line item within a fulfillment order. Primary key for the order line entity.

attributes.name: carton_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the shipping carton or container into which this line item was packed. Links line items to physical packages.

attributes.name: catalog_item_id
attributes.description: Internal product master identifier linking this line to the product catalog. Used for product attribute enrichment and reporting.

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent fulfillment order that contains this line item. Links line-level detail to the order header.

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Posts each order line's revenue and COGS to a specific GL account, supporting detailed financial statements and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: listing_offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketplace.listing_offer. Business justification: Supports Offer Performance Analytics by linking each order line to the specific listing offer purchased, enabling pricing and conversion analysis.

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_obligation. Business justification: Individual line items may be subject to specific regulations (e.g., controlled substances), requiring line‑level obligation linkage.

attributes.name: po_line_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.po_line_item. Business justification: Each sales order line is sourced from a specific PO line item; linking enables cost allocation, inventory traceability, and three‑way matching.

attributes.name: price_list_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_list_item. Business justification: Traceability of the exact price list item used for each order line; needed for the Line‑Level Price Audit report.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Required for the 'Pick and Pack' process to map each order line to the exact SKU for inventory allocation and performance reporting.

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific bin, slot, or location within the warehouse where the item was picked from. Critical for inventory accuracy and replenishment.

attributes.name: allocated_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of inventory allocated to this order line from warehouse stock. May differ from ordered quantity due to availability constraints.

attributes.name: confirmation_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether the pick has been confirmed and validated. Used for quality control and accuracy verification.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this order line record was first created in the system. Marks the beginning of the line item lifecycle.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the line item pricing. Supports multi-currency fulfillment operations.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration or best-before date of the picked item. Critical for perishable goods and FEFO inventory rotation.

attributes.name: gift_message
attributes.description: Customer-provided gift message to be included with this line item. Contains personal message content for gift orders.

attributes.name: gift_wrap_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether gift wrapping service was requested for this line item. True if gift wrap required, false otherwise.

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item contains hazardous materials requiring special handling and shipping compliance. True if hazardous, false otherwise.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the fulfillment order. Used for ordering and referencing specific line items.
attributes.references: EDI X12 Standard - Line Item Sequencing

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current fulfillment status of this order line. Tracks the line through the pick-pack-ship workflow lifecycle. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PENDING|ALLOCATED|PICKING|PICKED|PACKED|SHIPPED|CANCELLED|SHORT_PICK — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: line_total_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value for this line item calculated as unit price multiplied by packed quantity. Represents the line-level revenue.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing lot or batch number of the picked item. Critical for traceability, recalls, and expiration management.

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the SKU originally ordered by the customer. Represents the demand that must be fulfilled.

attributes.name: pack_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this line item was packed into a shipping container. Indicates readiness for shipment.

attributes.name: packed_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity successfully packed into shipping containers. Represents the final quantity being shipped to the customer.

attributes.name: pick_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the pick task for this line item was completed. Marks the end of the picking phase for this line.

attributes.name: pick_exception_code
attributes.description: Code indicating any exception or issue encountered during the pick process. Used for root cause analysis and process improvement.

attributes.name: pick_exception_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context about pick exceptions or issues. Captured by warehouse associates for investigation.

attributes.name: pick_method
attributes.description: The picking strategy used for this line item. Determines how the pick task was organized and executed within the WMS workflow.

attributes.name: pick_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the pick task for this line item was initiated. Used for calculating pick duration and SLA compliance.

attributes.name: pick_zone
attributes.description: Warehouse zone designation where the item is located. Used for zone-based picking strategies and workforce assignment.

attributes.name: picked_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity picked by warehouse associate or automation system. May differ from allocated quantity due to short picks or inventory discrepancies.

attributes.name: return_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item is eligible for return based on product category and business rules. True if returnable, false otherwise.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number of the individual item picked. Used for high-value or serialized inventory tracking.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system that originated or last updated this order line record. Used for data lineage and integration troubleshooting.

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Any special handling requirements or instructions for this line item such as fragile, keep refrigerated, or this side up.

attributes.name: substituted_sku
attributes.description: The SKU of the substitute product that was picked in place of the originally ordered SKU. Null if no substitution occurred.

attributes.name: substitution_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a product substitution was made for this line item due to stockout or customer preference. True if substituted, false otherwise.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which quantities are measured for this line item. Defines how the product is counted and handled in the warehouse.

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Price per unit for this line item at the time of order placement. Used for order value calculation and financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this order line record was last modified. Used for change tracking and data synchronization.

attributes.name: volume_cubic_meters
attributes.description: Total volume of the picked quantity for this line item in cubic meters. Used for cartonization and space optimization.

attributes.name: weight_kg
attributes.description: Total weight of the picked quantity for this line item in kilograms. Used for shipping cost calculation and carrier selection.

products.name: packing_slip
products.description: Consolidated operational record and SSOT for the full packing lifecycle of a fulfillment order — from pack station assignment and carton selection through QC verification and packing slip document generation. Stores pack station ID, packer associate, carton/box type, dimensional and actual weight, packing materials, QC scan results, packed SKUs with quantities, special handling instructions, gift message and branded insert flags, pack start/end timestamps, and generation timestamp. Serves as both the operational pack execution record (replacing standalone pack task) and the customer-facing documentation reference for shipment contents and returns processing.

attributes.name: warehouse_node_id

attributes.name: hazmat_flag

attributes.name: height_cm

attributes.name: invoice_included

attributes.name: length_cm

attributes.name: pack_end_timestamp

products.name: shipment_event
products.description: Immutable event log capturing carrier-reported and internal tracking milestones for a shipment throughout its transit lifecycle. Each record represents a discrete tracking event: event type (picked up, in-transit, out-for-delivery, delivered, exception, attempted delivery), event timestamp, event location (city, state, country), carrier event code, raw carrier scan message, and data source (carrier API, TMS webhook, EDI 214). Enables SLA breach detection and customer-facing tracking updates.

attributes.name: shipment_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the shipment tracking event record. Primary key for the shipment event log.

attributes.name: agent_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse or carrier employee who performed the scan or recorded the event. Used for internal audit and quality tracking. Null for automated or carrier-reported events.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the transportation carrier (e.g., FedEx, UPS, USPS, DHL) that reported this tracking event. Links to carrier master data.

attributes.name: center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse, fulfillment center, or carrier facility where the event occurred. Links to facility master data for internal events.

attributes.name: fulfillment_shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent shipment container that this event belongs to. Links this tracking event to the overall shipment record.
attributes.references: EDI 214 Transportation Carrier Shipment Status Message

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer order associated with this shipment event. Enables order-level tracking and SLA monitoring.
attributes.references: ISO 20022 - Universal Financial Industry Message Scheme

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_obligation. Business justification: Event‑level incidents (e.g., customs holds) must be linked to the governing compliance obligation for reporting.

attributes.name: carrier_event_code
attributes.description: The carrier-specific status code or event identifier from the carrier's tracking system. Raw code as provided by carrier API or EDI message.

attributes.name: carrier_event_description
attributes.description: The human-readable description of the tracking event as provided by the carrier. Raw scan message or status text from carrier system.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this shipment event record was first created in the system. Immutable audit field for data governance and compliance.

attributes.name: delivery_location_type
attributes.description: The specific location where the package was left upon delivery. Applicable only to delivered events. Provides proof-of-delivery detail for customer service and claims. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: front_door|back_door|side_door|mailroom|reception|neighbor|parcel_locker|carrier_facility — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: estimated_delivery_date
attributes.description: The carrier's current estimated delivery date for the shipment as of this event. Updated dynamically as the shipment progresses. Used for customer communication and SLA tracking.

attributes.name: event_location_city
attributes.description: The city where the tracking event was recorded by the carrier. May be null for certain event types that do not have precise location data.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE - United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations

attributes.name: event_location_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code where the tracking event occurred (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX). Supports international shipment tracking.

attributes.name: event_location_postal_code
attributes.description: The postal or ZIP code of the location where the tracking event was recorded. Enables geographic analysis of shipment flow.
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union - Postal Addressing Standards

attributes.name: event_location_state
attributes.description: The state or province where the tracking event occurred. Uses standard postal abbreviations (e.g., CA, NY, TX).

attributes.name: event_source
attributes.description: The system or channel through which the tracking event was received: carrier_api (direct carrier integration), tms_webhook (Transportation Management System callback), edi_214 (Electronic Data Interchange shipment status), manual_entry (operator input), wms_scan (Warehouse Management System scan).

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the tracking event occurred in the carrier's system. This is the real-world event time, not the system ingestion time.

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: The category of tracking event representing the shipment milestone: picked_up (carrier collected package), in_transit (package moving through network), out_for_delivery (on vehicle for final delivery), delivered (successfully received), exception (delay or issue), attempted_delivery (delivery tried but failed).
attributes.references: EDI 214 Transportation Carrier Shipment Status Message

attributes.name: exception_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the exception condition if is_exception is True. Describes the nature of the delay, damage, or delivery issue. Null for non-exception events.

attributes.name: ingestion_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this event record was ingested into the data platform. Distinct from event_timestamp (when the event actually occurred). Used for data lineage and latency monitoring.

attributes.name: is_customer_visible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this event should be displayed to the customer in tracking interfaces. False for internal-only events (warehouse scans, carrier facility transfers).

attributes.name: is_exception
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this event represents an exception or problem condition (delay, damage, lost package, address issue, weather delay, etc.). True if exception, False for normal milestone events.

attributes.name: is_sla_breach
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this event represents or contributes to an SLA breach. True if the event timestamp exceeds the SLA target, False otherwise.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the event location in decimal degrees. Enables precise geospatial analysis and mapping of shipment routes.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the event location in decimal degrees. Used with latitude for route optimization and delivery zone analysis.

attributes.name: raw_payload
attributes.description: The complete raw JSON or XML payload received from the carrier API, TMS webhook, or EDI message. Preserved for audit, troubleshooting, and reprocessing. May contain additional carrier-specific metadata.

attributes.name: signature_name
attributes.description: Name of the person who signed for the delivery. Captured for delivered events requiring proof of delivery. Null for events that do not involve signature capture.

attributes.name: sla_target_delivery_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Delivery Timestamp
attributes.description: The promised delivery date and time per the service level agreement. Used to detect SLA breaches by comparing against actual delivery timestamp.

attributes.name: temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Ambient or package temperature in degrees Celsius recorded at the time of the event. Critical for cold-chain shipments (pharmaceuticals, perishables). Null for non-temperature-controlled shipments.

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: The carrier-assigned tracking number for the shipment. Used for customer-facing tracking and carrier API queries.

attributes.name: weight_actual_kg
attributes.description: The actual measured weight of the shipment in kilograms as recorded during this event. May be captured at pickup, in-transit weighing, or delivery. Used for freight cost reconciliation.

products.description: Operational record capturing all exceptions and disruptions during the fulfillment lifecycle, including SLA breaches. products.description: Core transactional entity representing a physical shipment dispatched from a fulfillment node to a destination. products.name: tracking_event
products.description: Unified event stream recording all shipment lifecycle events from carrier integrations (EDI 214, carrier APIs). Event types include: pickup scan, in-transit scan, out-for-delivery, delivery attempt (with attempt sequence, outcome, and reattempt scheduling), exception (address correction, customs hold, damage, carrier delay — with exception reason code, responsible party, resolution action, and resolution timestamp), and proof-of-delivery confirmation (recipient name, signature capture, delivery photo URL, GPS coordinates). SSOT for ALL shipment status derivation, last-mile visibility, exception management, delivery confirmation, and SLA compliance monitoring. products.name: dynamic_price_rule
products.description: Defines algorithmic or rules-based dynamic pricing logic applied to SKUs, categories, or seller listings across platform-owned and marketplace channels. Includes trigger conditions (demand signals, inventory levels, competitor price thresholds, MAP violations, seller compliance triggers), adjustment type (percentage, fixed, floor/ceiling), rule scope (platform-wide, seller-specific, category-level, brand-level), priority rank, activation schedule, and enforcement actions. For marketplace-scoped rules: MAP enforcement thresholds, maximum price caps, commission-adjusted floor prices, seller-specific pricing agreements, and brand protection policies. Powers real-time price optimization, surge/markdown automation, MAP enforcement, marketplace pricing integrity, and seller pricing governance.

domains.name: content
domains.description: Manages digital content assets powering the buyer experience including product images, videos, descriptions, SEO metadata, and content localization. Supports CDN integration, content versioning, digital asset management, search and recommendation engine inputs, PDP/PLP editorial content, and A/B test content variants for international storefronts.

products.name: content_digital_asset
products.description: Master record for all digital content assets in the DAM system including product images, videos, banners, icons, and rich media files. Tracks asset metadata (file format, resolution, file size, MIME type, color profile), CDN distribution details (CDN URL, cache TTL, edge region), storage path, asset status, rights/licensing reference, expiry date, and upload source. Maintains full version history as embedded detail records capturing version number, change type (crop, recolor, reformat, retranslate), version status (draft, approved, archived), editor identity, approval timestamp, and CDN-published URL per version. Enables rollback, audit trail, and A/B content variant management. SSOT for all binary content objects, their metadata, and their complete revision lifecycle.

attributes.name: is_suppressed
attributes.description: True if the content was suppressed from public view after moderation.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639‑1 two‑letter code representing the language of the moderated content.

attributes.name: moderation_code
attributes.description: Business identifier or code for the moderation action, used for external reference.

attributes.name: moderation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the moderation record.

attributes.name: moderator_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the moderation was performed by a human reviewer or an automated system.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free‑form notes entered by the moderator providing context or rationale.

attributes.name: regulatory_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the moderation action must be reported for regulatory compliance (e.g., GDPR, FTC).

attributes.name: rule_triggered
attributes.description: Name or code of the moderation rule that was triggered for this action.

attributes.name: source_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the moderation request originated.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the moderation record.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version of the moderation record, incremented on each update.

attributes.name: violation_category
attributes.description: Category of policy violation identified by the moderation.

products.name: performance
products.description: Tracks content effectiveness metrics and engagement analytics per content item, digital asset, and A/B test experiment. Stores impressions, click-through rate (CTR), engagement time, bounce rate, conversion attribution, revenue influence, A/B test result outcomes (winning variant, statistical significance, lift percentage), content quality scores, and time-series performance snapshots by date granularity. Enables content ROI reporting, editorial optimization prioritization, underperforming content identification, and data-driven content investment decisions. SSOT for all content analytics and effectiveness measurement.

attributes.name: performance_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate key for each content performance record.

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.channel. Business justification: Enables channel‑level KPI reporting (impressions, clicks, revenue) by linking performance rows to the marketing channel definition.

attributes.name: content_digital_asset_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the associated digital asset (image, video, etc.) if the metric relates to an asset.

attributes.name: experiment_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the A/B test experiment linked to this performance snapshot.

attributes.name: item_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the content item (article, page, or editorial block) whose performance is being recorded.

attributes.name: ab_test_variant
attributes.description: Name or code of the A/B test variant presented to the user.

attributes.name: ab_test_winning
attributes.description: True if the variant is the statistically winning variant for the experiment.

attributes.name: audience_segment
attributes.description: Segment identifier used for targeting the content (e.g., new‑visitor, high‑value‑customer).

attributes.name: bounce_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of sessions where users left after a single view of the content.

attributes.name: clicks
attributes.description: Number of user clicks on the content or associated asset.

attributes.name: confidence_score
attributes.description: Model‑generated confidence level for the metric (0‑1).

attributes.name: content_quality_score
attributes.description: Composite score evaluating content relevance, readability, and compliance.

attributes.name: conversion_count
attributes.description: Number of conversion events (e.g., add‑to‑cart, purchase) attributed to the content.

attributes.name: conversion_rate
attributes.description: Ratio of conversions to impressions (conversion_count ÷ impressions).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the performance record was first inserted.

attributes.name: ctr
attributes.description: Ratio of clicks to impressions (clicks ÷ impressions). Stored as a raw measurement captured by the analytics engine.

attributes.name: engagement_seconds
attributes.description: Total time (in seconds) users spent interacting with the content.

attributes.name: impressions
attributes.description: Number of times the content was displayed to users.

attributes.name: is_control_group
attributes.description: True if the user was exposed to the control (baseline) variant.

attributes.name: is_deleted
attributes.description: True if the record has been logically deleted.

attributes.name: lift_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage lift of the winning variant over the control.

attributes.name: locale
attributes.description: Locale of the content view in language‑country format (e.g., en-US).

attributes.name: metric_date
attributes.description: Calendar date (day granularity) for the performance snapshot.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free‑form comments or observations about the performance record.

attributes.name: revenue_influence_usd
attributes.description: Estimated revenue (in US dollars) driven by the content, as calculated by the attribution model.

attributes.name: snapshot_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact time when the performance measurement was captured.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the upstream system that generated the metric (e.g., Search Engine, CMS, Marketing Automation).

attributes.name: statistical_significance
attributes.description: True when the observed lift meets the pre‑defined significance threshold.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the performance record.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version of the performance snapshot schema for backward‑compatibility tracking.

attributes.name: prior_period_performance_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on performance (prior_period_performance_id)

products.name: kpi_assignment
products.description: Associates a content_item with a kpi_definition and stores the target values, thresholds, ownership, and effective dates for that specific pairing. Each record represents the business-managed KPI target for a particular piece of content.. Existence Justification: Content teams define KPI targets for each content item (e.g., page views, conversion rate). A single KPI definition can be applied to many content items, and each content item can have multiple KPI definitions. The association stores target values, thresholds, ownership, and effective dates, which are managed as a distinct business object.

attributes.name: kpi_assignment_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the kpi_assignment association

attributes.name: item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the content item

attributes.name: kpi_definition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the KPI definition

attributes.name: ceiling_threshold
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable KPI value

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when the KPI target expires or is superseded

attributes.name: floor_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable KPI value

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date when the KPI target becomes effective for the content item

attributes.name: stretch_target_value
attributes.description: Stretch (higher) target value for the KPI

attributes.name: target_owner_reference
attributes.description: Identifier of the owner responsible for this KPI target

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: Primary KPI target value for the content item

products.name: personalization_rule
products.description: Master reference table for personalization_rule. Referenced by personalization_rule_id.

attributes.name: personalization_rule_id
attributes.description: Primary key for personalization_rule

attributes.name: rule_audience_segment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the audience segment definition used by the rule.

attributes.name: action_payload
attributes.description: JSON or key‑value payload that supplies parameters for the selected action type.

attributes.name: action_type
attributes.description: Type of action the rule triggers (e.g., recommendation, banner, email, push notification, discount).

attributes.name: condition_expression
attributes.description: Serialized logical expression (e.g., JSON or DSL) that defines when the rule fires.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date‑time when the rule record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed free‑text description of rule purpose and logic.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date when the rule becomes active for evaluation.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date when the rule expires; null indicates no planned end date.

attributes.name: is_experimental
attributes.description: Indicates whether the rule is in experimental mode and not yet fully rolled out.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Integer priority determining rule evaluation order; lower numbers run first.

attributes.name: rule_approval_status
attributes.description: Governance status indicating whether the rule has been approved for production.

attributes.name: rule_audience_criteria
attributes.description: Serialized criteria (e.g., JSON) defining the audience beyond simple segment ID.

attributes.name: rule_capping_type
attributes.description: Granularity of the frequency cap.

attributes.name: rule_capping_value
attributes.description: Numeric value associated with the capping type.

attributes.name: rule_category
attributes.description: Broad business category the rule belongs to.

attributes.name: rule_code
attributes.description: Compact alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies the rule across systems.

attributes.name: rule_confidence_score
attributes.description: Statistical confidence (0‑100) of the rule's predicted impact.

attributes.name: rule_created_by
attributes.description: User or system that created the rule record.

attributes.name: rule_effective_time_zone
attributes.description: Time zone used for interpreting effective_from and effective_until.

attributes.name: rule_enabled
attributes.description: True if the rule is currently enabled for evaluation.

attributes.name: rule_frequency_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of times the rule may fire for a single user within the effective period.

attributes.name: rule_last_run_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent evaluation of the rule.

attributes.name: rule_name
attributes.description: Human‑readable name of the rule used in UI and reporting.

attributes.name: rule_notes
attributes.description: Free‑form notes or comments about the rule.

attributes.name: rule_owner
attributes.description: Team or individual responsible for the rule's lifecycle.

attributes.name: rule_scope
attributes.description: Geographic or logical scope where the rule applies.

attributes.name: rule_status_reason
attributes.description: Free‑text reason explaining the current status (e.g., why a rule is inactive).

attributes.name: rule_tags
attributes.description: Comma‑separated list of user‑defined tags for categorization.

attributes.name: rule_target_channel
attributes.description: Delivery channel(s) the rule is intended for.

attributes.name: rule_target_device
attributes.description: Device type(s) the rule targets.

attributes.name: rule_target_locale
attributes.description: Locale (language‑region) the rule applies to, e.g., en_US.

attributes.name: rule_target_market
attributes.description: Market or country code where the rule is active.

attributes.name: rule_test_group
attributes.description: Identifier of the A/B test group the rule belongs to, if applicable.

attributes.name: rule_type
attributes.description: Category of rule logic (e.g., segment‑based, behavior‑based, contextual, or A/B test).

attributes.name: rule_updated_by
attributes.description: User or system that performed the latest update.

attributes.name: rule_version_number
attributes.description: Alternative version tracking field; mirrors version.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the upstream system or service that authored the rule.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the rule.

attributes.name: target_audience
attributes.description: High‑level description of the user segment or context the rule targets.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date‑time of the most recent modification to the rule.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Incremental version number of the rule definition.

attributes.name: overrides_personalization_rule_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on personalization_rule (overrides_personalization_rule_id)

domains.name: finance
domains.description: SSOT for enterprise financial records and reporting. Owns general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, cost center management, budget tracking, GMV-to-revenue reconciliation, and regulatory financial reporting. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA for financial consolidation. Ensures SOX compliance for financial controls and audit trails. Tracks MRR, ARR, and revenue recognition.
domains.references: Enterprise Resource Planning - SAP S/4HANA, SOX, GAAP, IFRS

products.name: general_ledger
products.description: SSOT for the enterprise chart of accounts and GL account master data. Defines account codes, account types (asset, liability, equity, revenue, expense), account hierarchies, and natural account groupings. Serves as the structural backbone for all financial postings, trial balance generation, and financial statement preparation. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA GL for multi-company-code chart of accounts and supports SOX-compliant period-end close.

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Primary key for general_ledger

attributes.name: account_balance_gc
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Ledger (GL) Account Balance in Group Currency
attributes.description: Current cumulative balance of the GL account in the group/consolidation currency. Used for multi-entity financial consolidation, group-level reporting, and GMV-to-revenue reconciliation across all company codes. Supports MRR and ARR tracking at the enterprise level.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 21; US GAAP ASC 830; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: account_balance_lc
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Ledger (GL) Account Balance in Local Currency
attributes.description: Current cumulative balance of the GL account in the company code local currency. Represents the net of all debit and credit postings to this account for the current fiscal period. Used for trial balance generation, financial statement preparation, and period-end close reporting.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 1; US GAAP ASC 205; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: account_category
attributes.description: Secondary classification grouping GL accounts into functional categories such as cash and equivalents, accounts receivable, inventory, fixed assets, accounts payable, accrued liabilities, deferred revenue, cost of goods sold, operating expenses, etc. Supports financial statement line-item grouping and management reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cash_and_equivalents|accounts_receivable|inventory|fixed_assets|accounts_payable|accrued_liabilities|deferred_revenue|cost_of_goods_sold|operating_expenses|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 1; US GAAP ASC 210; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL

attributes.name: account_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the GL account's business purpose, the types of transactions it records, and any special posting rules or restrictions. Used for financial governance documentation, new employee training, and SOX control documentation.

attributes.name: account_effective_from
attributes.description: The date from which this GL account became active and available for financial postings. Used for account lifecycle management, historical reporting, and SOX audit trails. Postings with a document date before this date are not permitted.

attributes.name: account_effective_until
attributes.description: The date after which this GL account is no longer available for financial postings. Null for accounts with no planned end date. Used for account decommissioning, chart of accounts rationalization, and SOX-compliant account lifecycle management.

attributes.name: account_group
attributes.description: Organizational grouping of GL accounts within the chart of accounts that controls the number range and field selection for account master data maintenance. Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA account group (KTOKS). Examples include balance sheet accounts, P&L accounts, cost accounts.

attributes.name: account_long_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the GL account providing complete context for financial reporting and audit purposes. Corresponds to the SAP S/4HANA GL account long text (TXT50). Used in detailed financial statements and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: Short descriptive name of the GL account as displayed in financial reports, trial balances, and the chart of accounts. Corresponds to the SAP S/4HANA GL account short text (TXT20).

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: The externally-known, human-readable GL account number as defined in the chart of accounts. Used in all financial postings, journal entries, and financial statement line items. Corresponds to the SAP S/4HANA GL account key (SAKNR).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; IFRS IAS 1; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the GL account master record. Active accounts accept financial postings; blocked accounts are temporarily restricted from new postings; marked_for_deletion accounts are pending archival after period-end close. Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA account blocking indicators.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Fundamental financial classification of the GL account per the accounting equation. Determines how the account appears on financial statements: asset and liability/equity accounts appear on the balance sheet; revenue and expense accounts appear on the income statement. Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA account type (KTOKS).
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 1; US GAAP ASC 205; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL

attributes.name: alternative_account_number
attributes.description: Alternative or country-specific account number used for local statutory reporting requirements. Enables mapping between the operational chart of accounts and country-specific or group chart of accounts. Supports multi-GAAP reporting and local statutory compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; IFRS IAS 1; Local GAAP

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the chart of accounts grouping to which this GL account belongs. In SAP S/4HANA, a chart of accounts is a classified directory of all GL accounts used by one or more company codes. Enables multi-COA structures for operational and group reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; IFRS IAS 1; US GAAP ASC 205

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA company code representing the legal entity or organizational unit for which the GL account is defined. Supports multi-company-code chart of accounts and financial consolidation across the enterprise.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA cost center code linked to this GL account for cost center accounting. Enables expense tracking and allocation by organizational unit, department, or function. Supports management reporting and budget variance analysis.

attributes.name: cost_element_category
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is also defined as a cost element in SAP Controlling (CO) module. Primary cost elements correspond to GL expense/revenue accounts; secondary cost elements are used for internal cost allocations and have no corresponding GL account. Drives cost center accounting and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA user ID of the person who created this GL account master record. Required for SOX-compliant audit trails, segregation of duties controls, and financial governance. Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA ERNAM field.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; ISO 27001

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this GL account master record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation point for SOX compliance and data lineage tracking. Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA creation date and time fields.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; ISO 27001

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the account currency. When set, all postings to this account must be in this currency. If null, the account accepts postings in any currency and balances are maintained in the company code currency. Critical for multi-currency financial reporting and foreign exchange management.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: field_status_group
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA field status group code assigned to this GL account that controls which fields are required, optional, or suppressed during document entry for postings to this account. Ensures data completeness and consistency for financial postings.

attributes.name: financial_statement_section
attributes.description: Identifies which primary financial statement this GL account contributes to. Drives automated financial statement preparation and regulatory reporting. Critical for SOX-compliant period-end close and IFRS/GAAP financial reporting.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 1; US GAAP ASC 205; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (accounting period) within the fiscal year to which the current account balance applies. Typically 1-12 for monthly periods, with additional special periods (13-16) for year-end adjustments. Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA posting period (MONAT).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; SOX Section 404; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which the current account balance and period-end close data applies. Supports multi-year financial reporting, year-over-year comparisons, and SOX-compliant audit trails. Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA fiscal year (GJAHR).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; SOX Section 404; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: fiscal_year_variant
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA fiscal year variant code that defines the fiscal year structure (calendar year, non-calendar year, or shortened fiscal year) and the number of posting periods. Determines how fiscal periods map to calendar months for financial reporting.

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA functional area classification that categorizes GL accounts by business function (e.g., sales, marketing, production, administration, research and development). Enables cost-of-sales accounting and functional income statement reporting per IFRS IAS 1.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; IFRS IAS 1; US GAAP ASC 205

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level of this GL account within the account hierarchy tree, where level 1 represents the top-most grouping (e.g., total assets) and higher numbers represent more granular accounts. Used for financial statement rollup logic and management reporting drill-down.

attributes.name: is_balance_sheet_relevant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account carries a balance that is reported on the balance sheet. Balance sheet accounts (assets, liabilities, equity) carry forward their balances at year-end; P&L accounts are reset to zero. Drives automated year-end closing and balance carryforward processes.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 1; US GAAP ASC 205; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL

attributes.name: is_posting_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether direct financial postings are permitted to this GL account. When false, the account is a summary/header account used only for hierarchical reporting and cannot receive direct journal entry postings. Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA posting block indicator.

attributes.name: is_reconciliation_account
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is a reconciliation account that is automatically updated when postings are made to subledger accounts (accounts receivable, accounts payable, asset accounting). Reconciliation accounts cannot receive direct manual postings. Critical for AR/AP subledger-to-GL reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; SOX Section 404; IFRS IAS 39

attributes.name: last_posting_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent financial posting made to this GL account. Used for account activity monitoring, dormant account identification, and chart of accounts maintenance. Supports period-end close validation and SOX control testing.

attributes.name: line_item_display
attributes.description: Indicates whether individual line items posted to this GL account are stored and displayable for audit and analysis purposes. When true, each posting line is retained for drill-down reporting. Required for SOX audit trails and financial investigation. Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA line item display indicator (XKRES).

attributes.name: normal_balance
attributes.description: Indicates whether the GL account normally carries a debit or credit balance per double-entry bookkeeping rules. Assets and expenses normally carry debit balances; liabilities, equity, and revenue normally carry credit balances. Used for trial balance validation and automated posting rules.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 1; US GAAP ASC 205; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL

attributes.name: open_item_management
attributes.description: Indicates whether open item management is activated for this GL account. When true, individual line items remain open until they are cleared against offsetting entries (e.g., payment clearing for bank accounts, GR/IR clearing accounts). Essential for bank reconciliation and clearing account management.

attributes.name: parent_account_number
attributes.description: Account number of the parent GL account in the account hierarchy. Enables multi-level account hierarchies for financial reporting rollups, management reporting, and financial consolidation. Null for top-level accounts in the hierarchy.

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA profit center code associated with this GL account for profitability analysis and segment reporting. Enables revenue and cost attribution to business segments, product lines, or geographic regions. Supports IFRS 8 operating segment disclosures.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA; IFRS 8; US GAAP ASC 280

attributes.name: reconciliation_account_type
attributes.description: Specifies the subledger type this reconciliation account is linked to. Determines which subledger transactions automatically update this GL account. Null or 'none' for non-reconciliation accounts. Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA reconciliation account type (MITKZ).

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Business segment identifier associated with this GL account for segment reporting. Supports IFRS 8 and US GAAP ASC 280 operating segment disclosures. Enables financial reporting by business segment such as marketplace, fulfillment, advertising, or subscription services.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; IFRS 8; US GAAP ASC 280

attributes.name: sort_key
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA sort key code that determines which field is used to populate the allocation field in line items posted to this account. Controls how line items are sorted and displayed in account statements. Examples: 001 (posting date), 003 (document number), 031 (order number).

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: Specifies the tax treatment applicable to postings on this GL account. Controls whether tax codes are required, optional, or not applicable for journal entries. Relevant for VAT/GST compliance, sales tax reporting, and indirect tax management. Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA tax category (MWSKZ). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: input_tax|output_tax|not_relevant|all_tax_codes|minus_sign — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; EU VAT Directive; IRS Tax Code

attributes.name: tolerance_group
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA tolerance group assigned to this GL account that defines the permitted payment differences and rounding tolerances for clearing transactions. Controls automatic write-off of small differences during payment processing and bank reconciliation. Supports SOX controls over financial accuracy.

attributes.name: updated_by_user
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA user ID of the person who last modified this GL account master record. Required for SOX-compliant audit trails, change management controls, and financial governance. Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA AENAM field.
