attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; ISO 27001

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this GL account master record. Tracks changes to account attributes for SOX-compliant audit trails and data lineage. Essential for change management controls and period-end close integrity.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; ISO 27001

products.name: journal_entry
products.description: Authoritative record of all double-entry accounting transactions posted to the general ledger, including both header-level metadata and line-level debit/credit detail. Header captures posting dates, fiscal periods, document types, reference documents (order IDs, payment IDs, invoice numbers), reversal indicators, and SAP document numbers. Each line item captures GL account, cost center, profit center, amount in transaction and local currency, tax code, business area, and trading partner. Supports SOX audit trails, automated period-end close postings (accruals, depreciation, revaluations), and granular reconciliation workflows. Every entry must balance (total debits = total credits).

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each journal entry record in the general ledger. Serves as the primary key for the journal_entry data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center responsible for the expenditure or revenue captured in this journal entry. Enables cost allocation, departmental P&L reporting, and budget variance analysis.

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Reference to the General Ledger (GL) account to which this journal entry header is primarily associated. The GL account determines the financial statement line item and chart of accounts classification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; GAAP/IFRS; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the SAP ledger to which the journal entry is posted (e.g., 0L for leading ledger, 2L for IFRS parallel ledger, 3L for local GAAP ledger). Supports parallel accounting under multiple accounting standards.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; GAAP/IFRS; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the profit center associated with this journal entry. Supports segment-level profitability reporting, GMV-to-revenue reconciliation, and management accounting.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the intercompany trading partner entity involved in this journal entry. Required for intercompany elimination during financial consolidation and statutory group reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; GAAP/IFRS Consolidation; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: assignment_number
attributes.description: A free-form alphanumeric field used to group or sort journal entry line items for reconciliation and reporting purposes (e.g., payment run ID, clearing document number, batch reference). Supports open item management and account clearing workflows.

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: SAP business area code representing a distinct operational segment of the enterprise (e.g., marketplace, fulfillment, advertising). Enables cross-company-code financial reporting by business segment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; GAAP/IFRS Segment Reporting (IFRS 8)

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the open item represented by this journal entry line was cleared (offset by a payment or contra-entry). Used for aging analysis, DSO (Days Sales Outstanding) calculation, and AR/AP reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; GAAP/IFRS; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP document number of the clearing transaction that offset this open item (e.g., payment clearing an invoice). Populated when the journal entry line has been cleared. Supports accounts receivable and accounts payable reconciliation workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; GAAP/IFRS; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code representing the legal entity or organizational unit for which the journal entry is posted. Used for entity-level financial consolidation and statutory reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 302/404; ISO 27001

attributes.name: debit_credit_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the journal entry line represents a debit (D) or credit (C) posting in double-entry accounting. Every journal entry must balance such that total debits equal total credits, enforcing the fundamental accounting equation.
attributes.references: GAAP/IFRS; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date of the original source document (invoice, receipt, contract) that triggered the journal entry. May differ from the posting date for accruals, reversals, or late-arriving documents.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: SAP document type code classifying the nature of the journal entry (e.g., SA=General Ledger, KR=Vendor Invoice, DR=Customer Invoice, AB=Accounting Document, ZP=Payment Posting, AA=Asset Posting). Drives posting rules and account determination. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SA|KR|DR|AB|ZP|AA|RE|RV|WA|WE — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: entry_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the journal entry record was first created and captured in the system. Used for SOX audit trails, data lineage, and period-end close monitoring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; SOX Section 302/404; ISO 27001

attributes.name: entry_type
attributes.description: Business classification of the journal entry indicating its accounting purpose: original posting, reversal of a prior entry, period-end accrual, asset depreciation run, currency revaluation, or intercompany elimination.
attributes.references: GAAP/IFRS; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign currency exchange rate applied to convert the transaction currency amount to the local currency at the time of posting. Critical for multi-currency reconciliation, currency revaluation, and GAAP/IFRS IAS 21 compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; GAAP/IFRS IAS 21; ISO 4217

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The accounting period (1–16) within the fiscal year to which the journal entry belongs. Periods 13–16 are typically used for special period-end adjustments, accruals, and audit postings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; GAAP/IFRS; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the journal entry is recorded (e.g., 2024). Used for annual financial reporting, SOX compliance, and year-end close processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; SOX Section 302/404; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: group_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount of the journal entry converted to the group (consolidation) currency. Used for consolidated financial statements, MRR/ARR tracking, and enterprise-level GMV-to-revenue reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; GAAP/IFRS IAS 21; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: group_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the enterprise group's reporting currency (e.g., USD). Used for consolidated financial statements and cross-entity comparisons.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; GAAP/IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: header_text
attributes.description: Free-text description at the journal entry header level explaining the business purpose or context of the posting (e.g., 'Q4 Accrual - Marketplace Seller Commissions', 'Monthly Depreciation Run'). Used for audit review and financial close documentation.

attributes.name: is_intercompany
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this journal entry represents an intercompany transaction between two legal entities within the same corporate group (True) or an external third-party transaction (False). Intercompany entries require elimination during group financial consolidation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; GAAP/IFRS IAS 27; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: is_statistical
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this journal entry is a statistical (non-real) posting used for management reporting and cost allocation purposes only (True), as opposed to a real posting that updates actual financial balances (False). Statistical postings do not affect the balance sheet.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the journal entry record was last modified. Supports change tracking, audit trails, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; SOX Section 302/404; ISO 27001

attributes.name: line_item_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the journal entry document identifying the position of each debit or credit line. Used to uniquely reference individual line items within a multi-line journal entry for reconciliation and audit purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; GAAP/IFRS; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: line_item_text
attributes.description: Free-text description at the individual line item level providing additional context for the specific debit or credit posting (e.g., 'Accrued seller commission - Nov 2024', 'Revenue recognition - Order #ORD-98765'). Supports granular audit trails and reconciliation.

attributes.name: local_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount of the journal entry converted to the local (company code) currency. Used for statutory financial reporting and local GAAP compliance in the jurisdiction of the legal entity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; GAAP/IFRS IAS 21; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: local_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the company code's local (functional) currency (e.g., USD for US entities, EUR for EU entities). Used for local statutory reporting and tax filings.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; GAAP/IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The principal real-world accounting date on which the journal entry is posted to the general ledger. Determines the fiscal period assignment and is the primary date used for period-end close, financial reporting, and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; GAAP/IFRS; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: posting_key
attributes.description: SAP two-digit posting key that determines the account type, debit/credit assignment, and field selection for the journal entry line (e.g., 40=GL Debit, 50=GL Credit, 01=Customer Invoice, 31=Vendor Invoice). Drives account determination and field status.

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the journal entry in the general ledger workflow. Draft entries are pending approval; posted entries are final; reversed entries have been offset by a counter-entry; parked entries await completion; held entries are saved but not yet posted; error entries failed validation.

attributes.name: reference_document_type
attributes.description: The type of source business document that originated this journal entry (e.g., order, payment, invoice, purchase_order, return, shipment). Enables traceability from the GL back to the originating operational transaction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; SOX Section 302/404; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reversal of this journal entry is scheduled or was executed. Used for automated period-end accrual reversals and audit trail completeness.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; GAAP/IFRS; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this journal entry is a reversal of a previously posted entry (True) or an original posting (False). Reversal entries offset prior postings and are critical for period-end close accuracy and SOX audit trails.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; GAAP/IFRS; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP document number of the original journal entry that this entry reverses. Populated only when reversal_indicator is True. Enables audit trail linkage between original and reversal postings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; SOX Section 302/404; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: sap_document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known accounting document number assigned by SAP S/4HANA upon posting. This is the primary business identifier used by finance teams to reference a journal entry across systems, audit trails, and reconciliation workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Module; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record that originated this journal entry (e.g., SAP_S4HANA for ERP-generated entries, OMS for order management system auto-postings, PAYMENT_GATEWAY for payment settlement entries, WMS for inventory adjustments, MANUAL for manually entered entries). Supports data lineage and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; SOX Section 302/404; ISO 27001

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The calculated tax amount (VAT, GST, or sales tax) associated with this journal entry in the transaction currency. Used for tax liability reporting, tax reconciliation, and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX; EU VAT Directive; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: SAP tax code identifying the applicable tax rate and tax category (e.g., VAT, GST, sales tax) for the journal entry line. Drives automatic tax calculation and tax reporting to regulatory authorities.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX; EU VAT Directive; FTC; GDPR

attributes.name: transaction_amount
attributes.description: The gross monetary amount of the journal entry in the transaction currency (the currency of the originating business event). Used as the base amount before currency conversion for multi-currency reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; GAAP/IFRS IAS 21; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: transaction_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the originating transaction (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Represents the currency in which the business event was denominated before conversion to local or group currency.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; GAAP/IFRS IAS 21

products.name: journal_entry_line
products.description: Individual debit or credit line items within a journal entry. Captures GL account, cost center, profit center, amount, currency, tax code, and business area for each posting line. Enables granular financial analysis at the line-item level and supports reconciliation workflows in SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: journal_entry_line_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each individual debit or credit line item within a journal entry. Serves as the primary key for this entity in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Journal Entry Line Item (ACDOCA)

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center responsible for this expenditure or revenue posting. Used for internal management accounting, departmental P&L reporting, and budget variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Cost Center Master (CSKS); SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the General Ledger account to which this line item is posted. The GL account determines the financial statement classification (asset, liability, equity, revenue, expense). Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE RESOURCE_REFERENCE category.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — GL Account Master (SKA1/SKAT); GAAP Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent journal entry header that this line item belongs to. Establishes the header-detail relationship for the posting document. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE HEADER_REFERENCE category.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Accounting Document Header (BKPF)

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the profit center associated with this posting line. Enables profitability analysis by business segment, product line, or geographic region within the enterprise.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA EC-PCA Module — Profit Center Master (CEPC); IFRS 8 Operating Segments

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: SAP account type indicator for this line item: A=Asset, D=Customer (Debtor), K=Vendor (Creditor), M=Material, S=General Ledger. Determines which subledger the posting affects. Corresponds to KOART in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BSEG.KOART; GAAP Chart of Accounts Classification

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount of this journal entry line in the transaction currency. Always stored as a positive value; the debit_credit_indicator determines the sign direction. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_VALUE_OR_RESULT category. Corresponds to WRBTR in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — ACDOCA.WRBTR; GAAP ASC 820; IFRS IFRS 13

attributes.name: amount_group_currency
attributes.description: The monetary amount of this line item translated into the group (consolidation) currency for enterprise-wide financial consolidation and consolidated financial statement preparation. Corresponds to KZBTR in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — ACDOCA; IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: amount_local_currency
attributes.description: The monetary amount of this line item translated into the company code local currency (functional currency). Used for statutory financial reporting in the entity's home jurisdiction. Corresponds to DMBTR in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — ACDOCA.DMBTR; IFRS IAS 21 Foreign Currency Transactions; GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: assignment_number
attributes.description: Alphanumeric assignment field used for sorting and matching open items in accounts receivable and accounts payable clearing. Typically populated with the customer/vendor reference or payment advice number. Corresponds to ZUONR in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BSEG.ZUONR; AR/AP Reconciliation Best Practices

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: SAP business area code representing a distinct area of operations or responsibility within the enterprise (e.g., marketplace, fulfillment, logistics). Enables cross-company-code financial reporting by business segment. Corresponds to GSBER in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — ACDOCA.GSBER; IFRS 8 Operating Segments

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: The date on which this open item was cleared (matched and offset) against a payment or credit memo. Null if the item remains open. Used for aging analysis and DSO (Days Sales Outstanding) calculations. Corresponds to AUGDT in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BSEG.AUGDT; GAAP ASC 310 Receivables

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: The accounting document number that cleared (offset) this open item in accounts receivable or accounts payable. Populated when an invoice is matched against a payment. Corresponds to AUGBL in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BSEG.AUGBL; AR/AP Clearing and Reconciliation Standards

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code representing the legal entity or organizational unit for which this journal entry line is posted. Enables multi-entity financial consolidation and legal reporting. Corresponds to BUKRS in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Company Code (T001); SOX Section 302/404; IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this journal entry line record was created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation timestamp required for SOX compliance and financial record integrity. Corresponds to CPUDT/CPUTM in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BKPF.CPUDT/CPUTM; SOX Section 404; ISO 27001

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the transaction amount on this line item (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Enables multi-currency financial reporting and foreign exchange revaluation. Corresponds to WAERS in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Module — ACDOCA.WAERS; IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: debit_credit_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item is a debit (D) or credit (C) posting. Fundamental to double-entry bookkeeping; every journal entry must have equal debits and credits. Corresponds to SHKZG in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — ACDOCA.SHKZG; GAAP Double-Entry Accounting Principles; IFRS Conceptual Framework

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date of the original source document (invoice, receipt, contract) that triggered this journal entry line. May differ from the posting date when documents are processed with a lag. Corresponds to BLDAT in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BKPF.BLDAT; GAAP ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Two-character SAP document type classifying the nature of the accounting document (e.g., SA=GL posting, KR=vendor invoice, DR=customer invoice, ZP=payment, AB=asset posting). Controls number range assignment and account types allowed. Corresponds to BLART in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BKPF.BLART; GAAP Source Document Classification

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The calculated due date for payment of this line item based on the document date and payment terms. Used for cash flow forecasting, payment run scheduling, and overdue item identification. Corresponds to FAEDT in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BSEG.FAEDT; GAAP ASC 310 Receivables Management

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (accounting period, typically 1–12 for monthly, or 1–16 including special periods) within the fiscal year for this posting. Enables period-level financial reporting and month-end close tracking. Corresponds to POPER in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — ACDOCA.POPER; GAAP ASC 270

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which this journal entry line is recorded for financial reporting purposes. Used for annual financial statement preparation and year-over-year comparisons. Corresponds to GJAHR in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — ACDOCA.GJAHR; GAAP ASC 270; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: Functional area classification for this posting line, used to categorize expenses by business function (e.g., cost of goods sold, selling, general and administrative, research and development) for income statement presentation. Corresponds to FKBER in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — ACDOCA.FKBER; GAAP ASC 220; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: is_cleared
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this open item has been cleared (True) or remains open (False) in the subledger. Drives open item management reporting for AR and AP aging analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BSEG Open Item Management; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: line_item_text
attributes.description: Free-text description of this individual journal entry line item, providing business context for the posting (e.g., 'Q3 marketplace commission accrual', 'FBA fulfillment fee reversal'). Corresponds to SGTXT in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BSEG.SGTXT; SOX Section 404 Documentation Requirements

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the parent journal entry, used to order and uniquely identify each posting line within a document. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_SEQUENCE category. Corresponds to BUZEI in SAP S/4HANA ACDOCA.

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the company code local (functional) currency. Enables reconciliation between transaction currency and statutory reporting currency. Corresponds to HWAER in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Module — ACDOCA.HWAER; IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Payment terms key applicable to this line item, defining the due date calculation and any early payment discount conditions (e.g., NET30, 2/10NET30). Relevant for vendor invoice and customer invoice line items. Corresponds to ZTERM in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BSEG.ZTERM; UCC Article 2 Commercial Terms

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which this journal entry line is posted to the General Ledger. Determines the fiscal period assignment and is the primary date used for financial reporting and period-end close. Corresponds to BUDAT in SAP S/4HANA. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_VALUE_OR_RESULT temporal component.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — ACDOCA.BUDAT; GAAP ASC 250; IFRS IAS 8

attributes.name: posting_key
attributes.description: Two-digit SAP posting key that controls the account type, debit/credit direction, and field selection for this line item (e.g., 40=GL debit, 50=GL credit, 01=customer invoice, 31=vendor invoice). Corresponds to BSCHL in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BSEG.BSCHL; SAP FI Configuration Guide

attributes.name: profit_center_partner
attributes.description: The partner profit center for intercompany or intra-company eliminations in profit center accounting. Used to eliminate internal transactions during segment and consolidated financial reporting. Corresponds to PRCTR_PARTNER in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA EC-PCA Module; IFRS 10 Consolidation Eliminations; GAAP ASC 810

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference number from the originating source document (e.g., vendor invoice number, purchase order number, payment reference). Enables traceability from the GL posting back to the originating business transaction. Corresponds to XBLNR in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BKPF.XBLNR; SOX Section 404 Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry line is a reversal posting (True) that offsets a previously posted entry. Critical for audit trail integrity and period-end close accuracy under SOX controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BKPF.STBLG; SOX Section 404 Internal Controls; GAAP ASC 250 Accounting Changes

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the business reason for reversing this journal entry line (e.g., incorrect account, wrong period, duplicate posting, accrual reversal). Supports audit trail documentation and SOX compliance. Corresponds to STGRD in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BKPF.STGRD; SOX Section 404; GAAP ASC 250

attributes.name: segment
attributes.description: Financial reporting segment assigned to this line item for segment-level P&L reporting under IFRS 8 or ASC 280. Represents a distinct business unit such as B2C marketplace, B2B wholesale, or third-party logistics. Corresponds to SEGMENT in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — ACDOCA.SEGMENT; IFRS 8 Operating Segments; GAAP ASC 280

attributes.name: source_ledger
attributes.description: The SAP ledger from which this journal entry line originates (e.g., 0L=Leading Ledger GAAP, 1L=Local GAAP extension ledger, 2L=IFRS extension ledger). Supports parallel accounting under multiple accounting standards. Corresponds to RLDNR in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Universal Journal Ledger (ACDOCA.RLDNR); IFRS IAS 1; GAAP ASC 205

attributes.name: special_gl_indicator
attributes.description: SAP special GL indicator used to classify non-standard postings such as down payments, guarantees, bills of exchange, or statistical postings. Enables separate reporting of these items from standard AR/AP balances. Corresponds to UMSKZ in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BSEG.UMSKZ; GAAP ASC 210 Balance Sheet Classification

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The calculated tax amount (VAT, GST, or sales tax) associated with this journal entry line in the transaction currency. Used for tax reporting, VAT return preparation, and tax reconciliation workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — ACDOCA; EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; GAAP ASC 740 Income Taxes

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax code assigned to this line item, determining the applicable tax rate and tax account for VAT, GST, or sales tax calculations. Drives automatic tax line generation in SAP S/4HANA. Corresponds to MWSKZ in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — ACDOCA.MWSKZ; EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; FTC Consumer Tax Compliance

attributes.name: trading_partner
attributes.description: Company code of the intercompany trading partner for intercompany transaction identification and elimination during group financial consolidation. Corresponds to VBUND in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — ACDOCA.VBUND; IFRS 10 Intercompany Eliminations; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this journal entry line record was last modified in the source system or Silver Layer. Supports change data capture, reconciliation workflows, and audit trail completeness.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Change Document Log; SOX Section 404; ISO 27001

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The date on which the financial value of this posting becomes effective for cash flow and liquidity management purposes. Particularly relevant for bank postings and payment transactions. Corresponds to VALUT in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — ACDOCA.VALUT; IAS 7 Statement of Cash Flows

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person or system process that created this journal entry line. Essential for SOX audit trail, segregation of duties compliance, and financial control monitoring. Corresponds to USNAM in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BKPF.USNAM; SOX Section 302/404 Audit Trail; ISO 27001 Access Control

products.name: cost_center
products.description: Master data for organizational cost centers and profit centers used to track, allocate, and report on operational expenses and internal profitability across business units, departments, and functions. Owns cost/profit center hierarchy, center type (cost-only or profit-tracking), responsible managers, budget allocation codes, and validity periods. Supports GMV-to-revenue reconciliation at the segment level and P&L reporting by business unit (marketplace, DTC, B2B). Integrates with SAP S/4HANA CO module for internal cost controlling and EC-PCA for profitability analysis.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the cost center record in the enterprise data platform. Primary key for the cost_center master data product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Cost Center Master Data

attributes.name: agent_id
attributes.description: Employee ID of the manager accountable for this cost center's budget, expenditures, and financial performance. Used for budget approval workflows, variance reporting, and SOX control ownership assignment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Cost Center Responsible Person; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.profit_center

attributes.name: activity_type_code
attributes.description: SAP CO activity type code associated with this cost center for activity-based costing. Activity types define the unit of output (e.g., machine hours, labor hours, API calls) used to allocate costs to cost objects such as orders or projects.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-ACT Module — Activity Types

attributes.name: actual_posting_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether actual cost postings (from FI, MM, HR, etc.) are permitted to this cost center. Controls financial transaction authorization at the cost center level in SAP CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Posting Authorization; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: annual_budget_amount
attributes.description: Total approved annual budget allocated to this cost center in the controlling currency. Represents the planned expenditure ceiling for the fiscal year. Used for budget vs. actual variance analysis and financial planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA Module; GAAP ASC 420; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: budget_allocation_code
attributes.description: Code that links this cost center to its approved budget allocation in the annual planning cycle. Used to match actual expenditures against planned budgets in SAP CO-PA and for variance analysis in financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PA Module; SOX Section 404; GAAP ASC 420

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: Top-level business unit to which this cost center belongs. Supports P&L reporting segmented by Marketplace, Direct-to-Consumer (DTC), Business-to-Business (B2B), Fulfillment, Technology, and Corporate functions. Enables GMV-to-revenue reconciliation at the segment level.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 280 Segment Reporting; SAP S/4HANA EC-PCA

attributes.name: center_type
attributes.description: Classifies whether the center tracks costs only (cost center), revenues and costs for P&L (profit center), capital investment accountability (investment center), or revenue generation only (revenue center). Drives how SAP EC-PCA profitability analysis is applied.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA EC-PCA Module; GAAP ASC 280 Segment Reporting

attributes.name: commitment_posting_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether commitment postings (purchase orders, purchase requisitions) are permitted to this cost center. Enables funds management and purchase order commitment tracking against the cost center budget.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM Module — Commitment Management; GAAP ASC 420

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP FI company code to which this cost center is assigned. Represents the legal entity for financial accounting and statutory reporting. Used for SOX compliance and inter-company reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Company Code; SOX Section 302; GAAP ASC 810

attributes.name: controlling_area_code
attributes.description: SAP CO controlling area code that defines the organizational unit within which cost accounting is performed. All cost centers belong to exactly one controlling area, which determines the currency and fiscal year variant for internal reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Controlling Area Configuration

attributes.name: cost_allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used to allocate or distribute costs from this cost center to other cost objects. Direct allocation posts costs directly; assessment uses statistical keys; distribution reallocates primary costs; activity-based costing uses activity types. Configured in SAP CO-OM cycle definitions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA Module — Allocation Cycles; GAAP ASC 420

attributes.name: cost_center_category
attributes.description: SAP CO cost center category code (e.g., E for administration, F for production, H for auxiliary) that classifies the functional nature of the cost center for internal cost allocation and reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: administration|production|auxiliary|sales|marketing|logistics|technology|finance — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Cost Center Category; GAAP ASC 280

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies the cost center within the controlling area. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA CO module and used across ERP, finance reporting, and budget systems for cross-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Cost Center Master Data; ISO 6093

attributes.name: cost_center_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the cost center's business purpose, scope of operations, and the types of expenses it tracks. Supports financial governance and audit documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Cost Center Master Data; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: cost_center_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the cost center as defined in the SAP CO module. Used in financial reports, P&L statements, and budget dashboards to identify the organizational unit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Cost Center Master Data

attributes.name: cost_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost center. Active centers accept postings; locked centers are frozen for new transactions; archived centers are closed and retained for historical reporting only. Aligns with SAP CO activation status.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Cost Center Status; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where this cost center operates. Used for statutory reporting, tax jurisdiction assignment, and GDPR/CCPA data residency compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GDPR Article 3; CCPA Section 1798

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cost center master data record was first created in the source system (SAP S/4HANA CO). Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance evidence of record creation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ISO 27001 A.12.4 — Logging and Monitoring

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the cost center's controlling currency (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Determines the currency in which cost center budgets, actuals, and variances are reported.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: Functional department within the business unit that owns this cost center (e.g., Engineering, Finance, Marketing, Operations, Logistics). Used for departmental budget tracking and headcount cost allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Organizational Assignment

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which the cost center's budget and validity are defined. Aligns with the SAP fiscal year variant configured for the controlling area. Used to scope budget allocations and financial reporting periods.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Fiscal Year Variant; GAAP ASC 270

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: SAP FI functional area code assigned to this cost center, used to classify costs by business function (e.g., Sales, Administration, Production, R&D) for cost-of-sales accounting and segment reporting under GAAP and IFRS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Functional Area; IFRS 8; GAAP ASC 280

attributes.name: gdpr_relevant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center processes or is associated with personal data subject to GDPR obligations. Used for data protection impact assessments and privacy-by-design compliance tracking.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 35 — Data Protection Impact Assessment; ISO 27001

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3) associated with this cost center. Used for regional P&L reporting, transfer pricing compliance, and multi-currency consolidation in international operations.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: Primary General Ledger (GL) account code associated with this cost center for financial consolidation in SAP FI-CO. Used to map cost center postings to the chart of accounts for statutory and management reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Module; GAAP ASC 230; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric depth of this cost center within the organizational cost center hierarchy. Level 1 represents the top of the hierarchy (enterprise); higher numbers represent more granular organizational units. Used for hierarchical roll-up and drill-down in financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Standard Hierarchy

attributes.name: hierarchy_node_code
attributes.description: Code of the parent node in the standard cost center hierarchy (SAP CO standard hierarchy). Enables roll-up reporting from individual cost centers to department, business unit, and enterprise levels for consolidated financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Standard Hierarchy; GAAP ASC 280

attributes.name: internal_order_code
attributes.description: SAP CO internal order code linked to this cost center for project-based or campaign-based cost tracking. Internal orders provide a more granular cost collection object within the cost center for specific initiatives (e.g., a marketing campaign or technology project).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-OPA Module — Internal Orders

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this cost center master data record in the source system. Used for change detection in ETL pipelines, audit trails, and SOX compliance evidence of record changes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ISO 27001 A.12.4 — Logging and Monitoring

attributes.name: lock_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cost center is locked for new financial postings. When True, no new actual or plan postings are permitted. Used during period-end close, audits, or organizational restructuring to prevent unauthorized transactions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Cost Center Lock; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: mrr_tracking_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center is configured to track Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) contributions for subscription-based revenue recognition. Relevant for B2B and marketplace seller subscription fee revenue streams.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR

attributes.name: parent_cost_center_code
attributes.description: Code of the parent cost center in a self-referencing hierarchy, enabling recursive organizational roll-up for management reporting. Null for top-level cost centers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Cost Center Hierarchy

attributes.name: plan_posting_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether planning postings (budget and forecast entries) are permitted to this cost center. Controls whether the cost center participates in the annual planning and rolling forecast cycles in SAP CO-OM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM Module — Planning Authorization

attributes.name: responsible_manager_name
attributes.description: Full name of the manager responsible for this cost center. Stored as a denormalized display field for financial reports and budget dashboards without requiring a join to the HR system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Cost Center Responsible Person

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Reporting segment code assigned to this cost center for IFRS 8 and GAAP ASC 280 segment disclosures. Enables GMV-to-revenue reconciliation and P&L reporting at the segment level (e.g., Marketplace, DTC, B2B).
attributes.references: IFRS 8 Operating Segments; GAAP ASC 280; SAP S/4HANA EC-PCA

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this cost center master data was sourced. Primarily SAP S/4HANA CO module. Used for data lineage tracking and ETL reconciliation in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: NIST Cybersecurity Framework — Data Provenance; ISO 27001

attributes.name: sox_relevant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center is in scope for Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) internal controls over financial reporting. SOX-relevant cost centers require documented control procedures, segregation of duties, and periodic audit evidence.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; SOX Section 404; PCAOB AS 2201

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Tax jurisdiction code assigned to this cost center for indirect tax (VAT/GST/sales tax) determination and reporting. Used in SAP FI-TX for tax calculation on cost center-related procurement and expense transactions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Module; FTC Consumer Protection; WTO International Trade Regulations

attributes.name: wbs_element_code
attributes.description: SAP PS Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) element code associated with this cost center for project cost tracking. Enables project-level cost reporting and capital expenditure (CapEx) vs. operating expenditure (OpEx) classification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS Module — WBS Elements; GAAP ASC 350 Capitalization

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: The date from which this cost center is active and can accept financial postings. Corresponds to the SAP CO validity period start date. Cost center records are time-sliced; this field defines the start of the current validity interval.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Validity Period; GAAP ASC 280

attributes.name: valid_to
attributes.description: The date until which this cost center is active and can accept financial postings. Corresponds to the SAP CO validity period end date. A null or far-future date (e.g., 9999-12-31) indicates an open-ended validity period.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Validity Period; GAAP ASC 280

products.name: profit_center
products.description: Master data for profit centers representing autonomous business segments for internal profitability reporting. Tracks revenue, costs, and margins by business unit (e.g., marketplace, DTC, B2B). Supports GMV-to-revenue reconciliation and segment-level P&L reporting in SAP S/4HANA EC-PCA module.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the profit center record in the enterprise data lakehouse. Primary key for the profit_center master data product.

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used to allocate shared costs and overhead to this profit center in SAP CO. 'direct' = costs posted directly; 'assessment' = allocated via assessment cycles; 'distribution' = allocated via distribution cycles; 'settlement' = settled from internal orders or projects.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-CCA; SOX Section 404; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: annual_cost_budget
attributes.description: Planned annual operating cost allocation for this profit center in the profit center's primary currency. Supports cost center management, overhead allocation, and budget adherence tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-CCA; SOX Section 404; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: annual_revenue_budget
attributes.description: Planned annual revenue target for this profit center in the profit center's primary currency. Used for budget vs. actuals variance analysis and segment-level P&L reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PA; SOX Section 404; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: budget_fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which the current budget allocation is defined for this profit center. Used to align budget tracking with the enterprise fiscal calendar in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PA; SOX Section 404; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: Business justification or reason code for the most recent change to this profit center's master data (e.g., 'Organizational restructuring', 'New business segment launch', 'Merger integration'). Required for SOX audit trail documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA EC-PCA Change Documents

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code representing the legal entity to which this profit center is assigned for financial consolidation and statutory reporting. Corresponds to the BUKRS field in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 302/404; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: controlling_area_code
attributes.description: SAP Controlling (CO) area code to which this profit center belongs. The controlling area defines the organizational unit within which cost and profit center accounting is performed. Corresponds to the KOKRS field in SAP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA Module; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Associated cost center code in SAP CO for tracking operating expenses attributable to this profit center. Enables cost allocation and margin analysis at the segment level.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-CCA Module; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the primary country of operation for this profit center. Used for statutory reporting, tax jurisdiction assignment, and regulatory compliance (GDPR, CCPA).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this profit center record was first created in the enterprise data lakehouse. Supports audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking per SOX and ISO 27001 controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; ISO/IEC 27001; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code representing the primary transaction currency for this profit center (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Used for financial postings, P&L reporting, and GMV-to-revenue reconciliation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA EC-PCA; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: data_privacy_classification
attributes.description: Data classification level assigned to financial data associated with this profit center per enterprise data governance policy. Drives access control, data masking, and retention policies in the lakehouse.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; CCPA Section 1798; ISO/IEC 27001; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: The date on which this profit center was deactivated or archived. Null if the profit center is currently active. Used for historical reporting, audit trails, and ensuring no new postings are made to deactivated profit centers.

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Organizational department code associated with this profit center. Links the profit center to the enterprise organizational structure for headcount allocation and overhead cost distribution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR/OM Module; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: erp_profit_center_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Profit Center ID
attributes.description: Native profit center identifier as stored in the source ERP system (SAP S/4HANA). Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational SAP system of record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA EC-PCA; SOX Section 404; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: fiscal_year_variant
attributes.description: SAP fiscal year variant code defining the fiscal year calendar applicable to this profit center (e.g., 'K4' for calendar year, 'V3' for April-March). Determines period mapping for financial reporting and budget tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP/IFRS; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or market associated with this profit center (e.g., 'North America', 'EMEA', 'APAC', 'LATAM'). Supports regional P&L segmentation and cross-border revenue reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: north_america|emea|apac|latam|global — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: WTO International Trade Regulations; GAAP/IFRS Segment Reporting (ASC 280/IFRS 8)

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: Primary General Ledger account code associated with this profit center for revenue and cost postings. Links profit center activity to the chart of accounts in SAP S/4HANA FI-GL for financial consolidation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Module; SOX Section 404; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: gmv_to_revenue_ratio
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) to Revenue Ratio
attributes.description: The standard ratio used to convert Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) to recognized net revenue for this profit center. For marketplace segments, this reflects the take rate (commission percentage). Critical for GMV-to-revenue reconciliation in financial reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; IFRS 15; SOX Section 302; SAP S/4HANA EC-PCA

attributes.name: group_code
attributes.description: Code of the profit center group (node in the standard hierarchy) to which this profit center belongs. Profit center groups enable aggregated reporting across multiple profit centers in SAP EC-PCA.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level of the profit center within the enterprise organizational hierarchy (e.g., 1 = top-level division, 2 = business unit, 3 = sub-segment). Supports roll-up reporting in SAP EC-PCA standard hierarchy.

attributes.name: intercompany_trading_partner
attributes.description: SAP trading partner code identifying the affiliated company for intercompany transactions originating from this profit center. Required for intercompany elimination during financial consolidation. Corresponds to the VBUND field in SAP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Consolidation; SOX Section 302/404; GAAP/IFRS ASC 810

attributes.name: is_dummy
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the dummy profit center used to capture postings that cannot be assigned to a real profit center. Each controlling area has exactly one dummy profit center. Corresponds to the DUMMY field in SAP EC-PCA.

attributes.name: is_statistical
attributes.description: Indicates whether this profit center is used for statistical (informational) postings only and does not carry actual financial balances. Statistical profit centers are used for internal management reporting without affecting the general ledger.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this profit center record. Used for change data capture (CDC), audit trail compliance, and detecting unauthorized modifications per SOX internal control requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; ISO/IEC 27001; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: mrr_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this profit center tracks Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) as a primary financial metric. Applicable to subscription-based or SaaS business segments. Drives MRR and ARR reporting in financial dashboards.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA EC-PCA

attributes.name: parent_profit_center_code
attributes.description: Business code of the parent profit center in the organizational hierarchy. Enables hierarchical roll-up of P&L data for consolidated segment reporting. Self-referencing relationship within the profit center hierarchy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA EC-PCA Standard Hierarchy; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: profit_center_category
attributes.description: Functional classification of the profit center indicating whether it is primarily a revenue-generating, cost-bearing, or investment unit. Used for internal profitability analysis and capital allocation decisions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA EC-PCA; SOX Section 404; ISO 27001

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the profit center as defined in SAP S/4HANA EC-PCA. Used in financial postings, journal entries, and segment reporting. Corresponds to the PRCTR field in SAP.

attributes.name: profit_center_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the profit center's business scope, revenue streams, and cost responsibilities. Provides context for financial analysts and auditors.

attributes.name: profit_center_name
attributes.description: Human-readable business name of the profit center (e.g., 'Marketplace - North America', 'DTC - Apparel', 'B2B - Enterprise'). Used in P&L reports and management dashboards.

attributes.name: profit_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the profit center in SAP EC-PCA. 'active' = operational and accepting postings; 'inactive' = temporarily suspended; 'locked' = blocked for new postings (SOX control); 'pending_activation' = created but not yet approved; 'archived' = historical, no longer in use.

attributes.name: responsible_manager
attributes.description: Name or employee ID of the business manager accountable for the profit center's financial performance, budget adherence, and P&L outcomes. Used for management reporting and SOX accountability assignments.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_method
attributes.description: Accounting method applied for revenue recognition within this profit center. Determines how GMV converts to recognized revenue. 'point_in_time' for standard product sales; 'over_time' for subscription/SaaS; 'percentage_completion' for long-term contracts; 'milestone' for project-based billing.

attributes.name: segment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the profit center by primary business model or channel. Drives segment-level P&L reporting and GMV-to-revenue reconciliation. Values: marketplace (third-party seller platform), dtc (Direct to Consumer), b2b (Business to Business), b2c (Business to Consumer), c2c (Consumer to Consumer), fulfillment (logistics/fulfillment services), advertising (ad revenue segment). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: marketplace|dtc|b2b|b2c|c2c|fulfillment|advertising — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FTC Consumer Protection Standards; SOX Section 302; SAP S/4HANA EC-PCA

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated display name for the profit center used in condensed financial reports, dashboards, and column headers where space is limited. Corresponds to the KTEXT field in SAP EC-PCA.

attributes.name: sox_control_relevant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this profit center is subject to Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) internal control requirements. SOX-relevant profit centers require enhanced audit trails, segregation of duties, and periodic management sign-off on financial balances.

attributes.name: take_rate_pct
attributes.description: The commission percentage charged to marketplace sellers on each transaction, representing the portion of GMV retained as revenue by the platform. Applicable to marketplace and seller-facing profit centers. Used in GMV-to-revenue reconciliation.
attributes.references: FTC Advertising Standards; SAP S/4HANA EC-PCA; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: target_margin_pct
attributes.description: Planned profit margin percentage target for this profit center, expressed as a percentage of revenue. Used as a KPI benchmark for segment-level profitability reporting and management performance evaluation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PA; SOX Section 302; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Tax jurisdiction code assigned to this profit center for tax calculation and reporting purposes. Determines applicable tax rates and rules for revenue and cost postings. Relevant for multi-jurisdiction e-commerce operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX; FTC; GDPR; CCPA; WTO

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this profit center becomes effective and can receive financial postings. Defines the start of the profit center's validity period in SAP EC-PCA. Corresponds to the DATAB field in SAP.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The date until which this profit center remains valid for financial postings. Null or 9999-12-31 indicates an open-ended validity period. Corresponds to the DATBI field in SAP EC-PCA.

products.name: accounts_payable
products.description: SSOT for vendor and supplier payable obligations and AP subledger management. Tracks AP invoices, credit memos, payment terms, due dates, payment status, aging buckets, three-way match results, and payment batch execution. Covers 3PL carrier invoices, marketplace seller disbursement obligations, SaaS vendor subscriptions, and supplier PO settlements. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA FI-AP for automated payment runs and vendor account reconciliation.

attributes.name: accounts_payable_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each accounts payable record in the AP subledger. Primary key for the accounts_payable data product. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — represents a discrete AP invoice or payable obligation with a full lifecycle.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center responsible for this payable obligation. Used for internal cost allocation, budget tracking, and financial reporting.

attributes.name: payment_batch_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the automated payment run batch in which this invoice was included for payment processing. Corresponds to the SAP F110 payment run identifier. Used for payment reconciliation, bank statement matching, and audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP F110 Payment Run; SOX Section 302/404; PCI DSS

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating purchase order that generated this payable obligation. Used for three-way match (PO, goods receipt, invoice) validation and PO settlement tracking.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or supplier master record associated with this payable obligation. Links to the vendor/supplier master entity for counterparty resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Vendor Master (LFA1); ISO 27001

attributes.name: aging_bucket
attributes.description: Aging classification of the outstanding payable based on the number of days past the invoice date or due date. Used for AP aging reports, cash flow forecasting, vendor relationship management, and SOX financial disclosure. Recalculated daily during Silver layer processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Aging Report (S_ALR_87012085); GAAP ASC 420; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: ap_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the AP record within the payment workflow. Drives aging analysis, payment run eligibility, and cash flow forecasting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|pending_approval|approved|scheduled|paid|disputed|cancelled — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The current approval workflow status of the invoice within the AP approval chain. Invoices must be approved before payment release. Supports segregation of duties controls required for SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Workflow; SOX Section 302/404; COSO Internal Controls Framework

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The username or employee ID of the individual who approved the invoice for payment. Required for SOX segregation of duties audit trail and internal controls documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Workflow; SOX Section 302/404; COSO Internal Controls Framework

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the invoice was approved for payment processing. Part of the SOX-required audit trail for AP internal controls. Distinct from posting date and payment date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Workflow; SOX Section 302/404; COSO Internal Controls Framework

attributes.name: base_currency_amount
attributes.description: The net payable amount converted to the company code base currency (typically USD) using the exchange rate at posting date. Required for consolidated financial reporting, GL posting, and multi-currency AP subledger reconciliation. Corresponds to DMBTR in SAP FI-AP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (DMBTR); GAAP ASC 830; SOX Section 302/404; ISO 4217

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The SAP company code representing the legal entity or organizational unit responsible for this payable obligation. Required for multi-entity financial consolidation, intercompany elimination, and entity-level SOX reporting. Corresponds to BUKRS in SAP FI-AP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI (BUKRS); SOX Section 302/404; GAAP ASC 810

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the AP record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, SOX compliance, and data lineage tracking. Corresponds to CPUDT/CPUTM in SAP FI-AP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; SOX Section 302/404; ISO 27001

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the invoice amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency AP management, foreign exchange revaluation, and cross-border vendor payment processing.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (WAERS); PCI DSS; GDPR

attributes.name: days_past_due
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the invoice has exceeded its payment due date. Negative values indicate days until due. Zero indicates due today. Used for AP aging analysis, vendor penalty calculations, and cash flow management. Recalculated daily.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; GAAP ASC 420; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The cash discount amount available if payment is made within the early payment discount window defined in the payment terms (e.g., 2/10 net 30). Supports working capital optimization and dynamic discounting programs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (SKFBT); GAAP ASC 420; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: discount_due_date
attributes.description: The last date by which payment must be made to qualify for the early payment discount. Calculated from invoice date plus discount period days in the payment terms. Drives dynamic discounting and working capital optimization decisions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (SKFDT); GAAP ASC 420; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: The reason code for placing an invoice in disputed status. Populated when ap_status is 'disputed'. Drives dispute resolution workflows, vendor communication, and root cause analysis for AP exception management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Dispute Management; FTC Consumer Protection; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which payment must be made to the vendor to satisfy the invoice obligation and comply with agreed payment terms. Calculated from invoice date plus payment term days. Critical for cash flow planning and avoiding late payment penalties.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (FAEDT); UCC Article 2; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The exchange rate applied to convert the invoice currency amount to the company code base currency at the time of posting. Required for foreign currency AP revaluation, FX gain/loss reporting, and multi-currency reconciliation. Corresponds to KURSF in SAP FI-AP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (KURSF); GAAP ASC 830; SOX Section 302/404; ISO 4217

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal posting period (01–12 for regular periods, 13–16 for special closing periods) within the fiscal year. Used for period-end close, monthly AP subledger reconciliation, and financial reporting. Corresponds to MONAT in SAP FI-AP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (MONAT); GAAP; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which this AP document is posted. Used for period-end close, financial reporting, and year-over-year AP analysis. Corresponds to GJAHR in SAP FI-AP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (GJAHR); GAAP; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: goods_receipt_number
attributes.description: The goods receipt document number from the Warehouse Management System confirming physical receipt of goods or services associated with this invoice. Required for three-way match validation. Corresponds to LFBNR in SAP FI-AP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM-GR (MIGO); WMS; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: The total gross amount of the vendor invoice before any deductions, discounts, or adjustments. Represents the full obligation as stated on the vendor invoice. Used for GMV-to-revenue reconciliation and AP aging analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (WRBTR); GAAP ASC 420; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date printed on the vendor invoice document. Serves as the principal business event date for the payable obligation and is the baseline for payment term calculations and aging bucket assignment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (BLDAT); GAAP ASC 420; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: The externally-assigned invoice number provided by the vendor or supplier on the source invoice document. Used as the primary business identifier for matching, dispute resolution, and audit trails. Corresponds to BELNR in SAP FI-AP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (BELNR); SOX Section 302/404; FTC Invoice Standards

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: Classification of the AP document type. Standard invoices represent normal vendor payables; credit memos reduce outstanding balances; debit memos increase obligations; recurring invoices are for subscription/SaaS vendors; prepayments are advance payments; intercompany invoices are for internal entity transactions. Corresponds to BLART in SAP FI-AP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (BLART); GAAP ASC 420; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: is_recurring
attributes.description: Indicates whether this invoice is part of a recurring payment schedule (e.g., SaaS subscriptions, lease payments, maintenance contracts). Recurring invoices are auto-generated by SAP recurring entry programs. Used for MRR/ARR tracking and cash flow forecasting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Recurring Entries (FBD1); GAAP ASC 606; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: The net amount payable to the vendor after deducting applicable discounts, credits, and adjustments from the gross invoice amount. Represents the actual cash outflow obligation. Used for payment run execution and cash flow forecasting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; GAAP ASC 420; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: payment_block_code
attributes.description: SAP FI-AP payment block indicator that prevents automatic payment processing when set. Common values: R (manual review), A (disputed), B (blocked by purchasing), V (verified pending). Empty string indicates no block. Corresponds to ZLSPR in SAP FI-AP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (ZLSPR); SOX Section 302/404; FTC

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which payment was executed and disbursed to the vendor. Populated upon successful payment run completion. Used for cash flow reporting, bank reconciliation, and vendor account statement generation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (AUGDT); SOX Section 302/404; PCI DSS

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The method by which payment will be or was made to the vendor (e.g., ACH, wire transfer, check, virtual card, EFT, SEPA). Corresponds to ZLSCH in SAP FI-AP. Used for payment run configuration and bank reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (ZLSCH); PCI DSS; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: The bank or payment gateway reference number assigned when payment was executed. Used for bank statement reconciliation, payment confirmation, and vendor remittance advice. Corresponds to AUGBL in SAP FI-AP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (AUGBL); PCI DSS; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: The vendor-agreed payment terms code defining the payment schedule, discount periods, and due date calculation rules (e.g., NET30, 2/10NET30, NET60). Corresponds to ZTERM in SAP FI-AP. Drives automated due date and discount date calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (ZTERM); UCC Article 2; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the AP document was posted to the general ledger in SAP S/4HANA. Determines the accounting period for financial reporting and revenue recognition. Corresponds to BUDAT in SAP FI-AP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (BUDAT); GAAP ASC 606; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: sap_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP FI document number (BELNR) assigned upon posting to the general ledger. Serves as the system-of-record identifier in SAP S/4HANA for cross-referencing between the AP subledger and the general ledger. Required for audit trail and financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (BELNR); SOX Section 302/404; ISO 27001

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The tax component of the vendor invoice, including VAT, GST, or applicable sales tax. Separated from gross amount for tax reporting, input tax credit recovery, and compliance with tax authority requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (WMWST); GDPR; FTC; ISO 27001; PCI DSS

attributes.name: three_way_match_status
attributes.description: Result of the three-way match validation comparing the purchase order, goods receipt (GR), and vendor invoice. A matched status is required before invoice approval and payment release. Exceptions trigger manual review workflows. Critical for AP internal controls and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM-IV (MIRO); SOX Section 302/404; COSO Internal Controls Framework

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the AP record. Supports change tracking, audit trails, and incremental data pipeline processing for the Silver layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; SOX Section 302/404; ISO 27001

attributes.name: vendor_invoice_receipt_date
attributes.description: The date on which the vendor invoice was physically or electronically received by the AP department. Distinct from invoice date (vendor-stamped) and posting date (system-stamped). Used for SLA compliance tracking and payment term baseline calculations where terms start from receipt date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (EINDT); UCC Article 2; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: vendor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vendor category for this payable. Distinguishes between product suppliers, 3PL carrier invoices, marketplace seller disbursement obligations, SaaS vendor subscriptions, intercompany entities, and utility providers. Drives routing rules, approval workflows, and reporting segmentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Vendor Classification; FTC; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: The withholding tax amount deducted from the vendor payment at source, as required by applicable tax regulations (e.g., 1099 reporting in the US, WHT for cross-border payments). Corresponds to QSSHB in SAP FI-AP. Required for tax compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (QSSHB); IRS 1099; GDPR; FTC; SOX Section 302/404

products.name: accounts_receivable
products.description: SSOT for customer and platform receivable balances and AR subledger management. Tracks AR invoices, credit memos, customer payment terms, collection workflows, dunning levels, aging analysis, cash application, and write-off processing. Covers B2B customer invoicing, marketplace seller fee receivables, advertising revenue receivables, and subscription billing. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA FI-AR for automated dunning and payment matching.

attributes.name: accounts_receivable_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for each accounts receivable record in the AR subledger. Serves as the system-of-record identifier for all AR transactions within the finance domain. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER.

attributes.name: collection_agent_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal collections agent or team assigned to manage the recovery of this overdue AR balance. Used for workload distribution, collector performance reporting, and escalation tracking in the collections workflow.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Collections Management; FTC Fair Debt Collection Practices Act

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating order that generated this AR invoice. Links the receivable to the Order Management System (OMS) for order-to-cash reconciliation and GMV-to-revenue tracing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Order Management System

attributes.name: seller_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketplace seller for whom a fee receivable or commission receivable is tracked. Applicable for marketplace seller fee receivables and advertising revenue receivables. Null for direct B2C customer invoices.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Seller Management Portal

attributes.name: aging_bucket
