attributes.description: Aging classification of the outstanding AR balance based on days past due. Used in AR aging reports for credit risk assessment, bad debt provisioning, and executive financial reporting. Recalculated daily based on due_date vs. current date.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310-10-50; IFRS 7; SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR

attributes.name: amount_paid
attributes.description: Cumulative amount of payments applied to this AR invoice to date. Supports partial payment tracking and open_amount calculation. Updated each time a payment is matched via cash application.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: ar_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the AR record within the collection and settlement workflow. Drives dunning automation, aging bucket classification, and cash application processes in SAP FI-AR. Transitions: open → partially_paid → paid; open → overdue → written_off; open → disputed.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; SOX Section 404; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: ar_type
attributes.description: Classification of the AR record by the nature of the receivable. Distinguishes B2B customer invoicing, marketplace seller fee receivables, advertising revenue receivables, and subscription billing per the product scope. Drives subledger routing and revenue recognition treatment.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR

attributes.name: billing_document_number
attributes.description: The source billing document number from the Order Management System or SAP SD (Sales and Distribution) that triggered the creation of this AR invoice. Enables order-to-cash traceability and billing dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD-BIL; Order Management System; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: cash_application_date
attributes.description: The date on which incoming payment was matched and applied to this AR invoice in the cash application process. Null if no payment has been applied. Used for DSO calculation, bank reconciliation, and revenue recognition confirmation.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The SAP company code representing the legal entity under which this AR invoice is posted. Required for multi-entity financial consolidation, intercompany elimination, and statutory reporting. Corresponds to SAP BUKRS field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; GAAP; IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The cost center to which the AR revenue is attributed for internal management reporting and P&L allocation. Corresponds to SAP CO-PA KOSTL field. Used for segment reporting and profitability analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; GAAP ASC 280 Segment Reporting; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the AR record was first created in the system of record (SAP FI-AR posting timestamp). Used for audit trail, SOX compliance, and data lineage tracking. Corresponds to SAP CPUDT/CPUTM fields.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; ISO 27001; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR

attributes.name: credit_memo_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the credit memo applied against this AR invoice. Reduces the net receivable balance. Null if no credit memo has been applied. Used in AR reconciliation and revenue adjustment reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: credit_memo_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the credit memo issued against this AR invoice, if applicable. Used for returns, billing adjustments, and dispute resolutions. Links to the credit memo document in SAP FI-AR for offset processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; GAAP ASC 606; RMA (Return Merchandise Authorization) process

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the invoice is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency AR management, FX translation to functional currency, and international trade compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; GAAP ASC 830 Foreign Currency; IFRS 21; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR WAERS

attributes.name: days_past_due
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the AR invoice is past its due_date as of the last calculation date. Zero or negative for current invoices. Drives aging_bucket assignment, dunning escalation, and bad debt reserve calculations.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310; IFRS 9; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; KPI: DPD

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount applied to the invoice, including early payment discounts (cash discounts), promotional discounts, and contractual volume discounts. Reduces the net amount due from the customer.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR SKFBT (Cash Discount Amount)

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Standardized reason code for the customer dispute raised against this AR invoice. Used for root cause analysis, dispute trend reporting, and process improvement in billing and order fulfillment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pricing_error|duplicate_invoice|goods_not_received|quality_issue|unauthorized_charge|other — promote to reference product if additional codes are needed]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; FTC Consumer Protection; Order Management System

attributes.name: dispute_status
attributes.description: Current status of any billing dispute raised by the customer against this AR invoice. Drives dunning_block activation, collection hold, and dispute resolution workflow routing. Integrates with the Customer Data Platform for dispute case management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; FTC Consumer Protection; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The contractual date by which the customer must remit payment in full. Calculated from invoice_date plus the applicable payment term days. Drives dunning level escalation, overdue classification, and SLA breach alerts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; GAAP ASC 310; FTC Fair Debt Collection Practices Act

attributes.name: dunning_block
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether automated dunning is blocked for this AR record (e.g., due to active dispute, customer agreement, or manual hold). When True, the dunning run in SAP FI-AR will skip this record. Corresponds to SAP MANSP field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR MANSP; FTC Fair Debt Collection Practices Act

attributes.name: dunning_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent dunning notice was issued to the customer for this AR record. Used to enforce minimum dunning intervals and track collection activity history. Corresponds to SAP FI-AR MAHND field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR MAHND; FTC Fair Debt Collection Practices Act

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: Current dunning escalation level for overdue AR, ranging from 0 (no dunning) to 4 (final notice / legal escalation). Incremented by the automated dunning run in SAP FI-AR. Drives collection workflow routing and customer communication templates. Corresponds to SAP MAHNS field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR MAHNS; FTC Fair Debt Collection Practices Act; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal accounting period (1–12 or 1–16 for special periods) within the fiscal year in which the AR invoice is posted. Used for monthly close, period-over-period AR trend analysis, and MRR/ARR revenue tracking. Corresponds to SAP MONAT field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; GAAP; IFRS; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the AR invoice is recognized for financial reporting purposes. Used for period-end close, annual financial statements, and SOX-controlled period locking. Corresponds to SAP GJAHR field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; GAAP; IFRS; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The General Ledger (GL) account code to which this AR transaction is posted in SAP S/4HANA FI. Used for financial consolidation, trial balance, and regulatory financial reporting. Corresponds to SAP HKONT (GL Account) field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; GAAP; IFRS; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: The total gross amount billed to the customer or counterparty before any discounts, credits, or adjustments. Represents the face value of the invoice. Used in GMV-to-revenue reconciliation and AR aging analysis.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; IFRS 15; SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The principal business event date on which the invoice was issued to the customer or counterparty. Used as the baseline for payment term calculation, aging analysis, and revenue recognition. Corresponds to SAP FI-AR BLDAT (Document Date).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; GAAP ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; IFRS 15

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable invoice reference number assigned to the AR document. Used in customer-facing communications, remittance matching, and audit trails. Corresponds to the SAP FI-AR BELNR (Accounting Document Number) field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; ISO 6422 Invoice Standards; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: The net amount due from the customer after applying discounts and adjustments (gross_amount - discount_amount). Represents the actual receivable balance for this invoice. Used in aging buckets and collection workflows.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310; IFRS 9; SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR

attributes.name: open_amount
attributes.description: The current outstanding balance remaining on the AR invoice after partial payments, credit memo applications, and cash applications. Equals net_amount minus total payments applied. Drives collection prioritization and DSO calculation.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310; IFRS 9; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: payment_block
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this AR invoice has been blocked from automated payment clearing (e.g., pending dispute resolution, credit hold, or manual review). When True, the automatic payment program in SAP FI-AR will not clear this item. Corresponds to SAP ZLSPR field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR ZLSPR; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument or method by which the customer is expected to or has settled the invoice. Drives cash application routing, reconciliation logic, and payment gateway integration. Corresponds to SAP FI-AR ZLSCH (Payment Method) field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR ZLSCH; PCI DSS; Payment Gateway and Processing Platform

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: The payment terms code governing when payment is due and any early payment discount conditions (e.g., NET30, NET60, 2/10NET30). Corresponds to SAP FI-AR ZTERM field. Determines due_date calculation and cash discount eligibility.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR ZTERM; GAAP ASC 310; Uniform Commercial Code (UCC)

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: The number of days from invoice date within which payment is due, as defined by the payment terms code. Stored explicitly for aging bucket calculation and DSO (Days Sales Outstanding) analytics without requiring a join to payment terms reference data.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; KPI: DSO

attributes.name: promised_payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the customer has committed to making payment, as captured during a collection contact or payment arrangement. Used to track promise-to-pay (PTP) agreements and measure collection effectiveness.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Collections Management; FTC Fair Debt Collection Practices Act

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: The date on which revenue associated with this AR invoice is recognized per ASC 606 / IFRS 15 five-step model. May differ from invoice_date for subscription billing, milestone-based contracts, or deferred revenue scenarios.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; IFRS 15; SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR)

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the originating operational system that generated this AR record. Supports data lineage, reconciliation between systems, and multi-source AR consolidation in the Silver layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: ISO 27001; SOX Section 404; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The tax component of the invoice, including VAT, GST, or sales tax as applicable by jurisdiction. Separated from gross amount for tax reporting, remittance, and regulatory compliance purposes.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 740; IFRS; EU VAT Directive; FTC; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the AR record, including status changes, payment applications, dispute updates, or write-off processing. Essential for change data capture (CDC) and SOX audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; ISO 27001; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR

attributes.name: write_off_amount
attributes.description: The amount of the AR balance that has been written off as uncollectible bad debt. Populated when ar_status transitions to written_off. Used for bad debt expense reporting, allowance for doubtful accounts, and SOX-controlled write-off approval workflows.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310-10-35; IFRS 9; SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR

attributes.name: write_off_date
attributes.description: The date on which the AR balance was formally written off as uncollectible. Required for bad debt expense period recognition, tax deduction timing, and SOX audit trail. Null if no write-off has occurred.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310-10-35; IFRS 9; SOX Section 404; IRS Tax Code Section 166

attributes.name: write_off_reason
attributes.description: Standardized reason code explaining why the AR balance was written off. Required for SOX-controlled write-off approval documentation and bad debt analytics.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310-10-35; SOX Section 404; IRS Tax Code Section 166

products.name: budget
products.description: Annual and periodic budget plans with granular line-item allocations by cost center, profit center, GL account, and fiscal period. Tracks approved budget amounts at both summary and line-item levels, budget versions (original, revised, forecast), monthly/quarterly allocations, actuals-to-date, encumbrances, commitments, and remaining budget. Supports variance analysis (price, volume, mix), rolling forecast updates, and drill-down from summary to individual account-level allocations. Enables financial planning, headcount budgeting, and performance management across all business units.

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each budget record in the enterprise financial planning system. Serves as the primary key for the budget data product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Budget Management; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: agent_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee or manager who owns and is accountable for this budget. The budget owner is responsible for spend authorization, variance explanations, and forecast updates. Maps to the HR employee master in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Responsible Cost Center Manager; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: approved_by_agent_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the finance authority (CFO, VP Finance, or delegated approver) who formally authorized this budget. Required for SOX audit trail of budget approval controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA Workflow Approval

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Budget allocations are made per cost center; linking provides hierarchy and removes redundant cost_center_code.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.profit_center

attributes.name: relevance_config_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to search.relevance_config. Business justification: Finance tracks spend on relevance tuning; FK to relevance_config enables precise cost attribution and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: actuals_amount
attributes.description: The actual expenditure or revenue posted against this budget to date, sourced from SAP S/4HANA General Ledger postings. Used for budget-to-actuals variance analysis and remaining budget calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Actual Cost Posting (CO); GAAP ASC 420; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the budget was formally approved by the authorized approver. Establishes the effective start of budget authorization and is required for SOX audit trail documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA Budget Approval Workflow

attributes.name: approved_amount
attributes.description: The total authorized budget amount for the period as approved by the budget governance process. Represents the baseline against which actuals and variances are measured. Denominated in the currency specified by currency_code.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Budget Control System (FM-BCS); SOX Section 302/404; GAAP ASC 420

attributes.name: availability_control_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether SAP S/4HANA Funds Management budget availability control is active for this budget, preventing expenditures that would exceed the approved amount. True enables hard stop or warning controls; False allows unrestricted posting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Funds Management Budget Control (FM-BCS); SOX Section 404

attributes.name: budget_name
attributes.description: Descriptive human-readable name for the budget plan (e.g., 'FY2024 Marketing Annual Budget', 'Q3 2024 Logistics Operating Budget'). Used in financial dashboards and reporting.

attributes.name: budget_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the budget plan (e.g., BDG-2024-000123). Used in financial reporting, audit trails, and cross-system references with SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Budget Object; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: budget_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the budget record within the financial planning and approval workflow. Draft indicates work-in-progress; submitted awaits approval; approved is authorized but not yet active; active is the current operating budget; frozen prevents further changes; closed is the completed period budget; cancelled is voided. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|approved|active|frozen|closed|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Budget Status; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: budget_type
attributes.description: Classification of the budget by its financial purpose. Operating budgets cover day-to-day expenses; capital budgets cover long-term investments; headcount budgets cover personnel costs; project budgets are scoped to specific initiatives; contingency budgets are reserve allocations; rolling forecasts are continuously updated plans.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Budget Category; GAAP ASC 420; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: business_unit_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the business unit or division responsible for this budget (e.g., BU-ECOM for E-Commerce, BU-LOG for Logistics, BU-MKT for Marketing). Enables cross-BU budget consolidation and performance management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Controlling Area; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: commitment_amount
attributes.description: Funds earmarked against the budget for internal commitments such as approved purchase requisitions or internal orders that have not yet been converted to purchase orders. Distinct from encumbrances which are legally binding. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Commitment Management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Commitment Management (CO); GAAP Commitment Accounting; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA company code representing the legal entity for which this budget is maintained (e.g., 1000 for Ecommerce Inc. US, 2000 for Ecommerce EU GmbH). Required for legal entity-level financial consolidation and SOX reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Company Code (FI); SOX Section 302/404; GAAP ASC 810

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this budget record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides the audit trail creation event required for SOX financial controls and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; ISO 27001; SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which budget amounts are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency budget consolidation and foreign exchange variance analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA Currency Configuration; GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: encumbrance_amount
attributes.description: Funds reserved against the budget for obligations that have been legally committed but not yet invoiced or paid (e.g., purchase orders raised but not yet received). Reduces available budget. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Funds Management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Funds Management (FM); GAAP Encumbrance Accounting; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: expense_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the budget by expense type for management reporting and KPI tracking. Personnel covers headcount and compensation; technology covers software/hardware; marketing covers advertising and promotions (ROAS, CAC tracking); logistics covers fulfillment and 3PL costs; facilities covers real estate and utilities. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: personnel|technology|marketing|logistics|facilities|professional_services|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Cost Element Category; GAAP ASC 420

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period granularity covered by this budget record. Annual covers the full fiscal year; H1/H2 are semi-annual halves; Q1–Q4 are quarterly periods. Enables drill-down from annual to quarterly budget analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: annual|H1|H2|Q1|Q2|Q3|Q4 — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Fiscal Period; GAAP ASC 270

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this budget applies (e.g., 2024). Aligns with the enterprise fiscal calendar defined in SAP S/4HANA for financial consolidation and year-end reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Fiscal Year Variant; GAAP ASC 270; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: forecast_amount
attributes.description: The latest rolling forecast estimate of expected spend or revenue for the period, updated periodically based on actuals-to-date and forward-looking projections. Supports rolling forecast updates and MRR/ARR tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Integrated Business Planning; GAAP ASC 270; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA General Ledger account code to which this budget line is mapped (e.g., 600100 for Marketing Expense, 700200 for Logistics Cost). Enables GL-level budget-to-actuals reconciliation and financial statement alignment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA General Ledger (FI-GL); GAAP ASC 420; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: is_locked
attributes.description: Indicates whether the budget record is locked against further modifications. True means the budget is frozen and no amendments can be made; False means the budget is open for updates. Typically set to True after period-close or year-end freeze.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Budget Lock; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: last_revised_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which the budget amounts were formally revised or amended. Null if no revisions have occurred since original approval. Used to track the currency of budget data and trigger re-approval workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Budget Amendment History; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for budget owners and finance managers to document assumptions, justifications, revision rationale, or special instructions associated with this budget record. Supports audit trail documentation for SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; SAP S/4HANA Budget Text

attributes.name: original_amount
attributes.description: The initial budget amount as approved at the start of the fiscal period before any revisions or amendments. Preserved for variance analysis between original plan and revised/forecast versions. Denominated in currency_code.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Budget Version; SOX Section 302; GAAP ASC 420

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the budget period expires and spending authorization ends. Null for open-ended rolling forecasts. Used for period-close processes and budget expiry controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Budget Validity Period; GAAP ASC 420

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the budget period becomes effective and spending against this budget is authorized to begin. Used for temporal filtering in variance analysis and financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Budget Validity Period; GAAP ASC 420

attributes.name: remaining_amount
attributes.description: The unspent and uncommitted budget balance available for new spending authorizations, calculated as approved_amount minus actuals_amount minus encumbrance_amount minus commitment_amount. Critical for budget availability checks and spend controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Budget Availability Control (FM-BCS); SOX Section 404

attributes.name: revised_amount
attributes.description: The budget amount after formal amendments or mid-period revisions have been approved. Null if no revisions have been made. Used to track budget changes and calculate revision variance vs. original_amount.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Budget Amendment; SOX Section 302; GAAP ASC 420

attributes.name: revision_count
attributes.description: The total number of formal revisions or amendments applied to this budget since original approval. A high revision count may indicate planning instability and is tracked for governance and audit purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Budget Version History; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: sap_budget_code
attributes.description: The native budget object identifier from SAP S/4HANA Funds Management or Controlling module. Used for cross-system reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the ERP system of record. Enables traceability back to the source transaction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Funds Management (FM-BCS); SOX Section 404

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the originating system from which this budget record was sourced or created. SAP_S4HANA indicates direct ERP entry; PLANNING_TOOL indicates integrated planning software; MANUAL indicates direct data entry; SPREADSHEET_IMPORT indicates bulk upload from Excel/CSV. Supports data lineage and audit traceability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Data Origin; SOX Section 404; ISO 27001

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which the budget was formally submitted for approval by the budget owner. Used to track adherence to the annual budget calendar and planning cycle SLAs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Budget Planning Cycle; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: tolerance_pct
attributes.description: The allowable overspend tolerance percentage above the approved budget before a hard block is triggered in SAP S/4HANA availability control (e.g., 5.00 means 5% overspend is permitted before blocking). Used to configure budget control thresholds.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Availability Control Tolerance (FM-BCS); SOX Section 404

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to this budget record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Required for change data capture, incremental ETL processing, and SOX audit trail of budget modifications.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; ISO 27001; SAP S/4HANA Change Log

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: The absolute monetary difference between the approved budget amount and actuals-to-date (approved_amount minus actuals_amount). Positive values indicate underspend; negative values indicate overspend. Used in variance analysis reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Variance Analysis (CO-PA); GAAP ASC 420; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: variance_pct
attributes.description: The percentage difference between approved budget and actuals-to-date expressed as a ratio (variance_amount / approved_amount * 100). Enables proportional comparison across cost centers and business units of different sizes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Variance Analysis (CO-PA); GAAP ASC 420

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Indicates the iteration or revision state of the budget plan. Original is the first approved plan; revised reflects approved amendments; forecast is the latest rolling estimate; final is the locked year-end version; supplemental covers additional approved allocations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Budget Version Management; SOX Section 302

products.name: budget_line
products.description: Granular line-item breakdown of budget allocations by GL account, cost center, and fiscal period. Captures monthly/quarterly budget amounts, actuals-to-date, encumbrances, and remaining budget. Enables drill-down variance analysis and supports rolling forecast adjustments at the account level.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA BPC Budget Line Item

attributes.name: budget_line_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each granular budget line item record within the enterprise financial planning system. Primary key for the budget_line data product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Budget Line Object; SOX Section 302/404 Internal Controls

attributes.name: agent_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or manager who owns and is accountable for this budget line. Used for budget responsibility assignment, approval routing, and variance accountability reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA User/Employee Master; SOX Section 302 Management Certification; Internal RACI Policy

attributes.name: approved_by_agent_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or manager who formally approved this budget line through the budget workflow. Required for SOX segregation of duties and audit trail documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Workflow Approval; SOX Section 302/404; Internal Financial Controls Policy

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.budget. Business justification: Budget line items belong to a budget; adding FK enables proper aggregation and removes need for separate budget_line_number as identifier of parent.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational cost center responsible for this budget line. Enables departmental budget tracking, variance analysis, and cost allocation reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Cost Center Master (CO-CCA); GAAP; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: experiment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to search.experiment. Business justification: Budget allocation for A/B testing experiments requires finance to track spend per experiment for reporting and cost control.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the profit center associated with this budget line. Enables profitability analysis and P&L reporting at the profit center level within SAP S/4HANA (CO-PCA).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Profit Center Accounting (CO-PCA); GAAP; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: relevance_config_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to search.relevance_config. Business justification: Finance budgets for relevance configuration changes need a FK to the specific relevance_config to allocate costs and audit spend.

attributes.name: actual_amount
attributes.description: The actual expenditure or revenue recorded against this budget line to date for the fiscal period. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA GL postings. Used in actuals-to-budget variance analysis and financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Actual Cost Posting (CO-PA); GAAP; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to allocate the budget amount to this line item: direct assignment, proportional distribution, top-down allocation, bottom-up build, or zero-based budgeting. Supports budget process transparency and audit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Allocation Cycle (CO-CCA); GAAP; Internal Budgeting Methodology Policy

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date on which this budget line was formally approved through the budget workflow. Required for SOX audit trail and financial controls documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Budget Approval Workflow; SOX Section 302/404; Internal Financial Controls Policy

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: The approved budget allocation amount for this line item in the specified currency and fiscal period. Represents the planned financial commitment as approved through the budget workflow. Core field for variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FM Budget Amount; GAAP; SOX Section 404; Internal Financial Planning Policy

attributes.name: budget_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the budget line by expenditure category: Capital Expenditure (CapEx), Operating Expenditure (OpEx), headcount, marketing, technology, or logistics. Drives financial reporting segmentation and cost type analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: capex|opex|headcount|marketing|technology|logistics|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Cost Element Category; GAAP ASC 420; Internal Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: budget_line_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the budget line item explaining the business purpose, initiative, or expenditure being budgeted. Provides context for financial reviewers and auditors.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Budget Line Text; SOX Section 404 Documentation Requirements

attributes.name: budget_line_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the budget line item as assigned by the Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system (SAP S/4HANA). Used in financial reports, audit trails, and cross-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FM (Funds Management) Budget Line; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: budget_line_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the budget line record. Tracks the approval workflow from initial draft through submission, approval, rejection, closure, or cancellation. Supports SOX audit trail requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|approved|rejected|closed|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Budget Workflow; SOX Section 302/404; Internal Financial Controls Policy

attributes.name: budget_type
attributes.description: Classifies the budget line as an expense budget, revenue budget, headcount budget, or investment budget. Determines how the line is treated in financial consolidation and P&L reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FM Budget Type; GAAP; Internal Budgeting Standards

attributes.name: budget_version
attributes.description: Identifies the version of the budget line: original approved budget, revised budget after amendments, rolling forecast, or supplemental allocation. Enables comparison across budget iterations and supports rolling forecast adjustments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Budget Version (FM); GAAP; Internal Financial Planning Policy

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA business area code representing a distinct operational segment (e.g., Marketplace, Fulfillment, Advertising) for cross-company-code financial reporting and segment analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Business Area (FI-BA); GAAP ASC 280; IFRS 8 Operating Segments

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA company code representing the legal entity or subsidiary to which this budget line belongs. Supports multi-entity financial consolidation and intercompany reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Company Code (FI); GAAP; SOX Section 404; IFRS IAS 27

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA controlling area code that groups company codes for management accounting and cost controlling purposes. Defines the organizational scope for internal cost reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Controlling Area (CO); GAAP; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this budget line record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation marker required for SOX financial controls and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404 Audit Trail; SAP S/4HANA Change Document; ISO 27001 A.12.4 Logging

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this budget line (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency financial consolidation and FX reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA Currency Configuration; GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: encumbrance_amount
attributes.description: The amount of the budget that has been committed or reserved through purchase orders (POs) or other obligations but not yet invoiced or paid. Reduces available budget and prevents over-commitment. Key for funds management in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Funds Management Commitment (FM); GAAP; Government Accounting Standards Board (GASB) Encumbrance Accounting

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period number (1–12 for monthly, 1–4 for quarterly) within the fiscal year to which this budget line applies. Supports monthly and quarterly budget drill-down and rolling forecast adjustments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Fiscal Period; GAAP ASC 420; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year (e.g., 2024) to which this budget line belongs. Used for annual budget planning cycles, year-over-year comparisons, and SOX financial period controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Fiscal Year Variant; GAAP ASC 420; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: forecast_amount
attributes.description: The latest rolling forecast amount for this budget line, reflecting updated projections based on actuals-to-date and anticipated future spend. Supports rolling forecast adjustments and financial planning cycles.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Planning (BPC/SAC); GAAP; Internal Rolling Forecast Policy

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA functional area classification (e.g., Sales, Marketing, Operations, Finance, Technology) used for segment reporting and cost-of-sales accounting. Supports P&L reporting by business function.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Functional Area (FI-FM); GAAP ASC 280 Segment Reporting; IFRS 8

attributes.name: fund_code
attributes.description: The fund identifier from SAP S/4HANA Funds Management (FM) that this budget line is allocated to. Used for ring-fenced budget tracking, grant management, and restricted fund reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Funds Management (FM); GAAP; Internal Fund Accounting Policy

attributes.name: internal_order_number
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP S/4HANA internal order used for collecting costs for a specific purpose (e.g., a marketing campaign, a technology initiative). Enables granular cost tracking below cost center level.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Internal Order (CO-OPA); GAAP; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: is_carry_forward
attributes.description: Indicates whether unspent budget from a prior period has been carried forward into this budget line. True means this line includes a carry-forward balance from the previous fiscal period or year.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Carry Forward (FM-BCS); GAAP; Internal Budget Carry-Forward Policy

attributes.name: is_locked
attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget line has been locked to prevent further modifications after period close or final approval. A value of True means the line is frozen and no amendments are permitted without an unlock workflow.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Budget Lock (FM); SOX Section 404 Period Close Controls; Internal Budget Governance Policy

attributes.name: justification_notes
attributes.description: Narrative justification provided by the budget owner explaining the rationale for the budget request, including business case, expected ROI, or regulatory requirement. Supports budget review and SOX audit documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404 Internal Controls Documentation; Internal Budget Governance Policy

attributes.name: last_revised_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which the budget line amount or attributes were revised or amended. Tracks the history of budget adjustments for audit and variance analysis purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Budget Revision Log; SOX Section 404; Internal Budget Amendment Policy

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The calendar end date of the fiscal period covered by this budget line (e.g., 2024-01-31 for January). Defines the effective end of the budget allocation window.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Fiscal Year Variant; GAAP; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The calendar start date of the fiscal period covered by this budget line (e.g., 2024-01-01 for January). Defines the effective start of the budget allocation window.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Fiscal Year Variant; GAAP; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget line represents a monthly, quarterly, or annual budget allocation. Determines the granularity of budget tracking and variance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Funds Management; GAAP; Internal Budgeting Policy

attributes.name: prior_year_actual_amount
attributes.description: The actual expenditure recorded for the equivalent GL account and cost center in the prior fiscal year. Used as a baseline for year-over-year budget variance analysis and trend reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Historical Actuals; GAAP; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: remaining_amount
attributes.description: The unspent and uncommitted budget remaining for this line item, calculated as budget_amount minus actual_amount minus encumbrance_amount. Represents available spending authority for the period. Critical for budget control and over-spend prevention.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Available Budget (FM); GAAP; SOX Section 404; Internal Budget Control Policy

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the originating system from which this budget line record was sourced: SAP S/4HANA ERP, manual entry, a dedicated budget planning tool, or Excel upload. Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Data Origin; SOX Section 404 Data Lineage; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to this budget line record. Tracks the last change event for audit trail, SOX compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404 Audit Trail; SAP S/4HANA Change Document; ISO 27001 A.12.4 Logging

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: The monetary difference between the approved budget amount and the actual amount for this line item (budget_amount minus actual_amount). A positive value indicates underspend; negative indicates overspend. Stored as a pre-computed field from SAP S/4HANA for reporting performance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Variance Analysis (CO-PA); GAAP; SOX Section 404; Internal Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: variance_pct
attributes.description: The percentage variance between the approved budget amount and the actual amount, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1250 = 12.50%). Sourced from SAP S/4HANA variance reporting. Enables proportional comparison across budget lines of different sizes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Variance Analysis (CO-PA); GAAP; Internal KPI Reporting Standards

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) element code from SAP S/4HANA Project System (PS) linking this budget line to a specific project or capital investment. Enables project-level budget tracking and CapEx management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project System (PS-WBS); GAAP ASC 350; PMI PMBOK WBS Standard

products.name: revenue_recognition
products.description: Tracks revenue recognition events and schedules per ASC 606 / IFRS 15 standards. Captures performance obligation identification, transaction price allocation, recognition trigger events, recognized amounts, and deferred revenue balances. Covers GMV-to-net-revenue waterfall, marketplace commission recognition, subscription MRR/ARR recognition, and promotional discount adjustments.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each revenue recognition event or schedule record in the enterprise financial system. Primary key for this table.

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating order that generated this revenue recognition event. Links to the Order Management System (OMS) order record.

attributes.name: seller_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketplace seller whose transaction generated this revenue recognition event. Relevant for marketplace commission recognition. Sourced from the Seller Management Portal.

attributes.name: vendor_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underlying customer contract or agreement governing this revenue recognition event, as maintained in SAP S/4HANA contract management.
attributes.references: ASC 606 Step 1 — Identify the Contract; IFRS 15.9

attributes.name: allocated_transaction_price
attributes.description: The portion of the total contract transaction price allocated to this specific performance obligation, based on relative standalone selling prices per ASC 606 Step 4. May differ from transaction_price when a contract has multiple performance obligations.
attributes.references: ASC 606 Step 4 — Allocate Transaction Price; IFRS 15.73-86

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The employee ID or username of the finance controller or manager who approved this revenue recognition event. Required for SOX compliance and audit trail. Populated for manual overrides and high-value recognition events.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; PCAOB AS 2201; GAAP Internal Controls

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this revenue recognition event was approved by the authorized finance controller. Part of the SOX-compliant audit trail for financial controls.

attributes.name: commission_amount
attributes.description: The absolute commission amount earned from the marketplace seller for this transaction. Represents the net revenue recognized by the platform as agent/principal in marketplace transactions per ASC 606 principal vs. agent guidance.
attributes.references: ASC 606 B34-B38 Principal vs Agent; IFRS 15.B34; Seller Management Portal

attributes.name: commission_rate
attributes.description: The percentage commission rate charged to the marketplace seller on this transaction. Used to calculate marketplace commission revenue recognized. Sourced from the Seller Management Portal commission schedule.
attributes.references: ASC 606 — Principal vs Agent Considerations; IFRS 15.B34-B38; FTC Marketplace Disclosure

attributes.name: constraint_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether the variable consideration constraint was applied to limit the recognized amount, preventing a significant revenue reversal per ASC 606. True = constraint applied; False = full variable consideration included.

attributes.name: contract_modification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this revenue recognition event was triggered or affected by a contract modification (e.g., order amendment, subscription upgrade/downgrade, price renegotiation). True = contract modification involved; False = original contract terms.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this revenue recognition record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for SOX compliance and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; ISO 27001; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this recognition record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency operations across international marketplace transactions.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS 15; GAAP ASC 830 Foreign Currency

attributes.name: deferred_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the transaction price that has been received or billed but not yet recognized as revenue, deferred to future accounting periods. Represents the deferred revenue liability balance for this obligation.
attributes.references: ASC 606; IFRS 15.105-116; GAAP ASC 210 Balance Sheet

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which the revenue recognition trigger event occurred (e.g., delivery confirmed timestamp, subscription period end timestamp). This is the principal real-world business event time, distinct from record audit timestamps.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal accounting period (year-quarter or year-month) to which this recognized revenue is attributed in the General Ledger (GL). Format: YYYY-QN (quarterly) or YYYY-MM (monthly). Used for period-close reporting and SOX financial controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; GAAP; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: functional_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter code for the entity's functional currency used for financial consolidation in SAP S/4HANA. Amounts may be converted from transaction currency to functional currency for GL posting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; GAAP ASC 830; IFRS IAS 21; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: fx_rate
attributes.description: The exchange rate applied to convert transaction currency amounts to the functional currency at the time of recognition. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA currency tables. Relevant for cross-border marketplace transactions.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 830; IFRS IAS 21; SAP S/4HANA Currency Module

attributes.name: gmv_amount
attributes.description: The total Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) of the transaction before any deductions. Starting point of the GMV-to-net-revenue waterfall. Represents the full face value of goods/services transacted on the platform.
attributes.references: E-Commerce Industry KPI Standard; ASC 606 Step 3

attributes.name: journal_entry_reference
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA General Ledger journal entry document number associated with the posting of this recognized revenue. Provides the audit trail link between the revenue recognition record and the financial ledger entry for SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Module; GAAP

attributes.name: net_recognized_amount
attributes.description: The net revenue amount recognized after applying promotional discounts, refund adjustments, and other variable consideration adjustments. Equals recognized_amount minus promotional_discount_amount minus refund_adjustment_amount. Bottom line of the GMV-to-net-revenue waterfall.
attributes.references: ASC 606 Step 5; IFRS 15; SEC Revenue Disclosure; SOX

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments entered by the finance team regarding this revenue recognition event. Used to document manual overrides, contract modification rationale, or audit observations.

attributes.name: percentage_complete
attributes.description: The estimated percentage of the performance obligation that has been satisfied as of the recognition event date. Used for over-time revenue recognition to calculate the recognized amount. Range: 0.00 to 100.00.

attributes.name: performance_obligation_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the distinct performance obligation being satisfied in this recognition event (e.g., 'Delivery of physical goods', 'Monthly SaaS subscription access', 'Marketplace listing service').

attributes.name: principal_agent_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the entity is acting as principal (recognizes gross revenue) or agent (recognizes net commission) for this transaction. Critical for marketplace revenue recognition and GMV-to-net-revenue waterfall. Determined per ASC 606 B34-B38.
attributes.references: ASC 606 B34-B38 Principal vs Agent; IFRS 15.B34-B38; FTC Consumer Protection

attributes.name: promotional_discount_amount
attributes.description: The value of promotional discounts, coupons, or price reductions applied to this transaction that reduce the recognized revenue amount. Part of the GMV-to-net-revenue waterfall adjustment. Sourced from Pricing and Promotions Management.

attributes.name: recognition_event_number
attributes.description: Externally referenceable business identifier for this revenue recognition event, used in financial reporting, audit correspondence, and reconciliation with SAP S/4HANA journal entries.

attributes.name: recognition_method
attributes.description: The accounting method used to measure progress toward complete satisfaction of the performance obligation for over-time recognition. Output methods measure results achieved; input methods measure effort expended. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: output_method|input_method|straight_line|usage_based|milestone_based|residual_approach — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: recognition_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the accounting period over which revenue is recognized. For point-in-time recognition, this equals the event date. For over-time recognition (e.g., subscription ARR), this is the end of the service period.
attributes.references: ASC 606 Step 5; IFRS 15.35; GAAP Matching Principle

attributes.name: recognition_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the accounting period over which revenue is recognized. For point-in-time recognition, this equals the event date. For over-time recognition (e.g., subscription MRR), this is the start of the service period.
attributes.references: ASC 606 Step 5; IFRS 15.35; GAAP Matching Principle

attributes.name: recognition_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the revenue recognition event. 'pending' = awaiting trigger; 'recognized' = revenue fully recognized; 'deferred' = revenue deferred to future period; 'partially_recognized' = portion recognized; 'reversed' = recognition reversed; 'cancelled' = event voided.

attributes.name: recognition_trigger
attributes.description: The business event that triggered this revenue recognition. Examples: delivery confirmation from TMS/WMS, subscription billing period elapsed, customer acceptance, refund/return window expiry, or manual finance override. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: delivery_confirmed|subscription_period_elapsed|milestone_achieved|customer_acceptance|refund_period_expired|manual_override|partial_shipment|contract_modification — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: recognition_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether revenue is recognized at a single point in time (e.g., product delivery) or over time (e.g., subscription MRR/ARR, service contracts), per ASC 606 / IFRS 15 criteria.

attributes.name: recognized_amount
attributes.description: The gross revenue amount recognized in this event or for this period. For partial recognition, this is the portion recognized in the current period. Core field in the GMV-to-net-revenue waterfall.
attributes.references: ASC 606 Step 5; IFRS 15; SEC Revenue Disclosure

attributes.name: refund_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: The amount of revenue reversed or adjusted due to customer returns, refunds, or Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) events. Reduces recognized revenue in the GMV-to-net-revenue waterfall. Negative values indicate revenue reduction.
attributes.references: ASC 606 Step 3 — Variable Consideration; IFRS 15.56; RMA Process

attributes.name: revenue_category
attributes.description: Business classification of the revenue stream being recognized. Covers GMV-to-net-revenue waterfall components: direct product sales, marketplace seller commissions, subscription MRR/ARR, advertising revenue, fulfillment fees, and other. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: product_sale|marketplace_commission|subscription|advertising|fulfillment_fee|data_licensing|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ASC 606 Step 2; IFRS 15; SEC Revenue Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record that originated this revenue recognition event. Supports data lineage and reconciliation across OMS, SAP S/4HANA, Payment Gateway, Seller Portal, and Subscription Platform.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 — Data Lineage; ISO 27001; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: source_transaction_reference
attributes.description: The native transaction identifier from the originating source system (e.g., OMS order number, payment gateway transaction ID, SAP document number). Enables end-to-end reconciliation and audit trail across systems.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; ISO 27001; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this revenue recognition record is subject to SOX internal control review and audit. True = SOX-controlled record requiring documented approval and audit trail; False = non-SOX-controlled record.

attributes.name: standalone_selling_price
attributes.description: The price at which the entity would sell this performance obligation separately to a customer. Used as the basis for allocating the transaction price across multiple performance obligations per ASC 606 Step 4.
attributes.references: ASC 606 Step 4 — Standalone Selling Price; IFRS 15.77-80

attributes.name: subscription_mrr_amount
attributes.description: The Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) amount recognized for subscription-based services in this period. Applicable when revenue_category = 'subscription'. Used for MRR/ARR tracking and SaaS revenue reporting.
attributes.references: ASC 606 Over-Time Recognition; IFRS 15.35; SaaS Revenue Metrics

attributes.name: transaction_price
attributes.description: The total transaction price allocated to this performance obligation per ASC 606 Step 4. Represents the amount of consideration the business expects to receive in exchange for satisfying this performance obligation, before adjustments.
attributes.references: ASC 606 Step 3 — Determine Transaction Price; IFRS 15.47

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this revenue recognition record was last modified. Tracks changes to recognition status, amounts, or approvals for SOX audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; ISO 27001; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: variable_consideration_estimate
attributes.description: The estimated amount of variable consideration (e.g., volume discounts, rebates, returns allowance, performance bonuses) included in the transaction price per ASC 606 Step 3. Subject to the constraint that a significant revenue reversal is not probable.

products.name: gmv_reconciliation
products.description: Reconciliation records mapping Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) to net revenue. Tracks gross order value, seller commissions, platform fees, promotional discounts, returns/refunds deductions, tax adjustments, and final recognized net revenue per period. Supports financial close, investor reporting, and SOX-compliant revenue attestation.

attributes.name: gmv_daily_snapshot_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for each GMV-to-net-revenue reconciliation record in the finance domain. Serves as the system-of-record identifier for financial close, SOX audit trails, and investor reporting.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 & 404 — Internal Controls over Financial Reporting

attributes.name: gmv_reconciliation_id
attributes.description: Primary key for gmv_reconciliation

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP S/4HANA cost center responsible for this reconciliation record, enabling P&L attribution, budget tracking, and internal financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO) — Cost Center Accounting; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: indexed_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to search.indexed_document. Business justification: GMV reconciliation per product listing requires linking each reconciliation record to the indexed_document representing that SKU.

attributes.name: period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fiscal period (month/quarter/year) to which this reconciliation record belongs. Drives financial close scheduling, MRR/ARR roll-ups, and period-over-period variance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO) — Fiscal Period; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: seller_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketplace seller whose transactions are included in this reconciliation record. Enables seller-level GMV attribution, commission calculation, and settlement reporting via the Seller Management Portal.
attributes.references: Seller Management Portal — Seller Performance Monitoring; FTC Marketplace Transparency Guidelines

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the finance controller who approved this reconciliation record during the financial close workflow. Distinct from SOX attestation — this is the operational approval step.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Internal Controls; SAP S/4HANA FI — Approval Workflow

attributes.name: attestation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when SOX attestation was formally recorded for this reconciliation record. Provides the precise audit trail timestamp required for regulatory compliance and external auditor review.

attributes.name: attested_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the finance controller or CFO who provided SOX attestation for this reconciliation record. Captured as part of the audit trail for regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 — CEO/CFO Certification; PCAOB AS 2201

attributes.name: cancelled_order_amount
attributes.description: Total value of orders cancelled within the reconciliation period, deducted from gross GMV to arrive at net GMV. Sourced from the Order Management System order lifecycle tracking.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606 — Variable Consideration; SAP S/4HANA FI Reversal Postings

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The sales channel through which the GMV was generated: 'web' (desktop/browser), 'mobile_app', 'bopis' (Buy Online Pick Up In Store), 'api' (API-driven B2B orders), 'edl' (Electronic Data Interchange). Supports channel-level revenue attribution and reporting.
attributes.references: Order Management System — Order Capture; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this GMV reconciliation record was first created in the data platform. Provides the audit trail creation marker required for SOX compliance and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Audit Trail; ISO 27001 — Information Security Management

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which all monetary amounts on this reconciliation record are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency operations and FX reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; GAAP ASC 830 Foreign Currency Matters

attributes.name: fx_rate
attributes.description: The exchange rate applied to convert transaction amounts from the transaction currency to the reporting currency (USD) for this reconciliation period. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA FI currency translation tables.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 830 — Foreign Currency Matters; SAP S/4HANA FI — Currency Translation

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA General Ledger account code to which the recognized net revenue is posted. Enables drill-through from financial statements to reconciliation detail and supports SOX audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL — Chart of Accounts; SOX Section 404 — Internal Controls

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reconciliation amounts were posted to the SAP S/4HANA General Ledger. Determines the accounting period for revenue recognition and is critical for period-end cut-off compliance.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606 — Revenue Recognition Timing; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: gross_gmv_amount
attributes.description: Total face value of all orders placed within the reconciliation period before any deductions. Represents the top-line GMV figure used in investor reporting, KPI dashboards, and GMV-to-revenue bridge calculations. Sourced from the Order Management System.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; SOX Section 302 — Revenue Attestation; FTC Advertising Standards

attributes.name: is_sox_attested
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reconciliation record has received formal SOX-compliant management attestation (True) or is pending attestation (False). Required for financial close gate and external audit evidence packages.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 & 404 — CEO/CFO Certification; PCAOB Auditing Standards

attributes.name: journal_entry_number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA accounting document number for the journal entry posting this reconciliation to the General Ledger. Provides the audit trail link between the reconciliation record and the posted GL entry for SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Accounting Document; SOX Section 302 & 404

attributes.name: logistics_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total last-mile delivery and fulfillment costs incurred within the reconciliation period, including 3PL charges, carrier fees, and FBA-style fulfillment costs. Sourced from the Transportation Management System and SAP S/4HANA AP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Materials Management (MM) — Logistics Invoice Verification; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: marketplace_segment
attributes.description: Business model segment classification for this reconciliation record: 'b2c' (Business to Consumer), 'b2b' (Business to Business), 'c2c' (Consumer to Consumer), or 'dtc' (Direct to Consumer). Enables segment-level revenue reporting and investor disclosures.
attributes.references: FTC Marketplace Transparency; GAAP ASC 606 — Contract Identification

attributes.name: materiality_threshold_amount
attributes.description: The monetary materiality threshold applied to this reconciliation record for SOX purposes. Variances exceeding this amount require escalation, formal explanation, and controller sign-off before the period can be closed.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 & 404; PCAOB AS 2101 — Audit Planning Materiality

attributes.name: net_gmv_amount
attributes.description: Gross GMV less cancelled orders and returns/refunds. Represents the value of successfully completed transactions before revenue deductions. Key intermediate figure in the GMV-to-revenue bridge used in investor reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; SOX Section 302 — Revenue Attestation

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for finance team annotations, adjustment explanations, or audit comments associated with this reconciliation record. Supports the financial close review process and provides context for auditors.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 — Management Commentary; PCAOB Auditing Standards

attributes.name: order_count
attributes.description: Total number of orders included in the gross GMV figure for this reconciliation record. Supports Average Order Value (AOV) calculation and volume-based variance analysis during financial close.
attributes.references: Order Management System — Order Lifecycle Tracking; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: payment_processing_fee_amount
attributes.description: Total fees charged by payment processors and card networks (e.g., interchange, gateway fees) within the reconciliation period. Deducted from gross revenue to arrive at net revenue. Sourced from the Payment Gateway and Processing Platform.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 — Payment Data Security; GAAP ASC 606 — Transaction Costs

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the reporting period covered by this reconciliation record. Defines the GMV measurement window close boundary for financial reporting and audit.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606 — Revenue Recognition; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the reporting period covered by this reconciliation record. Used to define the GMV measurement window for financial close and revenue recognition.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606 — Revenue Recognition; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: platform_fee_amount
attributes.description: Total fixed and variable platform service fees charged to sellers or buyers within the reconciliation period (e.g., listing fees, fulfillment fees, subscription fees). Distinct from commission-based revenue. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA AR.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606 — Distinct Performance Obligations; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: promotional_discount_amount
attributes.description: Total value of promotional discounts, coupons, and price reductions applied to orders within the reconciliation period. Deducted from gross GMV in the revenue bridge. Sourced from the Marketing Automation Platform and Order Management System.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606 — Variable Consideration; GAAP ASC 340-40 Contract Costs

attributes.name: recognized_net_revenue_amount
attributes.description: Final net revenue recognized for the period after all deductions: net GMV minus promotional discounts, minus payment processing fees, minus logistics costs, plus platform fees and seller commissions earned. Posted to the SAP S/4HANA General Ledger as the period revenue figure for SOX-compliant financial reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606 — Revenue Recognition; SOX Section 302 & 404; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL

attributes.name: recognized_net_revenue_reporting_ccy
attributes.business_glossary_term: Recognized Net Revenue in Reporting Currency
attributes.description: Recognized net revenue amount translated into the reporting currency using the period fx_rate. Used for consolidated financial statements, investor reporting, and MRR/ARR calculations in the reporting currency.

attributes.name: reconciliation_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for this reconciliation record, used in financial close packages, investor reports, and SOX attestation documentation. Format: REC-YYYY-MM-XXXXXXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 & 404; SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting (FI) Document Number convention

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the GMV reconciliation record within the financial close workflow. 'draft' = initial capture; 'in_review' = under finance team review; 'approved' = controller sign-off obtained; 'posted' = posted to general ledger in SAP S/4HANA; 'disputed' = variance flagged for investigation; 'closed' = period locked.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 & 404 — Financial Close Controls; SAP S/4HANA FI Document Lifecycle

attributes.name: reconciliation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reconciliation cadence: 'monthly' for standard MRR close, 'quarterly' for investor reporting, 'annual' for ARR and audited financials, 'ad_hoc' for out-of-cycle adjustments or restatements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GAAP ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: reporting_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 code for the functional/reporting currency to which all amounts are translated for consolidated financial reporting (e.g., USD). Distinct from currency_code which reflects the transaction currency.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; GAAP ASC 830 — Foreign Currency Matters

attributes.name: return_order_count
attributes.description: Total number of Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) orders processed within the reconciliation period. Used to calculate return rate and validate the returns_refunds_amount deduction.
attributes.references: Order Management System — RMA Processing; FTC Consumer Protection

attributes.name: returns_refunds_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of approved returns and refunds processed via the Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) workflow within the period. Deducted from gross GMV in the revenue bridge. Sourced from the Order Management System and Payment Gateway.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606 — Right of Return; FTC Consumer Protection — Refund Policies

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_method
attributes.description: The GAAP ASC 606 revenue recognition method applied to this reconciliation record: 'point_in_time' for standard product sales, 'over_time' for subscription or service revenue, 'milestone_based' for project-based arrangements.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606 — Step 5: Satisfy Performance Obligations; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: seller_commission_amount
attributes.description: Total marketplace commission fees earned from sellers on transactions within the reconciliation period. Represents platform revenue earned on GMV and is a key component of the GMV-to-net-revenue bridge. Sourced from the Seller Management Portal.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606 — Principal vs. Agent Considerations; FTC Marketplace Transparency

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this reconciliation record was sourced or initiated: 'SAP_S4HANA' (ERP financial consolidation), 'OMS' (Order Management System), 'PAYMENT_GATEWAY' (Payment Gateway and Processing Platform), 'SELLER_PORTAL' (Seller Management Portal), 'MANUAL' (manual finance entry). Supports data lineage and ETL audit trails.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 — Data Provenance; SOX Section 404 — Data Lineage

attributes.name: tax_collected_amount
attributes.description: Total sales tax, VAT, or GST collected from buyers on orders within the reconciliation period. Excluded from net revenue recognition as a pass-through liability. Sourced from the Payment Gateway and SAP S/4HANA Tax module.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606 — Taxes Collected from Customers; GDPR Article 5 (data minimization for tax records); SOX Section 404

attributes.name: tax_remitted_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amounts remitted to tax authorities within the reconciliation period. Reconciled against tax_collected_amount to identify timing differences and tax liability balances in SAP S/4HANA AP.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Tax Compliance; WTO International Trade Regulations

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent modification to this GMV reconciliation record. Tracks changes during the financial close review cycle and supports SOX change audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Audit Trail; ISO 27001 — Information Security Management

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: Monetary difference between the expected net revenue (as per budget or prior period) and the actual recognized net revenue for this reconciliation record. A non-zero variance triggers investigation and may require SOX-compliant explanatory notes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 & 404 — Variance Analysis; SAP S/4HANA CO — Variance Reporting

attributes.name: variance_explanation
attributes.description: Free-text narrative explaining the root cause of any material reconciliation variance. Required for SOX attestation when variance_amount exceeds the materiality threshold. Captured by the finance controller during the review workflow.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 & 404 — Management Attestation; PCAOB Auditing Standards

attributes.name: voucher_discount_amount
attributes.description: Total value of platform-funded vouchers and coupon redemptions applied within the reconciliation period. Tracked separately from seller-funded promotional discounts for accurate P&L attribution and marketing spend reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606 — Variable Consideration; Marketing Automation Platform — Salesforce Marketing Cloud

products.name: seller_disbursement
products.description: Records of financial disbursements made to marketplace sellers and third-party merchants. Tracks disbursement amounts, settlement periods, commission deductions, fee withholdings, tax withholdings, payment method, and disbursement status. Integrates with the seller domain for payee identity and the payment domain for settlement execution. Supports marketplace AP reconciliation.

attributes.name: seller_disbursement_id
attributes.description: Primary key for seller_disbursement

attributes.name: seller_performance_snapshot_id
