attributes.description: Unique system-generated primary key identifying each seller disbursement record in the marketplace accounts payable ledger.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP Module; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_obligation. Business justification: Seller payouts must comply with tax‑withholding and payment‑security regulations, captured as a compliance obligation.

attributes.name: payment_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the settlement execution record in the Payment Gateway and Processing Platform that executed this disbursement transaction.
attributes.references: Payment Gateway and Processing Platform; PCI DSS

attributes.name: seller_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketplace seller or third-party merchant receiving this disbursement. Links to the seller master record in the Seller Management Portal.
attributes.references: Seller Management Portal; SAP S/4HANA Vendor Master

attributes.name: actual_disbursement_date
attributes.description: The actual calendar date on which the disbursement was successfully transferred to the seller's bank account. May differ from scheduled date due to banking delays, holidays, or processing issues. Used for SLA compliance tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP Module; ISO 20022; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Net monetary adjustment applied to the disbursement for corrections, promotional credits, dispute resolutions, or other one-time modifications. Can be positive (credit to seller) or negative (debit from seller).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP Module; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status for this disbursement. SOX-compliant disbursements above defined thresholds require explicit approval before processing. Tracks whether the disbursement has been reviewed and authorized.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA AP Workflow; Internal Financial Controls

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Employee ID or system username of the finance team member who approved this disbursement. Required for SOX-compliant dual-control authorization and audit trail. Null for auto-approved disbursements below threshold.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA AP Workflow; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the disbursement was formally approved by an authorized finance team member. Part of the SOX-compliant audit trail for financial controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA AP Workflow

attributes.name: bank_account_last4
attributes.description: Last four digits of the seller's bank account number to which the disbursement was sent. Stored as a masked reference for reconciliation and audit purposes without exposing full account details per PCI DSS requirements.
attributes.references: PCI DSS Requirement 3; PCI SSC; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: bank_routing_code
attributes.description: Bank routing number, SWIFT/BIC code, or IBAN prefix identifying the destination financial institution for the disbursement. Used for payment routing and reconciliation with the payment gateway.
attributes.references: ISO 9362 SWIFT/BIC; PCI DSS; SAP S/4HANA AP Module

attributes.name: commission_deduction_amount
attributes.description: Total marketplace commission fees deducted from the gross disbursement amount. Represents the platform's revenue share withheld from the seller payout per the seller agreement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP Module; Seller Management Portal; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA cost center code associated with this disbursement for internal financial reporting, budget tracking, and departmental cost allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Controlling Module; SOX Section 404; GAAP

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp when this disbursement record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, SOX audit trails, and reconciliation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this disbursement record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency marketplace operations and cross-border seller payouts.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; WTO International Trade Regulations; GDPR

attributes.name: disbursement_reference
attributes.description: Externally-visible alphanumeric reference code assigned to this disbursement, used in seller-facing remittance advice and reconciliation communications.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP Module; ISO 20022 Payment Standards

attributes.name: disbursement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the disbursement. Tracks progression from pending approval through processing to completed settlement or failure/reversal. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|processing|completed|failed|reversed|on_hold — promote to reference product if additional states are needed]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP Module; SOX Section 404; ISO 20022

attributes.name: disbursement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the disbursement by payout mechanism or trigger. Standard disbursements follow the regular settlement cycle; accelerated are expedited payouts; manual are operator-initiated; adjustment corrects prior disbursements; reversal claws back funds; advance is a pre-settlement payout. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|accelerated|manual|adjustment|reversal|advance — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP Module; Seller Management Portal

attributes.name: failure_reason
attributes.description: Descriptive reason code or message explaining why a disbursement failed or was placed on hold (e.g., invalid bank account, insufficient funds, compliance hold, fraud flag). Null for successful disbursements.
attributes.references: Payment Gateway and Processing Platform; SAP S/4HANA AP Module

attributes.name: fee_deduction_amount
attributes.description: Total platform service fees deducted from the gross disbursement, including fulfillment fees, storage fees, listing fees, and other operational charges billed to the seller.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP Module; Seller Management Portal

attributes.name: fx_conversion_date
attributes.description: The date on which the foreign exchange rate was fixed for currency conversion in this disbursement. Used for FX gain/loss accounting and cross-border financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA Treasury Module; GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: fx_conversion_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate applied to convert the disbursement amount from the marketplace transaction currency to the seller's payout currency. Applicable for cross-border sellers operating in multiple currencies. Null if no conversion was required.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; WTO International Trade Regulations; SAP S/4HANA Treasury Module

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA General Ledger account code to which this disbursement is posted. Enables financial consolidation, P&L reporting, and SOX-compliant audit trails within the enterprise ERP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA GL Module; SOX Section 404; GAAP

attributes.name: gmv_amount
attributes.description: Total Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) of all orders settled in this disbursement period, representing the full customer-facing transaction value before platform deductions. Used for GMV-to-revenue reconciliation and marketplace financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Module; GAAP ASC 606; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: gross_disbursement_amount
attributes.description: Total gross amount owed to the seller before any deductions, representing the sum of all settled order revenues attributed to the seller within the settlement period. Core component of the monetary triplet for AP reconciliation and GMV-to-revenue reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP/AR Module; SOX Section 404; GAAP Revenue Recognition ASC 606

attributes.name: initiated_timestamp
attributes.description: The real-world business event timestamp when the disbursement was initiated and entered the payment queue. Distinct from system audit timestamps. Used for SLA measurement and settlement cycle reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP Module; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: marketplace_region
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the marketplace region in which the seller's sales were generated. Drives tax withholding rules, currency conversion, and regulatory reporting requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; WTO International Trade Regulations; GDPR; CCPA

attributes.name: net_disbursement_amount
attributes.description: Final net amount actually disbursed to the seller after all deductions (commission, fees, tax withholding, refunds, adjustments). This is the actual payout amount transferred to the seller's bank account. Core net-total component of the monetary triplet.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP Module; SOX Section 404; GAAP ASC 606; ISO 20022

attributes.name: net_payout_amount
attributes.description: Net disbursement amount expressed in the seller's payout currency after FX conversion. Equals net_disbursement_amount multiplied by fx_conversion_rate. Null if no currency conversion was applied.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA Treasury Module; GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for finance team annotations, special handling instructions, or contextual information about this disbursement. Used for manual disbursements, adjustments, and exception handling documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP Module; SOX Section 404 Internal Controls

attributes.name: on_hold_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why a disbursement has been placed on hold (e.g., seller account under review, tax documentation pending, dispute investigation, compliance verification). Null when disbursement is not on hold.
attributes.references: Seller Management Portal; FTC Consumer Protection; GDPR; CCPA

attributes.name: order_count
attributes.description: Number of individual customer orders included in this disbursement's settlement period. Used for reconciliation, seller performance reporting, and GMV-to-disbursement ratio analysis.
attributes.references: Order Management System; SAP S/4HANA AP Module

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The financial instrument or channel used to transfer funds to the seller. Determines the settlement rail and associated processing timelines. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bank_transfer|payoneer|paypal|check|wire_transfer|virtual_account — promote to reference product if additional methods are needed]
attributes.references: Payment Gateway and Processing Platform; PCI DSS; ISO 20022

attributes.name: payout_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code of the currency in which the seller actually receives the disbursement. May differ from currency_code when FX conversion is applied for cross-border sellers.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; WTO International Trade Regulations; SAP S/4HANA Treasury Module

attributes.name: refund_deduction_amount
attributes.description: Total amount deducted from the disbursement to recover costs associated with customer refunds and returns (RMA) processed during the settlement period and charged back to the seller.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP Module; Order Management System RMA Processing

attributes.name: remittance_advice_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether a remittance advice notification has been sent to the seller detailing the disbursement breakdown (gross amount, deductions, net payout). Supports seller reconciliation and dispute prevention.
attributes.references: Seller Management Portal; SAP S/4HANA AP Module

attributes.name: remittance_sent_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the remittance advice notification was dispatched to the seller. Used for seller communication tracking and SLA compliance measurement.
attributes.references: Seller Management Portal; SAP S/4HANA AP Module

attributes.name: reversal_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the original disbursement_reference that this record reverses or corrects. Populated only for disbursements of type 'reversal' or 'adjustment'. Enables full audit trail of disbursement corrections.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP Module; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: scheduled_disbursement_date
attributes.description: The planned calendar date on which the disbursement is scheduled to be transferred to the seller's bank account. Used for cash flow planning and seller expectation management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP Module; Seller Management Portal

attributes.name: seller_entity_type
attributes.description: Legal entity classification of the seller receiving the disbursement. Determines applicable tax withholding rates, regulatory reporting obligations (e.g., IRS 1099-K thresholds), and KYC/AML compliance requirements.
attributes.references: FTC; IRS Form 1099-K; GDPR; CCPA; Seller Management Portal

attributes.name: settlement_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the settlement period covered by this disbursement. Defines the closing boundary of the window during which seller sales transactions are aggregated for payout calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP Module; Seller Management Portal; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: settlement_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the settlement period covered by this disbursement. Defines the beginning of the window during which seller sales transactions are aggregated for payout calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP Module; Seller Management Portal; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: tax_form_type
attributes.description: Type of tax reporting form associated with this disbursement for regulatory compliance. Determines the applicable tax reporting obligation based on seller entity type and jurisdiction. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 1099-K|1042-S|W-9|W-8BEN|VAT|GST|none — promote to reference product if additional form types are needed]
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-K; IRS Form 1042-S; EU VAT Directive; FTC; WTO

attributes.name: tax_withholding_amount
attributes.description: Amount of tax withheld from the seller disbursement in compliance with applicable tax regulations (e.g., VAT, GST, income tax withholding for cross-border sellers). Reported to tax authorities as required.
attributes.references: FTC; GDPR; WTO International Trade Regulations; IRS Form 1099-K; EU VAT Directive

attributes.name: transaction_reference
attributes.description: External transaction reference number returned by the bank or payment processor confirming the fund transfer. Used for bank reconciliation, dispute resolution, and audit trail in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP Module; ISO 20022; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp when this disbursement record was last modified. Tracks status changes, corrections, and reversals for SOX compliance and audit trail integrity.

products.name: tax_record
products.description: SSOT for all tax obligations, filings, and tax line-item records across transactions. Captures tax type (VAT, GST, sales tax, withholding tax), tax jurisdiction, tax rate applied, taxable amount, tax amount, tax period, and filing status. Supports compliance with FTC, GDPR, and international tax regulations. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA tax determination.

attributes.name: tax_record_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each tax record entry in the enterprise financial system. Primary key for the tax_record data product.

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the e-commerce order associated with this tax record. Enables reconciliation of tax obligations back to the originating Order Management System (OMS) order.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the accounts receivable invoice document associated with this tax record. Supports invoice-level tax reconciliation in SAP S/4HANA AR module.

attributes.name: payment_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating financial transaction (order, invoice, payment, or settlement) that generated this tax obligation. Links tax record to its source transaction.

attributes.name: regulation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulation. Business justification: Tax filing requires each tax record to be linked to the specific regulation (e.g., VAT) that mandates the filing, essential for compliance reporting.

attributes.name: seller_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketplace seller responsible for the taxable transaction. Required for marketplace facilitator tax compliance where the platform collects and remits tax on behalf of sellers.
attributes.references: Seller Management Portal — Seller Onboarding; FTC Marketplace Facilitator Tax Rules

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA company code identifying the legal entity responsible for this tax obligation. Enables multi-entity tax consolidation and statutory reporting across the enterprise group.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code (BUKRS); SOX Section 302/404; GAAP Consolidation

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA cost center code to which the tax expense is allocated for internal management accounting and cost reporting. Supports cost center-level tax burden analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-CCA Cost Center Accounting; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the tax jurisdiction country. Used for international tax compliance, GDPR territorial scoping, and cross-border transaction reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GDPR Article 3; WTO International Trade Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tax record was first captured in the enterprise data platform. Used for audit trail, SOX compliance, and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the transaction currency in which taxable_amount, tax_amount, and net_amount are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency tax reconciliation and international financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Currency; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The statutory deadline by which the tax must be remitted to the tax authority. Used for cash flow planning, penalty risk monitoring, and compliance SLA tracking.
attributes.references: FTC Tax Compliance; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Payment Due Date; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign currency exchange rate applied to convert transaction currency amounts to local reporting currency at the time of the taxable event. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA exchange rate tables.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Exchange Rate; GAAP ASC 830; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: exemption_certificate_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the tax exemption certificate provided by the buyer or seller to justify a zero or reduced tax rate. Required for audit substantiation when is_tax_exempt is True. Confidential business document reference.
attributes.references: FTC Tax Exemption Documentation; SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Exemption Certificate; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: filing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the tax return or remittance was filed with the relevant tax authority. Null if not yet filed. Used to track compliance with filing deadlines and SLA obligations.
attributes.references: FTC Tax Filing Requirements; SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Filing Date; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: filing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the tax record within the filing workflow. Tracks progression from pending obligation through filed, accepted by authority, rejected, amended, or voided. Drives compliance monitoring and SOX audit controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; FTC Tax Compliance; SAP S/4HANA FI-TX

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period number within the fiscal year (1–12 for monthly, 1–4 for quarterly) to which this tax record is attributed. Used for period-end close, tax accrual, and financial consolidation in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Period; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year (e.g., 2024) to which this tax record is attributed for financial reporting and tax filing purposes. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA fiscal year variant configuration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year; SOX Section 302/404; GAAP Periodicity Principle

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The General Ledger (GL) account code in SAP S/4HANA to which the tax amount is posted (e.g., tax payable account, input VAT recoverable account). Enables financial consolidation and balance sheet reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Chart of Accounts; SOX Section 302/404; GAAP

attributes.name: is_marketplace_facilitator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tax was collected and remitted by the e-commerce platform acting as a marketplace facilitator (True) rather than by the individual seller (False). Relevant for US marketplace facilitator tax laws and similar international regulations.
attributes.references: FTC Marketplace Facilitator Tax Laws; Seller Management Portal; Electronic Commerce Directive (EU)

attributes.name: is_tax_exempt
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transaction or customer is tax-exempt (True), resulting in a zero tax amount. Requires a valid exemption certificate on file. Used for B2B tax exemption processing and audit compliance.
attributes.references: FTC Tax Exemption Rules; SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Tax Exemption; CCPA; GDPR

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the legal entity's local reporting currency (e.g., USD for US entities). Used to denominate tax_amount_local_currency for statutory reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA Company Code Currency; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: The total net amount inclusive of tax (taxable_amount + tax_amount), expressed in the transaction currency. Represents the gross total component of the MONETARY_TRIPLET. Used for revenue recognition, GMV-to-revenue reconciliation, and financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL General Ledger; SOX Section 302/404; GAAP Revenue Recognition ASC 606

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for tax analyst or compliance officer annotations, adjustment explanations, audit findings, or correspondence references related to this tax record. Supports SOX audit documentation requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404 Audit Documentation; SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Text Field

attributes.name: remittance_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the tax amount was remitted (paid) to the tax authority. Null if not yet remitted. Used to confirm payment completion and calculate late payment penalties.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Payment Clearing; SOX Section 302/404; FTC Tax Compliance

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record that originated this tax record (e.g., SAP S/4HANA ERP, Order Management System, Payment Gateway). Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404 Data Lineage; ISO 27001 Information Asset Management; SAP S/4HANA Integration

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The calculated tax amount charged or withheld on the transaction, expressed in the transaction currency. Represents the tax adjustment component of the MONETARY_TRIPLET. May differ from taxable_amount × tax_rate due to rounding rules or tax authority adjustments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Tax Amount; SOX Section 302/404; PCI DSS Requirement 3

attributes.name: tax_amount_local_currency
attributes.description: Tax amount converted to the local reporting currency of the legal entity, using the exchange rate at the time of the taxable event. Required for statutory financial reporting, SOX compliance, and SAP S/4HANA parallel ledger reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Local Currency; SOX Section 302/404; GAAP ASC 830 Foreign Currency

attributes.name: tax_authority_name
attributes.description: Name of the government tax authority to which the tax is owed or has been filed (e.g., 'IRS', 'HMRC', 'EU VAT Authority', 'California CDTFA'). Used for filing routing and regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: FTC; SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Tax Authority; WTO International Trade Regulations

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA tax condition code (e.g., 'A1', 'V5') that encapsulates the tax type, rate, and jurisdiction configuration. Used for tax determination, GL account assignment, and tax reporting in the ERP system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Tax Code (MWSKZ); OECD VAT/GST Guidelines

attributes.name: tax_document_number
attributes.description: Externally-known tax document reference number assigned by SAP S/4HANA FI-TX module or the tax authority. Used for audit trails, tax filings, and cross-referencing with regulatory submissions. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this transaction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Tax Document; SOX Section 302/404 Audit Trail

attributes.name: tax_event_timestamp
attributes.description: The principal real-world timestamp when the taxable event occurred (e.g., point of sale, invoice issuance, payment settlement). Distinct from record audit timestamps. Determines the applicable tax period and rate under tax authority rules.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Tax Point Date; ISO 8601; GDPR Article 5 (accuracy)

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the tax jurisdiction (country, state, province, county, or municipality) where the tax obligation arises. Follows ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 for country-level and ISO 3166-2 for sub-national jurisdictions. Drives tax rate lookup and filing routing.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; ISO 3166-2; SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Jurisdiction Code; GDPR Article 3 (territorial scope)

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level of the tax jurisdiction at which the tax is levied. Supports multi-level tax stacking (e.g., federal + state + county + city sales tax in the US) and jurisdiction hierarchy reporting.
attributes.references: FTC Sales Tax Nexus Rules; NIST Cybersecurity Framework; SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Jurisdiction Level

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the tax jurisdiction (e.g., 'California', 'United Kingdom', 'European Union VAT Area'). Complements the jurisdiction code for reporting and business user readability.
attributes.references: ISO 3166; SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Jurisdiction Description

attributes.name: tax_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the tax reporting period to which this tax record belongs. Together with tax_period_start_date, defines the fiscal period boundary for tax filing and financial consolidation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Tax Period; SOX Section 302/404; GAAP Periodicity Principle

attributes.name: tax_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the tax reporting period (month, quarter, or year) to which this tax record belongs. Determines the filing period for tax authority submissions and financial period-end close.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Tax Period; SOX Section 302/404; GAAP Periodicity Principle

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: The applicable tax rate expressed as a decimal fraction (e.g., 0.085000 for 8.5%). Sourced from SAP S/4HANA tax condition records for the applicable jurisdiction and tax type at the time of the taxable event.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Tax Condition Record; OECD VAT/GST Guidelines

attributes.name: tax_registration_number
attributes.description: The company's tax registration or identification number with the relevant tax authority (e.g., VAT registration number, EIN, GST registration). Required for tax invoice compliance and regulatory filings. Confidential business identifier.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; FTC Tax Registration; SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Company Tax Number; ISO 27001

attributes.name: tax_treatment
attributes.description: The VAT/GST tax treatment applied to the transaction line, determining how the tax is calculated and reported. Drives tax return categorization and compliance with EU VAT Directive and OECD guidelines.
attributes.references: EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; OECD VAT/GST Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Tax Treatment

attributes.name: tax_type
attributes.description: Classification of the tax obligation by tax regime type. Determines the applicable regulatory framework, filing requirements, and remittance rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: VAT|GST|sales_tax|withholding_tax|customs_duty|excise_tax|use_tax|digital_services_tax — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OECD International VAT/GST Guidelines; FTC; WTO International Trade Regulations; SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Tax Category

attributes.name: taxable_amount
attributes.description: The gross base amount subject to taxation before tax is applied, expressed in the transaction currency. Forms the basis for tax calculation: tax_amount = taxable_amount × tax_rate. Core component of the MONETARY_TRIPLET.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Tax Base Amount; SOX Section 302/404; PCI DSS Requirement 3

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the underlying business transaction that generated the tax record. Determines the direction of tax flow (payable vs. receivable) and applicable reporting treatment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Transaction Type; OECD International VAT/GST Guidelines; WTO

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tax record was last modified in the enterprise data platform. Supports change tracking, SOX audit controls, and incremental ETL processing.

products.name: financial_period_close
products.description: Tracks the status and workflow of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial period-close activities. Captures close task assignments, completion status, sign-off approvals, open items blocking close, and close date actuals vs. targets. Supports SOX-compliant close process governance and audit trail for financial attestation.
products.reference: Financial Close Management / SAP S/4HANA Period Close

attributes.name: financial_period_close_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each financial period close record in the enterprise data lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404 — Internal Controls over Financial Reporting

attributes.name: approver_agent_id
attributes.description: The employee identifier of the CFO, VP Finance, or designated approver who provides final sign-off on the period close. Required for SOX-compliant attestation workflow.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 — CEO/CFO Certification; SAP S/4HANA Workflow

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.legal_entity

attributes.name: primary_financial_agent_id
attributes.description: The employee identifier of the finance controller or close manager who owns and is accountable for the successful completion of this period close cycle. Primary party reference for the close workflow.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 — Management Certification; SAP S/4HANA User Management

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_program. Business justification: Period‑close is executed under a SOX compliance program; linking ensures auditability of close tasks against the program.

attributes.name: accruals_posted
attributes.description: Indicates whether all period-end accrual journal entries (e.g., accrued expenses, deferred revenue, accrued liabilities) have been posted to the general ledger. True = all accruals posted; False = pending.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 420 Accruals; SAP S/4HANA Accrual Engine; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: actual_close_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the period close was formally completed and all sign-offs obtained. Compared against target_close_date to compute close cycle variance and report on close efficiency KPIs.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; Internal Close Governance Policy

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the final sign-off approval was granted for this period close. Critical for SOX audit trail — establishes the exact moment of management certification.

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: The full name of the CFO or designated approver who signed off on the period close. Retained in the record for audit trail and SOX attestation documentation.

attributes.name: bank_reconciliation_complete
attributes.description: Indicates whether all bank account reconciliations have been completed and approved for this period. True = all bank reconciliations complete; False = one or more pending. Key SOX cash control.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Cash Controls; SAP S/4HANA Bank Reconciliation

attributes.name: close_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the period close was marked as fully completed and all required approvals were obtained. Used for audit trail and close cycle duration analytics.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA Financial Close Cockpit

attributes.name: close_cycle_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days elapsed from period_end_date to actual_close_date, representing the total close cycle duration. Used as a KPI to benchmark close efficiency and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
attributes.references: APQC Financial Close Benchmarking; Internal Finance KPI Framework

attributes.name: close_initiated_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the period close workflow was formally initiated in the system. Serves as the principal business event timestamp for the close cycle lifecycle. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Audit Trail Requirements; SAP S/4HANA Financial Close Cockpit

attributes.name: close_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for the close owner to document significant events, exceptions, judgments, or issues encountered during the period close (e.g., 'Q4 close delayed due to year-end inventory count discrepancy'). Supports audit documentation and knowledge transfer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Documentation Requirements; Internal Close Governance Policy

attributes.name: close_owner_name
attributes.description: The full name of the finance controller or close manager responsible for this period close. Retained for audit documentation and SOX attestation records independent of HR system changes.

attributes.name: close_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the period close cycle, used in SAP S/4HANA and cross-system references (e.g., FPC-2024-12-ANN-0001). Enables traceability across ERP, audit, and reporting systems.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Close Cockpit; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: close_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the period close cycle. Tracks progression from open through in-progress task execution, pending CFO/controller approval, final closed state, or reopened for adjustments. Core lifecycle field for SOX governance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA Financial Close Cockpit

attributes.name: close_variance_days
attributes.description: The difference in calendar days between actual_close_date and target_close_date (positive = late, negative = early). Measures SLA adherence and is used to identify systemic close delays for process improvement.
attributes.references: Internal SLA Policy; APQC Financial Close Benchmarking

attributes.name: completed_tasks
attributes.description: The number of close tasks that have been completed and signed off as of the last update. Compared against total_close_tasks to derive completion progress for dashboard reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Close Cockpit — Task Completion Tracking

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this financial period close record was first created in the enterprise data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements under SOX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Audit Trail; ISO 27001 A.12.4

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the reporting currency of this period close (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Determines the currency in which GMV-to-revenue reconciliation and financial statements are expressed.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; GAAP ASC 830 Foreign Currency

attributes.name: depreciation_run_complete
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fixed asset depreciation run has been executed and posted for this period in SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting. True = depreciation run complete; False = pending.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting (FI-AA)

attributes.name: external_audit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this period close is subject to external auditor review (e.g., Q4 annual audit, quarterly review). True = external audit scope; False = internal close only. Triggers additional documentation and evidence retention requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404(b) — External Auditor Attestation; PCAOB AS 2201

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period number within the fiscal year (1–12 for monthly, 1–4 for quarterly, or 13/16 for special periods in SAP). Identifies the specific accounting period being closed.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Posting Period; ISO 8601 Calendar

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this period close belongs (e.g., 2024). Aligns with the enterprise fiscal calendar defined in SAP S/4HANA and used for SOX financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Fiscal Year Variant; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: gl_period_locked
attributes.description: Indicates whether the general ledger posting period has been locked in SAP S/4HANA, preventing further journal entries. True = period is locked; False = period is still open for postings. Critical SOX control.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Posting Period Variant; SOX Section 404 — Access Controls

attributes.name: gl_posting_cutoff_date
attributes.description: The last date on which journal entries and transactions may be posted to the general ledger for this period. After this date, the posting period is locked in SAP S/4HANA to prevent unauthorized entries.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Posting Period Lock; GAAP ASC 855 Subsequent Events

attributes.name: gmv_to_revenue_reconciled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) to Revenue Reconciliation Complete Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the GMV-to-net-revenue reconciliation has been completed for this period, accounting for seller commissions, returns, refunds, and marketplace fees. True = reconciled; False = pending. Core e-commerce finance control.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; SEC Revenue Reporting; FTC E-Commerce Disclosure Standards

attributes.name: intercompany_eliminations_complete
attributes.description: Indicates whether all intercompany transaction eliminations have been processed for consolidated financial reporting. True = eliminations complete; False = pending. Required for multi-entity SOX consolidation.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 810 Consolidation; SAP S/4HANA Intercompany Reconciliation; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this financial period close record was most recently modified. Tracks the latest state change for audit trail and SOX compliance purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Audit Trail; ISO 27001 A.12.4

attributes.name: open_blocking_items
attributes.description: The number of unresolved issues or open items that are currently blocking the period close from progressing to the next stage or final approval. A non-zero value indicates the close is at risk.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Material Weakness Identification; SAP S/4HANA Close Cockpit

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the accounting period being closed (e.g., 2024-12-31 for December close). Defines the inclusive end boundary for all transactions posted to this period.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 270; SAP S/4HANA Posting Period Configuration

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the accounting period being closed (e.g., 2024-12-01 for December close). Defines the inclusive start boundary for all transactions posted to this period.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 270; SAP S/4HANA Posting Period Configuration

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Classification of the close cycle: monthly (standard month-end), quarterly (Q1–Q4 close), annual (year-end close), or special (adjustment/correction period). Drives the scope of close tasks and sign-off requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Fiscal Year Variant; GAAP ASC 270 Interim Reporting

attributes.name: reopen_authorized_by
attributes.description: The name and title of the senior finance officer who authorized the reopening of a closed period. Retained as a string for audit documentation. Populated only when close_status = reopened.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 — Management Authorization; Internal Finance Controls Policy

attributes.name: reopen_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the business justification for reopening a previously closed period (e.g., 'Material error in revenue recognition for marketplace seller commissions'). Populated only when close_status = reopened. Required for SOX audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Material Weakness Documentation; GAAP ASC 250 Accounting Changes

attributes.name: reporting_standard
attributes.description: The accounting standard under which this period close is being executed and reported. GAAP = US Generally Accepted Accounting Principles, IFRS = International Financial Reporting Standards, GAAP_IFRS_DUAL = dual reporting for multi-jurisdiction entities.
attributes.references: GAAP FASB ASC; IFRS Foundation; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_complete
attributes.description: Indicates whether all revenue recognition entries for the period have been processed and validated per ASC 606 / IFRS 15 standards. True = revenue recognition is complete; False = pending. Required for accurate MRR and ARR reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; IFRS 15; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: sox_attestation_status
attributes.description: The current status of the SOX management attestation for this period close. Tracks whether the required CEO/CFO certification of internal controls over financial reporting has been completed, is in progress, or has noted exceptions requiring remediation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 — CEO/CFO Certification; SOX Section 404 — Management Assessment

attributes.name: target_close_date
attributes.description: The planned calendar date by which the period close must be completed, as defined in the close calendar. Used to measure close cycle efficiency and SLA adherence against actual close date.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Close Calendar Governance; Internal SLA Policy

attributes.name: tax_provision_complete
attributes.description: Indicates whether the income tax provision calculation and journal entry have been completed for this period. True = tax provision posted; False = pending. Required for accurate net income reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 740 Income Taxes; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: total_close_tasks
attributes.description: The total number of close tasks (activities) defined in the close checklist for this period close cycle. Used to compute task completion percentage and monitor close progress.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Close Cockpit — Task Management

products.name: intercompany_transaction
products.description: Records of financial transactions between legal entities within the Ecommerce corporate group. Tracks intercompany billing, cost allocations, loans, and transfer pricing entries. Captures sending entity, receiving entity, transaction type, amount, currency, and elimination status for consolidated financial reporting. Supports SOX intercompany reconciliation and IFRS consolidation.

attributes.name: intercompany_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each intercompany transaction record within the Ecommerce corporate group. Serves as the primary key for this entity in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Intercompany Accounting; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center responsible for the intercompany charge on the receiving entity side, used for internal cost allocation and management reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Cost Center Accounting; IFRS 8 Operating Segments

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Reference to the General Ledger account code under which this intercompany transaction is posted in the chart of accounts, enabling financial consolidation and GL-level reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA GL Account; IFRS 10; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_obligation. Business justification: Intercompany pricing must satisfy transfer‑pricing regulatory obligations, tracked via a compliance obligation record.

attributes.name: primary_intercompany_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal entity within the Ecommerce corporate group that originates and bills the intercompany transaction (the seller/creditor side of the intercompany entry).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Company Code; IFRS 10; SOX Intercompany Reconciliation

attributes.name: receiving_entity_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal entity within the Ecommerce corporate group that receives and is charged for the intercompany transaction (the buyer/debtor side of the intercompany entry).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Company Code; IFRS 10; SOX Intercompany Reconciliation

attributes.name: agreement_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the intercompany service agreement, master service agreement (MSA), or transfer pricing agreement that governs this transaction. Links to the legal framework authorizing the charge.
attributes.references: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; SOX Section 302; IFRS 10; FTC Intercompany Agreements

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the total shared cost allocated to the receiving entity for cost_allocation transaction types. Must sum to 100% across all receiving entities for a given allocation event.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Cost Allocation; IFRS 10; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval workflow status for the intercompany transaction: pending (awaiting review), approved (authorized by required approvers), rejected (declined and requires correction), escalated (referred to senior management for decision).
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA Workflow; IFRS 10

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or employee identifier of the authorized approver who approved this intercompany transaction. Required for SOX audit trail and segregation of duties compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA Workflow Approval; PCAOB AS 2201

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the intercompany transaction received final authorization from the designated approver. Part of the SOX-compliant audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA Workflow; ISO 27001

attributes.name: cost_allocation_basis
attributes.description: The allocation driver used to apportion shared costs across entities for cost_allocation transaction types: headcount (employee count), revenue (proportional to entity revenue), usage (actual consumption), fixed (predetermined fixed amount), square_footage (facility area), transaction_volume (number of transactions processed).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Cost Allocation; IFRS 10; OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this intercompany transaction record was first created in the system. Part of the mandatory audit trail for SOX compliance and data lineage tracking in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; ISO 27001; SAP S/4HANA Created On

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the intercompany transaction is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Distinct from the functional currency of either entity.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IAS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates; SAP S/4HANA Currency Key

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the originating source document (e.g., intercompany invoice number, purchase order number, or service agreement reference) that supports this intercompany transaction for audit purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Reference Document Number; SOX Section 302; IFRS 10

attributes.name: elimination_date
attributes.description: The date on which this intercompany transaction was eliminated during the group consolidation process. Null if elimination has not yet occurred.
attributes.references: IFRS 10; SAP S/4HANA Consolidation Monitor; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: elimination_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this intercompany transaction has been eliminated in the consolidated financial statements to avoid double-counting of intra-group revenues and expenses. Required for IFRS 10 consolidation.
attributes.references: IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; SAP S/4HANA Consolidation; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The exchange rate applied to convert the transaction currency amount to the functional or group currency at the transaction date. Sourced from the SAP S/4HANA exchange rate table.
attributes.references: IAS 21; SAP S/4HANA Exchange Rate; OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month number 1–12 or 1–16 for special periods) within the fiscal year in which this intercompany transaction is recognized, used for period-end close and MRR/ARR reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Fiscal Period; IAS 1; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which this intercompany transaction is recognized for financial reporting purposes, aligned with the Ecommerce corporate fiscal calendar.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Fiscal Year; IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: functional_currency_amount
attributes.description: The net transaction amount converted to the functional currency of the sending entity, using the exchange rate applied at the transaction date. Required for local statutory reporting and GL posting.
attributes.references: IAS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates; SAP S/4HANA Local Currency Amount; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: The gross monetary value of the intercompany transaction before any adjustments, discounts, or withholding taxes, expressed in the transaction currency. Represents the billed amount from the sending entity.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA Amount Field; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: group_currency_amount
attributes.description: The net transaction amount converted to the Ecommerce group reporting currency (e.g., USD) for consolidated financial reporting and GMV-to-revenue reconciliation.
attributes.references: IFRS 10; IAS 21; SAP S/4HANA Group Currency Amount; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: intercompany_transaction_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the business purpose and nature of the intercompany transaction (e.g., 'Q3 shared IT infrastructure cost recharge from Ecommerce Tech Ltd to Ecommerce Retail Ltd'). Used for audit documentation and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Document Header Text; SOX Section 302; IFRS 10

attributes.name: loan_interest_rate
attributes.description: The annual interest rate (as a percentage) applied to intercompany loan transactions. Must comply with arm's-length pricing requirements per OECD guidelines. Null for non-loan transaction types.
attributes.references: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; IAS 39/IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; SAP S/4HANA Loan Management; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: loan_maturity_date
attributes.description: The contractual maturity date by which an intercompany loan must be repaid. Applicable only to loan transaction types. Null for non-loan transactions.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; SAP S/4HANA Loan Management; OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines

attributes.name: matched_transaction_number
attributes.description: The transaction_number of the corresponding intercompany transaction recorded by the receiving entity. Used to confirm bilateral matching in the SAP ICR reconciliation process.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Intercompany Reconciliation (ICR); SOX Section 404; IFRS 10

attributes.name: matching_status
attributes.description: Status of the intercompany reconciliation matching process between the sending and receiving entity records. Unmatched transactions require investigation before period-end close.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Intercompany Reconciliation (ICR); SOX Section 302/404; IFRS 10

attributes.name: materiality_threshold_breached
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transaction amount exceeds the defined materiality threshold for intercompany reconciliation and SOX reporting purposes. Transactions breaching the threshold require additional approval and documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; PCAOB AS 2101; SAP S/4HANA Intercompany Reconciliation

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: The net monetary value of the intercompany transaction after deducting adjustments and taxes from the gross amount. This is the amount recognized in the consolidated financial statements before elimination.
attributes.references: IFRS 10; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA Net Amount; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional operational notes or comments added by finance team members regarding disputes, adjustments, or special circumstances related to this intercompany transaction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Item Text; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the intercompany transaction was posted to the General Ledger. May differ from transaction_date due to period-end cut-off adjustments or late postings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Posting Date; IAS 10 Events After Reporting Period; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this intercompany transaction is a reversal (correcting) entry for a previously posted transaction. True if this is a reversal; False for original postings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Reversal Document; SOX Section 302/404; IAS 8 Accounting Policies

attributes.name: reversed_transaction_number
attributes.description: The transaction_number of the original intercompany transaction that this entry reverses. Populated only when reversal_indicator is True, enabling audit trail traceability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Reversal Document; SOX Section 302/404; IAS 8

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this intercompany transaction record originated: SAP_S4HANA (primary ERP), ERP (generic ERP), MANUAL (manually entered), CONSOLIDATION_TOOL (group consolidation platform).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Integration; ISO 27001; SOX Section 404 IT General Controls

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this intercompany transaction is subject to a Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) key internal control review. True for transactions above the materiality threshold or flagged for SOX audit scope.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; PCAOB Auditing Standards; SAP S/4HANA Audit Management

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The tax component (VAT, GST, withholding tax, or other applicable taxes) applied to the intercompany transaction. May be zero for intra-group transactions exempt from indirect tax.
attributes.references: IFRS 10; OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; EU VAT Directive; SAP S/4HANA Tax Amount

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The principal business event date on which the intercompany transaction was initiated or the service/goods were delivered between entities. Used as the primary date for period-end close and revenue recognition.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; SAP S/4HANA Posting Date; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the intercompany transaction, used in reconciliation reports, audit trails, and intercompany billing correspondence. Format: ICT-{YYYY}-{8-digit sequence}.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Intercompany Document Number; SOX Section 302/404; IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the intercompany transaction: draft (initiated, not yet posted), posted (recorded in GL), matched (confirmed by counterparty entity), disputed (discrepancy raised), eliminated (removed in consolidation), reversed (correcting entry applied).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Document Status; IFRS 10 Consolidation Eliminations; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the intercompany transaction by its business nature: billing (services/goods invoiced between entities), cost_allocation (shared cost recharge), loan (intercompany financing), transfer_pricing (cross-border goods/services at arm's-length price), dividend (profit distribution), royalty (IP licensing charge). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: billing|cost_allocation|loan|transfer_pricing|dividend|royalty|management_fee|reimbursement — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IFRS 10; OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA Intercompany Transaction Types; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: transfer_price_method
attributes.description: The OECD-approved transfer pricing methodology used to establish the arm's-length price for this intercompany transaction: CUP (Comparable Uncontrolled Price), RPM (Resale Price Method), CPM (Cost Plus Method), TNMM (Transactional Net Margin Method), PSM (Profit Split Method), or not_applicable for non-transfer-pricing transactions.
attributes.references: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines 2022; IFRS 10; SAP S/4HANA Transfer Pricing; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this intercompany transaction record was most recently modified. Tracks changes for audit trail purposes and Silver Layer incremental processing.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; ISO 27001; SAP S/4HANA Changed On

products.name: fixed_asset
products.description: Master data for all capitalized fixed assets including warehouse equipment, fulfillment center infrastructure, technology hardware, and leased assets. Tracks asset class, acquisition cost, accumulated depreciation, net book value, useful life, depreciation method, and asset location. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA FI-AA module for asset lifecycle management.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each fixed asset record in the enterprise asset register. Primary key for the fixed_asset data product.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.cost_center

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or supplier from whom the asset was purchased. Links to the vendor master in SAP S/4HANA for AP reconciliation, warranty management, and supplier performance tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Vendor Master; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation
attributes.description: Total depreciation expense charged against the asset from the acquisition date to the current reporting period. Represents the cumulative reduction in the asset's carrying value. Used to calculate net book value. Sourced from SAP FI-AA depreciation postings.
attributes.references: IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment; US GAAP ASC 360; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Original capitalized cost of the fixed asset at the time of acquisition, including purchase price, import duties, installation costs, and any directly attributable costs to bring the asset to its intended use. Recorded in the functional currency. Corresponds to SAP FI-AA acquisition value.
attributes.references: IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment; US GAAP ASC 360; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fixed asset was acquired, purchased, or placed in service. This is the date used to commence depreciation calculations and establish the asset's capitalization date in the general ledger. Corresponds to the SAP FI-AA asset value date.
attributes.references: IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment; US GAAP ASC 360; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: asset_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the asset type for balance sheet presentation and accounting treatment. Tangible assets include physical equipment; intangible assets include software licenses; right-of-use assets arise from IFRS 16/ASC 842 lease accounting.
attributes.references: IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment; IFRS 16 Leases; US GAAP ASC 360; ASC 842

attributes.name: asset_class_code
attributes.description: SAP FI-AA asset class code that categorizes the asset for depreciation rules, GL account determination, and financial reporting (e.g., '3000' for machinery, '4000' for IT equipment, '5000' for vehicles). Drives automatic posting to the correct balance sheet accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Asset Class Configuration; IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: asset_class_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the asset class corresponding to the asset_class_code (e.g., 'Machinery and Equipment', 'IT Hardware', 'Leasehold Improvements', 'Vehicles'). Used in financial statements and management reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA; IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment; US GAAP ASC 360

attributes.name: asset_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the fixed asset including specifications, model details, and operational purpose. Supports asset identification during audits and insurance valuations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Asset Master; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: asset_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the physical location where the asset is installed or deployed (e.g., fulfillment center ID, warehouse code, data center identifier, office location code). Used for physical asset verification, insurance, and logistics planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Location Field; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: asset_location_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the physical location where the asset resides (e.g., 'Seattle Fulfillment Center', 'AWS Data Center - US-East-1', 'Corporate HQ - Floor 3'). Used in asset registers, insurance schedules, and physical audit reports.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: asset_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the fixed asset (e.g., 'Conveyor Belt System - FC Seattle', 'Dell PowerEdge R750 Server'). Used in financial reports, depreciation schedules, and asset registers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Asset Master; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique asset identification number assigned by the ERP system (SAP S/4HANA FI-AA). Serves as the business-facing identifier used in procurement, finance, and audit documentation. Corresponds to the SAP Asset Master Number.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Asset Master; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: asset_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fixed asset within the enterprise asset register. 'active' indicates the asset is in service and depreciating; 'under_construction' indicates capital work in progress (CWIP); 'disposed' and 'retired' indicate the asset has been removed from service; 'transferred' indicates inter-company or inter-location transfer; 'impaired' indicates a recognized impairment loss.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA; IAS 16; IAS 36 Impairment of Assets; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: asset_tag
attributes.description: Physical barcode or RFID tag label affixed to the asset for inventory tracking and physical verification during annual asset audits. Used by warehouse and fulfillment center operations teams.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; SOX Section 302/404 Internal Controls

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA business area representing the operational segment or division responsible for the asset (e.g., Fulfillment Operations, Technology Infrastructure, Marketplace Platform). Supports segment-level financial reporting and management accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Business Area; IAS 8 Operating Segments; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: capitalization_date
attributes.description: Date on which the asset was formally capitalized and transferred from capital work in progress (CWIP) to the fixed asset register. May differ from acquisition_date for assets under construction. Triggers the start of depreciation in SAP FI-AA.
attributes.references: IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment; US GAAP ASC 360; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: capitalized_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the finance team member who approved and posted the asset capitalization in SAP S/4HANA. Required for SOX audit trail and segregation of duties controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Audit Trail; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA company code representing the legal entity that owns the fixed asset. Used for inter-company asset transfers, legal entity financial reporting, and statutory compliance. Essential for multi-entity e-commerce group structures.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code; SOX Section 404; IAS 27 Consolidated Financial Statements

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the asset is physically located. Used for multi-jurisdictional tax depreciation rules, insurance coverage, and regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; IAS 16; GDPR Article 44 (for data assets); WTO Trade Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the fixed asset record was first created in the enterprise data platform (Silver Layer). Supports data lineage, audit trail, and SOX compliance requirements for financial record integrity.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; ISO 27001 Information Security Management; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this asset record (acquisition cost, net book value, depreciation amounts). Supports multi-currency reporting for international fulfillment center assets.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IAS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Accounting method used to allocate the depreciable cost of the asset over its useful life. Straight-line is most common for warehouse infrastructure; units-of-production may apply to fulfillment equipment with measurable output. Configured in SAP FI-AA depreciation key.
attributes.references: IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment; US GAAP ASC 360; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Depreciation Key

attributes.name: depreciation_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which depreciation charges begin to be calculated and posted to the general ledger. Typically aligned with the capitalization date or the first day of the following month depending on company depreciation convention configured in SAP FI-AA.
attributes.references: IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment; US GAAP ASC 360; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: disposal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fixed asset was disposed of, sold, scrapped, or retired from service. Null for assets still in service. Used to calculate gain or loss on disposal and to cease depreciation postings in SAP FI-AA.
attributes.references: IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment; US GAAP ASC 360; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: disposal_proceeds
attributes.description: Net cash proceeds received upon disposal or sale of the fixed asset. Used to calculate the gain or loss on disposal (disposal proceeds minus net book value at disposal date). Null for assets still in service or scrapped with no proceeds.
attributes.references: IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment; US GAAP ASC 360; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA General Ledger account code to which the asset's acquisition cost and depreciation are posted. Determined by the asset class configuration. Used for financial consolidation, balance sheet reporting, and SOX audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; SOX Section 302/404; IAS 16

attributes.name: impairment_loss
attributes.description: Cumulative impairment loss recognized on the asset when its recoverable amount falls below its carrying amount. Recorded in accordance with IAS 36 / ASC 360 impairment testing. Reduces the net book value and is posted to the P&L impairment charge account.
attributes.references: IAS 36 Impairment of Assets; US GAAP ASC 360; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the insurance policy covering this fixed asset against loss, damage, or theft. Used for insurance claims processing, coverage verification, and risk management reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; SOX Section 404 Internal Controls

attributes.name: insured_value
attributes.description: Declared insured value of the fixed asset for insurance coverage purposes. May differ from net book value as it typically reflects replacement cost. Used for insurance premium calculations and claims settlement.

attributes.name: last_physical_verification_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical inventory count or asset verification exercise confirming the asset's existence and condition at its recorded location. Required for SOX compliance and annual audit procedures.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; ISO 55000 Asset Management; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: lease_end_date
attributes.description: Contractual end date of the lease agreement for right-of-use assets. Null for owned assets. Used to determine the lease term for IFRS 16/ASC 842 ROU asset amortization and lease liability calculations.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Leases; US GAAP ASC 842; SAP S/4HANA RE-FX

attributes.name: lease_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this asset is a right-of-use (ROU) asset arising from a lease arrangement accounted for under IFRS 16 or ASC 842. True indicates a leased asset; False indicates an owned asset. Drives different accounting treatment and disclosure requirements.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Leases; US GAAP ASC 842; SAP S/4HANA RE-FX Lease Accounting

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the manufacturer or OEM of the fixed asset. Used for warranty management, maintenance contracts, spare parts procurement, and vendor relationship management.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer's model or part number for the fixed asset. Used for maintenance planning, spare parts ordering, and asset standardization across fulfillment centers and technology infrastructure.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: net_book_value
attributes.description: Current carrying amount of the fixed asset on the balance sheet, calculated as acquisition cost minus accumulated depreciation minus any accumulated impairment losses. Represents the asset's remaining economic value as recognized in the financial statements. Sourced from SAP FI-AA.
attributes.references: IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment; US GAAP ASC 360; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Reference to the Purchase Order (PO) number in SAP S/4HANA MM (Materials Management) used to procure the asset. Provides the procurement-to-asset audit trail required for SOX controls and AP reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchase Order; SOX Section 302/404; PCI DSS (for technology assets)

attributes.name: remaining_useful_life_months
attributes.description: Number of months remaining in the asset's useful life as of the last reporting date. Calculated as useful_life_months minus elapsed depreciation months. Used for capital planning, asset replacement forecasting, and impairment assessments.
attributes.references: IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment; IAS 36 Impairment of Assets; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: salvage_value
attributes.description: Estimated residual value of the fixed asset at the end of its useful life, representing the amount the company expects to recover upon disposal. Used in depreciation calculations as the depreciable base equals acquisition cost minus salvage value. Also referred to as residual value under IFRS.
attributes.references: IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment; US GAAP ASC 360; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer-assigned serial number for the fixed asset. Used for warranty claims, maintenance tracking, insurance documentation, and physical asset verification during audits. Particularly important for IT hardware and fulfillment equipment.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Serial Number

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the fixed asset record in the enterprise data platform. Used for change data capture (CDC), data freshness monitoring, and SOX audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; ISO 27001 Information Security Management; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: useful_life_months
attributes.description: Estimated total useful economic life of the fixed asset expressed in months. Used to calculate the periodic depreciation charge. Determined at acquisition based on asset class policy and management judgment. Stored in SAP FI-AA as the depreciation period.
attributes.references: IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment; US GAAP ASC 360; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: warranty_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the manufacturer's or vendor's warranty for the fixed asset expires. Used to trigger maintenance contract renewals, plan preventive maintenance, and manage warranty claims before expiration.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) Standards

products.name: regulatory_filing
products.description: SSOT for all mandatory financial regulatory filings, compliance submissions, and period-end close governance. Captures filing type (SOX attestation, VAT return, annual report, SEC filing, transfer pricing documentation), filing period, submission deadlines, responsible legal entity, and submission confirmations. Manages the complete financial close calendar including close task assignments, task dependencies, completion status, sign-off approvals, open items blocking close, close date actuals vs. targets, and period lock status. Supports SOX Section 404 internal controls attestation, international financial reporting obligations, and provides the governance framework ensuring all close activities complete before filings are submitted.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each regulatory filing record in the enterprise financial compliance system. Primary key for the regulatory_filing data product.

attributes.name: financial_period_close_id
attributes.description: Reference to the financial close task in the period-end close calendar that must be completed before this regulatory filing can be submitted. Enforces task dependency governance ensuring all close activities complete before filings are submitted.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Financial Close; GAAP ASC 855

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
