attributes.description: Date and time when the invoice was approved (or rejected) by the designated approver in the procurement workflow. Critical for SLA (Service Level Agreement) measurement of invoice processing cycle time and SOX audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Workflow SWI; SOX Section 302; COSO Internal Controls

attributes.name: bank_account_reference
attributes.description: Masked or tokenized reference to the supplier's bank account designated for payment of this invoice. Stored as a reference token rather than raw account number to comply with PCI DSS. Full banking details are maintained in the secure vendor master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Vendor Bank Details (LFBK); PCI DSS v4.0 Section 3; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the supplier invoice record was first created in the procurement data platform. Serves as the audit trail creation marker and is used for invoice aging calculations from receipt date. Aligns with RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category requirement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CPUDT/CPUTM; SOX Section 404; ISO 27001 - Audit Logging

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the invoice is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency AP processing and foreign exchange revaluation. Maps to SAP S/4HANA MIRO WAERS currency key.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 - Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA WAERS; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Cash discount amount available if payment is made within the early payment discount period as defined by the payment terms. Supports working capital optimization and dynamic discounting programs. Maps to SAP S/4HANA SKFBT cash discount base amount.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SKFBT; ERP Procurement Module; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: discount_due_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which payment must be made to qualify for the early payment discount specified in the payment terms. After this date, the full gross_amount is due by payment_due_date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Payment Terms ZTERM; ERP Procurement Module

attributes.name: discrepancy_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the discrepancy between the invoiced amount and the expected amount based on PO and GR. Quantifies the financial exposure of the mismatch for prioritization of resolution and escalation decisions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MIRO Tolerance Keys; SOX Section 404 - AP Controls

attributes.name: discrepancy_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the specific discrepancy identified during three-way match validation or manual review. Provides context for resolution workflow, supplier dispute management, and audit trail. Populated when three_way_match_status is FAILED or PARTIAL_MATCH.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MIRO; COSO Internal Controls Framework; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: discrepancy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the discrepancy identified during three-way match validation. PRICE_VARIANCE: invoiced unit price differs from PO price beyond tolerance; QUANTITY_VARIANCE: invoiced quantity exceeds GR quantity; MISSING_GR: no goods receipt found; DUPLICATE_INVOICE: invoice number already processed; INCORRECT_PO: PO reference invalid or mismatched; TAX_MISMATCH: tax amount inconsistency.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MIRO Tolerance Keys; COSO Internal Controls Framework; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign currency exchange rate applied to convert the invoice currency to the company's functional/local currency at the time of invoice posting. Relevant for cross-border supplier invoices. Maps to SAP S/4HANA MIRO KURSF exchange rate field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MIRO KURSF; ISO 4217; SOX Section 404 - FX Controls

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal accounting period (month) within the fiscal year in which the invoice is posted. Two-digit format (01-12). Used for monthly accruals, period-end AP aging, and financial close reporting. Maps to SAP S/4HANA MONAT posting period.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MONAT; SOX Section 404; GAAP/IFRS Period Reporting

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the invoice is posted for accounting and financial reporting purposes. Used for period-end close, budget consumption tracking, and SOX-compliant financial reporting. Maps to SAP S/4HANA GJAHR fiscal year field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA GJAHR; SOX Section 404; GAAP/IFRS Financial Reporting

attributes.name: functional_currency_amount
attributes.description: Gross invoice amount converted to the company's functional (local) currency using the exchange_rate at posting time. Used for GL posting, financial reporting, and SOX-compliant AP ledger entries in the finance domain.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MIRO DMBTR; SOX Section 404; IFRS IAS 21 - Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total invoice amount inclusive of all taxes and charges (net_amount + tax_amount). Represents the total liability to be settled with the supplier. Used for AP aging, cash flow forecasting, and payment run in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MIRO WRBTR Gross; ISO 4217; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: invoice_category
attributes.description: Business category of the goods or services being invoiced. GOODS: physical merchandise; SERVICES: professional or managed services; FREIGHT: logistics and shipping charges; UTILITIES: energy, water, telecom; CAPEX: capital expenditure items; INTERCOMPANY: invoices between related entities. Used for spend analytics and GL account determination.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Account Assignment Category; ERP Procurement Module; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date printed on the supplier's invoice document, representing the date the supplier issued the invoice. Used as the principal business event date for payment due date calculation and aging analysis. Distinct from the system receipt date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MIRO BLDAT; ISO 6422 - Layout of Trade Documents

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Externally-assigned invoice number as submitted by the supplier on the invoice document. Used as the primary business identifier for three-way match (Purchase Order/Goods Receipt/Invoice) validation and AP correspondence. Maps to MIRO BELNR field in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MIRO; ISO 6422 - Layout of Trade Documents

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the invoice within the procurement AP verification workflow. RECEIVED: invoice logged; UNDER_REVIEW: validation in progress; MATCHED: three-way match successful; DISCREPANCY: match failed; APPROVED: cleared for payment; REJECTED: invoice rejected; PAID: payment disbursed; CANCELLED: voided. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: RECEIVED|UNDER_REVIEW|MATCHED|DISCREPANCY|APPROVED|REJECTED|PAID|CANCELLED — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MIRO Workflow Status; SOX Section 404 - AP Controls

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice document type. STANDARD: regular goods/services invoice; CREDIT_NOTE: supplier-issued credit reducing liability; DEBIT_NOTE: additional charge from supplier; PRO_FORMA: preliminary invoice for customs/planning; RECURRING: periodic service invoice.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Invoice Document Types; ISO 6422

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: The invoiced amount for goods or services before tax, representing the base payable amount. Used as the primary monetary value for PO price comparison in three-way match. Part of the monetary triplet (net_amount + tax_amount = gross_amount).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MIRO WRBTR; ISO 4217 Currency Standards; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: payment_block_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the invoice has been blocked from payment processing. True when a payment block is active due to discrepancy, pending approval, compliance hold, or manual block. Maps to SAP S/4HANA payment block indicator (ZLSPR) on the AP document. Finance domain uses this flag to exclude the invoice from payment run.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MIRO ZLSPR Payment Block; SOX Section 404 - AP Controls

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which payment must be made to the supplier to comply with agreed payment terms and avoid late payment penalties. Derived from invoice date and supplier payment terms but stored explicitly for operational payment scheduling and cash flow planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Payment Terms (ZTERM); SOX Section 404 - AP Controls

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument or method designated for settling this invoice. ACH: Automated Clearing House bank transfer; WIRE: international wire transfer; CHECK: paper check; VIRTUAL_CARD: single-use virtual procurement card; DYNAMIC_DISCOUNT: early payment via supply chain finance program. Informs the payment run configuration in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Payment Method (ZLSCH); PCI DSS v4.0 - Payment Controls; ERP Procurement Module

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the agreed payment terms for this invoice (e.g., NET30, NET60, 2/10NET30 for early payment discount). Determines the payment due date and any applicable early payment discount. Maps to SAP S/4HANA ZTERM payment terms key.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA ZTERM Payment Terms; ERP Procurement Module

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was physically or electronically received by the procurement team. Used to calculate payment due dates based on payment terms and to measure invoice processing cycle time. Maps to MIRO BUDAT (posting date) in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MIRO BUDAT; FTC Consumer Protection Standards

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by the approver when the invoice is rejected. Used for supplier communication, dispute resolution, and process improvement analytics. Populated only when approval_status is REJECTED.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MIRO; FTC Consumer Protection Standards; ERP Procurement Module

attributes.name: sap_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA accounting document number (BELNR) generated upon posting of the invoice in MIRO. Serves as the cross-reference key between the procurement data product and the finance domain's AP ledger and GL entries. Null until the invoice is posted in SAP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MIRO BELNR; SOX Section 404 - AP Audit Trail

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The originating system or channel through which the invoice was received and entered into the procurement platform. SAP_MIRO: direct SAP AP verification entry; EDI: Electronic Data Interchange automated feed; SUPPLIER_PORTAL: self-service supplier submission; EMAIL: email-based invoice receipt; MANUAL: manual data entry by AP team.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MIRO; EDI X12 810 Invoice Standard; ERP Procurement Module

attributes.name: supplier_reference_number
attributes.description: Supplier's own internal reference or order number associated with this invoice, as provided by the vendor. Used for supplier reconciliation, dispute resolution, and EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) matching with supplier systems.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MIRO XBLNR External Reference; EDI X12 810 Invoice Standard

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount charged on the invoice, including VAT, GST, or applicable sales tax as specified by the supplier. Used for tax reconciliation and input tax credit recovery. Maps to SAP S/4HANA MIRO WMWST tax amount field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MIRO WMWST; GDPR Article 5; EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax classification code applied to the invoice for VAT/GST determination and input tax recovery. Maps to SAP S/4HANA MIRO MWSKZ tax code, which drives the tax calculation procedure and GL tax account assignment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MIRO MWSKZ; EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: three_way_match_status
attributes.description: Result of the three-way match validation comparing the Purchase Order (PO), Goods Receipt (GR), and supplier invoice for quantity and price alignment. PENDING: match not yet executed; MATCHED: all three documents reconcile within tolerance; PARTIAL_MATCH: some line items match; FAILED: material discrepancy detected. Core control in the procure-to-pay process per SAP MIRO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MIRO Three-Way Match; SOX Section 404; COSO Internal Controls Framework

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the supplier invoice record was last modified in the procurement data platform. Tracks the most recent status change, discrepancy update, or approval action. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AEDAT/AEZET; SOX Section 404; ISO 27001 - Audit Logging

products.name: supplier_performance
products.description: Periodic supplier performance scorecard capturing operational KPIs per supplier per evaluation period (monthly/quarterly/annual). Tracks on-time delivery rate, fill rate, defect rate (DPPM), invoice accuracy rate, lead time adherence, return rate, SLA breach count, NPS from procurement team, overall weighted performance score, and performance tier classification (gold/silver/bronze/probation). Drives supplier development programs, contract renewal decisions, and automated supplier tier reclassification. SSOT for supplier operational performance metrics; does not own financial credit risk scores (finance domain).

attributes.name: supplier_performance_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each supplier performance scorecard record. Primary key for the supplier_performance data product in the procurement domain.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 11179 - Data Element Naming and Definition

attributes.name: evaluation_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fiscal or calendar evaluation period (monthly, quarterly, or annual) for which this scorecard applies. Aligns with the financial period close cycle in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Period - Fiscal Calendar

attributes.name: primary_supplier_agent_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal procurement team member (buyer or category manager) who completed and submitted this supplier performance scorecard. Used for accountability and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Internal Controls; ISO 27001 - Access Control

attributes.name: seller_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to seller.seller_profile. Business justification: Performance monitoring: supplier performance scores are evaluated per seller to drive procurement decisions and SLA enforcement.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier (vendor) being evaluated in this performance scorecard period. Links to the master supplier/vendor record managed in SAP S/4HANA Supplier Master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Supplier Master - Vendor Account

attributes.name: avg_actual_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Average number of calendar days between purchase order placement and goods receipt for all POs evaluated during the period. Compared against contracted lead time to compute lead_time_adherence_rate and inform replenishment planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Supply Chain Planning - Lead Time Management

attributes.name: contract_renewal_recommendation
attributes.description: Procurement team's formal recommendation for the supplier's contract renewal based on this evaluation period's performance scorecard. Drives contract lifecycle management decisions in SAP S/4HANA. Classified as confidential due to commercial sensitivity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Vendor Contract Management; Ecommerce Procurement Policy; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: contracted_lead_time_days
attributes.description: The agreed-upon lead time in calendar days as specified in the supplier's active vendor contract or purchase agreement. Serves as the benchmark for lead_time_adherence_rate calculation and SLA compliance assessment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Vendor Contract Management; SLA (Service Level Agreement) Terms

attributes.name: corrective_action_count
attributes.description: Number of formal corrective action requests (CARs) issued to the supplier during the evaluation period due to quality, delivery, or compliance failures. High counts indicate systemic supplier issues requiring escalation or probation review.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 - Corrective Action Process; Ecommerce Supplier Quality Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this supplier performance scorecard record was first created in the system. Audit trail field aligned with ISO 27001 data governance requirements and SOX internal control documentation.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 - Audit Trail; SOX Section 404 - Record Keeping

attributes.name: critical_sla_breach_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Critical Service Level Agreement (SLA) Breach Count
attributes.description: Number of high-severity SLA breaches that caused material business impact (e.g., stockouts, production stoppages, customer order cancellations) during the evaluation period. Subset of sla_breach_count; used for escalation and probation decisions.
attributes.references: SLA (Service Level Agreement) Contract Terms; Ecommerce Procurement Escalation Policy

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which the KPI data for this scorecard was primarily sourced. SAP_S4HANA for ERP-driven metrics; WMS for warehouse receiving data; TMS for delivery performance; SELLER_PORTAL for supplier self-reported data; MANUAL for procurement team input.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA ERP; WMS (Warehouse Management System); TMS (Transportation Management System)

attributes.name: defect_rate_dppm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Defect Rate - Defective Parts Per Million (DPPM)
attributes.description: Number of defective units received per one million units delivered by the supplier during the evaluation period. Industry-standard quality metric (DPPM - Defective Parts Per Million) used to assess product quality compliance and drive supplier quality improvement programs.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 - Product Quality; Six Sigma DPPM Methodology; CPSC Product Safety Standards

attributes.name: development_program_enrolled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier has been enrolled in a formal supplier development program as a result of this evaluation period's performance. Typically triggered by bronze tier or probation classification.
attributes.references: Ecommerce Supplier Development Program Policy; ISO 9001:2015 - Supplier Improvement

attributes.name: dispute_count
attributes.description: Number of formal disputes raised by either Ecommerce or the supplier regarding PO terms, invoice discrepancies, or delivery claims during the evaluation period. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA dispute management module.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Dispute Management; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: documentation_compliance_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of shipments accompanied by complete and accurate documentation (packing lists, certificates of conformance, customs documents, safety data sheets) as required by contract and regulatory standards during the evaluation period.
attributes.references: CPSC Product Safety Documentation; WTO International Trade Documentation; ISO 9001:2015

attributes.name: evaluation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for the procurement evaluator to capture qualitative observations, context, or exceptions that are not reflected in the quantitative KPI scores (e.g., force majeure events, supply chain disruptions, extraordinary performance).

attributes.name: evaluation_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the performance evaluation window. Paired with evaluation_period_start_date to define the full measurement interval for all KPIs.

attributes.name: evaluation_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the performance evaluation window. Used to define the measurement boundary for all KPIs captured in this scorecard.

attributes.name: evaluation_period_type
attributes.description: Granularity of the performance evaluation cycle: monthly for operational monitoring, quarterly for strategic reviews, and annual for contract renewal decisions.

attributes.name: fill_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of ordered quantity actually fulfilled and shipped by the supplier during the evaluation period. Calculated as (units shipped / units ordered) × 100. Measures supplier's ability to meet demand without shortfalls, critical for inventory replenishment planning.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 - Order Fulfillment Performance; WMS Fill Rate Standards

attributes.name: invoice_accuracy_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of supplier invoices that matched the corresponding purchase order without discrepancies (price, quantity, or terms) during the evaluation period. Calculated as (accurate invoices / total invoices) × 100. Impacts accounts payable efficiency and procure-to-pay cycle time in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Internal Controls; SAP S/4HANA AP Invoice Matching

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this supplier performance scorecard record was most recently modified. Tracks revisions during the draft, review, and dispute resolution lifecycle stages. Required for data lineage in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 - Audit Trail; SOX Section 404 - Record Keeping; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Standards

attributes.name: lead_time_adherence_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of purchase orders where the supplier's actual lead time met or was within the contracted lead time during the evaluation period. Calculated as (orders within lead time / total orders) × 100. Critical for inventory replenishment planning and MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity) management.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 - Lead Time Management; MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity) Standards

attributes.name: moq_compliance_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of purchase orders where the supplier honored the contracted MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity) terms during the evaluation period. Non-compliance may indicate supply constraints or contract violations requiring procurement intervention.
attributes.references: MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity) Contract Terms; SAP S/4HANA Procurement Policy

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of purchase orders delivered by the supplier on or before the confirmed delivery date during the evaluation period. Calculated as (on-time deliveries / total deliveries) × 100. Key operational KPI for SLA compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 - Delivery Performance; SLA (Service Level Agreement) Standards

attributes.name: open_corrective_action_count
attributes.description: Number of corrective action requests (CARs) issued to the supplier that remain unresolved as of the scorecard evaluation date. Unresolved CARs beyond SLA timelines may trigger escalation to probation tier.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 - Corrective Action Closure; Ecommerce Supplier Escalation Policy

attributes.name: overall_performance_score
attributes.description: Composite weighted performance score (0–100) aggregating all KPI dimensions (on-time delivery, fill rate, defect rate, invoice accuracy, lead time adherence, return rate, SLA compliance, NPS) per the procurement scoring model. Primary driver for performance tier classification and contract renewal decisions.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 - Supplier Scorecard Methodology; Ecommerce Procurement Scoring Model

attributes.name: performance_tier
attributes.description: Classified performance tier assigned to the supplier based on the weighted overall performance score for the evaluation period. Gold = top-tier preferred supplier; Silver = satisfactory; Bronze = needs improvement; Probation = at risk of contract termination. Drives supplier development programs and contract renewal decisions.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 - Supplier Classification; Ecommerce Procurement Policy

attributes.name: previous_performance_tier
attributes.description: The supplier's performance tier from the immediately preceding evaluation period. Used to detect tier reclassification events and trigger automated supplier development workflows.
attributes.references: Ecommerce Procurement Policy - Supplier Tier Reclassification

attributes.name: procurement_cost_variance_pct
attributes.description: Percentage variance between the contracted unit price and the actual invoiced price across all POs in the evaluation period. Positive value indicates supplier overcharged vs. contract; negative indicates undercharge. Flags pricing compliance issues for AP reconciliation in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Procurement Controls; SAP S/4HANA AP Price Variance

attributes.name: procurement_nps_score
attributes.description: Net Promoter Score (NPS) provided by the internal procurement team rating the supplier's responsiveness, communication quality, and overall partnership experience during the evaluation period. Scale: -100 to +100. Captures qualitative relationship health not reflected in operational KPIs.
attributes.references: NPS (Net Promoter Score) Methodology - Bain & Company; Ecommerce Procurement Relationship Management

attributes.name: return_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of received units returned to the supplier due to defects, non-conformance, or incorrect shipments during the evaluation period. Calculated as (units returned / units received) × 100. Feeds into RMA (Return Merchandise Authorization) processing and supplier quality programs.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 - Non-Conformance Management; RMA (Return Merchandise Authorization) Process

attributes.name: scorecard_published_date
attributes.description: The date on which the finalized supplier performance scorecard was formally published and shared with the supplier. Marks the start of the supplier's response and dispute window.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 - Supplier Communication; Ecommerce Procurement Policy

attributes.name: scorecard_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this supplier performance scorecard record, used in procurement communications, supplier development meetings, and audit trails. Format: SPC-YYYY-MM-SUPPID.

attributes.name: scorecard_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the supplier performance scorecard. Draft indicates data collection in progress; pending_review awaits procurement manager sign-off; approved is finalized; published is shared with supplier; disputed is under supplier challenge; closed is archived.

attributes.name: sla_breach_count
attributes.description: Total number of SLA (Service Level Agreement) violations recorded against the supplier during the evaluation period. Includes delivery, quality, and communication SLA breaches as defined in the vendor contract. Triggers penalty clauses and escalation workflows.
attributes.references: SLA (Service Level Agreement) Contract Terms; ISO 9001:2015 - Supplier Compliance

attributes.name: supplier_acknowledged_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier has formally acknowledged receipt and review of the published performance scorecard via the Seller Management Portal. Required for audit trail and dispute resolution process initiation.
attributes.references: Ecommerce Seller Management Portal - Supplier Acknowledgement; ISO 9001:2015

attributes.name: supplier_acknowledgement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the supplier formally acknowledged the performance scorecard in the Seller Management Portal. Null if supplier_acknowledged_flag is False. Used to track response timeliness.
attributes.references: Ecommerce Seller Management Portal; ISO 9001:2015 - Supplier Communication

attributes.name: sustainability_compliance_score
attributes.description: Score (0–100) reflecting the supplier's adherence to environmental, social, and governance (ESG) standards and Ecommerce's supplier code of conduct during the evaluation period. Assessed via audits, certifications, and self-reported data. Increasingly required for regulatory and investor reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 - Environmental Management; UN Global Compact; Ecommerce Supplier Code of Conduct

attributes.name: tier_reclassification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier's performance tier changed between the previous and current evaluation period. True triggers automated supplier development program enrollment or contract review workflows in the ERP.
attributes.references: Ecommerce Procurement Policy - Automated Supplier Tier Reclassification

attributes.name: total_pos_evaluated
attributes.description: Total number of purchase orders (POs) included in the performance evaluation for this period. Provides the denominator context for rate-based KPIs and ensures statistical significance of the scorecard.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Purchase Order Management; PO (Purchase Order) Standards

attributes.name: total_units_received
attributes.description: Total quantity of units received from the supplier across all purchase orders during the evaluation period. Used as the volume denominator for defect rate, return rate, and fill rate calculations. Sourced from WMS (Warehouse Management System) receiving records.
attributes.references: WMS (Warehouse Management System) - Receiving Records; ISO 9001:2015

products.name: rfq
products.description: Request for Quotation or strategic sourcing event issued to one or more suppliers for competitive bidding on goods or services. Captures RFQ/sourcing event number, event type (open tender/selective/single-source/reverse auction/annual category bid), sourcing strategy, category, submission deadline, evaluation criteria and weightings, required SKUs and quantities, target price, currency, estimated savings, timeline milestones, number of invited suppliers, award decision, event owner, and status (draft/issued/responses_received/evaluated/awarded/cancelled). SSOT for all sourcing events — covers both tactical spot-buy RFQs and strategic multi-round category sourcing initiatives (e.g., annual electronics tender, 3PL carrier bid).
products.reference: SAP Request for Quotation (EKKO RFQ type / ME41)

attributes.name: rfq_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate key identifying a Request for Quotation (RFQ) or strategic sourcing event record in the procurement domain.

attributes.name: approver_agent_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or manager who approved the RFQ for issuance to suppliers. Required for procurement governance and SOX internal controls compliance. Populated when the RFQ transitions from draft to issued status.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Release Strategy (ME28); SOX Section 302 Internal Controls; ISO 9001 Clause 8.4

attributes.name: awarded_supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier record that was selected as the winner of this RFQ. Populated upon award decision. For split awards, references the primary/lead supplier. Links to the supplier master in the procurement domain.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master (LFA1); ISO 9001 Clause 8.4.1 Supplier Selection

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center that will bear the procurement spend resulting from this RFQ. Used for budget allocation, spend tracking, and financial reporting in SAP S/4HANA CO module.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Center (CSKS); SOX Financial Reporting; GAAP Cost Allocation Standards

attributes.name: customer_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.profile. Business justification: Captures which customer.profile initiated an RFQ, essential for spend attribution and RFQ performance analysis.

attributes.name: rfq_agent_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal employee or procurement category manager responsible for managing this RFQ from initiation through award. Used for accountability tracking, workload management, and audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SRM Sourcing Event Responsible Person; ISO 9001 Clause 5.3 Organizational Roles

attributes.name: award_date
attributes.description: Date on which the sourcing event award decision was finalized and communicated to the winning supplier(s). Marks the closure of the competitive bidding phase and triggers purchase order or contract creation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA ME47 Quotation Award; ISO 9001 Clause 8.4 Supplier Selection

attributes.name: award_decision
attributes.description: Outcome of the sourcing event evaluation: single_award (one supplier selected for full volume), split_award (volume distributed across multiple suppliers), no_award (no suitable bid received), re_tender (event cancelled and reissued). Drives downstream purchase order and contract creation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA ME47 Award Decision; WTO GPA Article XIII Award of Contracts; CIPS Award Procedures

attributes.name: awarded_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the contract or purchase agreement awarded as a result of this RFQ, expressed in the RFQ currency. Used for spend commitment tracking, budget allocation, and savings realization reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Outline Agreement Value; SOX Financial Reporting; CIPS Contract Value Management

attributes.name: category_code
attributes.description: Standardized procurement category code classifying the goods or services being sourced (e.g., electronics, packaging, 3PL logistics, IT hardware). Aligns with the enterprise category taxonomy maintained in SAP S/4HANA and used for spend analytics and category management reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Group; UNSPSC (United Nations Standard Products and Services Code)

attributes.name: category_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the procurement category for the sourcing event (e.g., 'Consumer Electronics', 'Corrugated Packaging', 'Last-Mile Delivery Services'). Used in reporting dashboards and supplier communications.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Group Description; UNSPSC Category Taxonomy

attributes.name: clarification_deadline
attributes.description: Deadline by which suppliers may submit questions or requests for clarification on the RFQ requirements. Responses to clarifications are typically shared with all invited suppliers to ensure fair competition.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SRM Clarification Period; WTO GPA Article XI; FTC Fair Competition Standards

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual date on which the resulting contract or purchase agreement expires. Used for contract renewal planning and procurement calendar management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Outline Agreement Validity End; ISO 9001 Clause 8.4

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual date from which the resulting contract or purchase agreement becomes effective following the RFQ award. Used for procurement planning and contract lifecycle management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Outline Agreement Validity Start; ISO 9001 Clause 8.4

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when the RFQ record was first created in the procurement system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and procurement cycle time analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Audit Log; ISO 27001 Audit Trail Requirements; SOX Section 404 Internal Controls

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary values (target price, estimated savings, bid amounts) for this RFQ are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures consistent financial reporting and FX conversion in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA Currency Configuration; SOX Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: delivery_weight_pct
attributes.description: Percentage weight assigned to the delivery/lead time criterion in the supplier evaluation scorecard. Reflects the importance of supply chain reliability and on-time delivery performance in the award decision.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SRM Evaluation Weighting; CIPS Supplier Performance Framework; WTO GPA Article X

attributes.name: estimated_annual_spend
attributes.description: Projected total annual spend value for the goods or services covered by this RFQ, used for spend analysis, savings opportunity sizing, and procurement prioritization. Expressed in the RFQ currency. Confidential business data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Spend Analytics; CIPS Category Management; SOX Spend Controls

attributes.name: estimated_savings
attributes.description: Projected cost savings expected to be realized through this sourcing event, calculated as the difference between the current/baseline spend and the anticipated awarded price. Used for procurement KPI reporting and budget planning. Expressed in the RFQ currency.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Savings Tracking; CIPS Procurement Savings Methodology; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: evaluation_criteria
attributes.description: Structured description of the criteria used to evaluate and score supplier responses (e.g., price, quality, delivery lead time, sustainability, financial stability, compliance). Stored as a structured text or JSON-serialized string capturing criterion names and their relative weightings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SRM Evaluation Scorecard; ISO 9001 Clause 8.4.1 Supplier Evaluation; WTO GPA Article X Award Criteria

attributes.name: evaluation_deadline
attributes.description: Target date by which the procurement team must complete evaluation and scoring of all supplier responses. Used to track procurement cycle time and ensure timely award decisions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SRM Evaluation Timeline; CIPS Procurement Cycle Time KPI

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the sourcing event methodology: open_tender (unrestricted supplier participation), selective (pre-qualified suppliers only), single_source (sole supplier negotiation), reverse_auction (real-time competitive bidding), annual_category_bid (periodic category-level strategic sourcing).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SRM Sourcing Event Types; WTO Government Procurement Agreement (GPA) Article VII

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) specifying the delivery obligations, risk transfer point, and cost responsibilities between buyer and supplier for this RFQ. Standardized by the International Chamber of Commerce (ICC). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP S/4HANA MM Incoterms Configuration; WTO International Trade Regulations

attributes.name: invited_supplier_count
attributes.description: Number of suppliers formally invited to participate in this RFQ or sourcing event. Used to assess competitive intensity and compliance with procurement policy (e.g., minimum 3 quotes requirement).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SRM Supplier Invitation; WTO GPA Article IX; CIPS Competitive Tendering Policy

attributes.name: is_confidential
attributes.description: Indicates whether this RFQ is classified as confidential, restricting visibility to authorized procurement personnel only. Confidential RFQs may involve sensitive pricing strategies, new product launches, or strategic supplier negotiations.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security Management; GDPR Article 5 Data Minimization; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: is_multi_round
attributes.description: Indicates whether this sourcing event involves multiple bidding rounds (e.g., initial bid followed by best-and-final-offer round). True for complex strategic sourcing events; False for single-round tactical RFQs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SRM Multi-Round Bidding; CIPS Strategic Sourcing Methodology

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the RFQ was formally issued and made available to invited suppliers. Represents the principal business event timestamp for the sourcing event lifecycle. Used to calculate response windows and measure procurement cycle times.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA ME41 RFQ Issue Date; ISO 9001 Clause 8.4 Procurement Process

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable supplier lead time in calendar days from purchase order placement to delivery, as specified in the RFQ requirements. Used as a mandatory or scored criterion in supplier bid evaluation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchasing Info Record Lead Time; CIPS Supply Chain Lead Time Management

attributes.name: moq
attributes.description: Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) required per supplier response for this RFQ. Defines the smallest acceptable order volume that suppliers must be able to fulfill. Used in supplier bid evaluation and purchase order planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchasing Info Record MOQ; CIPS Procurement Terms

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms required for the resulting contract or purchase order (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30). Communicated to suppliers as part of the RFQ commercial requirements and used in SAP S/4HANA accounts payable configuration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Terms (T052); CIPS Commercial Terms; SOX Accounts Payable Controls

attributes.name: price_weight_pct
attributes.description: Percentage weight assigned to the price criterion in the supplier evaluation scorecard. Together with other criterion weights, must sum to 100%. Used to ensure transparent and auditable supplier selection decisions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SRM Evaluation Weighting; WTO GPA Article X; FTC Fair Competition Standards

attributes.name: quality_weight_pct
attributes.description: Percentage weight assigned to the quality criterion in the supplier evaluation scorecard. Reflects the relative importance of product/service quality versus price and other factors in the award decision.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SRM Evaluation Weighting; ISO 9001 Clause 8.4.1; WTO GPA Article X

attributes.name: realized_savings
attributes.description: Actual cost savings achieved through this sourcing event, calculated as the difference between the baseline spend and the awarded amount. Populated post-award. Used for procurement performance reporting and ROI measurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Savings Tracking; CIPS Savings Realization; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: response_count
attributes.description: Actual number of supplier quotation responses received by the submission deadline. Used to measure supplier engagement, assess market competitiveness, and determine if re-tendering is required.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA ME47 Quotation Comparison; CIPS Supplier Engagement Metrics

attributes.name: rfq_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the scope, requirements, and objectives of the sourcing event. Includes business context, technical specifications summary, and any special conditions communicated to suppliers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SRM Sourcing Event Description; ISO 9001 Clause 8.4.3 Information for External Providers

attributes.name: rfq_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for the RFQ or sourcing event, used in supplier communications, ERP references, and audit trails. Follows the format RFQ-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchasing — RFQ Object (ME41); ISO 9001 Procurement Process Standards

attributes.name: rfq_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the RFQ or sourcing event: draft (being prepared), issued (sent to suppliers), responses_received (supplier bids collected), evaluated (bids scored), awarded (supplier selected and notified), cancelled (event terminated without award).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchasing — RFQ Status Management; ISO 9001 Clause 8.4 External Provider Control

attributes.name: savings_percentage
attributes.description: Estimated savings as a percentage of the baseline spend, providing a normalized measure of sourcing event value. Used in procurement performance dashboards and category management reporting.
attributes.references: CIPS Procurement Savings KPI; SAP S/4HANA Savings Reporting

attributes.name: sourcing_strategy
attributes.description: Narrative description of the procurement strategy applied to this sourcing event, such as multi-supplier diversification, preferred supplier consolidation, total cost of ownership (TCO) optimization, or category-specific strategic sourcing approach. Free-text field capturing the strategic rationale documented by the category manager.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SRM Strategic Sourcing; CIPS (Chartered Institute of Procurement and Supply) Sourcing Strategy Framework

attributes.name: submission_deadline
attributes.description: Exact date and time by which suppliers must submit their quotation responses. After this timestamp, late submissions are rejected. Critical for procurement SLA compliance and supplier portal access control.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SRM Sourcing Event Deadline; WTO GPA Article XI Tendering Procedures

attributes.name: sustainability_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this RFQ includes mandatory sustainability, ESG (Environmental, Social, Governance), or ethical sourcing compliance requirements as part of the supplier evaluation criteria.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management; CIPS Ethical Procurement Standards; EU Electronic Commerce Directive

attributes.name: target_price
attributes.description: Internal benchmark or should-cost price per unit that the procurement team aims to achieve through the sourcing event. Used as the baseline for evaluating supplier bids and calculating estimated savings. Confidential — not disclosed to suppliers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Price Conditions; CIPS Should-Cost Modeling; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Short descriptive title of the RFQ or sourcing event as communicated to invited suppliers (e.g., 'Annual Electronics Components Tender Q1 2025', 'Last-Mile Carrier Bid — Southeast Region'). Used in supplier portal listings and internal procurement dashboards.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SRM Sourcing Event Header; CIPS Procurement Best Practices

attributes.name: total_quantity
attributes.description: Aggregate quantity of all goods or services requested across all line items in the RFQ. Used for volume-based negotiation leverage and supplier capacity planning. Unit of measure is defined at the line item level.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM RFQ Quantity; ISO 9001 Clause 8.4.3

attributes.name: total_sku_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct Stock Keeping Units (SKUs) or line items included in this RFQ. Indicates the complexity and scope of the sourcing event. Used for workload estimation and supplier capability assessment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM RFQ Line Items; CIPS Sourcing Complexity Assessment

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording the most recent modification to the RFQ record. Used for change tracking, data synchronization with downstream systems, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Change Document Log; ISO 27001 Audit Trail; SOX Section 404 Internal Controls

products.name: rfq_response
products.description: Supplier quotation submitted in response to an RFQ. Captures response date, quoted unit price, quoted lead time, MOQ, validity period, payment terms offered, delivery terms, discount structure, and response status (submitted/shortlisted/rejected/awarded). Enables multi-supplier price comparison and sourcing decision support.

attributes.name: rfq_response_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the supplier quotation response submitted in reply to an RFQ. Primary key for this entity. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — represents a discrete procurement business event with a clear lifecycle.
attributes.references: ISO 10845 Construction Procurement Standards; ERP SAP S/4HANA MM Purchasing

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Purchase Order (PO) created as a result of awarding this RFQ response. Populated when response_status is 'awarded'. Enables end-to-end procure-to-pay traceability from sourcing event to order fulfillment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA ME21N Purchase Order; ISO 10845; SOX Procure-to-Pay Controls

attributes.name: rfq_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating RFQ document to which this supplier response is submitted. Links the quotation response back to the sourcing event.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchasing — ME41/ME47 RFQ Object; ISO 10845

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) for which this quotation response is submitted. Links the procurement response to the product catalog for inventory planning and cost analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Material Master (MARA); PIM System SKU Catalog

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier (vendor) who submitted this quotation response. Enables multi-supplier price comparison and sourcing decision support. PARTY_REFERENCE category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role.

attributes.name: awarded_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this quotation response was formally awarded, resulting in a purchase order being raised. Populated only when response_status transitions to 'awarded'. Supports procurement cycle time analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA ME47 Award Date; ISO 10845; SOX Procurement Controls

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country where the quoted goods are manufactured or sourced. Required for customs compliance, import duty calculation, and trade regulation adherence.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Country Codes; WTO Rules of Origin; CPSC Product Safety Standards; FTC Made-in-USA Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this RFQ response record was first captured in the procurement system. Used for audit trail and data lineage. RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security Management; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this quotation response (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency procurement and financial settlement. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET category.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA Currency Configuration

attributes.name: delivery_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the destination warehouse or fulfillment center to which the supplier will deliver the goods under this quotation. Used for logistics planning and last-mile delivery coordination.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Plant/Storage Location; WMS Receiving Configuration

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Absolute monetary discount offered by the supplier on the total quoted amount. Complements discount_percentage for cases where suppliers offer fixed-value discounts rather than percentage-based reductions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA ME47 Discount Amount; ISO 10845

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage discount offered by the supplier on the quoted unit price. Represents the adjustment component of the monetary triplet. Used in total cost of ownership analysis and supplier negotiation.

attributes.name: evaluation_score
attributes.description: Composite numerical score assigned to this quotation response during the multi-criteria sourcing evaluation (e.g., 0-100 scale). Incorporates price, lead time, quality, and compliance factors. Supports sourcing decision support and supplier performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Supplier Evaluation (ME61); ISO 10845; WTO Procurement Principles

attributes.name: freight_cost
attributes.description: Freight and shipping cost quoted by the supplier for delivery of the goods to the specified delivery location. Used in total landed cost calculation and logistics cost analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Condition Type Freight; TMS Carrier Rate Management; ISO 10845

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) code defining the delivery obligations, risk transfer point, and cost responsibilities between buyer and supplier (e.g., FOB, CIF, DDP, EXW). Governs logistics cost allocation and risk management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; WTO International Trade Regulations; SAP S/4HANA ME47 Incoterms

attributes.name: incoterms_location
attributes.description: Named place or port associated with the Incoterms code (e.g., 'Port of Shanghai' for FOB Shanghai). Specifies the exact point of risk and cost transfer as required by ICC Incoterms 2020.
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; WTO International Trade Regulations

attributes.name: is_preferred_supplier
attributes.description: Indicates whether the responding supplier holds preferred supplier status in the procurement system at the time of this RFQ response. Influences sourcing decisions and award prioritization.

attributes.name: moq
attributes.description: Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) stipulated by the supplier as a condition of this quotation. Orders below this threshold may not be accepted or may incur additional charges. Critical for inventory planning and procurement cost optimization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Purchasing Info Record MOQ; ISO 10845

attributes.name: net_quoted_amount
attributes.description: Net total amount after applying all discounts to the total quoted amount. Represents the final payable value if this supplier is awarded the purchase order. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET net total.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA ME47 Net Value; ISO 10845; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Supplier-offered payment terms code for this quotation (e.g., NET30, NET60, 2/10NET30 for 2% discount if paid within 10 days). Drives accounts payable scheduling and cash flow planning. Maps to SAP S/4HANA payment terms configuration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Payment Terms (OBB8); ISO 10845; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: payment_terms_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the payment terms offered by the supplier (e.g., 'Net 30 days from invoice date', '2% discount if paid within 10 days, net 30'). Supplements the payment terms code for business user clarity.

attributes.name: quality_certification_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of quality or compliance certification codes applicable to the quoted product (e.g., ISO9001, CE, RoHS, FCC). Supports vendor compliance management and regulatory sourcing requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; CPSC Product Safety; FTC Consumer Protection; ISO 27001

attributes.name: quoted_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days from purchase order placement to expected delivery at the destination warehouse, as quoted by the supplier. Used for supply chain planning, inventory replenishment scheduling, and SLA compliance assessment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Purchasing Info Record Planned Delivery Time; ISO 10845

attributes.name: quoted_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the item for which the supplier has provided this quotation. May differ from the RFQ requested quantity if the supplier can only fulfill a partial quantity.

attributes.name: quoted_unit_price
attributes.description: Supplier's quoted price per unit of the item as stated in the RFQ response. Core monetary field enabling multi-supplier price comparison and sourcing decisions. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA ME47 Net Price; PCI DSS (financial data handling); ISO 10845

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description explaining why this quotation response was rejected during the sourcing evaluation. Populated when response_status is 'rejected'. Supports supplier feedback and sourcing process improvement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA ME47 Rejection Reason; ISO 10845; FTC Procurement Standards

attributes.name: response_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments provided by the supplier as part of the quotation response. May include special conditions, exclusions, assumptions, or clarifications relevant to the quoted price and terms.

attributes.name: response_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this quotation response, typically assigned by the supplier or the procurement system (e.g., QUOT-2024-00123). Used for cross-referencing with supplier documents and ERP purchase order creation. BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA ME47 Quotation Number; ISO 10845

attributes.name: response_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the supplier quotation response within the sourcing workflow. Drives procurement decision-making and supplier communication. LIFECYCLE_STATUS category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: submitted|under_review|shortlisted|rejected|awarded|withdrawn — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA ME47 Quotation Status; ISO 10845; FTC Procurement Standards

attributes.name: sample_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier can provide product samples prior to purchase order placement. Supports quality assurance processes and product evaluation before committing to full procurement.
attributes.references: CPSC Product Safety Standards; ISO 10845 Procurement

attributes.name: sample_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days required by the supplier to deliver product samples if sample_available is true. Used for quality evaluation scheduling and procurement timeline planning.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this RFQ response was sourced (e.g., SAP_S4HANA, ARIBA, COUPA). Supports data lineage tracking and multi-system procurement integration in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Data Lineage; SAP S/4HANA Integration Framework; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the supplier formally submitted this quotation response to the procurement team. Represents the principal real-world business event time. BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA ME47; ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard

attributes.name: supplier_sku_code
attributes.description: Supplier's own part number or item code for the quoted product. Used for cross-referencing internal SKUs with supplier catalog codes during purchase order creation and goods receipt matching.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Purchasing Info Record Supplier Material Number; EDI Standards

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount (VAT, GST, or applicable sales tax) included in or applicable to this quotation. Required for accurate total landed cost calculation and accounts payable processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Tax Condition; SOX Financial Controls; GDPR (financial data)

attributes.name: tiered_pricing_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier offers volume-based tiered pricing for this quotation. When true, additional pricing tiers are captured in the associated RFQ response pricing tier detail records.

attributes.name: total_quoted_amount
attributes.description: Total quoted value for the full quantity requested in the RFQ, calculated as quoted unit price multiplied by quoted quantity. Represents the gross monetary commitment if this supplier is awarded. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET category.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA ME47 Total Value; ISO 10845; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure applicable to the quoted quantity and unit price (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilogram, CS for case, PK for pack). Aligns with the UOM defined in the RFQ.
attributes.references: ISO 80000 Quantities and Units; SAP S/4HANA UOM Configuration

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this RFQ response record was last modified in the procurement system. Supports change tracking and audit compliance. RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security Management; SOX Section 404 Internal Controls

attributes.name: validity_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which the supplier's quoted prices and terms expire and are no longer binding. Procurement must raise a purchase order before this date to secure the quoted price. Critical for sourcing decision timelines.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA ME47 Validity Period End; ISO 10845

attributes.name: validity_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which the supplier's quoted prices and terms are valid. Defines the start of the binding quotation window during which a purchase order can be raised at the quoted price.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA ME47 Validity Period Start; ISO 10845

attributes.name: warranty_period_months
attributes.description: Duration in months of the product warranty offered by the supplier as part of this quotation. Relevant for total cost of ownership analysis, returns management, and vendor contract negotiations.
attributes.references: CPSC Product Safety Standards; FTC Warranty Disclosure Rules; ISO 10845

products.name: requisition
products.description: Internal purchase requisition raised by a business unit, buyer, or automated replenishment system (e.g., min/max reorder point trigger) requesting procurement of goods or services. Captures requisition number, requester, cost center, requested SKU, quantity, required-by date, estimated cost, sourcing recommendation (preferred supplier, contract reference), approval chain with delegation rules, and requisition status (draft/pending_approval/approved/converted_to_po/rejected/cancelled). Initiates the procure-to-pay workflow and provides the audit trail linking demand signal to purchase commitment.

attributes.name: requisition_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the internal purchase requisition record. Primary key for the requisition entity in the procurement domain.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Purchase Requisition (BANF/EBAN)

attributes.name: approver_agent_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee or manager currently assigned to approve this requisition based on the delegation rules and approval level. May change as the requisition progresses through multi-level approval chains.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Release Code; Internal Procurement Policy; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the organizational cost center that will bear the expenditure for this requisition. Used for budget validation, spend allocation, and financial reporting in the ERP general ledger.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Cost Center (KOSTL); SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: customer_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.profile. Business justification: Links internal requisitions to the corporate customer.profile that requested them, needed for budgeting and reporting.

attributes.name: preferred_supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the recommended or preferred supplier for fulfilling this requisition, based on existing contracts, supplier performance scores, or buyer sourcing recommendations. Null if no preference is specified.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Fixed Vendor (FLIEF); Seller Management Portal

attributes.name: price_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_list. Business justification: Requisition budgeting uses a price list to estimate spend; the link supports budget approval and spend forecasting reports.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the purchase order created from this requisition upon approval and conversion. Null until the requisition is converted to a PO. Provides the audit trail linking demand signal to purchase commitment in the procure-to-pay workflow.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Purchase Order Reference (EBELN); OMS Integration

attributes.name: requisition_agent_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee, buyer, or system user who raised the purchase requisition. Links to the internal employee or user master for approval routing and spend analytics by requester.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Requisitioner (AFNAM); GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Required for Requisition Processing report linking each requisition line to the exact SKU to track demand, lead times, and cost.

attributes.name: vendor_contract_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor contract or blanket purchase agreement that should be referenced when converting this requisition to a purchase order. Enables contract compliance tracking and negotiated pricing application.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Outline Agreement (KONNR); Internal Procurement Policy

attributes.name: warehouse_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse or fulfillment center for which the goods are being requisitioned. Used for inventory allocation, receiving planning, and WMS integration in the procure-to-pay workflow.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System - Facility Master; SAP S/4HANA Plant/Storage Location

attributes.name: approval_level
attributes.description: The approval tier required for this requisition based on spend thresholds and procurement policy delegation rules. Determines the approval chain routing (e.g., Level 1 = manager, Level 2 = director, Level 3 = VP, Executive = C-suite).
attributes.references: Internal Procurement Policy - Delegation of Authority; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: approval_notes
attributes.description: Free-text comments or justification provided by the approver during the approval or rejection action. Captures the rationale for approval decisions and supports audit trail requirements for SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; Internal Procurement Policy

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the requisition received final approval from the authorized approver(s), enabling conversion to a purchase order. Null if not yet approved or if rejected/cancelled.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Release Date; SOX Internal Controls; ISO 9001

attributes.name: budget_year
attributes.description: The fiscal or calendar year against which the requisition spend will be budgeted and tracked. Used for budget validation, annual spend planning, and financial period allocation in the ERP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Fiscal Year; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: Name or code of the business unit or department that originated the purchase requisition. Supports spend analytics, budget allocation, and organizational reporting across procurement categories.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Organizational Structure; Internal Procurement Policy

attributes.name: compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this requisition has been reviewed and confirmed as compliant with applicable procurement policies, vendor compliance requirements, and regulatory standards (e.g., CPSC product safety, FTC advertising standards). Set to True upon compliance review completion.
attributes.references: FTC Consumer Protection Standards; CPSC Product Safety; Internal Procurement Compliance Policy

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the purchase requisition record was first created in the system, whether by a business user, buyer, or automated replenishment trigger. Serves as the audit trail anchor for the procure-to-pay workflow.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Creation Date (BADAT); SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the estimated cost values on this requisition (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency procurement operations and financial consolidation in the ERP.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA Currency Configuration

attributes.name: delivery_address
attributes.description: Physical delivery address for the requisitioned goods, which may differ from the default warehouse address (e.g., direct-to-store, drop-ship, or project site delivery). Used for purchase order delivery instructions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Delivery Address; Internal Logistics Policy

attributes.name: erp_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA purchase requisition document number (BANFN) assigned by the ERP system upon creation. Serves as the cross-system reference key linking the data lakehouse record to the source-of-truth ERP transaction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Purchase Requisition Number (BANFN); EDI Integration Standards

attributes.name: estimated_total_cost
attributes.description: Total estimated cost for the requisition line, calculated as requested_quantity multiplied by estimated_unit_cost. Used for budget validation, approval routing by spend threshold, and procurement spend analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Total Value; SOX Financial Controls; Internal Procurement Policy

attributes.name: estimated_unit_cost
attributes.description: Estimated cost per unit of the requested item at the time of requisition creation. Used for budget validation, approval threshold checks, and spend forecasting. May be sourced from contract pricing, catalog price, or buyer estimate.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Valuation Price (PREIS); SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The General Ledger (GL) account code to which the requisition expenditure will be posted upon purchase order creation and goods receipt. Ensures correct financial classification and ERP account assignment for procure-to-pay.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module - GL Account (SAKNR); SOX Financial Controls; GAAP

attributes.name: is_automated_trigger
attributes.description: Indicates whether this requisition was automatically generated by the min/max reorder point replenishment system (True) or manually raised by a business user or buyer (False). Supports process analytics and system-vs-manual sourcing performance comparison.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System - Replenishment Rules; SAP S/4HANA MRP

attributes.name: item_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the goods or services being requested. Used when a specific SKU is not available or for service requisitions where no catalog item exists. Supports buyer interpretation and sourcing decisions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Short Text (TXZ01); ISO 9001

attributes.name: justification
attributes.description: Free-text business justification provided by the requester explaining the need for the goods or services. Required for high-value or non-catalog requisitions to support approval decisions and audit trail documentation.
attributes.references: Internal Procurement Policy - Requisition Justification Requirements; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: moq
attributes.description: The Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) required by the preferred supplier for the requested item. Used to validate that the requested_quantity meets supplier requirements and to adjust order quantities during PO conversion.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Minimum Order Quantity (MINBM); Supplier Contract Terms

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to the requisition, indicating processing urgency. Drives buyer workqueue prioritization, approval SLA targets, and expediting decisions for time-sensitive procurement needs.
attributes.references: Internal Procurement Policy - SLA Framework; ISO 9001

attributes.name: procurement_category
attributes.description: Spend category classification for the requisitioned item or service (e.g., Direct Materials, Indirect Goods, IT Equipment, Logistics Services, Marketing). Used for category management, spend analytics, and sourcing strategy alignment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Material Group (MATKL); UNSPSC Classification Standard

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or free-text explanation provided when a requisition is rejected by an approver. Used for requester feedback, process improvement analytics, and audit trail documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Rejection Reason; Internal Procurement Policy

attributes.name: reorder_point_trigger
attributes.description: The specific replenishment trigger method that initiated this requisition when is_automated_trigger is True. Values include min/max inventory rules, reorder point (ROP), MRP planning run, manual buyer action, or Kanban signal.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System - Replenishment Configuration; SAP S/4HANA MRP

attributes.name: requested_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of goods or services requested in the requisition, expressed in the unit of measure. Must meet or exceed the supplier Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) for the preferred supplier where applicable.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Quantity (MENGE); GS1 Standards

attributes.name: required_by_date
attributes.description: The date by which the requested goods or services must be delivered or available. Drives procurement urgency classification, supplier lead time validation, and delivery SLA commitments. Key input for purchase order scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Delivery Date (LFDAT); ISO 9001 Procurement Process

attributes.name: requisition_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally-known business identifier for the requisition, used in communications with approvers, buyers, and finance teams. Follows the format REQ-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Purchase Requisition Number (BANFN)

attributes.name: requisition_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the purchase requisition within the procure-to-pay workflow. Drives routing, approval actions, and downstream PO conversion eligibility.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Requisition Processing Status; ISO 9001 Procurement Process

attributes.name: requisition_type
attributes.description: Classification of the requisition by procurement category and urgency. Determines applicable approval thresholds, sourcing rules, and processing SLAs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|blanket|emergency|replenishment|service|capital — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Requisition Document Type; ISO 9001

attributes.name: sourcing_method
attributes.description: Recommended or applied sourcing approach for fulfilling this requisition. Determines whether the buyer should reference an existing contract, use a catalog price, issue an RFQ, or execute a spot buy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Source of Supply; Internal Procurement Policy; ISO 9001

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the requisition was formally submitted for approval, transitioning from draft to pending_approval status. Key lifecycle event timestamp for SLA measurement and approval cycle time analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Release Date; ISO 9001 Procurement Process

attributes.name: supplier_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Expected number of calendar days from purchase order placement to goods receipt for the preferred supplier. Used to validate the required_by_date feasibility and to calculate the latest PO creation date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Planned Delivery Time (PLIFZ); Supplier Performance Management

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for the requested quantity (e.g., EA=Each, CS=Case, KG=Kilogram, L=Litre). Aligns with GS1 and SAP UOM standards for inventory and procurement processing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|KG|LB|L|M|M2|M3|PK|BX|DZ|HR|DAY — 13 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Unit of Measure (MEINS); GS1 Standards; ISO 80000

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the purchase requisition record was most recently modified, including status changes, quantity revisions, or approval actions. Supports audit trail and change tracking requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Change Timestamp; SOX Internal Controls

products.name: supplier_price_list
