[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: new|open|in_progress|pending_customer|pending_internal|escalated|resolved|closed|cancelled — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: notification_channel
attributes.description: The channel used to notify the customer of this status change. None if no notification was sent.

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a customer notification was sent as a result of this status transition. True if notification was sent, False otherwise.

attributes.name: previous_status
attributes.description: The status the case was in immediately before this transition occurred. Captures the from-state in the case lifecycle state machine. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: new|open|in_progress|pending_customer|pending_internal|escalated|resolved|closed|cancelled — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: priority_at_transition
attributes.description: The case priority level that was in effect at the time of this status transition. Captures priority changes over the case lifecycle.

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the time spent in the previous status exceeded the SLA target, resulting in an SLA breach. True if breached, False if within SLA.
attributes.references: ITIL Service Operation - Service Level Management

attributes.name: sla_target_seconds
attributes.description: The SLA target duration in seconds that was applicable for the previous status. Used to determine if the case met or breached SLA during this status phase.
attributes.references: ITIL Service Operation - Service Level Management

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system that recorded this status transition. Examples: Salesforce Service Cloud, Zendesk, Custom CRM. Used for data lineage and multi-system integration tracking.

attributes.name: time_in_previous_status_seconds
attributes.description: Duration in seconds that the case spent in the previous status before this transition. Calculated as the difference between this transition timestamp and the prior transition timestamp. Critical for SLA compliance measurement and bottleneck identification.
attributes.references: ITIL Service Operation - Service Level Management

attributes.name: transition_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating why the status transition occurred. Enables categorization and root cause analysis of case workflow patterns. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: customer_response|agent_action|auto_escalation|sla_breach|resolution_confirmed|duplicate_case|customer_request|system_trigger|manager_override|workflow_rule — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: transition_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text explanation providing additional context for the status transition. Captures agent notes or system-generated rationale.

attributes.name: transition_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential order of this transition within the cases complete lifecycle. First transition is 1, second is 2, etc. Enables chronological ordering and lifecycle stage analysis.

attributes.name: transition_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the status transition occurred. Primary business event timestamp for this history record. Used for SLA calculation and workflow bottleneck analysis.

attributes.name: triggered_by_system
attributes.description: Name of the automated system or workflow engine that triggered this transition if not manually initiated by an agent. Examples: SLA Monitor, Auto-Escalation Engine, Workflow Automation.

products.name: entitlement
products.description: Master record defining the service entitlements and support tier benefits associated with customer accounts or order types. Captures entitlement name, customer segment eligibility (standard, prime, VIP, B2B enterprise), support tier (basic, priority, dedicated), included contact channels, maximum cases per period, response time SLA tier, dedicated agent assignment flag, and entitlement validity period. Drives case routing logic and SLA policy assignment based on customer service tier.

attributes.name: entitlement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the service entitlement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: annual_fee_amount
attributes.description: Annual subscription fee charged for this entitlement tier in base currency (USD). Null indicates no annual fee option.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether customer subscriptions to this entitlement automatically renew at the end of the billing period.

attributes.name: business_hours_coverage
attributes.description: Support availability hours under this entitlement (business hours 9-5, extended hours 7am-11pm, or 24x7).

attributes.name: cancellation_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance notice required for customer to cancel this entitlement without penalty.

attributes.name: concierge_service_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this entitlement includes white-glove concierge service for complex requests, special orders, or personalized assistance.

attributes.name: contact_channels
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of support contact channels included in this entitlement (e.g., email, phone, chat, social_media, video_call, in_person).

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user who created this entitlement record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this entitlement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: customer_segment
attributes.description: Customer segment eligible for this entitlement tier (standard consumer, prime member, VIP, B2B enterprise account, marketplace seller, or partner).

attributes.name: dedicated_agent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this entitlement includes assignment of a dedicated support agent or account manager.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this entitlement tier expires or is discontinued. Null indicates open-ended validity.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this entitlement tier becomes active and available for assignment to customer accounts.

attributes.name: entitlement_code
attributes.description: Business-readable unique code for the entitlement tier (e.g., STD_BASIC, PRIME_PRIORITY, VIP_DEDICATED, B2B_ENTERPRISE).

attributes.name: entitlement_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the service entitlement benefits, coverage scope, and included features.

attributes.name: entitlement_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the service entitlement tier (e.g., Standard Support, Prime Priority Support, VIP Dedicated Support).

attributes.name: entitlement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the entitlement tier (active and assignable, inactive, deprecated and being phased out, or pending approval).

attributes.name: escalation_path
attributes.description: Escalation path tier for unresolved cases (standard queue, expedited to management, executive escalation, or no escalation).

attributes.name: free_return_shipping_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether return shipping costs are waived for customers under this entitlement.

attributes.name: language_support
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of languages supported for customer service under this entitlement (e.g., en, es, fr, de, zh, ja).

attributes.name: max_cases_per_month
attributes.description: Maximum number of support cases the customer can open per calendar month under this entitlement. Null indicates unlimited.

attributes.name: monthly_fee_amount
attributes.description: Monthly subscription fee charged for this entitlement tier in base currency (USD). Null indicates no recurring fee.

attributes.name: pricing_tier
attributes.description: Pricing tier associated with this entitlement (free, basic paid, standard paid, premium paid, enterprise custom pricing).

attributes.name: priority_routing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether cases under this entitlement receive priority routing to senior agents or specialized teams.

attributes.name: proactive_outreach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this entitlement includes proactive outreach for service issues, order updates, or account reviews.

attributes.name: refund_processing_priority
attributes.description: Priority level for refund processing under this entitlement (standard 7-10 days, expedited 3-5 days, immediate 24 hours).

attributes.name: resolution_time_sla_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Resolution Time Service Level Agreement (SLA) Hours
attributes.description: Maximum resolution time in hours guaranteed by SLA for case closure or escalation.

attributes.name: response_time_sla_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Response Time Service Level Agreement (SLA) Hours
attributes.description: Maximum response time in hours guaranteed by SLA for initial agent response to customer inquiry.

attributes.name: return_window_days
attributes.description: Number of days after delivery during which the customer can initiate a return under this entitlement (e.g., 30, 60, 90 days).

attributes.name: rma_auto_approval_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether RMA requests under this entitlement are automatically approved without manual review.

attributes.name: self_service_access_level
attributes.description: Level of access to self-service tools, knowledge base, and automated resolution features (basic, advanced, premium, full).

attributes.name: sla_document_url
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Document Uniform Resource Locator (URL)
attributes.description: URL link to the detailed SLA document specifying response times, resolution commitments, and service guarantees.

attributes.name: support_tier
attributes.description: Service support tier level defining the quality and speed of support (basic, priority, premium, dedicated, enterprise).

attributes.name: technical_support_included_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether technical product support (setup, troubleshooting, configuration) is included in this entitlement.

attributes.name: terms_and_conditions_url
attributes.business_glossary_term: Terms and Conditions Uniform Resource Locator (URL)
attributes.description: URL link to the full terms and conditions document governing this entitlement tier.

attributes.name: trial_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days of free trial period offered for this entitlement tier. Null indicates no trial available.

attributes.name: updated_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user who last modified this entitlement record.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this entitlement record was last modified.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this entitlement configuration, incremented with each modification to track change history.

attributes.name: warranty_extension_months
attributes.description: Number of additional warranty months provided beyond standard manufacturer warranty under this entitlement. Null indicates no extension.

products.name: case_queue
products.description: Master record defining service case queues and routing configurations for the contact center operation. Captures queue name, queue type (skill-based, round-robin, priority, overflow), supported case types and priorities, assigned team reference, operating hours, capacity limits, overflow routing rules, average wait time targets, and active/inactive status. Drives real-time case distribution to agents, enables workload balancing across teams, and supports queue-level performance monitoring (average handle time, abandonment rate, queue depth). Essential for contact center workforce management and case routing automation.

attributes.name: case_queue_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the case queue configuration.

attributes.name: assigned_team_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the support team primarily responsible for this queue.

attributes.name: escalation_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the escalation policy applied when SLA thresholds are breached.

attributes.name: average_wait_time_target_minutes
attributes.description: Desired average wait time for cases in this queue, expressed in minutes.

attributes.name: capacity_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of cases that can be simultaneously assigned to the queue.

attributes.name: case_queue_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the queue purpose and behavior.

attributes.name: case_queue_name
attributes.description: Human‑readable name of the queue.

attributes.name: case_queue_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the queue.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the queue record was first created.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the queue configuration ceases to be effective (null if open‑ended).

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the queue configuration becomes effective.

attributes.name: is_priority_queue
attributes.description: Indicates whether the queue is designated for high‑priority cases.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who performed the most recent update.

attributes.name: max_wait_time_minutes
attributes.description: Hard ceiling for how long a case may wait in the queue before escalation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free‑form field for any supplemental information about the queue.

attributes.name: operating_hours_end
attributes.description: Daily end time for queue operation (HH:mm, 24‑hour clock).

attributes.name: operating_hours_start
attributes.description: Daily start time for queue operation (HH:mm, 24‑hour clock).

attributes.name: overflow_routing_rule
attributes.description: Rule applied when the queue exceeds its capacity (e.g., redirect to overflow queue).

attributes.name: queue_depth_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of cases that can be queued awaiting assignment.

attributes.name: queue_type
attributes.description: Classification of the queue routing strategy.

attributes.name: routing_algorithm
attributes.description: Algorithm used to distribute cases to agents.

attributes.name: sla_target_abandon_rate_percent
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable percentage of cases abandoned before service.

attributes.name: sla_target_average_wait_minutes
attributes.description: Service‑level agreement target for average wait time, in minutes.

attributes.name: timezone
attributes.description: IANA time‑zone identifier for the queue's operating schedule.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the queue record.

attributes.name: overflow_case_queue_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on case_queue (overflow_case_queue_id)

domains.name: marketplace
domains.description: Owns the multi-sided marketplace platform connecting buyers and sellers. Manages marketplace catalog listings, C2C and B2C transaction facilitation, GMV reporting, buy-box eligibility rules, seller-buyer dispute resolution, sponsored listing management, and FTC-compliant advertising disclosure for the marketplace ecosystem.

products.name: marketplace_listing
products.description: Core master entity representing a seller's product offering on the marketplace platform. Captures the full lifecycle of a marketplace listing including listing status (active, inactive, suspended, pending review), listing type (B2C, C2C, auction, fixed-price), buy-box eligibility status, featured listing flag, listing creation and expiry dates, listing title, description, condition (new, used, refurbished), category path, brand, ASIN/UPC/EAN identifiers, seller SKU, marketplace-assigned listing ID, fulfillment type (FBA-style, seller-fulfilled, dropship), listing visibility flags, and FTC-compliant advertising disclosure indicators. SSOT for marketplace catalog listings distinct from the product domain's master catalog.

attributes.name: marketplace_listing_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the marketplace listing.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Required for Promotion ROI Report linking each listing to the marketing campaign that promoted it; marketers expect this direct association.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.carrier. Business justification: Sellers often designate a default carrier for their listings; needed for contract compliance and rate negotiations.

attributes.name: catalog_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.catalog_item. Business justification: Required for listing‑catalog synchronization report that maps each marketplace listing to the internal catalog item for inventory and pricing alignment.

attributes.name: content_digital_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.digital_asset. Business justification: REQUIRED: Listing page needs primary product image; the primary_asset_id FK links to digital_asset for image rendering on marketplace listings.

attributes.name: delivery_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.delivery_zone. Business justification: Shipping SLA and cost calculations are based on the delivery zone assigned to each listing.

attributes.name: item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.content_item. Business justification: REQUIRED: Marketplace listing displays rich product description and SEO fields stored in content_item; FK enables content management system to supply listing copy.

attributes.name: price_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_list. Business justification: Required for Listing Price Determination Report linking each listing to the price list used for pricing calculations, essential for audit and dynamic pricing.

attributes.name: regulation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulation. Business justification: Regulatory Compliance Report requires each listing to reference the regulation it must satisfy (e.g., safety, labeling). This is standard in e‑commerce product compliance.

attributes.name: seller_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the seller who owns this marketplace listing.

attributes.name: seo_metadata_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.seo_metadata. Business justification: REQUIRED: Per‑listing SEO overrides (title, meta tags) are managed in seo_metadata; FK allows marketplace to apply SEO settings specific to each listing.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Needed for inventory and fulfillment tracking per SKU, enabling real‑time stock reconciliation between marketplace listings and internal SKU records.

attributes.name: warehouse_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.warehouse_node. Business justification: Assign fulfillment warehouse for merchant‑fulfilled (FBM) listings; used in fulfillment planning and inventory allocation reports.

attributes.name: advertised
attributes.description: True when the listing includes FTC‑compliant advertising disclosures.

attributes.name: buy_box_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the listing qualifies for the marketplace buy‑box algorithm.

attributes.name: category_path
attributes.description: Hierarchical category taxonomy path for the product (e.g., Electronics > Mobile Phones > Smartphones).

attributes.name: commission_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of the sale price retained by the marketplace as commission.

attributes.name: condition
attributes.description: Physical state of the item being sold.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date‑time when the listing record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three‑letter ISO 4217 code of the listing price currency.

attributes.name: end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date‑time when the listing expires or is deactivated.

attributes.name: featured
attributes.description: True if the seller has paid for promotional placement of the listing.

attributes.name: ftc_ad_disclosure
attributes.description: True when the listing includes required FTC advertising disclosure statements.

attributes.name: fulfillment_type
attributes.description: Method by which the product is delivered to the buyer.

attributes.name: height_cm
attributes.description: Physical height of the product for dimensional shipping.

attributes.name: inventory_quantity
attributes.description: Number of units the seller has allocated to this marketplace listing.

attributes.name: is_searchable
attributes.description: True if the listing is included in search and recommendation results.

attributes.name: is_visible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the listing is visible to shoppers on the marketplace.

attributes.name: length_cm
attributes.description: Physical length of the product for dimensional shipping.

attributes.name: listing_source
attributes.description: Origin of the listing record (e.g., seller uploaded, system generated, bulk import).

attributes.name: listing_type
attributes.description: Business model of the listing (B2C, C2C, auction, or fixed‑price).

attributes.name: marketplace_listing_description
attributes.description: Full textual description of the product, including features and specifications.

attributes.name: marketplace_listing_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the listing.

attributes.name: price
attributes.description: Base monetary amount the buyer pays before taxes, fees, or discounts.

attributes.name: rating_average
attributes.description: Mean rating score from buyer reviews (scale 1‑5).

attributes.name: review_count
attributes.description: Total number of customer reviews submitted for the listing.

attributes.name: shipping_weight_kg
attributes.description: Weight of the product used for shipping calculations.

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date‑time when the listing becomes active for purchase.

attributes.name: stock_status
attributes.description: Current availability state of the inventory for this listing.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The headline or title of the product offering displayed to buyers.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date‑time of the most recent modification to the listing record.

attributes.name: width_cm
attributes.description: Physical width of the product for dimensional shipping.

products.name: listing_offer
products.description: Represents a specific seller's price offer on a marketplace listing at a point in time. A single listing may have multiple competing offers from different sellers. Captures offer price, shipping cost, condition, seller fulfillment method, offer rank, buy-box winner flag, offer start and end dates, quantity available, handling time SLA, and offer suppression reason. Drives buy-box eligibility determination and competitive pricing intelligence on the marketplace.

attributes.name: listing_offer_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the seller's offer on a marketplace listing.
attributes.references: Primary Key for the offer record

attributes.name: catalog_item_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the product (SKU) that the offer is for.

attributes.name: listing_category_id
attributes.description: FK to marketplace.listing_category

attributes.name: marketing_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Offers often belong to marketing campaigns (discounts, bundles); linking enables Offer‑Campaign performance dashboards.

attributes.name: marketplace_listing_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the marketplace listing to which this offer belongs.

attributes.name: price_list_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_list_item. Business justification: Needed for Offer Price Audit to trace each offer back to the specific price list item that generated its price, supporting compliance and price change traceability.

attributes.name: seller_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the seller who submitted the offer.
attributes.references: Reference to the seller providing the offer

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Enables offer pricing and stock allocation per SKU, essential for dynamic pricing engine.

attributes.name: stock_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_position. Business justification: Offer availability must reflect allocated stock; linking offer to stock position enables quantity validation and replenishment triggers.

attributes.name: buy_box_winner_flag
attributes.description: True if the offer is the current buy‑box winner for the listing.
attributes.references: Flag indicating if this offer currently holds the buy‑box

attributes.name: buyer_feedback_score
attributes.description: Aggregated rating given by buyers who purchased this specific offer.
attributes.references: Average buyer feedback score for this offer

attributes.name: commission_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of the offer price retained by the marketplace as commission.
attributes.references: Commission percentage taken by the marketplace

attributes.name: compliance_flag
attributes.description: True if the offer meets required FTC advertising disclosures.
attributes.references: Indicates compliance with FTC advertising disclosure

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Additional information regarding compliance status or special handling.
attributes.references: Free‑form notes about compliance or policy exceptions

attributes.name: condition
attributes.description: State of the product as described by the seller.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the offer record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Currency in which the offer_price and related monetary fields are expressed.

attributes.name: fulfillment_method
attributes.description: Logistics approach used to deliver the item to the buyer.
attributes.references: Method by which the seller fulfills the order

attributes.name: gift_wrap_price
attributes.description: Additional charge for gift‑wrap when selected by the buyer.

attributes.name: handling_time_sla_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days the seller commits to process the order before shipment.
attributes.references: Service level agreement for handling time, in days

attributes.name: is_gift_wrap_available
attributes.description: True if the seller offers gift‑wrap service for this offer.

attributes.name: is_prime_eligible
attributes.description: True if the offer qualifies for accelerated shipping benefits.

attributes.name: target_audience

domains.name: search
domains.description: Manages product search indexing, query processing, personalization algorithms, recommendation engines, and search relevance optimization. Owns search configuration, A/B testing of search results, and behavioral signals for ranking.

products.name: index
products.description: Master record defining the search index configuration for a product catalog or content corpus. Captures index name, index type (product, content, seller), schema version, language locale, tokenization strategy, stemming configuration, stop-word lists, and index build status. Serves as the authoritative registry of all active and archived search indexes powering the e-commerce platform.

attributes.name: index_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate key for each search index configuration.

attributes.name: price_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_list. Business justification: Required for price‑aware search ranking; each index uses a specific price list to display correct regional prices and generate the Price‑List Performance report.

attributes.name: relevance_config_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to search.relevance_config. Business justification: An index uses a single relevance configuration; moving relevance settings to relevance_config eliminates duplication and creates a clear parent‑child relationship.

attributes.name: analyzer
attributes.description: Name of the text analyzer used (standard or custom).

attributes.name: build_status
attributes.description: Current status of the most recent index build operation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date‑time when the index record was created.

attributes.name: document_count
attributes.description: Total number of documents currently indexed.

attributes.name: index_code
attributes.description: System‑generated unique code for the index, often used in API calls.

attributes.name: index_description
attributes.description: Free‑form description of the index purpose and scope.

attributes.name: index_name
attributes.description: Human‑readable name of the index used in UI and reporting.

attributes.name: index_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the index.

attributes.name: index_type
attributes.description: Category of assets the index serves (e.g., product catalog, content pages, seller profiles, or category taxonomy).

attributes.name: is_default
attributes.description: Indicates whether this index is the default for its type.

attributes.name: is_public
attributes.description: Indicates whether the index is exposed to public search APIs.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: ISO 639‑1 two‑letter language code for the indexed content.

attributes.name: last_build_timestamp
attributes.description: Date‑time when the index was last successfully built.

attributes.name: locale
attributes.description: Locale identifier combining language and region (e.g., en_US).

attributes.name: max_result_window
attributes.description: Maximum number of search results that can be returned in a single query.

attributes.name: refresh_interval_minutes
attributes.description: Scheduled interval in minutes for incremental index refreshes.

attributes.name: retention_policy_days
attributes.description: Number of days indexed documents are retained before expiration.

attributes.name: schema_version
attributes.description: Version of the index schema definition (e.g., v1.0, v2.3).

attributes.name: size_mb
attributes.description: Physical storage size of the index in megabytes.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the upstream system that supplied the data for this index.

attributes.name: stemming_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether stemming is applied during indexing.

attributes.name: stop_word_list
attributes.description: Reference name of the stop‑word list applied to the index.

attributes.name: tokenization_strategy
attributes.description: Algorithm used to split text into searchable tokens.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date‑time of the most recent modification to the index record.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or service that created the index record.

attributes.name: superseded_index_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on index (superseded_index_id)

products.name: indexed_document
products.description: Represents a single indexed document (SKU, catalog item, seller listing, or content page) within a search index. Captures document ID, source entity type and reference, indexed field payload (title, description, attributes, price, availability), boost score, index timestamp, and document status (active, suppressed, pending). This is the operational record of what is actually searchable on the platform at any point in time.

attributes.name: indexed_document_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate key for each searchable document in the index.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.carrier. Business justification: Enables search UI carrier filter, allowing customers to select products shipped by preferred carriers; required for shipping option display and delivery time estimation.

attributes.name: catalog_item_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the originating entity (product, seller listing, or content page).

attributes.name: content_digital_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.digital_asset. Business justification: MEDIA SEARCH: Linking assets to indexed_document enables asset‑level rights tracking and performance metrics for image/video search results.

attributes.name: delivery_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.delivery_zone. Business justification: Supports zone‑based search filtering to show products deliverable to a customer’s region and calculate zone‑specific shipping costs and SLA.

attributes.name: index_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to search.index. Business justification: Each indexed document belongs to a specific search index; adding index_id creates the required parent‑child link.

attributes.name: marketplace_promotion_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the promotion campaign applied to the document.

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_obligation. Business justification: Regulatory tagging: each indexed product must be linked to its compliance obligation for audit and display compliance status.

attributes.name: price_list_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_list_item. Business justification: Ensures each indexed document references its price list item for accurate price display and supports the Search‑Price Synchronization audit.

attributes.name: seller_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the seller who owns the listing.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: SKU‑LEVEL SEARCH: SKU-specific documents need a direct FK to sku.sku_id to support locale/variant indexing and inventory visibility in search results.

attributes.name: stock_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_position. Business justification: Needed for real‑time availability in search index; indexing pulls stock_position to populate inventory_quantity for each SKU.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: Required for Supplier Catalog Search and compliance reports that filter indexed products by supplying vendor, a core e‑commerce operation.

attributes.name: warehouse_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.warehouse_node. Business justification: Search index may be scoped per warehouse for location‑specific availability; linking provides node metadata for indexing.

attributes.name: asin
attributes.description: 10‑character identifier used on Amazon‑style marketplaces.

attributes.name: availability_status
attributes.description: Current stock availability of the item.

attributes.name: boost_score
attributes.description: Manual boost factor applied to influence ranking.

attributes.name: brand
attributes.description: Brand associated with the product or listing.

attributes.name: category_path
attributes.description: Full hierarchical path of categories (e.g., Electronics>Computers>Laptops).

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: Color variant of the product.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date‑time when the document record was first created.

attributes.name: dimension_height_cm
attributes.description: Physical height of the product in centimeters.

attributes.name: dimension_length_cm
attributes.description: Physical length of the product in centimeters.

attributes.name: dimension_width_cm
attributes.description: Physical width of the product in centimeters.

attributes.name: discount_percent
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to the list price.

attributes.name: discount_price
attributes.description: Promotional price after discount, if applicable.

attributes.name: ean
attributes.description: 13‑digit international product identifier.

attributes.name: image_url
attributes.description: URL to the primary product image used in search results.

attributes.name: index_timestamp
attributes.description: Date‑time when the document was indexed.

attributes.name: indexed_document_description
attributes.description: Full textual description used for relevance scoring.

attributes.name: indexed_document_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the indexed document.

attributes.name: is_promoted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document is part of a paid promotion.

attributes.name: keywords
attributes.description: Comma‑separated list of keywords extracted for indexing.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: Two‑letter ISO language code of the document content.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date‑time of the most recent update to the indexed document.

attributes.name: locale
attributes.description: Two‑letter ISO country code representing the locale.

attributes.name: material
attributes.description: Primary material composition of the product.

attributes.name: personalization_score
attributes.description: Score reflecting personalization signals for the user segment.

attributes.name: price_amount
attributes.description: Standard list price of the item in the catalog.

attributes.name: price_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three‑letter currency code for the price.

attributes.name: rating_average
attributes.description: Mean star rating from customer reviews.

attributes.name: relevance_score
attributes.description: Algorithmic relevance score computed at indexing time.

attributes.name: review_count
attributes.description: Total count of customer reviews for the item.

attributes.name: seller_name
attributes.description: Display name of the seller.

attributes.name: shipping_weight_kg
attributes.description: Weight of the item used for shipping calculations.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Size or dimension variant (e.g., Small, Medium, Large).

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Internal stock keeping unit used for inventory management.

attributes.name: source_entity_type
attributes.description: Type of source entity that the indexed document represents (e.g., SKU, seller listing, content page).

attributes.name: thumbnail_url
attributes.description: URL to a small thumbnail version of the product image.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Primary title displayed in search results.

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: 12‑digit global product identifier.

attributes.name: previous_version_indexed_document_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on indexed_document (previous_version_indexed_document_id)

products.name: query_log
products.description: Immutable transactional record capturing every search query submitted by a user or automated agent on the platform. Stores raw query string, normalized query, session ID, customer reference, device type, platform channel, timestamp, result count returned, zero-result flag, applied filters, sort order, and query latency in milliseconds. Primary behavioral signal source for relevance tuning and personalization.

attributes.name: query_log_id
attributes.description: Globally unique identifier for each query log record.

attributes.name: ab_test_variant_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the A/B test variant applied to the search experience for this query.

attributes.name: customer_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the customer who issued the query.

attributes.name: index_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to search.index. Business justification: Each query_log record is generated against a specific search index; adding index_id enables direct join to index without indirect lookup.

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_obligation. Business justification: Search audit: queries that may retrieve regulated items need to be associated with the relevant compliance obligation for reporting.

attributes.name: price_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_list. Business justification: Captures the active price list at query time for pricing‑impact analytics, required for the Pricing Effectiveness Dashboard.

attributes.name: applied_filters
attributes.description: JSON-encoded string of filter criteria applied to the search (e.g., price range, brand).

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Category of device used to submit the query.

attributes.name: event_source_reference
attributes.description: Identifier of the search service instance or node that processed the query.

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact time when the search query was issued by the user or agent.

attributes.name: event_type_or_channel
attributes.description: Category of the search interaction, e.g., standard search, autocomplete, or suggestion request.

attributes.name: geo_city
attributes.description: City component of the client location.

attributes.name: geo_country_code
attributes.description: Three‑letter ISO country code derived from the client IP.

attributes.name: geo_region
attributes.description: State, province, or region component of the client location.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the client device that issued the query.

attributes.name: normalized_query
attributes.description: Standardized version of the query after tokenization, stemming, and case folding.

attributes.name: platform_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the search request was made.

attributes.name: query_language
attributes.description: ISO language code of the query text (e.g., en, es, fr).

attributes.name: query_latency_ms
attributes.description: Time in milliseconds from query submission to result delivery.

attributes.name: raw_query
attributes.description: Exact text entered by the user before any normalization or preprocessing.

attributes.name: result_count
attributes.description: Number of search results returned for the query.

attributes.name: search_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the search algorithm or configuration used for this query.

attributes.name: session_code
attributes.description: Identifier linking the query to a user session for behavioral analysis.

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Sorting option selected for the query results.

attributes.name: user_agent
attributes.description: Browser or application user-agent header identifying client software.

attributes.name: zero_result_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the query returned zero results (true) or at least one result (false).

attributes.name: refined_from_query_log_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on query_log (refined_from_query_log_id)

products.name: result
products.description: Transactional record capturing the ranked result set returned for a specific search query execution. Stores query log reference, result position, document reference, relevance score, ranking algorithm version, personalization flag, sponsored flag, and whether the result was clicked. Enables offline relevance evaluation, A/B test measurement, and ranking model training.

attributes.name: result_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the search result record.

attributes.name: customer_profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer who performed the search.

attributes.name: indexed_document_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the product or content document displayed as the result.

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_obligation. Business justification: Result filtering: each search result must reference the compliance obligation of the document to enforce compliance rules at display time.

attributes.name: query_log_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the search query that produced this result set.

attributes.name: click_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the user clicked the result (null if not clicked).

attributes.name: clicked_flag
attributes.description: True if the user clicked on the result; otherwise false.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Type of device used for the search (e.g., desktop, mobile, tablet).

attributes.name: event_source
attributes.description: Identifier of the search engine instance or service that produced the result.

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the search result was generated.

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Type of event, e.g., search_result or search_suggestion.

attributes.name: location_country
attributes.description: Three‑letter ISO country code representing the user's location at query time.

attributes.name: personalization_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the result was personalized for the user (true) or generic (false).

attributes.name: position
attributes.description: Ordinal position of the result within the returned result set (1‑based).

attributes.name: query_text
attributes.description: The literal text entered by the user for the search.

attributes.name: ranking_algorithm_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the ranking algorithm used to produce the score.

attributes.name: relevance_score
attributes.description: Score assigned by the ranking algorithm indicating relevance of the document to the query.

attributes.name: search_query_category
attributes.description: High‑level category or intent classification of the query (e.g., electronics, apparel).

attributes.name: session_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the user session during which the query was executed.

attributes.name: sponsored_flag
attributes.description: True if the result is a paid/sponsored placement; otherwise false.

attributes.name: user_agent
attributes.description: Browser or app user‑agent string identifying the client software.

attributes.name: previous_result_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on result (previous_result_id)

products.name: click_event
products.description: Transactional behavioral signal record capturing each click interaction a user makes on a search result or recommendation widget. Captures query log reference, clicked document reference, result position at time of click, click timestamp, session ID, customer reference, device type, and downstream conversion flag. Core input to click-through rate (CTR) computation and learning-to-rank (LTR) model training.

attributes.name: click_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the click event record.

attributes.name: customer_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the customer who performed the click.

attributes.name: experiment_id
attributes.description: A/B test or experiment identifier associated with the click.

attributes.name: indexed_document_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the product or content document that was clicked.

attributes.name: payment_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.payment_transaction. Business justification: Enables Click‑to‑Purchase Conversion Tracking, a core metric in marketing dashboards linking a click event to the resulting transaction.

attributes.name: query_log_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking to the originating search query record.

attributes.name: result_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to search.result. Business justification: A click event should be linked to the specific result set it originated from for end‑to‑end traceability. Adding result_id (FK) to click_event enables direct navigation from click to result record wit

attributes.name: click_latency_ms
attributes.description: Elapsed time in milliseconds between result display and user click.

attributes.name: click_rank_score
attributes.description: Score assigned by the ranking algorithm to the clicked item at click time.

attributes.name: click_source
attributes.description: Originating UI element or channel that generated the click.

attributes.name: click_type
attributes.description: Classification of the click source (e.g., organic search, sponsored ad, recommendation widget).

attributes.name: conversion_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the associated conversion was recorded (null if no conversion).

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three‑letter ISO country code of the user's location at click time.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Category of device used for the click.

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact time when the click event occurred.

attributes.name: experiment_variant
attributes.description: Variant of the experiment shown to the user.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the client at click time.

attributes.name: is_bot
attributes.description: True if the click is identified as generated by an automated bot.

attributes.name: is_conversion
attributes.description: True if the click later resulted in a purchase or other conversion event.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: Two‑letter language code of the user's interface.

attributes.name: page_section
attributes.description: Logical section of the page where the result was displayed.

attributes.name: page_url
attributes.description: URL of the page where the click occurred.

attributes.name: personalization_flag
attributes.description: True if the result was personalized for the user.

attributes.name: recommendation_widget_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the recommendation widget that displayed the clicked item.

attributes.name: referrer_url
attributes.description: URL of the page that referred the user to the current result.

attributes.name: result_position
attributes.description: Zero‑based position of the clicked item in the result list.

attributes.name: search_query
attributes.description: The raw text entered by the user for the search.

attributes.name: session_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the user session during which the click occurred.

attributes.name: user_agent
attributes.description: Browser or application user‑agent string reported by the client.

attributes.name: previous_click_event_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on click_event (previous_click_event_id)

products.name: relevance_config
products.description: Master configuration record defining the relevance tuning parameters applied to a search index. Captures field boost weights (title, brand, category, description), BM25 or TF-IDF parameter settings, freshness decay function, popularity boost coefficients, personalization weight, and active version flag. Owned by the search team and versioned to support rollback and A/B comparison of relevance configurations.

attributes.name: relevance_config_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate key for each relevance configuration record.

attributes.name: content_ab_test_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the A/B test linked to this relevance configuration.

attributes.name: active_version_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this configuration is the currently active version for its type.

attributes.name: bm25_b
attributes.description: BM25 length normalization factor.

attributes.name: bm25_k1
attributes.description: BM25 term frequency scaling factor.

attributes.name: config_code
attributes.description: Unique business code used to reference the configuration in downstream systems.

attributes.name: config_name
attributes.description: Human‑readable name identifying the relevance configuration (e.g., "Base Search Boost").

attributes.name: config_type
attributes.description: Category of the configuration indicating its primary purpose.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date‑time when the configuration record was first created.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date on which the configuration becomes effective for live traffic.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date after which the configuration is no longer applied (null if open‑ended).

attributes.name: enable_spellcheck
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether automatic spell‑checking is performed on user queries.

attributes.name: enable_synonyms
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether synonym expansion is applied during query processing.

attributes.name: field_boost_brand
attributes.description: Relative boost applied to the brand attribute in relevance calculations.

attributes.name: field_boost_category
attributes.description: Relative boost applied to the product category field.

attributes.name: field_boost_description
attributes.description: Relative boost applied to the product description field.

attributes.name: field_boost_title
attributes.description: Relative boost applied to the product title field during relevance scoring.

attributes.name: freshness_decay_days
attributes.description: Number of days after publication when freshness decay begins.

attributes.name: freshness_decay_rate
attributes.description: Daily percentage reduction applied to relevance after the decay start.

attributes.name: is_default
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this configuration is the default fallback for its type.

attributes.name: locale
attributes.description: Locale identifier (language and region) for which the configuration applies, e.g., "en_US".

attributes.name: max_results
attributes.description: Upper limit on the number of results returned for a query.

attributes.name: min_query_length
attributes.description: Minimum number of characters required for a query to be processed.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional remarks, change‑log entries, or operational comments.

attributes.name: personalization_weight
attributes.description: Weight given to personalized signals (e.g., user behavior) in the final relevance score.

attributes.name: popularity_boost_coefficient
attributes.description: Multiplier applied based on product popularity metrics (e.g., sales velocity).

attributes.name: ranking_algorithm
attributes.description: Algorithm used to compute relevance scores.

attributes.name: relevance_config_description
attributes.description: Free‑form text describing the purpose and scope of the configuration.

attributes.name: relevance_config_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the configuration.

attributes.name: rollout_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of traffic exposed to this configuration during an experiment.

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system that performed the latest update.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date‑time of the most recent modification to the configuration.

attributes.name: use_tfidf
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether TF‑IDF scoring is enabled instead of BM25.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version identifier for change tracking.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system that created the configuration.

attributes.name: superseded_relevance_config_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on relevance_config (superseded_relevance_config_id)

products.name: ranking_model
products.description: Master record representing a trained or rule-based ranking model used to order search results. Captures model name, model type (LTR, BM25, neural, hybrid), training dataset reference, feature set version, evaluation metric (NDCG, MRR, MAP), deployment status, champion/challenger flag, and model artifact location. Enables governance of which ranking model is live in production versus in experimentation.

attributes.name: ranking_model_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate key for the ranking model record.

attributes.name: analytical_dataset_id

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `ecommerce_ecm`.`_metrics`.`analytics_ab_test_result`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "AB testing outcomes, supporting product and experience optimization decisions"
  source: "`ecommerce_ecm`.`analytics`.`ab_test_result`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "experiment_id"
      expr: experiment_id
      comment: "Experiment identifier"
    - name: "ab_test_variant_id"
      expr: ab_test_variant_id
      comment: "AB test variant identifier"
    - name: "metric_name"
      expr: metric_name
      comment: "Name of the metric being tested"
    - name: "test_type"
      expr: test_type
      comment: "Type of AB test (e.g., A/B, multivariate)"
    - name: "ab_test_result_status"
      expr: ab_test_result_status
      comment: "Current status of the AB test result"
  measures:
    - name: "total_ab_test_results"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Baseline count of AB test result records"
    - name: "average_relative_lift"
      expr: AVG(CAST(relative_lift AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average relative lift across experiments"
    - name: "average_confidence_level"
      expr: AVG(CAST(confidence_level AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average confidence level of test results"
    - name: "statistically_significant_rate"
      expr: AVG(CASE WHEN is_statistically_significant THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Proportion of tests that are statistically significant"
$$
metric_views.description: AB testing outcomes, supporting product and experience optimization decisions
